At the same time, the Stone Pillar Hongjun in other cities were also successively activated, regardless of whether the city had been besieged or not, each was now emanating a powerful pressure with the Heavenly Crane Array operating again, suppressing the invading demon clan.
The perilous situation for the Human Clan's cultivators once again stabilized during this moment.
Meanwhile, slightly farther from Yin Mountain City in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, a city called Chongjin City was undergoing another fierce battle.
Here too had suffered the demon clan's fierce assault, the city defense was on the brink of collapse.
Not far outside the city, at the bottom of a gorge, Su Wu and the Reincarnation Demon Lord were both cross-legged on a giant rock.
Both showed visible scars, their aura was unstable, clearly they were gravely injured.
Especially the Reincarnation Demon Lord, whose chest and stomach bore two bloody holes, with bones and organs exposed, a sight horrendous.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord took out a blood-red elixir and consumed it, blood light shimmered at his wounds, beginning to heal slowly.
Su Wu was enveloped in black mist, and his wounds instantly healed completely.
The wounds of the Reincarnation Demon Lord had shrunk somewhat, but his healing speed was noticeably much slower.
"This recovery is too slow, why not use the Reincarnation True Intent to heal your body?" Su Wu looked at the Reincarnation Demon Lord, couldn't help but ask.
"The Reincarnation True Intent transmitted from the main body is already exhausted; otherwise, how could Ice Lan Old Ghost escape." the Reincarnation Demon Lord said through gritted teeth, his tone revealing deep unwillingness.
Su Wu did not pay much attention to what he heard, he merely said flatly: "Ancestor Bing Lan's foundations are deeper than we expected, our preparations were not sufficiently thorough."
Yet in his heart, there was a bigger knot.
The failure in the contest for the World Tree with someone still lingered as a shadow he couldn't shake off.
At this moment, both suddenly sensed something, soared into the sky, looking toward the direction of Chongjin City.
Chongjin City suddenly radiated with a burst of light, a light pillar shot straight to the sky, the Heavenly Crane Array unexpectedly operated again.
This scene made both reveal expressions of surprise.
"How is this possible?" Su Wu frowned tightly, his eyes full of confusion.
He gazed toward Chongjin City, where a dazzling light pillar shot to the sky, as if it wanted to tear the sky apart.
The Stone Pillar Hongjun in White Emperor City had clearly been destroyed, how could the Heavenly Crane Array possibly operate again?
"It seems someone has repaired the Hongjun Pillar." said the Reincarnation Demon Lord indifferently beside him, his tone seemingly not too surprised, as if all this was within his expectations.
"To repair the Stone Pillar Hongjun in such a short time, your Chuyun Realm truly hides talents..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1010 - 975: The Best Moment for the Situation
chapters.content:
Su Wu quickly suppressed the shock in his heart and said solemnly, "We cannot let this matter be ignored. The Heavenly Crane Array must be destroyed!"
"Are you going back to White Emperor City?" The Reincarnation Demon Lord raised an eyebrow, seemingly a bit puzzled.
"No, we just fought a fierce battle with Ancestor Bing Lan, and we've expended a lot. There must be experts stationed at White Emperor City now. Rather than risking going there, we should destroy the Stone Pillar Hongjun beneath Chongjin City. The effect is the same." Su Wu grinned, a hint of cunning flashing in his eyes.
"The Three Realms Immortal Boat has already been returned to the Demon World. Destroying a perfectly intact Stone Pillar Hongjun, how can it be easy?" The Reincarnation Demon Lord shook his head and sighed.
"My chances of success alone are slim, but if you lend your assistance, Demon Lord, it's almost guaranteed." Su Wu looked at the Reincarnation Demon Lord, eyes shimmering with a hopeful light.
"Su Wu, the Ten Thousand Demon Country was just a pawn for us to find the Three Realms Immortal Boat. Now that the boat has been found, they are of no use anymore. You're not seriously going to help them restore their nation and change the fate of being oppressed by the Human Clan, are you?" The Reincarnation Demon Lord frowned and said.
"The Ten Thousand Demon Country is naturally a pawn, but if used well, it can also be a good force. It's also a good thing to incorporate them under our command. Besides, some matters are better filled with the lives of Ten Thousand Demon Country than with your Demon Clan's lives, no?" Su Wu replied with a smile.
After a moment of consideration, the Reincarnation Demon Lord nodded in agreement: "If that's the case, I will help you once. But afterward, you need to provide at least a hundred Returning to Void Cultivators or Level 5 Demon Clan practitioners for me to test the effects of the Ten Thousand Tribulation Blood Soul Curse. This divine skill is still not perfect."
Su Wu agreed without the slightest hesitation: "No problem."
Just as the two were about to set off, a voice echoed slowly from a certain direction:
"Where are you two intending to go?"
As the voice fell, in the void before them, a wisp of wind seemed to pass gently, accompanied by a ripple. Out of nowhere, a figure slowly stepped out from it.
This person, clad in a worn long robe as if weathered by countless ages, had a slightly hunched figure. His skin was dark as iron, his eyes completely white, with no traces of pupils, precisely the legendary Xia Jie.
His appearance was silent and stealthy, neither causing a ripple of mana nor a stir of the Divine Soul.
By the time Su Wu and the Reincarnation Demon Lord realized it, Xia Jie was already standing quietly in front of them like an ancient mountain peak.
"Xia Jie!" The Reincarnation Demon Lord exclaimed, with a shock that was hard to conceal in his voice.
Su Wu, on the other hand, seemed entirely unaware of the name, but hearing such a loss of composure from the Reincarnation Demon Lord, he couldn't help but feel an inexplicable chill surge within him.
That name seemed to carry an unfathomable curse, which just by hearing, made Su Wu's courage inexplicably dissipate by three parts.
Without any hesitation, Su Wu's entire body erupted in a black light. In an instant, six thin wings of the Heavenly Cicada grew behind him. In a tremor, he transformed into a black shadow, escaping swiftly, so fast it seemed to tear through the void.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord was not to be outdone. A flash of blood light flickered around him as he donned a suit of blood-red armor. The Protective Blood Light ignited, and a dense Blood Mist shot out from the armor, enveloping him entirely.
Within the Blood Mist, his figure transformed into a Blood Shadow, rapidly flying off in another direction.
Xia Jie did not move. He only spoke calmly: "All methods of Flying Escape are forbidden here!"
His voice boomed like a grand bell, resonating continuously, precisely the speak and follow the law divine skill.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on .net
A vast and incomparable power descended from the sky, forcefully rushing towards Su Wu and the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
Su Wu's expression changed drastically. With a flip of his hand, he summoned that black longsword, cutting through the void.
"Swish"
A Black Sword Qi flashed by, splitting the incoming immense power in two.
But Xia Jie's speak and follow the law divine skill had long been perfected, far superior to Yuan Ming, Xi Ying, and others, not affected in the slightest.
The cleaved forces instead transformed into two even more formidable surges, fiercely hitting Su Wu from both sides.
Under this force, Su Wu's six wings of the cicada shattered directly. Blood flowed from his seven orifices, and he couldn't suppress a muffled groan as his body plummeted rapidly.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord also suffered the blow, his Blood Light extinguishing as he plummeted from mid-air.
The power of speak and follow raged within both their bodies, causing great destruction.
Su Wu and the Reincarnation Demon Lord, these two people infinitely close to the Mahayana Realm, now seemed like two heavily-struck stones falling from the sky.
However, both were practitioners with profound cultivation and adept in various techniques.
With a calm mindset, they swiftly resolved the anomalies within their bodies, each summoning a Spiritual Treasure to stabilize their figures.
Yet, at that moment, their bodies suddenly sank.
Nearby, in the void, a massive river appeared, the waves surging, persistent and uninterrupted.
It was a vast and pure Great Wish River, boundless like the sea.
"This is not good, Xia Jie is about to use the Great Wish of All Living Beings. This divine skill can't be resisted, quickly use the Two Realms Pearl to escape!" The Reincarnation Demon Lord suddenly turned his head and urgently shouted towards Su Wu.
Su Wu heard these words and immediately summoned a white treasure bead.
The bead spun rapidly, emitting a gentle glow, then a large swath of white light shot out, swiftly forming into a towering white light gate.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord did not choose to flee; instead, he turned and charged directly at Xia Jie, seemingly determined to win Su Wu one last chance for escape.
"The Heavenly Dao governs all things; all living beings derive from the Heavenly Dao. Who can oppose the wishes of all beings?" Xia Jie's voice echoed like a mighty bell, resonating throughout the heaven and earth.
In an instant, the river of Desire Power in mid-air seemed to ignite, burning fiercely.
Outside Chongjin City, the previously clear sky suddenly changed color, with the winds and clouds raging. An indescribable, almighty force descended from the heavens.
Everything between heaven and earth seemed to come to a halt at this moment, even the white light emitted by the Two Realms Pearl froze in the air, and the Reincarnation Demon Lord's flying form abruptly paused.
Time appeared to be bound by some mysterious force, with only Xia Jie's grand voice still resounding through the heavens and earth.
"May the demon insects and evil forces here not be tolerated by the Great Dao, and be punished by heaven and earth!"
As Xia Jie's words fell, a force resembling heavenly punishment descended from the sky, flooding over Su Wu and the Reincarnation Demon Lord like an overwhelming torrent.
Their bodies simultaneously exploded under this force. Su Wu's form transformed into dense black smoke, and the black longsword tightly gripped in his hand was shaken free. As for the Reincarnation Demon Lord, he turned into a puff of Blood Mist, dissipating into the air.
"May all evil here be utterly obliterated into nothingness!"
Xia Jie's voice rang out once more, accompanied by an even grander force of heavenly punishment descending.
The black smoke and Blood Mist had no resistance against this force and quickly dissipated completely.
Just at that moment, the entire realm suddenly shook violently without any warning.
The white light gate formed by the Two Realms Pearl suddenly burst with dazzling light, breaking free from the suppression of the Great Wish of All Living Beings.
Following that, a gigantic black demon claw extended from the light gate, bearing nine fingers, each densely covered with crimson eyes, exuding a profoundly sinister feeling.
The murderous aura emanating from this giant claw was chilling.
The demon claw grasped the remnants of Su Wu's black smoke and swiftly retreated into the white light gate.
At the same time, the Two Realms Pearl also flew into the light gate, which flickered and vanished from its original location.
The clone of the Reincarnation Demon Lord, lacking assistance, was soon completely obliterated by the heavenly punishment force, leaving no trace.
Gazing at this scene, Xia Jie murmured to himself, "Yama's Demon Claw... it seems the Yan Emperor intervened personally, and this Su Wu was just one of his spares..."
Having said that, he slowly descended, bending down to pick up the black longsword Su Wu dropped. As soon as the sword entered his hand, black Demonic Qi surged on the blade, burning like flames, attempting to break free from Xia Jie's grasp.
"A replica of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword, huh? It even contains a fragment of the Heavenly Demon Sword, it indeed has some charm." Xia Jie murmured lightly, a layer of white glow appearing in his palm, instantly enveloping the sword entirely. The flames on the black longsword immediately extinguished, suppressed by Xia Jie's power.
"This sword can be given to Yuan for training, and it will surely become a significant help to him in the future." Xia Jie mused to himself, a hint of deep meaning flashing in his eyes.
...
In the deepest part of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, a majestic black peak pierced the sky, seemingly connecting with the heavens. This peak was unique, constantly shrouded in a thin veil of black mist regardless of the sunlight outside, as if perpetually bathed in night. Whirlwinds swept through the mountains, producing sharp howls, sometimes shrill like phantom cries, sometimes low like ghostly laughter, sending shivers down the spine.
Yet, on this black peak, there were magnificent structures built, stretching endlessly, appearing as a massive giant city, its grandeur rivalling even the legendary White Emperor City. Here was the core of the Ten Thousand Demon Country - the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge.
Within the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge, a grand and splendid hall stood among them. Wu Yu, the wise sage of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, was standing in front of an earthy-yellow map scroll, depicting a detailed map of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. Mountains, rivers, volcanoes, and lakes were vividly illustrated, as if the entire mountain range were condensed onto this scroll.
The map clearly showed the location of nineteen cities and the areas controlled by the thirty-six clans of the Ten Thousand Demon Country. The places where living beings congregated were represented by densely packed light spots, many of which were slowly moving, like twinkling stars.
This scroll was an Exotic Treasure of the Ten Thousand Demon Country - the Mountain and River Map.
It could communicate with the Spirit Veins beneath the ground, perceive and display the terrain and geography of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
The powerful beings within the mountain range also appeared as light spots on the map, and during warfare, it undoubtedly served as an ultimate sharp weapon.
Inside the great hall, besides Wu Yu, were more than a dozen Level 5 Demon Clan Practitioners.
They held Communication Magical Artifacts, occasionally reporting the latest battle updates to Wu Yu.
Wu Yu swiftly issued command after command, deploying the battle forces of the Ten Thousand Demon Country to attack in all directions.
Now that the Heavenly Crane Array had been partially destroyed, and Ancestor Bing Lan had been defeated and fled, this undoubtedly presented the best situation for the Ten Thousand Demon Country in tens of thousands of years.
If they could seize those nineteen cities in one swoop, even if unable to use the Three Realms Immortal Boat to destroy the Pillar Hongjun, they could still find another way to slowly erode the Heavenly Crane Array and ultimately destroy it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1011 - 976: Token
chapters.content:
Wu Yu focused intently on the map, eyes suddenly landing on the camps of the Fire Wolf Clan and the Roc Clan.
Currently, these camps were filled with dense clusters of light, but only half of their forces had been mobilized.
"This battle concerns the millennia-long hegemony of the Ten Thousand Demon Country. I mentioned earlier that all clans should send out all their forces. Why do the Fire Wolf Clan and Roc Clan still have so much strength left unused?" Wu Yu frowned, turning to a messenger beside her, with a tone of obvious dissatisfaction and doubt.
"Reporting to Her Majesty the Empress, your order has been conveyed to all clans. However, the Flame Wolf King and Electric Roc King replied that the private soldiers they lead are tasked with guarding the women and children of their clans and are not under your command..." The messenger lowered his head and said.
As the messenger's voice gradually fell, the hall plunged into silence.
Wu Yu slightly closed her eyes, as if pondering something.
She knew well that internal strife within the Ten Thousand Demon Country was incessant, and many clans harbored resentment towards her as the Empress, due to deeply ingrained patriarchal beliefs.Latest content published on novelFɪre.net
Fortunately, if she could successfully capture the Nineteen Cities and destroy the Heavenly Crane Array, her prestige would peak, solidifying her position as the Demon Emperor completely.
At this moment, the Mountain and River Map suddenly began to hum, as if some power was resonating.
The location of White Emperor City suddenly shone with a dazzling cyan light, which swiftly spread, encompassing the other eighteen cities.
The cyan lights interconnected and eventually formed an immense Array, seemingly enveloping the entire Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
Wu Yu's eyes snapped open, her expression changing dramatically as she exclaimed, "This... the Pillar Hongjun of White Emperor City has actually been repaired? The Heavenly Crane Array is reactivated? How is this possible!"
The other demon clans in the hall also noticed the changes in the Mountain and River Map, and immediately, there was an uproar.
They looked nervously at Wu Yu, waiting for her instructions.
Quickly, messages arrived from the communication magical artifacts, stating that the city protection arrays of places like Black Tiger City, Tianshui City, and Cold Crow City suddenly activated, and their power drastically increased.
"Her Majesty the Empress, Black Tiger City's city protection array suddenly activated, with drastically increased power."
"The Green Snake Clan reports their attack is obstructed, nearing defeat."
"Tianshui City is the same, the Wood Demon Clan has already retreated."
"Cold Crow City is the same..."
Wu Yu's expression grew increasingly unsightly, she flipped her hand to take out a black jade, channeling demonic power into it.
The jade shone with a cluster of black light, yet no further reaction ensued.
Her heart sank, knowing things were grim.
After a moment of silence, Wu Yu swept her sleeve and a white round mirror emerged.
Five beams of white crystalline light shot forth, revealing the figures of five Demon Kings—Flame Wolf King, Electric Roc King, Black Bear King, Green Snake King, and Giant Tree King.
"Her Majesty the Empress, has the Heavenly Crane Array truly reactivated? We personally saw the Three Realms Immortal Boat snap the Pillar Hongjun, White Emperor City was destroyed, how could it be repaired so quickly?" Flame Wolf King asked with widened eyes.
Wu Yu had calmed down and said in a deep voice, "The Mountain and River Map has reacted, and reports from fronts confirm that the Heavenly Crane Array has indeed reactivated."
The Five Great Demon Kings' expressions darkened at these words. Giant Tree King hurriedly asked, "And what about the Three Realms Sect, what do they say?"
"I just contacted Su Wu, no response," Wu Yu shook her head and said.
"The Three Realms Sect is utterly untrustworthy, indeed cannot be believed! This might be their plot in alliance with Heavenly Saint Academy and Taixuan Sect, aiming to draw out the main forces of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, to encircle and annihilate us!" Electric Roc King suddenly spoke.
The other Demon Kings remained silent, pondering the possibility internally.
"Given the unclear situation now, do not rashly speculate. Presently, the most crucial thing is to ascertain what exactly transpired in White Emperor City." Wu Yu raised her hand and said.
"Why not just go and check White Emperor City? I'm the closest now, let me go over there," Electric Roc King impatiently proposed.
"Certainly, something has occured in White Emperor City now, going alone might not be prudent." Wu Yu however shook her head and said.
"This won't work, that won't work, are we supposed to just wait here?" Flame Wolf King impatiently said.
"Electric Roc King, I'm not stopping you from going. My clone is there too, let her accompany you, it's safer this way," Wu Yu said.
"If so, let's meet at Black Wind Ridge northwest of White Emperor City, and then go together," Electric Roc King nodded and proposed.
After saying this, her wings spread, arcs of electricity flowed as her figure vanished from the crystalline light.
...
White Emperor City, hidden beneath the earth.
Daoist Mu has stopped casting spells.
At this moment, he sits cross-legged, silent and meditative, appearing composed and at ease.
The World Tree, under the nourishment of his mana, grows ever stronger, its crown breaking through the earth, lush with branches and leaves, with roots tightly entwined with the Stone Pillar Hongjun. The Heavenly Crane Array, influenced by it, operates more smoothly and freely.
Yuan Ming had also gradually adapted to the influence of the Desire Power within the Spirit Vein, though maintaining the Tree Man form for an extended time had a significant impact on him.
"Senior, since the Heavenly Crane Array has stabilized, should you not focus on repairing the Stone Pillar Hongjun? After all, I cannot stay here indefinitely, replacing the Stone Pillar Hongjun." Yuan Ming communicated to Daoist Mu, asking.
Daoist Mu slowly opened his eyes and calmly said, "Rest easy, young friend. I have already sent someone to repair the Stone Pillar Hongjun. This matter cannot be completed overnight; it will take several decades to thoroughly repair it."
"Decades! Is Senior Mu expecting me to maintain the Tree Man form for the coming decades?" Yuan Ming's heart sank.
Although cultivating in the Tree Man form does allow for progression, merging with the Stone Pillar Hongjun requires enduring the influence of the Spirit Vein's Desire Power daily, greatly reducing cultivation efficiency.
"Do not worry, young friend. The Stone Pillar Hongjun only needs initial repair to maintain the operation of the Heavenly Crane Array. At that time, you will only need to guard this pillar. My people will arrive in a few months, so please bear with it for a few months more." Daoist Mu seemed to see through his concerns and explained.
"I understand." Yuan Ming felt somewhat relieved in his heart and agreed.
A few months were still reasonable, and he could use this time to refine the World Tree within the Shura Palace as much as possible.
"Old Niu, this time Yuan Ming helped you guard the Heavenly Crane Array and thwarted the plots of the Demon Clan and the Magic Clan. For such a great contribution, rewarding him with only the land of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range seems rather insufficient, don't you think?" Suddenly, Kong's figure flashed into appearance.
"Senior Kong, what is this..." Yuan Ming was slightly taken aback and communicated to ask.
"Do not speak, leave everything to me!" Kong immediately interrupted him, saying.
"Haha, the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is rich in spiritual energy, abundant in resources, and inhabited by countless demon tribes. It is one of the best cultivation paradises in the entire Chuyun Realm. How can it be said to be insufficient?" Daoist Mu upon hearing this, laughed.
"Old Niu, don't just say nice things. The Nineteen Cities of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range have long been infiltrated by various major forces of the Chuyun Realm. Even if Yuan sits in the chief seat, how much actual benefit can he gain? Moreover, sitting in this position means carrying the burden of confronting the Ten Thousand Demon Country, not to mention the threats from the Three Realms Sect and the Demon World. If you want the horse to run, you must at least feed it well." Kong disagreed, retorting.
Daoist Mu pondered for a moment, nodding, and said, "Fellow Daoist Kong speaks with reason. I wonder what young friend Yuan might desire?"
Kong spoke ahead, saying, "He doesn't ask for much, just two things. One Enlightenment Pill and a chance to enter the Wentian Secret Realm. Isn't that reasonable?"
Daoist Mu, hearing this, his gaze flickered, and after pondering for a moment, said, "Young friend Yuan already controls the World Tree, being the top Dharma Phase Cultivator in the Chuyun Realm. Naturally, he has the qualification to enter the Wentian Secret Realm. However, there is indeed no stock of the Enlightenment Pill at present; the only one has already been gifted to Puppet Immortal."
"Since the Enlightenment Pill is used up, then settle for the next best thing and substitute with the main materials of the Enlightenment Pill. Nine-Turned Separation Gold, Taiyi Divine Water, Five-Colored Stone, these three items should be available? Don't tell me these are also gone." Kong frowned slightly, said.
Daoist Mu gazed at Kong, seemingly seeing through his thoughts, and coolly said, "It seems Fellow Daoist Kong has found an outstanding Alchemist and plans to personally refine the Enlightenment Pill. Very well, I agree to this."
Saying this, he turned his wrist, and a white crescent-shaped Jade Talisman appeared in his palm.
He lightly tossed it, the Jade Talisman flew towards the World Tree, transformed into a white light, and merged into the trunk.
"This is the credential to enter the Wentian Secret Realm when it opens after a hundred years. Young friend Yuan, keep it well. As for the three spiritual materials for the Enlightenment Pill, they will be given to you at that time." Daoist Mu instructed.
"Thank you, Senior." Yuan Ming controlled a tree root to gently catch the Jade Talisman, carefully storing it away.
Seeing this, Daoist Mu nodded slightly, then closed his eyes again, as if falling into some kind of contemplation.
Meanwhile, Kong flickered his figure and vanished without a trace, evidently returning to the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
At this moment, Yuan Ming was filled with questions in his mind and couldn't help but ask, "Senior Kong, what exactly is this Enlightenment Pill you mentioned earlier?"
Kong's voice echoed in Yuan Ming's heart, with some leisure, "The Enlightenment Pill is a Seventh-grade Elixir, refined with Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, the Five Elements Origin Materials as the base. Taking this elixir can enhance your understanding of the Five Elements True Intent, thereby increasing the chances of breaking through to the Mahayana Realm. In the Chuyun Realm, this elixir is renowned, being the coveted advancement treasure of many cultivators."
Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, was naturally delighted.
His talent in magic practices was mediocre, and reaching today's realm was entirely due to the accumulation of various resources.
Regarding the critical juncture of breaking through the Mahayana, he indeed lacked confidence. With the help of this Enlightenment Pill, his worries were greatly alleviated.
In his joy, Yuan Ming couldn't help but think of some issues, and quickly asked:
"Is Senior Kong planning to personally refine the pill? You know, refining a Seventh-grade Elixir requires a Seventh-grade Alchemist, where are we going to find such an Alchemist? Furthermore, the Enlightenment Pill requires Five Elements Origin Materials; you only requested three from Daoist Mu. How will you find the remaining two?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1012 - 977: Return
chapters.content:
The voice of Kong resonated in Yuan Ming's heart, carrying a hint of confidence: "Leave the alchemist's matter to me, there's no need for you to worry. As for the remaining two sources of the Five Elements, among them, the Ten Thousand Wood Origin, condensed by the World Tree, is the purest Wood Origin. As for the final Fire Origin, I've got a lead; it's hidden within the Wentian Secret Realm."
"I understand," replied Yuan Ming, feeling somewhat relieved.
He deeply trusted Kong's capability; since he spoke so, he surely had preparations in place.
"The refinement of the Enlightenment Pill also requires some auxiliary materials. I have listed them on this Jade Scroll; you need to collect them swiftly, for these materials are crucial for refining the elixir," Kong continued.
As he spoke, Kong handed a Jade Scroll to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming received the Jade Scroll and scanned it with Divine Thought, revealing a densely packed list of dozens of spiritual materials, most of which were of Level 6 and above quality, with even some Level 7 materials.
He furrowed his brows slightly, as these spiritual materials weren't easily obtainable, and several seemed not directly used for alchemy.
He said no more, only storing the Jade Scroll and agreeing: "Rest assured, Senior Kong, I will gather these materials as quickly as possible. Thank you for your assistance, which I shall never forget."
"There is no need for verbal gratitude; after you advance to Mahayana, I need you to help me with a task," Kong said with a faint smile.
"May I know what task Senior refers to?" asked Yuan Ming, rather relieved in his heart.
Since Kong had a request of him, he would wholeheartedly aid him.
"You wouldn't be able to accomplish it even if I told you now. Let's discuss it after you've advanced to Mahayana. The task is beneficial for you, though somewhat dangerous," responded Kong.
"Senior Kong has assisted me greatly; I remember these kindnesses well. As long as it's within my capability, I will certainly strive to aid," Yuan Ming solemnly promised.
"Good." Kong showed a slight smile, then disappeared into the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Yuan Ming steadied his mind, preparing to close his eyes to cultivate when suddenly he sensed something and looked upwards.
Daoist Mu also slightly opened his eyes, seemingly sensing something.
...
Outside the ruins of White Emperor City, suddenly the sounds of wind and thunder erupted, with dozens of figures rushing in - all were powerful members of the Demon Clan of Ten Thousand Demon Country.
The leader among them was the alluringly beautiful Wu Yu.
Beside him was the Electric Roc King, and the others were all Level 5 demons, looking fierce and formidable.
In the center of everyone's attention, within the ruins of White Emperor City, was a towering giant tree that rose from the ground, reaching a hundred meters high. Its lush foliage blocked out the sun and sky, full of vibrant life.
This tree was like a divine wood descending from the heavens, filling one with awe.
Upon seeing this, the demons' expressions changed.
"The World Tree..." Wu Yu immediately recognized it.
Upon seeing the lone giant tree standing on the city, he suddenly understood why the Heavenly Crane Array could be reactivated.
The Electric Roc King also showed a fierce glare, scanning the surroundings but detecting no other presences, thus he spoke: "Could it be that this giant tree is causing problems? It seems no one is guarding this place. Why don't we take this opportunity to destroy it?"
Wu Yu heard him, but slightly shook her head.
Understanding the exceptional nature of this tree, she warned against reckless action: "Let's take a closer look first, don't act rashly."
With that, her figure moved, flying towards the World Tree.
Just as she ascended into the air, suddenly a majestic aura erupted from White Emperor City, and a figure dressed in a Daoist robe appeared, suspended in mid-air.
It was Daoist Mu.
His gaze was deep, looking down at the demons below, his voice gentle yet commanding: "Dear friends, what you seek today is doomed to fail. It would be best if you leave swiftly."
Upon hearing this, the Electric Roc King burned with anger, roaring loudly while attempting to push forward.
The other demons also shouted angrily, expressing displeasure at Daoist Mu's remarks.
"Stop." Wu Yu suddenly commanded in a low voice, halting the uproar among them.
The demons hesitated and looked at her.
Ignoring their curious glances, Wu Yu bowed respectfully towards Daoist Mu, saying, "I didn't expect Senior Mu to be here; we are impolite."
Upon hearing the name "Daoist Mu," the demons' suspicion and rage were extinguished as if doused in cold water, replaced by indescribable astonishment.
The Demon Clan, long suppressed for ages and mostly dormant in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, seldom ventured into other regions of the Central Continent. Though they'd never seen Daoist Mu in person, his name was legendary.
Daoist Mu, who had cultivated on Evergreen Island for many years and rarely roamed the world, was renowned with countless stories circulating about him in the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
Even if most demons didn't recognize his true face, they had great respect for his reputation.
At this moment, Daoist Mu waved his sleeve, speaking lightly: "Return. You should not be here at this time."
The tone was calm and unwavering, yet it carried an undeniable authority.
Upon hearing this, Wu Yu's expression shifted slightly, and she said sorrowfully, "Senior Mu, your true form is also of the Demon Clan, the Sky Demon Royal Court once achieved great military prowess in the realm wars, and now has suffered extermination. Do they not even deserve a chance to continue their bloodline?"
Daoist Mu responded indifferently, "Reflect well on my words earlier, and go back."
Wu Yu seemed to have gained insight and immediately bowed again: "In that case, I will take my leave, Senior."
With that, she turned and left without a moment's hesitation.
Seeing this, the Electric Roc King and other demons also followed, leaving White Emperor City in dead silence once more.
A flash of green light enveloped Daoist Mu, and he retreated into the ground again, as if he had never appeared.
"Thank you, Senior Mu, for assisting me," Yuan Ming expressed his gratitude to Daoist Mu in his heart.
Daoist Mu turned to look at Yuan Ming, his eyes reflecting a hint of deep meaning: "Yuan, what do you think of the current Ten Thousand Demon Country?"
"What do you mean by this, Senior?" Yuan Ming was taken aback and pondered slightly before speaking.
"It is as it sounds. Do you believe the Ten Thousand Demon Country should continue to exist?" Daoist Mu smiled slightly and said.
"Previously, I had no great animosity toward the Ten Thousand Demon Country, but now that they have colluded with the Three Realms Sect and the Demon World, it is unforgivable," Yuan Ming replied after some contemplation.
Daoist Mu nodded slightly, without saying much more.
Yuan Ming, understandingly, did not mention the issue again, and instead, closed his eyes to sense the situation within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
At that moment, Kong was stimulating the Stealing Heaven Tripod, absorbing the Wish Power accumulated by the Heavenly Crane Array over millennia.
Interestingly, this Wish Power did not enter the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform but was transferred elsewhere by Kong through some mysterious means.
Xi Ying was seated quietly in the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, engaging in Breathing Control to recover.
Yuan Ming sensed that Xi Ying's aura had mostly stabilized, and he relaxed.
He promptly opened the Shura Palace, merging his physical body with the World Tree, and entered within in the forms of a bean soldier clone and main soul.
The territory of the Shura Palace had expanded greatly, with originally isolated regions like the Extreme Fire Realm and Cold Martial Realm respectively expanding, and some peripheral areas extending into brand new spaces.
The entire Shura Palace's terrain had grown more complex and intricate, captivating far more than before.
Yuan Ming went directly to Yin Capital City, where he had set up a Sixth-level Magic Array covering the city. Although the city's area hadn't changed much, the city's former gloomy ghostly aura had entirely dissipated, replaced by Spiritual Energy as rich as elsewhere.
He arrived at the area where cultivators of the Sunset Sect were held and saw Wang Fulong and others. These days, the people of Sunset Sect had not seen Yuan Ming and were anxious about what fate awaited them. Now that Yuan Ming had arrived, they quickly and sincerely admitted their mistakes.
Wang Fulong and others, with fearful expression, bowed their heads to Yuan Ming: "Fellow Daoist Wan, we have realized our mistakes and humbly ask for mercy. Name your conditions, even if it means having the Sunset Sect surrender to you, it is not out of the question. As long as you let us go, within five years, I will lead the entire Sunset Sect to pledge loyalty to you."
Yuan Ming sneered, his gaze sharp as a knife: "You indeed were under orders, but the fact that you attempted to assassinate me remains undeniable. I have been lenient by sparing your lives, yet you dare dream of escape?"
Wang Fulong and others' faces paled, ashen-like.
These days, they had attempted to study the array around the city but found those arrays to be exquisitely crafted, far beyond their capability to break.
Moreover, the recent upheaval in the Shura Palace had made the Space Power stronger, making the arrays here even more solid.
If Yuan Ming intended, he could undoubtedly imprison them until their death.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, what is it you wish to accomplish?" Wang Fulong and the others exchanged a glance and cautiously inquired.
"You know I am a Soul Cultivator, and my deity is the Nether Moon God. I want you to join the Moon Sect, become believers of the Nether Moon God, pray and worship for a thousand years in the Shura Palace, earnestly supplying Desire Power for me," Yuan Ming said calmly.
A thousand years is a long time for cultivators.
Especially a thousand years while trapped.Find the newest release on novelꜰire.net
Upon hearing this, everyone fell silent.
Wang Fulong gritted his teeth and asked, "After a thousand years, can we regain our freedom?"
"As long as you serve earnestly, I will naturally keep my word. Furthermore, if someone worships sincerely, I might release them before a thousand years. Now I have been appointed by Evergreen Island Wood Ancestor to oversee the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range and am in need of assistance," Yuan Ming nodded.
Mentioning "Evergreen Island Wood Ancestor," Wang Fulong and others showed expressions of shock, similar to the earlier response of the Ten Thousand Demon Country's group of demons.
"I am willing to join the Moon Sect and become your believer," Wang Fulong took a deep breath and expressed his stance first.
The others saw this and also agreed one by one.
Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction, planting Soul Descent Runes in their Sea of Consciousness, and taught them the prayer methods before turning away.
Having made their decision, Wang Fulong and others did not hesitate and immediately began sincere prayers, and Desire Power gushed forth like a spring.
With the addition of Zheng Heng and He Xiuwen, two Dharma manifestation cultivators, the production of Vow Power Pill significantly increased, allowing one pill to be produced roughly every ten days.

chapters.title: Chapter 1013 - 978: The Top Priority
chapters.content:
Ever since Yuan Ming surpassed sixty restrictions in the refining of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his control over the Vow Power Pill has already exceeded that of Artifact Spirit Kong.
Thus, all the Vow Power Pills produced during this period have fallen into his hands, and about twenty or so pieces have been condensed.
Yet Yuan Ming still feels it's not enough.
He takes out a Vow Power Pill, gently rubs it in his hand, and murmurs to himself: "Xi Ying has cultivated the Great Wish of All Living Beings, and requires an immense amount of Desire Power. Over the years, she's been busy with cultivation and the business of the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce, with few believers. I must prepare enough Vow Power Pills for her, just in case."
His thoughts shift, and he considers that he now manages the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range and can greatly develop believers from there. If he could bestow the Vow Power Pills to potential followers, it would sharply enhance the strength of the Moon Sect.
Soul cultivation is difficult; if aided by the Vow Power Pill, many would accept it. This could attract numerous believers. Although such practices may lead to divine soul instability, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages, allowing for the rapid cultivation of a batch of potent Soul Cultivators.
In this calculation, the current pace of Vow Power Pill production is still far from sufficient.
"It seems I must continue to vigorously develop the Moon Sect, gathering more followers." Yuan Ming sighed lightly, formulating a plan in his mind.
...
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's main soul sat upon the White Jade Lotus Platform.
With a thought, he sensed Yin Lang through Desire Power.
Yin Lang was currently in Yinshan City.
Not long ago, the city had endured a fierce attack from the demon race, and he was compelled to join the battle. Luckily, the city was well-handled, preventing significant damage.
The followers he recruited earlier in Yinshan City were mostly preserved.
Upon learning this, Yuan Ming felt quite relieved and expressed appreciation for Yin Lang's capability: "You've done well."
"It's merely my duty, not worth mentioning." Yin Lang responded respectfully.
"Also, keep an eye out for auxiliary materials for the Dharma Manifestation Pill. Purchase what you can, or reserve it if Spirit Stones are insufficient. Soon, someone will come to Yinshan City to deliver Spirit Stones." Yuan Ming gave Yin Lang a new task.
"As you command." Yin Lang agreed promptly.
And the people Yuan Ming mentioned to deliver the Spirit Stones were Hua Zhi and Vajra, two demons.
Due to delays, they were only then setting out for the Central Continent; they had already departed from the Dongji Sea Area, and were on their way to Yinshan City.
After finishing with Yin Lang's matters, Yuan Ming's figure vanished from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, reappearing next to the World Giant Tree within the Shura Palace.
There gathered many cultivators, initially there for the spectacle, but upon Yuan Ming's arrival, they wisely took their leave.
To Yuan Ming, the World Giant Tree held immense significance. Even though the cultivators in the Shura Palace were trustworthy, he decided to enhance protective measures.
Therefore, he increased several sets of array restrictions around the World Tree to ensure its safety.
Just then, a glow approached from afar, the Xi He Tablet carrying Xi Hezi's figure gracefully arrived.
She examined the World Giant Tree, then scanned the surrounding void, her eyes showing admiration: "With this World Tree, your Shura Palace now has the potential surpassing most Space Spiritual Treasures, even the possibility of advancing to a Space Dao Treasure."
"A Space Dao Treasure! Fellow Daoist Xi Hezi, is this true?" Yuan Ming was overjoyed upon hearing this.
He had seen the Three Realms Immortal Boat crash with destructive might upon the Pillar Hongjun from the spirit beans' clone; if the Shura Palace could possess such power, even just half of it, it would be a significant trump card.
"Indeed it is true. However, the artifact refining of this space treasure was too crude; to advance to a Dao Treasure, a fundamental re-refining is necessary." Xi Hezi confirmed with a nod.
"No worries, Fellow Daoist Xi He, proceed as you wish. As long as no harm comes to the mortals and cultivators within the Shura Palace, ask for any materials you need." Yuan Ming stated unwaveringly.
"Good, I'll take this job." Xi Hezi said excitedly upon hearing this.
She then waved her hand, sending a black long sword towards Yuan Ming.
The sword seemed unchanged from before, yet Yuan Ming could feel the powerful force within it.
He reached out to catch the sword, yet its tip suddenly turned, releasing a Sword Qi with a destructive aura.
As the Sword Qi hit, Yuan Ming immediately felt his divine soul shaking fiercely, almost showing signs of collapse.
Heart racing, he quickly activated the Stealing Heaven Tripod to stabilize his divine soul, inwardly acknowledging this re-forged Soul Destroying Sword was truly extraordinary.
"Be careful, though this re-forged Soul Destroying Sword hasn't birthed an Artifact Spirit, it already possesses considerable sentience. You need to refine it anew with Essence Blood for it to recognize you again." Xi Hezi explained with a smile.
Yuan Ming nodded in agreement, opening his mouth to spray out a mass of Essence Blood.
The Essence Blood transformed into a Blood Mist, entwining around the Soul Extinguishing Sword and quickly merging within.
The Soul Extinguishing Sword did not resist, obediently absorbing the Blood Mist, and sure enough, the connection with Yuan Ming's mind strengthened considerably.
After a round of refining, Yuan Ming lifted his hand and flicked it, and the Soul Extinguishing Sword shot swiftly into the air, reaching over a hundred feet high in the blink of an eye.
Buzz, buzz, buzz...
In the high sky, the Soul Extinguishing Sword flipped like a spirit butterfly and elegantly flew downwards, happily circling around Yuan Ming, occasionally lightly touching him, as if conveying flattery and joy to its master, resembling a spirit pet trained from an early age trying to win favor from its owner.
Yuan Ming's lips curled slightly, a hint of admiration in his eyes, as he gently received the Soul Extinguishing Sword, closed his eyes, and released his Divine Sense to closely examine the changes within.
Inside the sword body, the ordinary runes were cleverly eliminated by Xi Hezi, replaced by two brand new and complex runes, seemingly containing endless mysteries.
"These two runes, one named 'Yin Erosion' and the other 'Shattering Soul', are attack runes specifically targeting the Divine Soul." Xi Hezi explained softly from the side, her voice like a flowing spring, pleasant and melodious.
The two new runes, along with the previous Curse, Frenzy Blood, and Annihilation runes, formed a completely new rune formation.
Although the rune formation contains only five runes, its power greatly exceeds the previous one, with strength that is purer and more concentrated.Find the newest release on net
Once the rune formation is activated, the Sword Qi emanated by the Soul Extinguishing Sword reveals a hint of the True Meaning of Dao, enhancing the effectiveness of attacks on the Divine Soul by more than threefold.

"Next, you just need to properly refine this sword. With your talent, I believe you'll soon comprehend the Soul Destruction True Intent," Xi Hezi continued to instruct Yuan Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 1014 - 979: Guidance Through Confusion
chapters.content:
In the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Kong's figure appeared stealthily at an unknown moment.
He sat cross-legged on the White Jade Lotus Platform, eyes closed and focused, resembling an old monk deep in meditation.
All around the void, Desire Power flowed in small streams, gathering from all directions, gradually forming a multicolored river, like a rainbow descending from the heavens to the mortal world, finally merging into the altar beneath the Lotus Platform.
Yuan Ming stood in the void, sensing this powerful fluctuation of Desire Power, far surpassing that which ordinary believers could generate.
His gaze lingered on Kong for a moment, then turned towards Xi Ying.
Xi Ying had already awakened, quietly watching Kong casting his spells.
The fluctuations of her Divine Soul were gradually stabilizing, and her aura had returned to a peaceful state.
"Are you alright?" Yuan Ming asked, his face lighting up with joy but still somewhat cautious.
"Senior Kong assisted me, helping to repair the damage to my Divine Soul. After some period of Breathing Control, there's no longer anything to worry about," Xi Ying said with a slight smile.
"The backlash of the Great Wish of All Living Beings is too intense, even surpassing your Causality Decree to some extent. Such a power that harms both oneself and others should be used sparingly in the future," Yuan Ming nodded, speaking with a heavy expression.
"I understand what you mean. However, the Great Wish of All Living Beings does not always result in such a strong backlash," Xi Ying nodded gently.
"What do you mean by that?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled by her words.
Xi Ying's gaze fell on the center of Yuan Ming's forehead, she suddenly raised her hand and pointed in the air, uttering in a grand voice: "May the soul-devouring bugs here be scattered and vanish!"
As her voice fell, the Desire Power in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space erupted as if ignited, an invisible and intangible force quietly permeated into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, enveloping the Heavenly Silkworm Egg.
The egg, previously on the verge of death from the attack of the Great Wish of All Living Beings, was thoroughly crushed by this second assault.
Xi Ying stopped the Great Wish of All Living Beings, her complexion slightly pale, but she quickly returned to normal.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was shocked and hurriedly sensed Xi Ying's aura, finding that she did not have the severe Divine Soul damage as before, and he finally felt at ease.
Recalling the earlier situation, he spoke with some understanding: "When casting the Great Wish of All Living Beings, the easier the wish is to fulfill, the smaller the price to pay?"
"Indeed. Like just then, destroying a weak bug required almost no cost," Xi Ying nodded and said.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but develop a keen interest in this Divine Skill, the Great Wish of All Living Beings.
He curiously asked, "Where did you learn this Great Wish of All Living Beings?"
"It was Senior Xia Jie who taught it to me. A few days ago, he came to White Emperor City to meet me personally. It was thanks to his guidance and help that I was able to smoothly break through to the Realm of Life Witch," Xi Ying said softly.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt both surprised and unsurprised.
Thinking of Xia Jie's erudition and wisdom, perhaps only he could have created such a miraculous power.
"After breaking through to the Life Witch, I also used the life-reversing ability of the Life Witch to help Senior Xia Jie restore his Divine Soul, as a gesture of gratitude for his teaching," Xi Ying continued.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel happy for Xia Jie.
At the same time, he felt somewhat ashamed; he too had once promised to help Xia Jie restore his Divine Soul, but his progress in Soul Cultivation was slow, and he had been unable to fulfill the promise in time.
Fortunately, Xi Ying had completed this wish on his behalf, easing some of the guilt in his heart.
Seeing the flicker of longing in Yuan Ming's eyes, Xi Ying gently parted her red lips and continued, "Seeing your eagerness, let me explain a bit further. The Great Wish of All Living Beings actually shares many similarities with the Great Black Sky Palm, requiring the perfect fusion of Mana, Soul Power, and Desire Power to unleash its earth-shattering might. Moreover, my current grasp of this Divine Skill is only at the entry-level."
Recalling the scenes of Xi Ying casting this technique twice before, Yuan Ming's heart was filled with doubt, so he asked, "I noticed that the power displayed by the Great Wish of All Living Beings varied greatly when you used it twice before. Why is that?"
"The power of the Great Wish of All Living Beings is indeed related to the amount of Desire Power used. Remember when dealing with Su Wu, it was Senior Kong's generous assistance, lending me a large amount of Desire Power, that allowed me to repel a strong enemy in one blow," Xi Ying said with a slight smile, explaining.
Upon hearing this, a hint of contemplation flashed across Yuan Ming's face, having gained some understanding.
After a brief silence, he mustered up his courage and tentatively asked, "Xi Ying, could you possibly teach me this Divine Skill, the Great Wish of All Living Beings?"
He was quite eager for this tremendously powerful Divine Skill.
Moreover, with the Stealing Heaven Tripod in his possession, and the Moon Sect growing stronger under his leadership, collecting Desire Power was not a difficult task for him; if he could master this technique, he could surely unleash even more astonishing power.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴovelfire.net
However, Xi Ying gently shook her head, politely refusing: "At the moment, you are unable to learn this skill. Such Divine Skills can only be touched by Soul Cultivators who have reached the Realm of Life Witch, and it requires extremely high understanding from the cultivator. You have yet to meet these standards."
Yuan Ming felt a surge of helplessness upon hearing this.
Recently, his progress in soul cultivation has been slow, and even the cultivation of the "Love Inquiry Technique" has come to a standstill. The refinement of the Seven Spirits is yet incomplete, making the Life Witch Realm seem far out of reach.
At this moment, a spark of spirit light flickered in his eyes as he fixed his gaze on Xi Ying.
Xi Ying felt a bit uneasy being stared at like this and slightly frowned, saying, "Why are you staring at me like that? Do you intend to possess me to comprehend the Great Wish of All Living Beings' divine skill? That's impossible. Without reaching the Life Witch Realm, one cannot touch upon the mysteries of fate and thus cannot comprehend the Great Wish of All Living Beings."
Yuan Ming quickly shook his head and denied it, "Of course not. I just thought that since you've completed the refinement of the Seven Spirits, perhaps I could possess you to accelerate my understanding of the Seven Spirits."
"That might indeed be a way. However, my Soul Power exceeds yours, so you can't directly possess me," Xi Ying pondered slightly and said.
"I have a way to solve this," Yuan Ming replied with a slight smile, full of confidence.
Having said that, he focused his mind, and the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space opened immediately.
Before him, the void rippled with waves, and grayish-green vines emerged, entwining and weaving together in the void, quickly forming a wooden figure as tall as Xi Ying.
"Wu Yu's Soul Power also surpasses mine, but I once possessed her clone before, gaining some insights similarly. Xi Ying, you can separate a part of your Divine Soul to create a clone, then I can possess you," Yuan Ming said.
"You possessed that Wu Yu?" Xi Ying's eyebrows slowly raised.
"It was just her clone, and I only possessed it once, to advance the 'Love Inquiry Technique,'" Yuan Ming felt a pang in his heart and hastened to explain.
Xi Ying wrinkled her nose, snorted lightly, and turned her gaze away, but still controlled her Divine Soul to separate a portion, which transformed and merged into the indistinctly featured wooden figure.
As the part of Xi Ying's Divine Soul gradually merged into the previously featureless wooden figure, its appearance rapidly became more distinct.
In an instant, a clone nearly identical to Xi Ying formed, appearing lifelike and realistic, like a facsimile of the real person.
With a thought, Xi Ying's clone began to dance gracefully in place, her movements light and seamless, indistinguishable from a real person.
It was hard to believe this was just a clone, unless one observed carefully.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was thrilled, immediately went to the outside world, and took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, lighting a stick of Black Incense.
He closed his eyes and focused, attempting to possess Xi Ying's clone.
However, regardless of how he beckoned the image of the clone or tried to communicate with it, his efforts were in vain.
"Ordinary clones, although seemingly unrelated to the main body, still have an essence connected to the main body's Mana and Divine Soul. Therefore, when you attempt to possess it, the clone and the main body are still considered a whole, leading to possession failure," Xi Ying observed and analyzed.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brow in confusion, "Then what about Wu Yu's clone? I successfully possessed her clone before."
Xi Ying slightly frowned, contemplated for a moment, and said, "Wu Yu must have mastered a special secret technique for clones, capable of completely severing the connection between the clone and the main body. Unfortunately, I'm not aware of such a technique. If you truly want to speed up your soul cultivation, I can help you search for this secret technique for clones, but it's evidently not an ordinary secret technique, and I can't guarantee to find it."
"No matter, I may get a chance to contact Wu Yu again and see if I can directly obtain this secret technique from her," Yuan Ming thought for a moment and said.
"Let's talk about that later; take this first," Xi Ying took out a bronze token, palm-sized, and handed it over.
"Senior Kong just told me about your matters. Controlling the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is indeed a good opportunity. You need a stable foothold. However, that place is a mix of dragon and snake, with complex forces at play. To firmly sit as the Master of the Demon Mountain Range, you need to further enhance your strength. The Forbidden on this token has been lifted, take it to comprehend the Five Elements Dao Fruit as soon as possible," Xi Ying said thus.
Yuan Ming took the token, slowly channeling Mana into it from his palm.
The mysterious rune on the token instantly lit up with five-colored spiritual light, and streams of information flowed into his Sea of Consciousness like water.
Moved in his heart, he immediately closed his eyes, focused his mind, and began to meticulously study these messages.
The surrounding environment seemed to blur, and Yuan Ming's mind completely immersed in the information conveyed by the token.
He seemed to be in a resplendent world where the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth intertwined and danced around him, exuding enchanting brilliance...
As his comprehension of the Five Elements Dao Fruit deepened, Yuan Ming gradually grasped its mysteries.
He appeared to see the subtle relationship of mutual generation and restraint among the Five Elements, perceived the operating principles of the Five Elements Power in the cosmos, and began to understand the truth of "the way of heaven, lessens what is more and supplements what is less."
Everything in the universe seemed to follow and maintain a subtle balance.
The balance is continuously broken and formed anew, repeatedly...
His state of mind, along with his deepening comprehension, gradually began to transform, becoming more peaceful and profound.

chapters.title: Chapter 1015 - 980: Man and Sword Unity
chapters.content:

The potency of the Five Elements Dao Fruit is determined by the True Meaning of Dao infused within it.
The stronger the True Intent integrated, the more astonishing the power of the cultivated Five Elements Dao Fruit.

As soon as the words were spoken, several beams of tunneling light shot in from all directions, landing on the plaza.

The handsome man nodded, confidence flashing in his eyes: "Indeed, now that I am one with the Starry Sky Swordman, Sima Changqin is no longer a threat in my eyes. With just one sword, I can cut him down!"

chapters.content:

"Father, I have reached your requirements in my recent closed-door cultivation. Will you keep your promise and send someone to propose to the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce?" The handsome man suddenly put on a smile, looking expectantly at the Green Robed Taoist.

According to the information from the Dark Sword, Xi Ying has already given her heart to someone mentioned in the Communication Talisman, Wan Tianren. This person is a Body Cultivator with an Undying Body and extraordinary strength. With so many competitors, you should..."
The handsome man's expression kept changing, but he finally gritted his teeth and said, "Father, it's been years before I finally met someone I like. Just go to the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce and propose; I will handle the rest."
