He smiled, looking at the Bright Moon Palace Master and the Green Robed Taoist, saying, "Indeed, I invited Fellow Daoist Qinglian over. The Three Realms Immortal Boat has now fallen into the hands of the Demon World, and the situation is extremely dangerous. Although the World Tree was taken, making the Three Realms Immortal Boat temporarily unusable, with the resources of the Demon World, it's only a matter of time before its power is restored. The Fourth Realm War is imminent; we must swiftly plan a response."
Upon hearing Daoist Mu's words, the expressions of the Bright Moon Palace Master and the Green Robed Taoist became solemn.
They understood the cruelty and ruthlessness of realm wars; once started, it would surely lead to widespread destruction and upheaval.
"Has the situation deteriorated to this extent?" Green Robed Taoist asked, frowning deeply.
Daoist Mu shook his head, sighing, "The Demon World's mastery over Space Power is becoming increasingly proficient. Even without the Three Realms Immortal Boat, they could fully breach the boundaries of the Chuyun Realm in at most two or three thousand years. The resurrection of the Demon Lord of Reincarnation only hastens the war."
The Bright Moon Palace Master was silent for a moment, then finally spoke, "It seems the Guardian plan needs to proceed to the next step quickly."
Daoist Mu and the Green Robed Taoist exchanged glances, both nodding in agreement.
They knew that at this moment, the responsibility of guarding the Chuyun Realm had fallen upon the shoulders of them, the Guardians.
The Bright Moon Palace Master waved her hand, and a gentle white light screen instantly enveloped the three figures, thoroughly sealing the surrounding space.
This was a unique secret technique of the Bright Moon Palace, capable of isolating any external prying and interference.
Under the veil of light, the three began their deep discussion.
As time passed, the atmosphere within the light veil grew increasingly heavy, as if even the air had frozen.
A moment later, the white veil slowly dissipated.
The figures of Daoist Qinglian and Fellow Daoist Mu had disappeared, leaving the Bright Moon Palace Master standing alone under the laurel tree, gazing into the distance.
Her gaze was deep and far-reaching, as if she was pondering something.
Her figure swayed gently in the breeze, merging with the surrounding scenery, appearing solemn and mysterious.
After another moment, she lightly swept her sleeve, and the void in front suddenly split open, as if slashed by an invisible sword.
A white world appeared before her eyes, filled with towering white laurel trees, as if moonlight elves were dancing.
This space was vast and boundless, seeming endless at a glance.
The Bright Moon Palace Master stepped inside, her figure flickering until she appeared beside an extraordinarily tall laurel tree.
This laurel tree was exceptionally thick, with lush branches and leaves, as if bearing the weight of endless years and secrets.
Hanging on the tree were seven or eight white light orbs, emitting a soft glow.
Strange and bizarre scenes occasionally flashed within the light orbs, like dream-like visions, as if they contained the dreams of many people, resembling small worlds.
The Bright Moon Palace Master reached out her hand and gently touched one of the white light orbs.
The orb trembled slightly, and the scene within immediately froze, revealing the figure of an aged matron with white hair.
She wore plain white clothes and had a kind face. Upon seeing the Bright Moon Palace Master, she immediately bowed in greeting.
"This old body greets the Palace Master," the matron's voice was respectful and calm.
The Bright Moon Palace Master nodded slightly and asked, "How is the Goddess now?"
"The Goddess's Divine Map Game Painting has reached the third stage, but the backlash is exceptionally strong. To proceed to the fourth stage would likely require a long period of rest," the matron replied.
Upon hearing this, the Bright Moon Palace Master frowned slightly and instructed, "Have the Goddess cease her cultivation and return to prepare for the Wentian Secret Realm."
"Yes," the matron responded respectfully.
The Bright Moon Palace Master was silent for a moment before asking again, "What about the Saint Heir's situation?"
"The Saint Heir's whereabouts remain unknown. According to reports from our spies, he was recently seen in White Emperor City," the matron replied.
"White Emperor City!"
A look of surprise appeared on the Bright Moon Palace Master's face as she turned her hand to take out an exquisite jade box and gently opened it.
Inside lay a semi-transparent jade scroll, intact and undamaged.
Only then did the Bright Moon Palace Master breathe a sigh of relief, put away the jade box, and said, "Summon the Saint Heir back immediately and prepare his Heavenly Soul Fruit."
"Yes," the matron bowed again and her figure faded away.
...
Deep within the palace of the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
In a grand stone-built hall, a bonfire blazed fiercely, like a Fire Dragon roaring in the dark night.
The flames danced, illuminating every corner of the hall, casting mottled shadows, staining the stone walls and chairs with a mix of gold and black hues.
Gathered around the bonfire were numerous Demon Kings of the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
They sat or stood, but at the moment, every face was filled with solemnity and unease.
The atmosphere in the hall was oppressive and heavy, as if a storm might break out at any moment.
Wu Yu was seated at the main position, lightly massaging her forehead. A hint of fatigue, hard to conceal, showed on her beautiful face.
Her gaze was deep and complex, as if contemplating something difficult and undecidable.
In recent days, Wu Yu had been continually contacting Su Wu and those from the Demon World, hoping to gain their support, but to no avail.
Both groups seemed to have vanished into thin air, leaving no trace, causing her immense unease and fostering more doubts about her future plans.
"Your Majesty the Empress, the Demon Clan forces attacking various cities suffered heavy losses. Not only have we failed to restore the past glory of our Ten Thousand Demon Country with this campaign, but we have also sustained serious damage to our primordial qi. All clans are voicing grievances, and we can't suppress it. At this point, we must give the group of demons an explanation," the Flame Wolf King stood up and said in a loud voice.
Wu Yu looked up, her gaze calm and profound, as if seeing through the Flame Wolf King's heart.
She asked lightly, "What kind of explanation do you want?"
The Flame Wolf King met Wu Yu's gaze without flinching and said sternly, "The blame for this battle lies entirely with the Three Realms Sect. Those who advocated for an alliance with the Three Realms Sect and the Demon World should take full responsibility for the current situation."
Though his words didn't name anyone directly, everyone in the hall understood the implication clearly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1017 - 982: Wu Yu’s Decision
chapters.content:
"Flame Wolf King, the situation has evolved to this point because the Human Clan was well-prepared. Even Daoist Mu was dispatched; the failure is not entirely Her Majesty the Empress's fault," declared the Electric Roc King.
Though her words seemed to scold the Flame Wolf King, she was implying that Wu Yu should bear some responsibility.
"Shut up! For the future of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, Her Majesty the Empress has endured for many years, painstakingly planning. Now that circumstances have rendered our efforts impossible, instead of reflecting on your own faults, you blame Her Majesty. What kind of intention is this?" Xuan Ye stood up, his face pale with anger.
"I certainly understand Her Majesty's hard work, but the plan to seize the Heavenly Crane Array was quite hasty. The largest oversight was not informing us of the plan's entirety beforehand, leading to so many loopholes. It seems Her Majesty is overly fatigued and can no longer oversee the entire situation." The Flame Wolf King altered his usual respectful stance and attacked directly.
"Flame Wolf King, Her Majesty the Empress is the sovereign of the Ten Thousand Demon Country. How dare you speak such disrespectful words?" said the Giant Tree King in a deep voice.
"There's some truth in the Flame Wolf King's words. Her Majesty oversees many affairs and indeed should lighten her burden. Although the Demon Emperor Army is strong, the return of the various clans' armies could also ease Her Majesty's load somewhat," the Electric Roc King remarked.
"This simply cannot be done! The reason our Ten Thousand Demon Country can compete with the Human Clan is because of our unity. The Demon Emperor Army is the core of our power. If disbanded, our clan will lose the cornerstone in countering the Human Clan!" Xuan Ye heard and his face changed abruptly, saying urgently.
Wu Yu sat on the grand hall, a solemn expression appearing across her brow.
The greatest reliance she has to maintain her position as the Ten Thousand Demon Empress is her command over the Demon Emperor Army composed of elite warriors from various clans. Once she loses this, the Five Royal Families will no longer have any concerns.
"Protector Xuan Ye is worrying too much. In this great battle, the various clans suffered heavy losses and should recuperate. The Human Clan is also heavily damaged and won't initiate conflict anytime soon. When the war begins again, we'll just regroup the Demon Emperor Army then," the Electric Roc King replied nonchalantly with a slight smile.
"The morale and soul of the Demon Emperor Army cannot be gathered overnight. If disbanded, re-gathering it will be exceedingly difficult!" Xuan Ye replied.
The grand hall quickly erupted into disorder, with various demon kings arguing and sharing differing opinions.
One faction, led by the Flame Wolf King and the Electric Roc King, advocated punishing Wu Yu and undermining her military authority.
Another faction, headed by Xuan Ye and the Giant Tree King, resolutely defended the Demon Emperor Army and Wu Yu's position.
The third faction, the neutral party, was led by the Black Bear King and the Green Snake King, maintaining neutrality and observing the situation.
"No need for further discussion. As of today, the Demon Emperor Army is disbanded, and the various clans will return to rest and recuperate. You may all leave." Wu Yu suddenly spoke, leaving one sentence behind before standing up and gracefully departing.
The grand hall was immediately silenced, with the varied expressions of all the demon kings.
The Flame Wolf King and the Electric Roc King showed joy on their faces, while Xuan Ye and the Giant Tree King looked solemn. The Black Bear King and the Green Snake King exchanged a glance and silently left the hall.
Meanwhile, in the distant forest of the grand hall, a figure quietly emerged.
It was Wei Ling, sent by Yuan Ming to monitor the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
His body flickered with yellow light, instantly transforming into a common stone, lying quietly in the grass, silently.
As they say, know yourself and know your enemy, and you will win a hundred battles.
Since Yuan Ming intends to command the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, it is natural to send someone to monitor the Ten Thousand Demon Country. Wei Ling was sent under his orders to infiltrate.
This person was previously refined by Yuan Ming into an Undying Tree Puppet. After the Undying Tree advanced to the World Tree, its puppet body's capabilities greatly improved, especially its increasingly exquisite Wood Shield Technique, even the existence of the dharma manifestation was hard to detect.
As for Wei Ling's recent Transformation Technique, it is indeed the Transformation Stone Talisman.
Wei Ling is not only Yuan Ming's puppet but also a Nether Moon God believer, the Stealing Heaven Tripod has restored the Desire Power anchor's Investigation Divine Power. With this person stationed near the Ten Thousand Demon Country, Yuan Ming can grasp its every move.
In addition, Yuan Ming has another important objective: to seek intelligence on Wu Yu's unique clone secret technique.
...
Wu Yu stepped into her bedchamber, lightly closing the door.
As she turned, layers of golden light appeared beside her in the void.
In the golden light, an elegant figure gradually emerged, precisely the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
"Her Majesty the Empress, are you truly set on abandoning the Demon Emperor Army? Losing this crucial power, your position as the sovereign of the Ten Thousand Demons will likely become precarious," Great Sun Glaze Flame asked with furrowed eyebrows, puzzled.
Wu Yu gently shook her head, slowly walking to the bed to sit down, her voice carrying traces of fatigue: "The Flame Wolf King and the Electric Roc King are ambitious. If I don't abandon the Demon Emperor Army, how could they possibly cease? Besides, I indeed need to reduce some pressure now and prepare for the upcoming Mahayana Realm. I still need your assistance in this matter."
Upon hearing this, Great Sun Glaze Flame's eyes slightly focused: "Your Majesty, you've only comprehended the true intent of gold, water, fire, and earth, yet you haven't touched the Wood True Intent. Advancing to Mahayana now is fraught with risk."
Wu Yu sighed softly, her eyes showing a hint of resolve: "I know the risks, but there is no time to hesitate. News has spread that the Ten Thousand Demon Country has allied with the Three Realms Sect, my clan is heavily damaged, and the Human Clan's army may invade at any time. If I don't quickly advance to Mahayana, the Ten Thousand Demon Country may face total annihilation. As for the Wood True Intent, I plan to compensate using the Ju Mang Taoist Pearl."
Great Sun Glaze Flame was silent for a moment, seemingly wanting to advise further, but ultimately let out a soft sigh, not saying more.
Wu Yu gently spun her wrist, revealing a fist-sized white jade in her hand.
The jade was round at the top and bottom with sharp corners on the sides, the bottom engraved with faded text like a part of a grand seal.The source of this content ɪs net
The gaze of the Great Sun Glaze Flame was instantly drawn to this jade, moving closer to inspect it carefully, only to find that although the jade appeared extraordinary, it possessed no energy fluctuations.
"What is this?" the Great Sun Glaze Flame asked curiously.
A hint of a smile flashed in Wu Yu's eyes: "This is the Demon Seal passed down from the time of the Sky Demon Royal Court. It was the reward I obtained when I reached the nine hundredth step during the staircase trial of the Three Realms Immortal Boat."
Upon hearing this, the eyes of the Great Sun Glaze Flame lit up: "The Demon Seal? It is said that this seal was a treasure used by the Sky Demon Royal Court to suppress the nation's fate and that it could collect the Demon Clan's fortune. I didn't expect to see its remnants here."
"On that day, when the Heavenly Crane Array was broken, part of the Demon Clan's fortune scattered. I used the remnant of this seal to gather it together. Although the fortune still seems insufficient, for me, it is a worthwhile opportunity to take a risk." Wu Yu nodded gently.
"If that's the case, I will lend a hand to Her Majesty. Do not worry about external matters while you enter seclusion; leave them to me to handle," the Great Sun Glaze Flame said solemnly, taking a deep breath.
After receiving the firm support of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, the next day, Wu Yu once again gathered the Demon Kings and announced her decision to go into seclusion to reach the Mahayana Realm.
The news had different reactions among the Demon Kings.
Xuan Ye and the Giant Tree King wore solemn expressions, clearly opposing the idea, believing it too risky and warning that the consequences could be unimaginable should it fail.
Electric Roc King's eyes glimmered with insight, thinking that in these perilous times, without Mahayana cultivators to hold the fort, the Demon Clan would be in grave danger.
The Flame Wolf King remained silent; neither opposing nor supporting, he sat quietly on one side, seemingly pondering something.
The Green Snake King and the Black Bear King, after carefully inquiring about the details, cautiously expressed their support after much deliberation.
Only half a day later, the rampaging Demon Soldiers throughout the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range received orders and began retreating together.
They swiftly assembled around the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge, sealing it off as if protecting something significant.
Though the outside world remained unaware of this information, Yuan Ming quickly learned through Wei Ling's informants of Wu Yu's seclusion in preparing to reach the Mahayana Realm.
"Aiming for the Mahayana Realm, this is indeed a great opportunity to observe Wu Yu's True Meaning of Dao," thought Yuan Ming, whose main soul then entered the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
He borrowed the White Jade Lotus Platform from Senior Kong and sat cross-legged atop it.
The Desire Power within the lotus platform slowly fused with Yuan Ming's Divine Soul, elevating his Soul Power to the Late Stage of the Word Witch.
"Even with the Soul Power of the Late Stage of the Word Witch, it should still be inferior to Wu Yu's. I wonder if I can avoid Wu Yu's perception with the assist of the Stealing Heaven Tripod?" Yuan Ming pondered secretly.
Without any hesitation, he closed his eyes, focusing his Divine Sense downward, centered on the Desire Power anchor of Wei Ling.
His Divine Sense discreetly and meticulously enveloped nearly the entire Ten Thousand Demon Ridge, slowly covering the position where Wu Yu was currently located.
At this moment, Wu Yu sat calmly within a massive sacrificial forbidden ground.
At the center of this forbidden ground stood a circular altar nine zhang high, surrounded by five octagonal stone pillars.
Intricate runes carved on these stone pillars seemed to contain some mysterious power.
The tops of the pillars were carved with symbols representing Wood, Fire, Earth, Gold, and Water.
These symbols shimmered under the sunlight, emitting a faint glow.
On the ground of the altar, spiritual talisman array patterns had long been inscribed.
These array patterns formed a five-pointed star shape overall, with a circular core at the center, atop which lay a black-and-white mat.
Wu Yu sat cross-legged on this mat, hands forming incantations in front of her body.
A faint golden halo surrounded her, gently fluctuating with her breath.
When she slowly opened her eyes, the golden halo suddenly radiated dazzling light, splitting into multicolored rays that entered the five stone pillars.
The runes on the pillars lit up, rushing upward toward the stone carving seal at the top.
As the mana within Wu Yu continuously surged, the great array beneath her began to glow.
A Yin Yang Dual Fish mark expanded from the mat, transforming into a colossal Yin Yang Diagram, which began to rotate slowly.
The spiritual energy from the surrounding void poured in like a tide, continuously channeling into Wu Yu's body.
Her aura continuously climbed, seemingly reaching the threshold of the Mahayana Realm.
"A level six auxiliary array, its spirit-gathering effect is average. It seems to support comprehension," Yuan Ming observed secretly at this sight.
He cautiously maneuvered his Divine Sense closer to Wu Yu, but just then, Wu Yu suddenly opened her eyes, her sharp gaze scanning the surrounding void.

chapters.title: Chapter 1018 - 983: The Nine Infants' Deal
chapters.content:
"Indeed, the disparity in Divine Sense between us is too vast. Even with the Stealing Heaven Tripod's support, it's difficult to completely conceal myself." Yuan Ming slightly raised his brow. Though he felt a bit regretful, he did not withdraw his Divine Sense.
He quickly adjusted his strategy, transforming his Divine Sense into a faint mist, like ethereal smoke clouds, reducing its presence.
Wu Yu sensed something amiss around her, but as she was about to investigate further, a torrent of Spiritual Energy surged towards her like a flood, gathering around her.
She had to temporarily put aside her doubts and focus, preparing to break through to the Mahayana Realm.
Moments later, Wu Yu's eyes flashed with spirit light, and multicolored brilliance suddenly soared from her body.
Among them, the lights of Fire, Earth, Gold, and Water glowed especially brightly, instantly rising into the sky, lighting up the marks at the tops of four of the five Stone Pillars.
Around these lit marks, each encircled with a halo of light, the Spiritual Essence manifested by the True Meaning of Dao emerged, displaying the scorching heat of crimson-gold flames, the heaviness of earth-yellow flying sand, the sharpness of sharp golden leaves, and the agility of formless water.
Only the mark representing the Wood Attribute Stone Pillar remained dim and unlit.
Wu Yu changed her spell with both hands, and a sphere of green light appeared before her, revealing a blue-black wooden-grain orb.
The orb lit up with green light, becoming translucent like jade, and inside, a fresh green shoot was faintly visible, dreamlike and vibrant.
Yuan Ming observed Wu Yu's displayed True Meaning of Dao from above, feeling no great waves of emotion in his heart.
To him, these True Meanings of Dao, though remarkable, were still inferior to the Illusion Sun True Intent of the Xi He Tablet, not to mention the Fire Emperor True Intent summoned by Su Wu the other day through the Red Eyebrow Taoist.
When his Divine Sense scanned over the wooden-grain orb, touching the tender green shoot within, his heart involuntarily trembled slightly.
"Such true intent, could it be the legendary Wood Emperor True Intent?" Yuan Ming was filled with uncertainty.
Since the transformation of the Undying Tree within him to the World Tree, his perception of the Wood Attribute had become increasingly precise and keen.
Just a fleeting glance allowed him to feel the extraordinary True Meaning of Dao hidden within the wooden-grain orb, far surpassing the other True Meanings of Dao.
He was almost certain that the True Meaning contained within was highly likely to be the Wood Emperor True Intent.
Yuan Ming had long resolved in his heart that when cultivating the Five Elements Dao Fruit, he must comprehend the top-tier Emperor-level True Intent, as ordinary true intents were simply not up to his standards.
Only by understanding all five types of Emperor-level True Intent could the power of the Five Elements Dao Fruit be elevated to its highest level.
The True Meaning of Dao within this wooden-grain orb was undoubtedly of great reference value to him, even sparking a desire to seize it.
However, he also clearly understood that this treasure was currently in Wu Yu's possession, and with his current strength, it was nearly impossible to snatch it away.
As Yuan Ming struggled internally, a flash of insight suddenly surfaced in his mind, recalling what Xia Jie had once told him.
When the Stealing Heaven Tripod is refined to one hundred levels, it can break through the limitation of only possessing living beings, gaining the ability to possess inanimate objects.
At that time, he might be able to use this possession ability to attach himself to the Wooden Bead and thereby comprehend the True Meaning of Dao within it.
However, at present, the prohibition of the Stealing Heaven Tripod had only been refined to over sixty layers, still a considerable distance from one hundred layers.
Yuan Ming silently decided that in the future, he must pay greater attention to refining the Stealing Heaven Tripod in order to enhance its power.
He gathered his thoughts, focusing entirely on observing Wu Yu's breakthrough process.
To him, this was a rare opportunity to draw upon experience and lay a solid foundation for his own future breakthrough to the Mahayana Realm.
Yet Wu Yu seemed to encounter a bottleneck in her understanding of the Wood True Intent. She embraced the blue-black wooden-grain orb, closing her eyes in thought, showing no progress for a long time.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming expanded his Divine Sense, carefully sensing surrounding other parts of the altar.
He discovered that outside the forbidden area, in three corners, stood three stone halls, each distributed in a triangular fashion, forming a powerful and mysterious presence.
In each of these three halls, a "Wu Yu" sat cross-legged. They were Wu Yu's clones.
These clones bore no difference in appearance from the main body, with similar auras, only their clothing varied.
One wore a blue gauze dress, another a purple robe, and the remaining one wore a light green silk skirt—the clone Yuan Ming was most familiar with.
Yuan Ming had often possessed this light green silk-skirted clone, but each time he woke up in a pitch-black space, seemingly imprisoned within a space artifact.
Today, this clone finally left that mysterious space and emerged into daylight.
"It seems that Wu Yu's main body is unlikely to achieve breakthrough in the short term. I might as well do something else first." Yuan Ming thought internally and withdrew his Divine Sense, concluding this exploration of the Divine Soul.
He returned to the space inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, stepping off the White Jade Lotus Platform and flashing outside.
He took out a stick of Black Incense and placed it in the incense burner, then lit it.
This was Black Incense capable of controlling the body; once ignited, his Divine Soul could possess Wu Yu's light green silk-skirted clone.
After the possession was completed, Yuan Ming immediately began inspecting the storage magic tool of this clone.
Except for some spirit stones, elixirs, and defensive magic treasures, he did not find anything too valuable.
Regarding the secret technique of the clone, it was naturally nowhere to be found.
Yuan Ming felt slightly disappointed but did not give up.
He manipulated this clone, pointing like a knife, and carved a line on the ground in front: "I am the Mahayana Nine Infant of the ancient demon clan, today my soul travels here, seeing you stuck at the Dharma manifestation Stage, unable to enter Mahayana, I feel deeply regretful. Considering the kinship of the same clan, I can pass on to you a secret technique to help you comprehend the Wood True Intent."
After carving this line, he paused briefly and continued to carve: "However, if the technique is passed on lightly, it will surely lead to karma. This clone's secret technique of yours is quite peculiar and can be used for exchange. Prepare your letter, and it will be fulfilled in seven days."
This was his deception strategy, hoping to fool Wu Yu with it.
After leaving these words, he sat down quietly, experiencing the uniqueness of this clone.
But he could not feel much until the Black Incense burned out, at which point his Divine Soul returned to the main body.
Yuan Ming immediately sat back on the White Jade Lotus Platform, using Wei Ling as an anchor, with his Divine Soul overlooking the entire Ten Thousand Demon Ridge.
When his Divine Thought enveloped the hall where the clone was closed off, he found that the words he left not only shocked the clone but also the main body.
At this moment, Wu Yu's main body had already stopped trying to break through to the Mahayana Realm and, together with the Great Sun Glaze Flame, came to the hall where the clone was located.
She looked at the two lines of words on the ground with a serious expression, seemingly pondering who could have done this.
"Are you sure no one has infiltrated here?" Wu Yu's main body asked in a deep voice.
"At least I haven't discovered any abnormalities. I've even gone to ask the Demon Kings guarding the perimeter, and they haven't noticed anything unusual." The clone replied.
"There are sensing arrays set up at the altar and the places where the three corpse avatars are closed off, but none of them issued any warnings." Wu Yu's main body's brows furrowed, a vague unease rising in her heart.
Recalling the strange feeling when she comprehended the Ju Mang Taoist Pearl earlier, she couldn't help but begin to suspect whether someone truly had the ability to infiltrate the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge undetected.
"What do you think of the words on the ground?" Wu Yu's clone asked the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
"Nine Infant? I've never heard of this name. He can assist you and silently infiltrate this place, yet why does he refuse to reveal himself? Such behavior is truly enigmatic." The Great Sun Glaze Flame frowned slightly and said slowly:
"Perhaps he wants to hide his true identity?" the clone suggested.
Wu Yu's main body recalled the classics from the Royal Court and said slowly: "I have read about the name 'Nine Infant' in the classics, it is an ancient strange beast named because it possesses nine forms."
Upon hearing this, the clone's eyes flashed with a hint of joy, and excitedly said: "Could this truly be an elder of the demon clan who has remained hidden from the world? If we can recruit him into the Ten Thousand Demon Country, we will no longer have to fear the Human Clan's cultivators."
"Even if there is truly such a great figure, it may be difficult for him to make a difference. The demon clan's fate in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range has been suppressed by the Heavenly Crane Array, the Mahayana demon clan will be restricted here, making cultivation extremely unfavorable." The Great Sun Glaze Flame sighed and shook his head.
The clone's smile froze immediately, appearing somewhat disappointed.
"Regardless, we must try our best to keep this predecessor." Wu Yu's main body said firmly.
Yuan Ming watched as the three talked more seriously; he secretly rejoiced, feeling that his plan was more than halfway successful.
He noticed Wu Yu placing hope on an ephemeral person, evidently lacking much confidence in breaking through to Mahayana.
At this moment, the Great Sun Glaze Flame spoke again: "Regardless of whether this predecessor wishes to stay, should we engage in the proposed transaction?"ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NoveI-Fire.ɴet
Wu Yu's main body thought for a moment and said: "Naturally, it must proceed. But why does the Nine Infant predecessor want the Three Corpses Split Body Technique?"
Yuan Ming thought to himself, "So that clone's secret technique is called the Three Corpses Split Body Technique."
"Though the Three Corpses Split Body Technique is rare, it shouldn't incite greed in a Mahayana cultivator. I think the Nine Infant predecessor may simply be making an excuse to assist you all." The Great Sun Glaze Flame pondered aloud.
"Could there be secrets within the Three Corpses Split Body Technique that you're unaware of?" the clone suddenly asked.
Wu Yu's main body heard this and fell into contemplative silence, unable to think of any secrets within the Three Corpses Split Body Technique.
She immediately twisted her wrist, taking out a book with a gold cover, and handed it to the Great Sun Glaze Flame, saying: "Let's explore this book together, maybe we can discover something."
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's spirit was instantly lifted, promptly gathering his Divine Sense to probe towards that book.
The book appeared thin, entirely made of very slender jade slices, with "Demon Emperor Jade Scroll" written in four large characters on its cover, appearing ancient and solemn.
Wu Yu pinched her fingers together to invoke a spell, pointing at the Demon Emperor Jade Scroll.
The book with the golden cover immediately flipped its pages "swoosh swoosh," stopping at a middle page.
Written vertically on the left side of that page were a few words, precisely "Three Corpses Split Body Technique."

chapters.title: Chapter 1019 - 984: It's in Hand
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming originally planned to use the Wood Dao Fruit Divine Power as a bargaining chip to exchange for that mysterious secret technique, but unexpectedly, Wu Yu took out the secret technique jade album without hesitation and directly opened it.
In his heart, a wave of surprise surged, feeling as if he had found what he sought without any effort, and he quickly focused his divine sense, delving deeply into it, memorizing the characters recorded on the jade album one by one.
To speak of it, this "Three Corpses Split Body Technique" is vastly different from the commonly seen clone techniques, and even distinct from those body separations formed by splitting the divine soul.
It is more like a heart refining secret technique rather than a simple clone technique.
This art can strip away a person's greed, anger, and ignorance, sealing them into the avatars, forming what is known as the Three Corpse Avatars.
The true intent of the Three Corpses Split Body Technique is not to create avatars, but to sever the three corpse evil roots.
Once the three corpse evil roots are severed, the cultivator's main body can more easily enter a state of tranquility without desires, clarity of spirit, which greatly benefits the cultivation process.
However, if the severed evil roots are not properly managed, they may return to the main body, leading to a complete loss of previous efforts.
It was precisely to address this issue that the predecessors of the Sky Demon Royal Court created this miraculous Three Corpses Split Body Technique.
This clone secret technique is mysteriously unpredictable and exceptionally domineering, capable of completely sealing the three corpse evil roots within the avatars, utterly isolating them from the main body. It is for this reason that it can be possessed by the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
While Yuan Ming meticulously memorized the secret method, Wu Yu and the Great Sun Glaze Flame also carefully perused the jade album, exchanging insights, yet despite their lengthy discussion, they still couldn't grasp its true meaning.
"Rather than blindly speculating like this, it's better to wait for seven days and see if that predecessor will offer exclusive divine skills in exchange," suggested the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
"That's the only way," Wu Yu's main body sighed lightly and put away the Demon Emperor Jade Scroll.
After memorizing the "Three Corpses Split Body Technique," Yuan Ming gently withdrew his invested divine sense, his heart filled with indescribable joy.
He leaped gracefully down from the White Jade Lotus Platform, his steps swift, almost flying as he hurried to Xi Ying's side.
Xi Ying was meditating with closed eyes, surrounded by a faint layer of spiritual energy, as if merging with the heaven and earth.
Yuan Ming's sudden arrival broke this serenity, and Xi Ying abruptly opened her eyes, a trace of doubt flashing in her eyes, and asked, "What are you doing? Why are you in such a hurry?"
Yuan Ming laughed heartily, his eyes flashing with a proud light: "Haha, I've got it!"
"What did you get?" Xi Ying was puzzled, slightly frowning, her crescent moon eyebrows seemingly enchanting.
"The clone secret technique I mentioned earlier."
Yuan Ming couldn't contain his joy, speaking as he engraved the Three Corpses Split Body Technique he just memorized into a jade scroll, handing it to Xi Ying:
"Take a look, this is the secret technique of the Sky Demon Royal Court."
Xi Ying took the jade scroll, her divine sense diving into it, and after a moment, she raised her head, admiration on her face: "The reputation of the Sky Demon Royal Court is truly deserved, producing several Mahayana Demon Ancestors, creating such a wondrous secret technique, truly a blessing for cultivators like us."
Yuan Ming felt a sense of pride in his heart, but then he worriedly asked: "This Three Corpses Secret Technique is extraordinary, requiring high aptitude and determination. Can you master it?"
"Don't worry, ever since my second wisdom awakening, I feel that no difficult secret technique can stump me. Also, after advancing to Life Witch, my soul power has increased significantly, and my comprehension ability has also improved a lot. I can master this Three Corpses Split Body Technique in just a few days," Xi Ying said with a slight smile.
Yuan Ming's expression stiffened upon hearing this.
He clearly remembered the records on the Demon Emperor Jade Scroll, that practicing the Three Corpses Split Body Technique requires gradual progress, and even those with high comprehension and strong will need several years to get started.
But now, hearing Xi Ying claim she could master it in just a few days, he was indeed surprised.
If the demon cultivators of the Ten Thousand Demon Country knew, who knows what they would think.
"Is the Wisdom Awakening Secret Technique of the Hui Clan really that powerful? It makes you so confident. It's making me want to undergo wisdom awakening myself," Yuan Ming mused aloud as he came to.
Xi Ying glanced over Yuan Ming, chuckling: "Your soul power has already become much purer. Once you break through to Life Witch, the hidden issues caused by absorbing Desire Power before should vanish. By then, I can help you awaken your wisdom once."
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's heart stirred and he nodded in agreement.
Xi Ying said no more, closing her eyes and beginning to practice the Three Corpses Split Body Technique.
Yuan Ming, seeing this, didn't disturb her and turned to leave.
...
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, seven days had passed.
Wu Yu was preoccupied with the divine skills of that mysterious predecessor, and while comprehending the Ju Mang Taoist Pearl, her mind was restless, unable to grasp its secrets.
As the agreed-upon day arrived, she hurriedly went to her avatar, hoping that the transaction with the predecessor would proceed as scheduled.
A day and a night passed, and until sunrise on the second day, the figure of the "Nine Infant" predecessor never appeared.
Wu Yu was anxious and pondered to herself: "Could it be that the discussion with the Great Sun Glaze Flame angered the predecessor? Or perhaps the current predicament of the Ten Thousand Demon Country has made the predecessor lose confidence in me?"
After a moment of silence, she suddenly gritted her teeth and took out seven golden copper coins, rapidly forming seals with her hands, chanting incantations.
The seven copper coins flickered up and down in her hands, as if dancing a silent dance.
With the exertion of her mana, her face gradually turned pale, as if drained of color.
Yet in front of her eyes, slender white mist gradually appeared, slowly coalescing into a vague image.
In the scene, the outline of a majestic great city gradually appeared, resembling the White Emperor City.
Wu Yu's face slightly changed color, as if perceiving something from this scene.
At that moment, streams of transparent and twisted crystal light suddenly emerged from the void, dashing towards them like lightning with a sizzling sound.
Wu Yu's expression changed drastically, wanting to stop the divination immediately, but it was already too late.
The crystal lightning shot forth like sharp swords, striking her fiercely.
Wu Yu's body trembled violently, as if hit by a powerful force.
She fell to the ground with her head up, bleeding from all seven orifices, appearing extremely miserable.
The crystal lightning did not last long, disappearing after a single strike.
The white mist also slowly dispersed, with seven copper coins falling to the ground, losing their luster.
The shadow of the Great Sun Glaze Flame suddenly appeared, helping Wu Yu up, with a hint of reproach in her voice: "Your divination skills are not suited for tracking; forcing the calculation will surely trigger fate's backlash. Are you courting death?"
Wu Yu wiped the blood off her face and said softly, "For the future of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, no faint hope can be overlooked..."
Upon hearing this, the Great Sun Glaze Flame sighed and asked, "So what did you divine?"
Wu Yu slowly opened her eyes and said, "I saw the White Emperor City, where the senior Nine Infant who left us the book might be."
Upon hearing this, the Great Sun Glaze Flame showed a solemn expression and looked towards the direction of White Emperor City, as if contemplating something.
After a moment, she asked, "What do you plan to do then?"
Wu Yu closed her eyes, took a deep breath, and said slowly, "Whether that senior Nine Infant is indeed our demon clan's ancestor or someone impersonating, it is unlikely they will appear again. Let's rely on ourselves."
"Indeed so." The Great Sun Glaze Flame nodded.
Wu Yu spent half a day regaining her composure and then went into seclusion to meditate again.
Meanwhile, a different scene was unfolding on Yuan Ming's side.
In just seven days, Xi Ying, through her extraordinary insight, successfully severed greed, refining the first Greed Corpse Avatar.
This avatar, although far weaker than the original body, had acquired cultivation at the Nascent Soul Stage.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed and immediately burned incense to possess it, successfully attaching himself to Xi Ying's avatar, starting to comprehend the Love Inquiry Technique.
The Greed Corpse Avatar not only inherited all of Xi Ying's memories and insight but also possessed the ability due to Xi Ying having surpassed the Life Witch and completed the refinement of the Seven Spirits.
The secret technique for refining the Seven Spirits of the Greed Corpse Avatar was not the Love Inquiry Technique, but such secret techniques were quite similar. Possessing the Greed Corpse, Yuan Ming's sense of the Love Inquiry Technique progressed rapidly.
More than a month later, his Love Inquiry Technique finally reached the Refining Emotion realm, and he started attempting to refine the Seven Spirits.
His Seven Spirits gradually became lively, manifesting in his perception as a dazzling array of colors.
The Spirit of Joy appeared yellow, the Spirit of Anger red, the Spirit of Sorrow blue, the Spirit of Fear black, the Spirit of Love orange, the Spirit of Evil gray, and the Spirit of Desire pink.
The originally colorless and intangible Divine Soul now shimmered like a seven-colored rainbow.
Yuan Ming was engrossed in cultivation when suddenly, his Divine Soul and Dantian trembled violently, with a rumbling sound in the void above his head.
A force of Heaven and Earth Dao Power descended from the heavens, merging into his body.
As it turned out, his Emotion Manipulation Ability, due to the refinement of the Seven Spirits, had reached the Perfect Realm, condensing into a Dao Seal.
This Emotion Manipulation Seal resembled a seven-fingered hand, with each finger representing a different emotion's power.
Not only could it more exquisitely manipulate the Power of Seven Emotions, but it also possessed the Divine Skill of Desire Power aggregation, comparable to Wu Yu's Outer Soul Avatar.
Yuan Ming pondered briefly, channeling the Desire Power within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, divided by the Seven Emotions, into the seven fingers of the Emotion Manipulation Seal.
The Emotion Manipulation Seal immediately radiated seven-colored brilliance, its power swiftly increasing.
"Originally, I planned to condense an Outer Soul Avatar after achieving mastery of the Love Inquiry Technique. Now with this Emotion Manipulation Seal, gathering Desire Power within it is indeed an excellent choice," Yuan Ming mused internally.
He then closed his eyes, continuing to refine the Seven Spirits while channeling Desire Power into the Emotion Manipulation Seal.
As Yuan Ming was about to dive into closed cultivation, the ruins of White Emperor City welcomed the first batch of visiting cultivators.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming was cultivating the Love Inquiry Technique when the Void forcefully woke him.
"Those fixing the Stone Pillar Hongjun have arrived. You need to make contact with them and assist them," the Void's voice echoed in Yuan Ming's ear.
"They really came quickly." Yuan Ming said no more, halted his practice, stood up, and prepared to go out.Read complete version only at novèlfire.net
At this moment, Xi Ying also awoke from her cultivation, frowning as she looked at Yuan Ming.
"I'll go handle this and be back soon," Yuan Ming said to Xi Ying with a smile.
Xi Ying nodded gently without saying more.

chapters.title: Chapter 1020 - 985: Wanxiang Renewed
chapters.content:
The main soul of Yuan Ming slowly returned to its place, and the spirit bean clone seemed infused with new vitality. He gently stepped out of the Stealing Heaven Tripod space, his figure gradually condensing above the ruins of White Emperor City.
All around lay desolation, with broken walls and ruins, where wild grass swayed with the wind, as if telling of the past glory and the current changes.
Not far away, seven or eight cultivators dressed in blue gathered together. Whether male or female, their expressions varied, but they all looked quite curious and eager.
They were surrounding the clone of Daoist Mu, asking about the changes in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range and various questions about the Stone Pillar Hongjun.
Daoist Mu's clone was surrounded by the crowd, frowning slightly, appearing a bit impatient.
Finally, he spoke, saying, "Fellow Daoists, regarding the current situation of the Stone Pillar Hongjun and the changes in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, you should ask Fellow Daoist Yuan. He understands these matters most thoroughly."
"Fellow Daoist Yuan?" Following the voice, the group looked over and found the still standing figure under the giant shade of the World Tree.
Yuan Ming slightly raised his head, his gaze slowly swept over these seven or eight cultivators, all young and talented men and women, the leading one being a young girl in a pink dress.
The girl's face was charming and beautiful, her almond eyes softly smiling, just like a freshly bloomed peach blossom, gently swaying in the spring breeze.
She led the group elegantly towards Yuan Ming, her demeanor exuding a refined quality.For more chapters visit NoveI-Fire.ɴet
"I am Nangong Xian'er, I have met Fellow Daoist Yuan." She slightly bowed to Yuan Ming in greeting.
"I am Yuan Ming, I greet all fellow Daoists." Yuan Ming also cupped his hands in response.
As they spoke, Yuan Ming was overwhelmed by a strange sense of familiarity, seemingly having heard the name "Nangong Xian'er" before, but could not quite trace the origin of this memory.
After exchanging greetings, Yuan Ming led them underground, arriving at the damaged Stone Pillar Hongjun.
The Stone Pillar was covered in the marks of time, with intersecting cracks, as if narrating past vicissitudes.
Nangong Xian'er carefully examined the condition of the Stone Pillar, a hint of surprise flashed in her eyes.
"It turns out that the Stone Pillar Hongjun relies on the divine skills of the World Tree to maintain the operation of the Heavenly Crane Array. It's truly awe-inspiring." She exclaimed sincerely.
"Ultimately, this method is not a long-term solution. We still need to trouble everyone to repair the Stone Pillar Hongjun as soon as possible to ensure the stability of the array." Yuan Ming entrusted.
"The Stone Pillar Hongjun itself has the work of fortune. We simply need to set up a repair formation. Once the formation operates, it can draw upon Earth Spirit Power to gradually repair the pillar. However, this repair process could be quite lengthy." Nangong Xian'er nodded with a serious expression.
"Thank you." Yuan Ming cupped his hands again in thanks.
Afterward, Nangong Xian'er began to direct everyone to set up the formation.
Yuan Ming did not leave, and watched silently from the side, only to see that Nangong Xian'er's technique was skillful, her formation expertise profound, and she was actually a Level 6 Array Master, her formation level nearly reaching the seventh level, which was truly breathtaking.
"This formation is actually composed of three sixth-level arrays nested together, its standard is almost approaching the seventh-level array, it is truly awe-inspiring." Yuan Ming couldn't help but laud it.
Nangong Xian'er heard this, looked at Yuan Ming with some surprise, and asked, "Fellow Daoist Yuan is also proficient in the way of formations?"
Yuan Ming waved his hand and laughed, "I only know a little bit. I have some simplistic ideas, would Fellow Daoist Nangong be willing to hear me out for a bit?"
As soon as he finished speaking, a man in a blue robe beside him said with a hint of mockery, "This repair formation was meticulously improved by Lady Hua Xian and is already top-notch, where is there room for adjustment or improvement?"
This remark surprised Yuan Ming slightly.
He wasn't disturbed by the man's sarcasm, but finally remembered why Nangong Xian'er's name seemed so familiar.
As it turned out, she was one of the three Guardians of the Chuyun Realm, the renowned Lady Hua Xian.
Nangong Xian'er noticed Yuan Ming lost in thought, seemingly contemplating, and apologized for the blue-robed man's rudeness, saying, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, please don't mind him. The way of formations is profound and hard to reach a perfect realm. If you notice any omissions, please feel free to point them out."
Yuan Ming returned from his reverie, and said in a gentle voice, "I think we could incorporate a Level 5 Linked Spirit Array into the existing three sixth-level arrays, which could not only enhance the stability of the formation but also improve the efficiency of Earth Spirit Power conversion."
Nangong Xian'er was surprised upon hearing this, and her gaze towards Yuan Ming carried a bit more respect.
"To be honest, Fellow Daoist Yuan, I also had this thought, but unfortunately, the Linked Spirit Array I have doesn't fit well with the Great Array, so it couldn't fulfill its purpose." Nangong Xian'er confessed.
Yuan Ming gave a slight smile and said, "I happen to have a suitable array."
With that said, he wielded his brush and ink, producing the array and explaining its intricacies.
This Level 5 Linked Spirit Array was a fortuitous find for Yuan Ming in the Three Realms Immortal Boat, and now using it here, it's like the icing on the cake.
Nangong Xian'er witnessed this, her beautiful eyes lit up, and she couldn't help but clap in admiration. She immediately arranged for her people to adjust the formation strategy to incorporate the Level 5 Linked Spirit Array.
This move subtly shifted everyone's attitude towards Yuan Ming, and Nangong Xian'er even more so couldn't stop praising him.
Once the matters of formation were settled, Nangong Xian'er approached Yuan Ming curiously, asking, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, may I ask which sect or faction you belong to?"
Yuan Ming shook his head and was about to speak when a cool voice of Xi Ying suddenly resonated in his Sea of Consciousness:
"Since the matter is resolved, hurry back to cultivate."
Her voice was calm, but Yuan Ming sensed something unusual in it. With a feeling stirring in his heart, he cupped his hands towards Nangong Xian'er and said, "Apologies, since things are settled here, I shall continue my cultivation and take my leave."
With that said, he intended to find a quiet place to return to the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Nangong Xian'er suddenly asked, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, wait a moment, is this World Tree perhaps your handiwork?"
Yuan Ming nodded but did not say more.
"I have a request. I wonder if I could exchange some suitable treasures for a portion of the World Tree?" Nangong Xian'er asked sincerely.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming shook his head and declined politely, "Apologies, this matter involves my secrets, it is indeed difficult to give."
By this point, his deliberately distant attitude was quite clear.
"Then... I won't disturb you further." Hearing this, a look of disappointment flashed in Nangong Xian'er's eyes. However, she did not get angry and turned to busy herself with other matters.
...
A year later.
At the Hongjun Pillar ruins, the traces of past battles gradually faded, replaced by vigorous renewal and vitality.
This land seemed to have undergone a rebirth, once again exuding endless vitality.
Tender green grass emitted a faint spirit light, covering the ground, as if draping it with a brocade robe of emerald green.
Countless flowers bloomed quietly among the green leaves, releasing a delicate fragrance, like the sleeves of a fairy brushing gently, exuding an enchanting aroma.
These flowers and grasses were all personally cultivated by Nangong Xian'er. They not only adjusted the surrounding spiritual energy and promoted the recovery of the spirit vein but also provided great convenience for the restoration of the Hongjun Pillar.
However, the growth of these plants was not easy. Their rapid expansion within a year owed much to the life aura emitted by the World Tree.
During this year, the World Tree, which Yuan Ming had transformed into, also underwent tremendous changes.
Its body became taller and more upright, with lush foliage, and its demonic power reached the Level 6 standard.
But compared to the increase in the World Tree's demonic power, more remarkable was the dense life aura it exuded.
This aura differed from the sinister and dark feeling associated with the Demon Clan of the Ten Thousand Demon Country. Instead, it gave a sense of tranquility and harmony. Bathing in it felt like it could cleanse the soul, providing an extraordinary sense of comfort.
To show respect for this miraculous World Tree, Nangong Xian'er and her group had never approached it, setting up their camp far away and dedicating themselves wholeheartedly to the restoration of the Hongjun Pillar.
The restoration of the Hongjun Pillar was a vast and complex project. Nangong Xian'er and her group did not dare to relax for a moment.
Their comings and goings were incessant, each tasked with their responsibilities, and the camp was bustling with orderly activity.
This external hustle and bustle did not affect Yuan Ming.
He seemed to be in an independent world, unconcerned with external matters, deeply focused on cultivating the Five Elements Dao Fruit.
Throughout the year, Yuan Ming's cultivation never wavered.
He continually comprehended the Five Elements, integrating the mana within him with the Five Elements Power.
And today marked the moment when his achievements would come to fruition.
At some point, Yuan Ming ended his cultivation. When he examined his own body, a hint of joy flashed in his eyes.
At the center of the World Tree, five gourd phantoms quietly floated outside the mana vortex.
The phantoms emitted a faint glow, appearing to contain endless power.
These five gourd phantoms were the initial condensation of Yuan Ming's Five Elements Dao Fruit.
Although only phantoms, they were already intimately connected with Yuan Ming's mana, forming spiritual power veins that integrated into the mana vortex.
After a year of accumulation, Yuan Ming finally grasped the basics and initially condensed the Five Elements Dao Fruit.
Though only initially formed, it still significantly increased Yuan Ming's mana, surpassing the initial level of the Dharma manifestation Stage.
Yuan Ming estimated that once the Five Elements Dao Fruit fully solidified, his cultivation should naturally break through to the mid-stage Dharma manifestation Stage.
Just as Yuan Ming was examining his cultivation achievements, ripples suddenly spread through the void around the World Tree, and Daoist Mu's figure slowly emerged from the void.
He wore a green robe, with hair and beard as white as snow, but his gaze was like a torch, carrying an indescribable majesty.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming's heart tightened, thinking some major event had occurred, and he immediately manifested a wooden man avatar to greet him.
When he saw Daoist Mu's calm expression, and what seemed like a hint of a smile in his eyes, Yuan Ming couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief, inwardly chiding himself for overthinking.
Sure enough, Daoist Mu merely glanced around before explaining his visit: "I sensed an unusual fluctuation of the Five Elements aura here and guessed that you must have achieved something in your retreat, so I came to take a look. How has your cultivation been during this time?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1021 - 986: Daoist Mu's Instructions
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming, hearing this, hastily bowed and replied, "Thanks to the senior's blessing, I have glimpsed the mysteries of the Five Elements Dao Fruit. However, to completely condense it, I fear it will still take some effort."
"Your talent is commendable, and you are diligent. Condensing the Five Elements Dao Fruit is not a difficult task for you. With perseverance, you will surely achieve it," Daoist Mu nodded and encouraged.
"Thank you, senior, for your kind words," Yuan Ming replied respectfully.
Daoist Mu nodded slightly, and suddenly changed the subject with a meaningful inquiry, "But, to breakthrough the Mahayana Realm, merely condensing the Five Elements Dao Fruit is insufficient. Do you have other plans or preparations?"
Yuan Ming was stirred within, about to answer when his expression changed suddenly, lifting his head toward the northwest direction.
In that direction, where the sky had been clear, it suddenly became multicolored, and the boundless Five-Colored Spirit Cloud obscured the horizon, as if a tremendous force was surging.
Daoist Mu also detected the anomaly, furrowing his brows. With a wave, he took Yuan Ming and his wooden man avatar to the sky.
Within the Spirit Cloud, countless Five-Colored Long Dragons appeared and disappeared, roiling and entangling, causing the entire cloud to churn as if boiling.
Above the Spirit Cloud, the Meteor Stream Fire and Mysterious Dark Ice reflected each other, and the Power of Dao collided in the void, erupting with bursts of startling phenomena.
This astounding sight also caught the attention of others in White Emperor City.
The crowd flew into the sky, following Yuan Ming and Daoist Mu, and gazed at the distant spectacle with faces full of uncertainty.
"Senior Mu, what is this phenomenon?" Yuan Ming turned to Daoist Mu and asked.
Daoist Mu gazed deeply at the horizon and replied calmly, "Someone is attempting to breakthrough the Mahayana Realm."
"Who? Could it be the Ten Thousand Demon Empress?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"Who else could it be? It seems the Ten Thousand Demon Country's plans failed, putting considerable pressure on her, forcing her to take this gamble," Daoist Mu nodded and said.
"Aren't you planning to stop her, senior? Adding a Mahayana cultivator from the Demon Clan is not good for the Human Clan," Yuan Ming hastily asked.
Daoist Mu shook his head, speaking lightly, "She is still short of what it takes to breakthrough Mahayana Realm, and the Heavenly Crane Array is not completely destroyed. A hasty breakthrough will most likely fail. We need not interfere much, let things take their course."
Yuan Ming, hearing this, felt somewhat reassured.
At this moment, a floral fragrance suddenly wafted over, and Nangong Xian'er flew behind the two, bowing slightly, "Senior Mu, Fellow Daoist Yuan, you're both here as well."
Daoist Mu nodded and casually asked, "How goes the repair on the Pillar Hongjun?"Googlᴇ search novel⸺fire.net
Nangong Xian'er replied respectfully, "Initial repairs have been completed, it'll take only another month to piece together most of the Pillar Hongjun. Afterward, it will take several decades to fully restore."
"Well done. Once the Stone Pillar Hongjun is pieced together, it will be able to communicate with the underground Spirit Vein and ensure the operation of the Heavenly Crane Array. Then, you can revert to human form and no longer need to suppress in the World Tree form," Daoist Mu nodded in satisfaction.
Yuan Ming felt a surge of happiness and promptly bowed in gratitude.
Even though transforming into a giant tree to suppress wasn't burdensome for him, returning to human form was naturally a preferable choice.
He wouldn't voice this thought but merely kept it to himself.
Seeing she had reported adequately, Nangong Xian'er didn't linger, citing the need to continue overseeing repairs, she took her leave.
After Nangong Xian'er departed gracefully, Daoist Mu suddenly asked, "What do you think of Nangong Xian'er?"
"Fellow Daoist Nangong is clever and insightful, handles affairs with grace, masters nuances perfectly, and her cultivation is outstanding, truly a remarkable talent. Compared to her, Sima Changqin pales considerably," Yuan Ming answered calmly.
Daoist Mu, hearing this, smiled subtly, then directly revealed his thoughts, "Do you have the intention of becoming Daoist companions with her, jointly cultivating the Dao?"
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming could only muster a bitter smile, repeatedly waving his hands, "Senior, please stop teasing me."
Daoist Mu shook his head seriously, "I'm not joking. Becoming Daoist companions with her is mutually beneficial. Her true form is an ancient miraculous flower, the Wangyou Flower, possessing extraordinary effects aiding in the Mahayana breakthrough. Now having cultivated into human form, she has mastered the Wangyou Immortal Sound. This divine skill can be used only once in a lifetime. If you dual cultivate with her, you can receive its divine blessing, enhancing your chances of reaching Mahayana. She too can leverage your Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power to breakthrough again; thus both of you can achieve the Mahayana Realm, wouldn't that be a splendid tale?"
Seeing the earnestness in his expression, Yuan Ming knew he couldn't avoid the matter any longer, sighed deeply, "Senior, you might not know, I already have a Daoist companion, so let's not discuss this further."
Daoist Mu, hearing this, briefly flashed a peculiar expression, glanced subtly at the Stealing Heaven Tripod imprint on his arm, and said no more.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's main soul also stealthily glanced at the meditating Xi Ying.
Seeing she was still immersed in cultivation, without any response, he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
...
Half a month later, Ten Thousand Demon Country.
The sky, where the intricate multicolored Spirit Cloud had been, suddenly churned violently, a heavy snort echoed from the clouds, shaking the entire world.
Subsequently, the Five-Colored Spirit Cloud unraveled like a torn tapestry, disintegrating into strands of spirit light, dissipating into the sky.
This phenomenon instantly alarmed everyone in Ten Thousand Demon Country.
Countless demons looked up at the sky, their eyes filled with wonder and disappointment.
They all knew this represented the failure of the Ten Thousand Demon Empress's breakthrough.
Deep within the Demon Emperor Hall, a group of Level 6 Demon Kings had already gathered.
They saw the celestial phenomena in the sky dissipate, and most of their expressions turned grim.
After all, if the Ten Thousand Demon Empress could successfully break through to the Mahayana realm, it would be an immensely inspiring event for the entire Ten Thousand Demon Country.
Among this group of disappointed Demon Kings, the Electric Roc King and the Flame Wolf King exchanged a furtive glance, a barely perceptible trace of joy flashed in their eyes.
They didn't seem surprised by the Empress's failure, instead, they seemed relieved.
At that moment, a figure suddenly appeared on the throne of the Demon Emperor Hall.
It was none other than Wu Yu, the Ten Thousand Demon Empress.
Her posture hadn't changed from before, but there was a trace of fatigue and disappointment in her eyes.
She glanced around at the Demon Kings and calmly said, "I need to retreat for some time to recuperate. Before I emerge, the Ten Thousand Demon Country will be in lockdown, and all matters will be jointly discussed by you, with final decisions made by the Great Sun Glaze Flame."
Having said this, she turned into a streak of light and disappeared from the great hall before the demons could react.
The Demon Kings were momentarily stunned, then began to discuss among themselves.
They speculated how injured the Empress was and whether she could truly recover.
After all, failing to break through to the Mahayana realm is a significant blow to any cultivator.
After returning to the inner hall, Wu Yu could no longer support herself. She staggered and spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, staining her lapels crimson.
Her aura quickly diminished, turning her complexion a ghastly pale, as if she had lost all vitality.
Her demonic power also waned and plummeted, finally stopping at the mid-stage Level 6.
At this moment, she was no longer the Empress who commanded the Ten Thousand Demon Country, but a severely injured and frail devil cultivator.
Just then, the figure of the Great Sun Glaze Flame instantly appeared beside her, gently supporting her up.
There was intense concern and worry in her eyes, her voice trembling slightly: "Are you alright?"
Wu Yu gave a bitter smile, shaking her head, "At least I'm not dead."
The Great Sun Glaze Flame sighed deeply, "You shouldn't have taken the risk. How are your injuries? How long will it take to recover?"
"It's pointless to talk about this now. I failed in my breakthrough; chaos will likely soon ensue in the Ten Thousand Demon Country. I just made a strong appearance to buy you some time. You must use this time to gather support, at least to confine the chaos within a certain limit." Wu Yu shook her head and said.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame remained silent for a moment before nodding, "I'm aware, you don't need to worry about these things. Just focus on recuperating and rest well."
Wu Yu managed to muster a weak smile on her pale face and nodded.
With the Great Sun Glaze Flame's support, she slowly walked into the seclusion room and began cultivating quietly to heal.
…
Time passed swiftly, and it was soon time for farewells.
Nangong Xian'er and her group were about to embark on their journey home. With the final piece of the Pillar Hongjun perfectly in place, Yuan Ming finally regained his human form from the state of the World Tree.
At the ruins of White Emperor City, the once towering giant tree was gone, replaced by hills and fields of blooming flowers and spirit grass.
The flowers and grasses competed in splendor amidst the ruins, filling the desolate place with vibrant life.
Outside the ruins, Hua Xian and the others had packed up, ready to set out.
However, Nangong Xian'er seemed to be waiting for someone, her gaze tinged with anticipation.
On a distant mountain, Daoist Mu's clone stood quietly, hands behind his back, gazing thoughtfully at the ruins of White Emperor City.
Beside him, Yuan Ming stood by silently, not daring to be negligent.
Suddenly, Daoist Mu spoke, his voice low and firm, "I've already discussed with Bing Lan and the others. For the days to come, you will temporarily assume the position of White Emperor City Lord, overseeing the affairs of the Nineteen Cities in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range."
Yuan Ming was not surprised by these words and replied respectfully, "Yes, Senior."
Daoist Mu nodded slightly and continued, "The position of city lord of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range carries a heavy responsibility. There aren't many requirements, but there is one iron rule you must strictly follow."
Yuan Ming cupped his hands and said, "Please enlighten me, Senior."
Daoist Mu, with a piercing gaze, said solemnly, "No matter what happens, you must always guard the Pillar Hongjun and not leave the confines of the city without authorization. This is your duty and your mission. If you wish to step down, you must ensure a smooth handover and leave only after the next city lord takes office."

chapters.title: Chapter 1022 - 987: Summons
chapters.content:
"I will definitely remember the teachings of my senior and not let you down. However, how should I oversee the affairs of the Nineteen Cities?" Yuan Ming asked with confusion.
Daoist Mu smiled faintly and, with a wave of his hand, a Black Wood Token floated down like a falling leaf into Yuan Ming's hand.
This token was no bigger than a palm but exuded an archaic and profound aura.
"This is the Demon City Lord Token, carried by every City Lord throughout the generations. All you need to do is refine it, and you can coalesce a clone, allowing you to communicate with other City Lord Tokens at any time and instantaneously appear in any city. This way, contacting various places and handling affairs will be effortless."
Following the instructions, Yuan Ming refined the token and immediately felt a mysterious connection established between his mind and the token.
With a thought, he instantly sensed the exact locations of the other eighteen tokens.
With another casting of magic, a clone appeared beside him, identical to his original self, but with limited power and unable to engage in combat.
Seeing that Yuan Ming had grasped the essentials, Daoist Mu nodded in satisfaction.
Then he turned around, raised his hand, and a large azure flag appeared out of thin air, fluttering loudly in the air.
With a gentle wave of the flag, the devastated ground of White Emperor City seemed to reverse in time, with broken walls and ruins trembling and automatically repairing themselves.
In a short time, with bricks and tiles flying and the ground rising and falling, a brand new White Emperor City sprung up.
Looking around, Yuan Ming saw the city's streets neatly arranged and the pavilions towering, even the Teleportation Array had been completed, requiring only a few Spirit Stones to activate.
However, most of the other arrays in the city were missing, indicating that the spiritual treasure in Mu Daoist's hand could only restore buildings and the Teleportation Array, unable to truly turn back time.
"Therefore, you don't need to start rebuilding from scratch. I will send people to spread the news of the reconstruction of White Emperor City. Soon, cultivators will come, and you only need to focus on managing." Daoist Mu said plainly, putting away the flag.
"Thank you, senior, for your gracious help." Yuan Ming bowed deeply to Daoist Mu.
"No need for excessive courtesy. Later, I will inform the other City Lords to send their clones here to see you. Regarding the specific time, you can inform them through the Demon City Lord Token." Daoist Mu waved his hand dismissively.
Yuan Ming hurriedly agreed.
"Now that things are settled, it's time for me to leave. Yuan Ming, remember, what you shoulder is not just a city, but the heritage and lifeline of the Human Clan. Under no circumstances should it be lost." Daoist Mu looked at the sky and said solemnly.
After speaking, Daoist Mu, with Hua Xian and others, slowly departed.
Watching their departure, Yuan Ming had the urge to ask Daoist Mu to stay here for a while longer, but after a moment's hesitation, he did not express his thoughts and instead watched as Daoist Mu's clone left.
His reputation was not renowned, and his achievements were mostly unspoken deeds. Upon hearing that a Mahayana cultivator wanted him to oversee the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, other City Lords would certainly not be convinced.
Whether testing or provoking, although they couldn't openly seize White Emperor City from him, their covert methods were unpredictable.
Yuan Ming understood that this was precisely the trial Daoist Mu left for him.
If he couldn't even defend White Emperor City, how could he talk about managing the entire Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range and becoming the leader of the Human Clan here?
Yuan Ming quickly made up his mind, and after Daoist Mu's figure completely disappeared from sight, he activated the City Lord Token to send a message to all City Lords.
"Ten days later, I will be awaiting you all in White Emperor City." Yuan declared.
