Ten days later, inside the Transmission Hall of White Emperor City.
A burst of spirit light suddenly appeared, transforming into a figure that steadily appeared at the center of the Teleportation Array.
Leading the way was a kindly middle-aged Great Scholar. As he stepped down from the array and glanced around, he noticed someone already waiting quietly nearby.
The middle-aged Great Scholar walked forward, cupped his hands, and said, "Apologies, apologies, some matters in the city delayed me, so I'm a bit late."
The person turned around, revealing a long-bearded elder in a Daoist robe who smiled gently, "No matter, City Lord Yuan's affairs are numerous; I also just arrived not long ago."
Although the two did not emit the slightest wave of Mana, appearing just like ordinary people, any cultivator long accustomed to the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range would immediately recognize them as the renowned City Lords of Zhen Shan City and Yeque City.
At this moment, Sikong Zhan, who had been waiting on the side, stepped forward and respectfully saluted the two, saying, "Esteemed sirs, City Lord Yuan has already prepared a banquet in the city and has specifically sent me to welcome you. Please follow me."
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged Great Scholar felt slightly displeased but did not show it. He just snorted coldly before following Sikong Zhan with the long-bearded elder out of the Transmission Hall.
As the three stepped out of the great hall, the view of White Emperor City unfolded before their eyes.
The streets were neatly arranged, the towers towering, the city flourishing with flowers and shaded by green trees, a scene full of vitality.
Upon seeing this, a trace of surprise flashed in their eyes.
"I've heard that not long ago White Emperor City suffered a great disaster and became a ruin, but now it seems to be mere rumors," the middle-aged Great Scholar whispered.
"No, I have sent people to investigate, at that time White Emperor City was indeed a ruin. I think Senior Mu must have intervened and used the power of the Creation Flag to reshape this city," the long-bearded elder shook his head slightly and said in a deep voice.
"Creation Flag? That legendary treasure refined by Senior Mu, with the effect of reversing time and reopening the world. To see it today is truly fortunate, making this trip worthwhile," the middle-aged Great Scholar exclaimed in awe upon hearing this.
"I was fortunate enough to witness Senior Mu wield this flag, although not as miraculous as the rumors, but to reshape White Emperor City clearly shows Senior Mu's regard for City Lord Yuan," the long-bearded elder nodded gently and said.
The middle-aged Great Scholar still felt somewhat dissatisfied, frowning: "What good is his regard? The Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is a critical area for guarding the Demon Clan, how can Yuan Ming, a newly advanced loose cultivator, bear the responsibility of guarding the Hongjun Pillar? Furthermore, he also dreams of taking over the jurisdiction of the entire Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. If failure occurs, who can bear this responsibility?"
The long-bearded elder remained silent, though he agreed in his heart, he did not voice his support.
He looked up at the sky, suddenly his expression changed, and he transmitted his voice: "Old Qi, look above."
The middle-aged Great Scholar looked up and saw a colorful light shield above White Emperor City, tightly protecting the entire city.
On the light shield, shadows of Five Elements Techniques constantly flickered, like a true dragon swimming and a phoenix soaring, with an overwhelming aura that made people tremble in fear.
He frowned and said: "There are no Demon Clan wandering outside the city, yet Yuan Ming specifically activated the City Protection Array, seems he's trying to give us a demonstration!"
"It's more than just a demonstration, Old Qi, this array I've seen in an ancient text, named 'Five Elements Reverse Disaster Array,' it is a sixth-level array. Once activated, it can control the Five Element Spiritual Energy over the entire area, evolving various techniques to confront adversaries, and cannot be broken unless a Mahayana cultivator personally intervenes!" the long-bearded elder tugged at his beard.
"What, a sixth-level array? How is that possible, he's just a loose cultivator, how could he lay down such an array? Could it be that Senior Mu helped him too?" the middle-aged Great Scholar found it hard to hide his expression.
The long-bearded elder shook his head, his eyes flickered: "Unlikely, the scent of this array is completely different from Senior Mu's, it has its unique rhythm and strength."
A surge of indescribable shock rose within them, for the rest of the journey, they tacitly chose silence, what they each thought in their hearts, was not to be spoken to outsiders.
Soon after, they arrived at the council hall of the City Lord Mansion.
Upon entering, they saw that the other City Lords had mostly arrived, and they were the last to come.
Yuan Ming sat calmly at the top of the hall, and when he saw the two arriving, he merely lifted his hand slightly, signaling them to sit.
The middle-aged Great Scholar and the long-bearded elder complied and took their seats, soon acquaintances among the City Lords sent them transmitted greetings.
At this moment, Yuan Ming stood up, his voice like a great bell, echoing throughout the hall: "Since everyone is present, let's officially start the meeting. I am Yuan Ming, early-stage Dharma manifestation, early-stage Undying Body, late-stage Word Witch. Entrusted by Senior Mu, I temporarily serve as White Emperor City Lord, overseeing affairs of the Ten Thousand Demon Nineteen Cities. If you have any questions, feel free to raise them."
These words caused the hall to suddenly boil over.
"City Lord Yuan has great talents and is favored by the Great Mahayana Ancestor, we ought to trust him. However, this place is the theater of conflict between the Human and Demon clans, not to be taken lightly. City Lord Yuan has just arrived, perhaps you should understand the situation first before overseeing affairs?"
"Indeed, City Lord Yuan has just arrived, surely there are many things you don't understand. In my opinion, it would be wise to first visit each city, familiarize yourself with the situation."
"White Emperor City has just been rebuilt, the talents under City Lord Yuan are not yet complete, the pressing matter should be the revival of White Emperor City, rather than overseeing the affairs of the demons."
The eighteen City Lords spoke one after another, although their words were polite, the undertones revealed their disapproval of Yuan Ming overseeing affairs. Only a few remained silent, giving no opinion.
Yuan Ming did not get angry at this, instead he smiled cheerfully at everyone, as if he was looking at a treasury of moving human-shaped treasures.
After a moment, he waved his hand to stop further discussion, saying: "What you all said is very reasonable. However, I am entrusted by the Great Mahayana Ancestor, I have no choice but to comply. Why not this, let each of you display your cultivation situation first and write down your adept Magical Powers along with True Intent for me to understand."
Upon hearing this, the City Lords found it somewhat strange, but considering that Yuan Ming was appointed by Daoist Mu as the overseer of Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, the request was not excessive, so they proceeded to write down their information and handed it to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming took the jade scrolls handed by the crowd, and after checking them one by one, his smile grew wider.
"Good, you truly are the elite talents guarding the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, your reputations are indeed well-deserved. I've got a comprehensive understanding of the situation. As one of the City Lords just said, from now on I will focus on reviving White Emperor City. Please, when you return, continue managing your city as before. If any unsolvable problems arise, come to me."
Upon hearing this, the crowd felt even more confused, but seeing that Yuan Ming had no intention to infringe upon their interests, they temporarily eased their hearts, and all expressed that they would surely follow Yuan Ming's lead in the future.
Yuan Ming naturally did not believe their empty promises, but on the surface, he portrayed an image of being deeply moved.
After a few more pleasantries exchanged, they all took their leave one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 1023 - 988: Staying
chapters.content:
A few months later, Hua Zhi and Vajra, two demons, flew to White Emperor City.
Looking at the towering city gate, Hua Zhi's eyes flashed with excitement, and she couldn't help but say: "Haha, we finally made it. White Emperor City is indeed extraordinary. Just look at its grandeur; it's more magnificent than any city in the Extreme East Sea Domain."
Vajra silently followed beside her, his gaze sweeping over the city, seeing the bustling crowds and shops lining both sides of the street, presenting a scene of prosperity.
He couldn't help but scratch his head, puzzled, and said: "Didn't our master say that White Emperor City was in need of development and particularly short of people? It's so lively now, it really surprises me."
Hearing this, Hua Zhi shook her head and laughed, "Oh Vajra, you don't know. This Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is a treasure land that countless cultivators want to come to for hunting demons and treasure hunting. As long as the word gets out, White Emperor City will naturally not lack popularity."
As the two were talking, they suddenly saw a Dharma Manifestation Cultivator approaching them, and they immediately became vigilant.
When the cultivator got closer, he cupped his hands to them and said, "There's no need for alarm, I am Wang Fulong, ordered by Master Yuan Ming to wait for the two of you here for a long time."
Feeling a trace of Yuan Ming's aura from Wang Fulong, Hua Zhi and Vajra immediately relaxed and followed him into the city, heading straight for the City Lord Mansion.
Inside the City Lord Mansion, Yuan Ming sat at the main seat, smiling as he saw Hua Zhi and Vajra arrive.
Upon seeing Yuan Ming, Hua Zhi joyfully rushed forward, saying in a sweet voice, "Master, I missed you so much."
Yuan Ming smiled, patting her head, and then turned his gaze to Vajra, asking, "Did you encounter any trouble on the way?"
Vajra honestly shook his head and said, "We followed Master's instructions, disguised ourselves the whole way, and flew from the wilderness without passing through Human Clan's cities. Aside from some blind demon beasts, we didn't encounter any trouble."
Yuan Ming nodded slightly and then asked, "And the items I asked you to bring?"
Upon hearing this, Hua Zhi quickly took out a small Jade Box from her arms and presented it with both hands: "Master, all the auxiliary materials for refining the Dharma Manifestation Pill are here."
Yuan Ming took the Jade Box, opened it, and saw various rare spiritual materials inside, all necessary for refining the Dharma Manifestation Pill.
He nodded in satisfaction and then said to Wang Fulong, "Go and fetch Master Dian."
Wang Fulong took his leave, and Hua Zhi looked at his back, curiously asking, "Master, is he a new believer you have taken in?"
Yuan Ming nodded and briefly recounted his experiences after arriving in White Emperor City.
Hua Zhi listened with eyes wide open, her face full of admiration.
In no time, Dian Xiaosan came in and gave Yuan Ming a salute.Read complete version only at novèlfire.net
Yuan Ming pointed to the spiritual materials on the table, saying, "Master Dian, the auxiliary spiritual materials have arrived. Please go ahead and refine another batch of Dharma Manifestation Pills."
Dian Xiaosan agreed, took the materials, and returned to the alchemy room.
After he left, Hua Zhi couldn't wait to speak: "Master, you must be too busy with your cultivation to manage White Emperor City, right? Why not let me take over? With my experience running the Holy Spirit Association, I am confident I can manage White Emperor City effectively!"
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming pondered for a moment.
He knew that although Hua Zhi was lively by nature, she had considerable ability and means when it came to management.
Thus, he nodded and said, "Very well, but the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is not quite like the Extreme East Sea Domain, and there's a lot of hostility towards the Demon Clan. Remember to suppress your demon energy daily, and don't let others discover your identity. Moreover, the situation here is quite complex, so you should also consult Wang Fulong's opinions after taking over."
Hua Zhi agreed wholeheartedly, looking excited.
"When you left the Extreme East Sea Domain, how did you arrange for the Holy Spirit Association?" Yuan Ming asked proactively upon seeing this.
"Some of them were willing to follow me, so I brought them with me, and now they are camped outside the city. As for those unwilling to leave, I left a few trustworthy people to continue operating the forces in the Extreme East Sea Domain," Hua Zhi replied.
"Good, assign the Human Clan's cultivators among them into the city for use. As for the Demon Clan's cultivators, let them infiltrate the Ten Thousand Demon Country and monitor the happenings there," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
Hua Zhi patted her chest with confidence and said, "Understood, leave it to me!"
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, then turned his gaze to Vajra, seemingly about to ask about his plans.
At this point, Hua Zhi suddenly remembered another matter:
"Oh, Master!"
Hua Zhi's crisp voice held a hint of excitement: "When we passed through Yin Mountain City, Lord Yin Lang specifically recommended someone to us, named 'Qiu Nu'. She has remarkable talent, and Lord Yin Lang feels it's a waste to keep her by his side, so he wants us to bring her here to learn from you."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but show a bit of curiosity: "Oh? Where is she now?"
"I have already arranged for her to camp with the Holy Spirit Association outside the city. Please wait a moment, Master, and I will bring her here," Hua Zhi said and then lightly turned to leave.
Soon, Hua Zhi returned with a young girl in green clothes.
The girl was about sixteen, possessing Foundation Establishment Cultivation, with a baby face that made her appear quite innocent.
When Hua Zhi led her into the room, she appeared slightly nervous, glanced at Yuan Ming, and quickly lowered her head, respectfully giving a salute.
"Yin Lang said you have outstanding talent. What specific abilities do you possess?" Yuan Ming's tone was calm and gentle.
Qiu Nu nervously replied, "Sir, I possess a Wood Attribute Heavenly Spirit Root and awakened at a young age with the ability to communicate with plants."
Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows, feeling intrigued.
He gently placed his hand on Qiu Nu's shoulder. As spiritual power flowed, he confirmed the truth of her words.
Indeed, she was a rare girl with a Wood Attribute Heavenly Spirit Root.
Retracting his hand, Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and then sent someone to summon Ye Xinyao.
When Ye Xinyao arrived, Yuan Ming briefly explained Qiu Nu's talent and abilities and instructed, "Take her to verify the specific effects of her talent. If confirmed, let her follow you to learn how to become a Spirit Plant Master."
Ye Xinyao nodded in agreement. As she turned to Qiu Nu, a flicker of curiosity and anticipation flashed in her eyes.
After Ye Xinyao and Qiu Nu left, Yuan Ming turned his gaze back to Vajra and asked, "Vajra, what are your plans next?"
Vajra thought for a moment and replied, "I plan to continue hunting demon beasts in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range to train myself."
Yuan Ming nodded in agreement, "Very well, then go ahead. However, keep an eye on the Ten Thousand Demon Country for me, especially to see if they still have any connections with the Demon World."
Vajra nodded in response and then withdrew with Hua Zhi.
Yuan Ming also stood up and left, heading to the Shura Palace to seek out Xi Hezi.
Upon entering the Shura Palace, Yuan Ming immediately saw Xi Hezi meditating in practice.
He approached and gently called out, "Xi Hezi, how is the refining of the Innate Bitter Bamboo going?"
Xi Hezi slowly opened her eyes, a smile appearing on her face, "It has long been refined."
As she spoke, she waved her hand, and a delicate Jade Box gently floated into Yuan Ming's hand.
Yuan Ming opened the Jade Box to find a wooden hairpin about five inches long.
The head of the hairpin was carved into the shape of a phoenix, its wings intricately outlined with golden threads. The phoenix's mouth held a white-petaled Dao Flower, and the entire hairpin was both delicate and exquisite.
Yuan Ming gently picked up the hairpin and infused it with a bit of mana. Instantly, a peaceful power surged through his body, making him feel calm and serene as if all distracting thoughts had been swept away.
The effect of this wooden hairpin was indeed several times better than the previous Innate Bitter Bamboo Leaf.
Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction, putting away the hairpin. He praised Xi Hezi, "Excellent, Xi Hezi, your artifact refining skills have never disappointed me."
"Naturally. It's a pity that the piece of Innate Bitter Bamboo you have is only ten thousand years old. If it were to grow to a hundred thousand years, and I were to refine it, the Spiritual Treasure produced could significantly aid in breaking through to the Mahayana Realm." Xi Hezi lamented with some regret.
"Is that true? However, waiting for it to grow to a hundred thousand years might take quite some time." Yuan Ming was pleased but quickly showed a slight difficulty.
"Treasure necessary for a breakthrough to the Mahayana is not so easily obtained. At least you see a glimmer of hope, which is far beyond the ordinary." Xi Hezi comforted.
Yuan Ming sighed and nodded as well.
...
Half a month later, sunlight filtered through the window lattice, dappled across the Alchemy Room.
The rising elixir vapor intertwined with the sunlight above the Alchemy Furnace, exuding a faint glow.
Dian Xiaosan took a deep breath and waved his hand, a stream of air burst out, lifting the lid of the Furnace.
With a gesture from afar, a pellet floated out and gently fell into the Purple Sandalwood Box prepared nearby.
Cautiously cradling the box, Dian Xiaosan gently placed it into Yuan Ming's hand.
With closed eyes, Yuan Ming sensed the rich spiritual power contained within the elixir through the gap of the box, a satisfied smile appearing on his face.
He put away the box and turned his gaze to Dian Xiaosan, only to find him hesitating, standing in place rather than leaving as usual.
"Master Dian, is there anything else?" Yuan Ming asked in some confusion.
Dian Xiaosan was silent for a moment, finally mustering the courage to speak, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, the century-long agreement between us is nearing its end."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was moved and then smiled, "Master, are you worried that I will not honor our agreement and not grant you freedom after a hundred years?"
"Fellow Daoist, you misunderstand. I never meant that. Over the years, Fellow Daoist Yuan has treated me like a friend, even generously giving me opportunities, an kindness I cherish deeply. To be honest, though the Chuyun Realm is vast, people like you who treat me so well are rare. Once the century agreement is fulfilled, you promised me freedom, but after much thought, I feel that continuing to follow you is the better choice." Dian Xiaosan shook his head repeatedly and said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt a warmth in his heart and replied with a smile, "I see, Master Dian is willing to stay, which naturally makes me happy."
Dian Xiaosan expressed gratitude on his face but then showed a hint of difficulty, "Actually, there is one more thing I find hard to mention, but after careful consideration, I hope Fellow Daoist Yuan can help me with it."
"Master, feel free to speak. As long as it's within my abilities, I will certainly do my best to assist." Yuan Ming said with a slight smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1024 - 989: Farewell
chapters.content:
Dian Xiaosan hesitated for a moment, finally mustering the courage to say: "I have been stuck at the Returning to Void Stage for many years, always yearning to break through to the Dharma Manifestation Realm, but have never been able to fulfill this wish. These years, I've assisted Fellow Daoists in refining the Dharma Manifestation Pill, gaining some insights, yet I always feel there's just a slight gap missing. Therefore…"
He blushed all over at this point, appearing somewhat embarrassed.
Yuan Ming, understanding his intent, continued for him: "So, the Master hopes I can lend you a helping hand by preparing the materials to refine a Dharma Manifestation Pill?"
Dian Xiaosan nodded repeatedly, saying: "Indeed, I hope Fellow Daoist will fulfill this request."
Yuan Ming pondered slightly, finding Dian Xiaosan's request not unreasonable, just about to agree when a subtle voice transmission reached his ears. He furrowed his brow slightly, a trace of doubt flashing in his eyes, yet he didn't show a hint on his face.
After thinking for a while, he didn't directly agree to Dian Xiaosan's request: "While the Master's conditions are indeed reasonable, I have a better proposal here."
Upon hearing this, Dian Xiaosan lifted his head in confusion, looking at Yuan Ming.
At this moment, Yuan Ming flipped his hand, revealing a jade scroll in his palm.
"Inside is a Soul Cultivation Method I've modified, called 'Moonlight Technique', consisting of six layers. Compared to typical Soul Cultivation Methods, it takes an unusual path; although it doesn't allow you to employ Divine Soul Transformation and other soul cultivation methods, in contrast, it is extremely fast in cultivation with no bottlenecks. You only need elixirs that enhance Soul Power to quickly reach the Life Witch level." Yuan Ming explained in detail.
Dian Xiaosan, upon hearing this, felt slightly hesitant but soon fell into contemplation.
After a moment, he worriedly furrowed his brows: "This method may rapidly increase soul power, but without accompanying Divine Skills, even reaching the Realm of Life Witch, isn't it still hard to compete with magic practitioners?"
"Fellow Daoist's words are indeed correct. But if I can help you break through to the Seventh-level Alchemist realm, wouldn't that be even more advantageous when combined?" Yuan Ming smiled slightly.
Upon hearing the words "Seventh-level Alchemist," a fiery gleam flashed in Dian Xiaosan's eyes.
He asked excitedly: "Is what Fellow Daoist said true?"
"I can swear as a testament." Yuan Ming said solemnly.
"I trust Fellow Daoist won't disappoint me." After contemplating briefly, Dian Xiaosan finally made up his mind.
Yuan Ming handed the jade scroll to Dian Xiaosan and smiled: "Please diligently cultivate this method, on the day you succeed, I shall assist you in breaking through to the alchemist realm."
After Dian Xiaosan left, the smile on Yuan Ming's face gradually faded, replaced by a faint trace of helplessness.
He sighed lightly, thinking silently: "Senior Kong, I've made the promise to Dian Xiaosan as you instructed. Should he ultimately fail to become a Seventh-level Alchemist, I fear offending him."
At this moment, Kong's voice rang in his ear: "Rest assured, with my assistance, Dian Xiaosan will certainly break through to the Seventh-level Alchemist realm."
After speaking, a mysterious message subtly flooded into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming, carefully savoring this message, showed a hesitant expression: "This method demands much; Dian Xiaosan might not agree."
"He will agree." Kong's voice conveyed irrefutable confidence.
Although Yuan Ming still had doubts in his heart, recalling Kong's previous words were never wrong, his hesitation gradually dissipated.
He temporarily set aside the matter, carrying the Dharma Manifestation Pill and the bitter bamboo wooden hairpin, turned to seek Xi Ying.
Xi Ying was currently cultivating in seclusion; seeing Yuan Ming's arrival, she did not spend time on formalities.
She took the Dharma Manifestation Pill and bitter bamboo wooden hairpin from him, showing a satisfied smile.
"I need some time to prepare; at most half a year later, I will attempt a breakthrough." Xi Ying explained her plan to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming nodded, softly saying: "You just focus on cultivation; I will protect you here."
...
Half a year later.
The peaceful White Emperor City suddenly became tense; the originally quiet streets were empty, and every household had their doors and windows tightly shut, as if a great enemy was approaching.
The City Protection Array operated at full power, emitting layers of brilliance, safeguarding the entire city meticulously.
The cultivators within the city were anxious, speculating what significant event could be causing White Emperor City to be on such high alert.
Suddenly, the earth trembled fiercely, as if a colossal entity was about to awaken.
Immediately, spiritual clouds quickly gathered above the sky, seemingly summoned by something.
Meanwhile, a terrifying aura shot up from the City Lord Mansion, like a stormy sea, sweeping across the entire city.
Only then did the people realize that a powerful figure was breaking through to the Dharma Manifestation Realm in the City Lord Mansion!
This full-city lockdown was actually to protect this person's breakthrough.
The phenomenon of breakthrough did not last long, but the majestic ambiance lingered long in memory.
As the nature's spiritual energy converged, a female emperor's Dharma manifestation gradually formed in the sky above White Emperor City.
Draped in luxurious attire, with an exquisite beauty, her eyes shone like torches, exuding an indescribable majesty and dignity.
Everyone gazed up at the female emperor's Dharma manifestation, their faces filled with awe.
The female emperor's Dharma manifestation scanned in all directions, finally settling on a corner of the City Lord Mansion.
A hint of joy flashed in her eyes, and she transformed into a streak of light, vanishing into the air.
With the disappearance of the female emperor's Dharma manifestation, the pressure over the city dissipated instantly.
With their senses returning, people began whispering and guessing the identity of the breakthrough individual.
At this moment, inside the City Lord Mansion, Xi Ying stood smilingly in front of Yuan Ming, her aura of Dharma manifestation naturally exuding, as if to flaunt her achievements to Yuan Ming.
"I've just broken through the Dharma manifestation Realm, not sure how much stronger I've become. How about we spar a bit?" Xi Ying proposed, her face full of eagerness.
"Sure, but I can't leave White Emperor City. Let's spar in the Shura Palace," Yuan Ming smiled slightly, not declining the invitation.
In an instant, the two figures vanished from their spot, reappearing inside the Shura Palace.
After sparring, both felt satisfied.
Yuan Ming not only witnessed Xi Ying's growth in strength but also found his shortcomings during the spar.
In the following days, the two stayed closely together, with Yuan Ming taking the opportunity to help Xi Ying stabilize her cultivation.
It wasn't until a few days later that they had some free time to sit down and discuss their future plans.
"In a while, I will return to the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce," Xi Ying said suddenly while half-lying in Yuan Ming's arms.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming felt a wave of sorrow in his heart, and after a moment of silence, he asked, "Can't you stay?"This text is hosted at Nove1Fire.net
Xi Ying sat up straight, speaking earnestly, "After breaking through the Dharma manifestation Realm, I am now qualified to enter the Elder Council. Now is the time to gather allies and gradually grasp power. Staying here makes it hard to participate in the power struggles within the Chamber of Commerce. The Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce ranks in the top three in the Chuyun Realm; giving up this opportunity would be a real shame."
Yuan Ming sighed helplessly, saying, "I know your decision is right; it's just that we've been apart for too long, and our time together is so short."
"It's okay; once I've established myself in the Chamber of Commerce, I'll naturally come back to find you," Xi Ying gently caressed Yuan Ming's cheek, comforting him.
Yuan Ming held her hand tightly, embracing her, "Alright, you go ahead. But if you ever encounter any trouble out there, be sure to tell me, and I'll be there to help you at once."
Xi Ying nodded slightly, snuggling into Yuan Ming's embrace like a kitten.
"By the way, any updates on the follow-up content of the Moonlight Technique?" After a while, Yuan Ming suddenly remembered something and asked.
"Not yet. I still only have the Seventh Layer's mnemonic. Perhaps I can only seek it from the Bright Moon Palace, but I haven't had much contact with them yet," Xi Ying shook her head, saying somewhat helplessly.
"Nan Shangfeng seems to have some connections with the Bright Moon Palace; you can try to start from there," Yuan Ming said after a moment of contemplation.
"I know. You mentioned this clue to me before; I'll keep it in mind. I will handle the matter of the follow-up cultivation technique; you don't need to worry too much. If I really need your help, I won't hesitate to ask," Xi Ying nodded.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming felt somewhat relieved.
He thought for a moment, then took out a Storage Ring and a Jade Scroll and handed them to Xi Ying, "The ring contains thirty Vow Power Pills. Using the Great Wish of All Living Beings last time was truly risky, and unless absolutely necessary, you must not use it again. If you do need to use it, remember to take a Vow Power Pill first to prevent harming yourself from insufficient Desire Power."
Xi Ying nodded gently, placing the ring into her sleeve, then took out the Jade Scroll and began carefully reading its contents.
"Seven-Colored Flower, Heavenly Spirit Water, Star Iron... these materials..." Xi Ying furrowed her brows, her eyes showing confusion.
The materials listed on the Jade Scroll were all extraordinarily precious, with not only a large number but also of high quality, Seventh-level Spiritual Materials like stars scattered, dazzling the eyes.
"Some of these are auxiliary materials for refining Enlightenment Pills and Dharma Manifestation Pills, while the rest are needed for refining Spiritual Treasures. Xi Ying, when you go back, see if you can help me gather them," Yuan Ming said with an awkward smile.
"So many spiritual materials, and they're not cheap. Even selling the entire Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce might not be enough to gather them," Xi Ying's beautiful eyes widened in surprise:
"Just collect them; as for the Spirit Stones, I have my own clever ways," Yuan Ming waved his hand confidently.
Although still concerned, Xi Ying put away the Jade Scroll and then took out a new Jade Scroll, handed it to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming took the Jade Scroll, finding it contains detailed management plans for White Emperor City and the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
The content was detailed and well-organized, especially the suggestions for buying and selling within the city to earn Spirit Stones, which were truly eye-opening.
"I organized this during my secluded cultivation; it should be of help to you," Xi Ying said with a hint of pride.
As Yuan Ming flipped through the Jade Scroll, a look of joy appeared in his eyes, "This is really a timely help! I was worrying about how to manage the forces; with this plan, White Emperor City's development now has a direction. Xi Ying, you truly are my wise companion!"
Saying this, he couldn't help but gently kiss Xi Ying on the forehead.
A blush spread across Xi Ying's face as she playfully punched Yuan Ming, but seeing his joyful expression, her eyes also revealed satisfaction and joy.
The two sat embracing, enjoying the rare moment of peace.
However, a thought suddenly arose in Yuan Ming's mind.
"Xi Ying, before you leave, there's another matter I need your help with."

chapters.title: Chapter 1025 - 990: Ring Complete
chapters.content:
Xi Ying lifted her head slightly, looking at Yuan Ming with confusion.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, and slowly revealed his plan: "You should have already seen the golden palace within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, right? I have a spiritual treasure that is said to be able to forcibly break through a seven-level magic array. But with my strength alone, it's difficult to unleash its maximum power; I need the assistance of several Dharma manifestation experts."
Upon hearing this, a flash of understanding appeared in Xi Ying's eyes.
She sat upright, sincerely nodding her head, indicating her willingness to assist.
However, relying solely on the power of her and Yuan Ming was still insufficient.
After a slight consideration, Yuan Ming decided to invite Wang Fulong, Zheng Heng, and He Xiuwen to help.
To ensure confidentiality, Yuan Ming first blocked the five senses of the three, then set up an illusion array inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod to obscure the scene within, and only then brought them into the tripod.
Soon, Yuan Ming led everyone to the pre-arranged Melding Spirit Array, each finding a place to sit down.
Yuan Ming gazed at the golden palace from a distance, took another deep breath, then waved a hand, causing the Four Mountains Linked Seal to rise into the air.
Seeing this, Xi Ying and the others immediately circulated their Mana, under the effect of the Melding Spirit Array, directing the vast Mana into Yuan Ming's body.
Simultaneously, with a thought, Yuan Ming summoned a lush World Tree behind everyone, its branches and leaves gently swaying, emitting a faint spirit light, continuously injecting the vast spiritual power into Yuan Ming's body.
Using the experience from last time, Yuan Ming quickly guided the gathered forces before the pain could arise in his meridians, and began to practice the Mysterious Sect's Root Qi Skill.
His thoughts flowed like lightning, and as his Mana circulated, he reached a state of perfect mastery.
The Four Mountains Linked Seal spun rapidly in the air, like a gigantic devouring beast, crazily absorbing the gathered Mana of everyone.
Soon, it emitted a deep, dull roar, and a huge Cross Magic Array suddenly appeared over everyone's heads, shining brilliantly.
The next moment, the Cross Magic Array descended with a roar, striking heavily upon the invisible barrier outside the golden palace.
Unexpectedly, numerous frost-white spirit lights suddenly appeared on the barrier, intertwining into a sheet, actually blocking all the power of the Cross Magic Array, making it unable to advance even a bit.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming frowned slightly.
He tried several more times, each time exerting himself fully, yet still returned fruitless.
The invisible barrier seemed unbreakable; no matter how they attacked, it couldn't be shaken the slightest.
"It seems that by relying only on us, the gathered power is still insufficient. Perhaps with three or four more Dharma Phase cultivators aiding, we might break through this array." Yuan Ming sighed, helplessly leading everyone out of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
...
Several days later, Xi Ying bid her farewell, embarking on her return to the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce.
Before departing, she specially left the Five Elements Child in White Emperor City to assist Yuan Ming with the Medicine Garden, particularly paying attention to the growth condition of the Innate Bitter Bamboo.
Yuan Ming watched Xi Ying's departing silhouette, feeling both reluctant and full of anticipation for the future.
After her figure disappeared into the horizon, he turned to find the Five Elements Child to inquire about the progress of cultivating the Bitter Bamboo.
Just as he returned to the City Lord Mansion, Nan Shangfeng arrived hastily, bluntly saying, "Brother Yuan, I intend to return to the Daluo Sect."
Yuan Ming was slightly taken aback, then remembered that Nan Shangfeng had been worried about his master and sect, taken by the Three Realms Sect, so he nodded and said, "Since you have this intention, you should go back and check soon. Let me know if you need any help."
"Thank you Brother Yuan for your care during this time, but the internal affairs of the Daluo Sect are complicated. I will handle it alone. If the senior brothers see me blindly obedient, it will only raise suspicion and cause trouble." Nan Shangfeng shook his head, politely refusing.
"Then have a safe journey, and if you encounter trouble, feel free to send me a message." Yuan Ming responded, ceased to insist, and simply advised.
Nan Shangfeng gave a bow to Yuan Ming, then turned and left.
Yuan Ming watched him disappear from sight, feeling indescribably sentimental.
Afterwards, he stepped towards the Medicine Garden.
Along the way, the scenery of White Emperor City unfolded before his eyes; the ancient trees towered, flowers scented, presenting a scene of tranquility and peace.
Yet Yuan Ming's heart was preoccupied with the growth condition of the Innate Bitter Bamboo, causing his pace to involuntarily quicken.
Soon, he arrived at the Medicine Garden managed by the Five Elements Child.
The Five Elements Child was busy recording something, holding a Jade Scroll, speaking while inputting information into it.
"Master, you're here." Seeing Yuan Ming, the Five Elements Child quickly came up to greet.
Yuan Ming gestured in acknowledgment and asked, "How is the cultivation of the Innate Bitter Bamboo going?"
Saying this, he stepped towards the area where the Bitter Bamboo was planted.
The Five Elements Child followed right behind, responding as they walked, "The Bitter Bamboo is growing well, but it's extremely difficult to shorten its growth time. I have tried various methods, adjusted the spirit soil ratio, crafted special spiritual liquid, and used many other techniques but can only reduce the original five-year growth period to one year."
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows slightly as he took the jade scroll handed over by the Five Elements Child and started to read.
He knew that even a year of growth was still too long for him, who was waiting for the Bitter Bamboo to mature.
"By this calculation, the Bitter Bamboo needs more than forty thousand years to reach ten thousand years of age, which is too slow," Yuan Ming sighed.
"Master, I have done my best. The growth rate of the Bitter Bamboo is constrained by the laws of heaven and earth, and even I cannot find other methods to increase its growth speed," the Five Elements Child said, expressing his difficulty.
While they were talking, they had already arrived at the planting site of the Innate Bitter Bamboo. The Five Elements Child had specially built a place here to study and observe the Bitter Bamboo, showing great dedication.
"Fine, you go ahead with your tasks. I'll ponder slowly over the remaining matters to see if I can find another way," Yuan Ming sighed, knowing his demands might be excessive, and said to the Five Elements Child.
The Five Elements Child respectfully nodded, saluted Yuan Ming, then turned and left to continue his patrol work in the Medicine Garden, carefully tending each spiritual material.
Yuan Ming, on the other hand, stared intently at the Innate Bitter Bamboo, observing its growth condition.
A moment later, he entered the simple dwelling constructed by the Five Elements Child.
Inside, various classics were laid out, all collected by the Five Elements Child as insights of Spirit Plant Masters.
Yuan Ming casually took a book and immersed himself in the sea of books, savoring the wisdom of the predecessors.
When the Five Elements Child returned from patrolling the Medicine Garden, Yuan Ming was still lost in the world of the classics, seemingly forgetting the passage of time.
Seeing this, the Five Elements Child dared not disturb him. He quietly organized the classics, putting them back in order for Yuan Ming to access anytime.
After an indeterminate period, Yuan Ming suddenly put down the classical book, pointed to a certain content in the book, and asked the Five Elements Child, "Have you carefully studied this grafting secret technique?"
The Five Elements Child looked in the direction Yuan Ming pointed, thought for a moment, and nodded, "Master, I indeed have read this secret technique. However, the requirements for both parties in the grafting are extremely high, needing a very high degree of compatibility for success. Although I tried to modify it to lower the compatibility requirements, there are still two major drawbacks."
"Oh? I am eager to hear them." Yuan Ming perused the research records of the Five Elements Child, showing great interest.
The Five Elements Child explained, "Firstly, this technique requires the spirit plant to be grafted onto a mother body of higher age to effectively promote growth. Secondly, the damage to the grafted party is severe, and in my many experiments, no spirit plant could last beyond a month before rapidly wilting."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming nodded slightly and fell into deep thought.
Moments later, a flash of brilliance appeared in his eyes as he proposed a bold idea: "What if we use the World Tree as the grafting mother body? Would it be feasible?"
The World Tree, being the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees, naturally exceeds the Innate Bitter Bamboo in age.
Moreover, its life force is so strong that Yuan Ming has never seen anything like it.Updates are released by novel(ꜰ)ire.net
Even a master at the Mahayana Realm may not be able to harm it in the slightest.
The Five Elements Child was taken aback by his words, then carefully pondered.
Moments later, he also found Yuan Ming's idea quite reasonable, worth a try.
Thus, Yuan Ming and the Five Elements Child wasted no time and started immediately.
The grafting process was extremely complicated and needed to be carried out cautiously to avoid damaging the spiritual aura of the Innate Bitter Bamboo.
The two of them used a large amount of Spiritual Liquid as an auxiliary, executing each step with the utmost care.
After exhausting a month's time, they finally succeeded in transplanting part of the root of the Innate Bitter Bamboo to the roots of the World Tree through the grafting secret technique.
Fortunately, as Yuan Ming had anticipated earlier, after the grafting, the power of the World Tree was not damaged in the slightest.
What delighted them even more was that the growth rate of the Innate Bitter Bamboo had significantly increased.
Time flew by, more than another month passed.
When Yuan Ming re-entered the Medicine Garden, the scene before him filled him with joy.
Originally, just a solitary root had transformed into a tall green bamboo, though only as long as a forearm and exceedingly slender, yet its spiritual aura was extraordinarily thick, with an ancient atmosphere swirling around it, as if it had endured countless ages.
The Five Elements Child observed closely from the side and stroked his beard with a smile, "Master, the Innate Bitter Bamboo seems to have undergone some mystical transformation after the transplant and grafting. Not only is this transformation not bad, but it is very beneficial. According to my estimates, now each year of growth for this bamboo accumulates spiritual aura equivalent to a hundred years in the past."
"By this account, it only takes a thousand years for the Innate Bitter Bamboo to reach ten thousand years of age." Yuan Ming was overjoyed upon hearing this.
As he contemplated, he circled around the green bamboo several times, his eyes full of anticipation.
Subsequently, he solemnly instructed the Five Elements Child to carefully attend to this Bitter Bamboo and report to him immediately in case of any unusual circumstances.
After making arrangements, Yuan Ming turned and left the Medicine Garden, preparing to continue his secluded cultivation.
However, when he stepped into that tranquil cultivation room, he unexpectedly received good news.
"The Moon God Ring has been refined," the voice of the void echoed in his sea of consciousness, tinged with a faint joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1026 - 991: Three Demon Emperors
chapters.content:
As soon as Kong finished speaking, a cyan-green crescent-shaped moon ring flew out from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, gently landing in Yuan Ming's palm.
The ring was shrouded in a thin mist of Spiritual Energy, hazy and mysterious, like an illusory reflection.
Yuan Ming gently put the ring on, and the mist of Spiritual Energy instantly contracted, transforming into a phantom of a round moon, flashing at his fingertips before disappearing.
Immediately, an inexplicable power merged into his body, causing his Divine Soul to feel a burst of coolness and a vague impulse to leave his body.
He immediately sat cross-legged, his mind moved, and the main soul slowly left the body.
At this moment, the phantom of the round moon on the Moon God Ring flickered again, and Yuan Ming's main soul instantly felt a dizzying sensation, as if he were in the vast starry sky.
When his vision cleared again, Yuan Ming was surprised to find that his main soul had turned into a bright moon, hanging high in the sky.
Looking down, the endless mountain ranges and dense forests, along with magnificent cities, were all in view—this was the scene of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range centered around White Emperor City.
At the same time, Moonlight Power poured down like a waterfall, merging into his main soul.
The speed was several times faster than before.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed and immediately began to practice the Moonlight Technique silently.
Over the years, under Xi Ying's meticulous guidance, he had already cultivated the Love Inquiry Technique to the Emotion Control Realm.
Now, with the assistance of the Moon God Ring, he believed that the breakthrough to the Refining Emotion Realm, refining the Seven Spirits, and having the qualification to surpass the Life Witch was within reach.
Meanwhile, while cultivating the Divine Soul, Yuan Ming's physical body was not neglected either.
The training of the Undying Body goes without saying; his main focus now was on condensing the Five Elements Dao Fruit.
As the Five Elements Spiritual Power from the World Tree continued to flow into his body, his Mana also gradually improved along with his Soul Power.

Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, the Purple Bamboo Forest stretched like a sea, the bamboo leaves gently swaying and making a rustling sound, like the sound of heavenly music.
Deep within this vast Purple Bamboo Forest, an elderly man sat serenely on a flat boulder.
He held a cane, dressed in a simple long robe, his face old but exuding an air of authority without needing to show anger.
The elder held a bamboo cup fashioned from a tube, tilting his head slightly, letting the clear water flow into his throat with a gurgling sound.
Not far away, a young man named Wulu sat on a rock, gripping the end of a golden rope with both hands, his expression focused and tense.
The other end of the rope bound an elderly man with green whiskers, dressed in a green robe, his hands and feet tightly bound by the golden rope, struggling like a green insect wrapped in golden threads, unable to move.
"Xia Jie, let me go immediately!" the green-whiskered elder shouted loudly, his voice full of anger and helplessness.

The blind elder, Xia Jie, only slightly lowered the water cup in response to the Inspector's roar, his eyeless eyes slowly turning towards the Inspector.

"Fellow Daoist Inspector, you are too modest. Your Array Formation Cultivation has reached the Seventh Level, a rare talent anywhere. If you could lend a hand, Chuyun Realm's chances of victory would increase significantly," Xia Jie said with a slight smile.
"Even if I agree with the way you're treating me, I can't genuinely put in effort," the Inspector remained unmoved, speaking in a frustrated tone.
At this time, Wulu also spoke: "Senior, it was because the Demon World and the Ten Thousand Demon Country colluded that the Three Realms Immortal Boat lost power and was severely damaged. Can you swallow this indignity?"
Hearing this, a change occurred in the Inspector's expression, his eyes filling with anger.
Seeing this, Wulu immediately added fuel to the fire: "Senior, you don't want those guys to succeed, right? If you agree to help, I can swear here and now, that even if it costs my life, I will definitely help you reclaim the Three Realms Immortal Boat from the Demon World and return it to you."
His voice was clear and firm, evidently making a resolution.
The Inspector remained unmoved, firmly saying: "First intimidation, then temptation. You two are playing the good cop, bad cop game with me, aren't you? I said I don't want to get involved, and I don't want to get involved. Right now, I just want to find a place to steadily cultivate. Don't force me, I absolutely won't agree."
Wulu sighed, looking helplessly at Xia Jie.
He knew it wouldn't be easy to persuade the Inspector.
Xia Jie also sighed, casually tossing the bamboo cup aside and rubbing his hands together.
His actions seemed casual, yet exuded an undeniable authority.
Immediately, he separated his hands, and a purple light flashed in both palms simultaneously when strange purple runes appeared.
These runes seemed to contain mysterious power, making people feel a flutter of anxiety.
Xia Jie then thrust his palms out, striking Wulu and the Inspector's foreheads with lightning speed.
The two had no time to react, only feeling a powerful force surge into their bodies, instantly permeating throughout.
Two purple runes flashed across their foreheads and quickly penetrated after the light converged, disappearing without a trace.
"Senior Xia Jie, what did you do?" Wulu's eyes widened, somewhat surprised.
Before Xia Jie could answer, Jie Cha was already cursing loudly.
"Xia Jie, you shameless old scoundrel damned by the heavens, how dare you plant the Twin Life Curse on me?" Jie Cha's voice was both furious and shocked.
"Twin Life Curse?"
Although Wulu didn't know what it was, seeing Jie Cha's reaction, he knew it wasn't anything good.
"Rest assured, it might be bad for him, but it's exceptionally good for you," Xia Jie patted Wulu's shoulder, but didn't dispel his doubts.
"I beg you, senior, please explain," Wulu pursued.
"The Twin Life Curse is merely a trick that ties two people's lives through a curse seal. Now your life is linked with Jie Cha's, a relationship where one's glory brings glory to the other, and one's disgrace brings disgrace to the other. Should you meet with misfortune and accidentally die, then no matter where Jie Cha runs, he will die too," Xia Jie said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Wulu immediately understood.
Bound by the Twin Life Curse, Jie Cha can't get away even if he wants to. He has to protect and assist Wulu; as long as Wulu gets involved, Jie Cha is compelled to follow.
"Xia Jie, Xia Jie, you atrocious old ghost damned by the heavens, you've truly ruined me," Jie Cha continued to curse.
"Enough, enough. Just lend your aid to Chuyun Realm to get through this realm-wide battle, regardless of the credit size, and I'll immediately lift the Twin Life Curse and help you fulfill your desire of traveling to other realms. How about that?" Xia Jie scratched his ear impatiently.
"What choice do I have? Once I get entangled with your shameless self, there's no way it'll be good," Jie Cha sighed, saying.
Then, he sized up Wulu with a stern warning: "Kid, until this curse is lifted, you better take care of your life for my sake."
Wulu helplessly clenched his fist in acknowledgment.
Xia Jie, seeing this, slowly turned, his head slightly raised as if he were gazing afar.
Moments later, the smile on his face gradually faded as he muttered, "Oh, hopefully, we can make it..."
...
Demon World, a barren land.
High above the sky, a solitary moon hung radiantly, casting its cold glow, adding mystery and solitude to this desolate place.
Under the moonlight, an endless field of white desert unfurled, littered with stones, akin to scattered bones, arousing unease.
At the center of this desert, a pool of black water resembled a black gemstone set into the earth, gleaming deeply under the moonlight.
A young man's naked body floated quietly on the lake's surface.
His body covered in uneven wounds, ghastly to behold, yet those cold eyes fixed on the lone moon above, brimming with defiance and hatred.
Heavy footsteps echoed from the lakeside, shattering the night's tranquility.
The naked man slightly turned his head, his eyes cold.
On the shore, a tall figure became clearer; clad in a crimson robe, his dark skin and malicious features resembled a demon god emerging from hell.
An intimidating aura exuded from him; the dark crimson patterns on his robe seemed to flow with blood, filled with mystery and wickedness.
"Without advancing to the Mahayana Realm, you'll never truly contend with Xia Jie, let alone that kid vying with you for the Three Realms Immortal Boat," the tall man sneered, his voice filled with disdain and disappointment towards Su Wu.
Upon hearing, Su Wu sneered: "Mahayana Realm? So what? That guy, I never regarded him. If not for the complex situation inside the Three Realms Immortal Boat, he would've died long ago."
The tall man was none other than the renowned Yan Emperor of the Demon World.
He coldly glanced at Su Wu, shaking his head: "You're too arrogant. That kid, disrupting our plans, proves his extraordinariness. If you remain careless, you'll suffer greatly in the future."
Su Wu fell silent for a moment, his eyes determined: "Yan Emperor, I'll soon attempt the Mahayana Realm. Next time, I won't fail."
Yan Emperor said no more, turning towards the depths of the lake.
As he raised his hand, the ground trembled, stones autonomously gathered, forming small altars encircling the entire black lake, establishing a large magic array.
The array formed, and the wind howled; waves of Demonic Qi surged, rushing into the lake, pouring into Su Wu's body.
Nourished by Demonic Qi, his damaged body began to repair visibly, with his aura rapidly augmenting.
In the distance, Yan Emperor's figure gradually vanished in the night.
Beside him, the ground suddenly emitted black light, transforming into a black-bearded elder; from the sky, a white starlight descended, coalescing into a white-clothed woman.
They were the Mountain Emperor and Star Emperor of the Demon World, together with Yan Emperor, known as the Three Demon Emperors.

chapters.title: Chapter 1027 - 992: Destiny
chapters.content:
"Yan Emperor, acting so swiftly against Su Wu, isn't it a bit hasty?" Mountain Emperor's voice was rough, carrying some doubt.
"No matter, he is merely the least conspicuous of the three embryos. Even if there's some loss, it won't affect the overall situation. Star Emperor, do you have any new information on your side?" Yan Emperor smiled slightly, speaking with indifference:
After speaking, his gaze turned to the woman in white.
Star Emperor's expression was indifferent, and her voice was crisp like a spring: "The Demon Son has brought back the Three Realms Immortal Boat."
"Good, then let's go investigate." Yan Emperor said.
As his words fell, the figures of the three flickered and disappeared from the spot.
In the next instant, the three were in a massive valley.
This valley was wide and deep, with the surface exposed with black rock, as if stripped bare by the relentless passage of time, presenting a desolate and ancient atmosphere.
Outside the valley, dense black mist swirled, like a natural barrier, blocking the view of the outside world.
Inside the valley, in the central flat and open area, a gigantic silver formation stood prominently.
This formation was pentagonal, surrounded by seventy-two sky-reaching demon pillars, responding to the void crystal stones on the ground, emitting a faint light.
As if countless eyes, those crystals silently watched everything within the formation, making one's scalp tingle.
At the five corners of the formation, each had a half-human height altar.
On the altars, dense demonic qi rolled, and five Demon Clan Mahayana cultivators were sitting cross-legged, focusing on maintaining the operation of the great array.
Among them, was the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
Under the combined efforts of the five, a gigantic silver bubble gradually formed in the void.
Inside the bubble, a silver giant boat hundreds of feet long was quietly floating, it was the legendary Three Realms Immortal Boat.
Beside the Immortal Boat, a massive silver giant fish was floating. It looked similar to a whale but appeared listless, as if it had lost its vitality.
Yan Emperor's gaze was as sharp as a torch, sweeping over the giant boat and the silver fish, then walked to the Reincarnation Demon Lord's side, and asked in a deep voice: "Is the delivery matter completed?"
The Reincarnation Demon Lord respectfully replied: "Reporting to Yan Emperor, the delivery is complete. All four Reincarnation Seeds have been successfully delivered to the Chuyun Realm without anyone noticing."
"Well done, you must always be cautious and not expose your whereabouts." Yan Emperor, hearing this, nodded, satisfied, and said.
After speaking, his gaze again turned to the silver giant fish.
He raised his hand and grabbed the void, and the fish's eyes suddenly turned, a "thump, thump" beating black heart flew out from its body, flying towards Yan Emperor.
As the heart approached Yan Emperor's body, it flashed with a dark light and merged into his body.
Immediately after, the body of the silver giant fish began to shrink rapidly, eventually transforming into a hunchbacked man.
This man was Jiang Liu.
Jiang Liu fell with difficulty at Yan Emperor's feet, weakly asking: "Father, how did I do this time?"
At this moment, he appeared dispirited, with a declining aura, looking like a withered and decrepit figure close to death.
"You completed this mission quite well." Yan Emperor gently stroked Jiang Liu's head, a loving smile on his face.
Upon hearing this, Jiang Liu was filled with joy, and a satisfied smile appeared on his face.
However, this satisfaction did not last long, as his head suddenly tilted, and he passed out.
Yan Emperor's expression remained unchanged, his gaze then shifting to the quietly floating Three Realms Immortal Boat.
His divine thought gently probed inside it, but in the next moment, his face suddenly changed, as if covered in frost.
"Where is the World Tree? Why is there no trace of the World Tree in this Immortal Boat?" Yan Emperor's voice revealed strands of coldness.
He looked down at Jiang Liu, who was unconscious on the ground, a hint of confusion and anger flashing in his eyes.
But at this moment, Jiang Liu could not respond to his question.
The anger in Yan Emperor's heart instantly ignited, he shouted violently: "Useless!"
Then he suddenly raised a foot and stomped hard on Jiang Liu's body.
With a "boom", Jiang Liu's body exploded under Yan Emperor's foot, like an overripe watermelon, flesh and blood flew everywhere.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord, seeing this, was shocked in his heart, quickly raising his hand and shooting out a blood light.
In mid-air, the blood light transformed into a six-sided disk, with six black holes distributed on it, each surrounded by complex runes.
In one of the holes, light burst forth, forming a spinning vortex, sucking in Jiang Liu's shattered body and the flying flesh around.
Soon after, the runes on the disk lit up one by one, emitting brilliant light.
Before long, light sprayed from another hole, and a human figure flew out, heavily falling to the ground.
The person was naked, with a hunched back, it was Jiang Liu.
At this moment, his body had returned to its original state, the previous state of decline swept away, looking full of vitality.
However, he remained unconscious.
Yan Emperor coldly swept a glance at Jiang Liu, the anger in his heart had already subsided a lot.
He did not blame the Reincarnation Demon Lord for saving him, after all, Jiang Liu still had value to be used.
He turned to Mountain Emperor and said: "Collect materials as soon as possible to repair this Three Realms Immortal Boat. The day the Wentian Secret Realm opens will be our chance to completely take over the Chuyun Realm. At that time, we will advance to higher realms and conquer more lands."
The Mountain Emperor responded in a deep voice, "Alright."
As soon as the words were spoken, the black mist shrouding the outside of the valley suddenly dissipated, revealing the scene beyond.
Outside the valley entrance was a vast plain, filled with countless Demon Clan cultivators.
These Demon Clan cultivators had strong auras and powerful cultivation.
Among them, there were as many as ten Dharma Phase Cultivators, and several Body Cultivators who had refined the Fiery Sun Body.
Behind them were hundreds of Dharma manifestation Stage cultivators, Body Cultivators with the Undying Body, and Soul Cultivators of the Realm of Life Witch.
And beyond these people were countless Demon Clan warriors, arranged neatly, forming a formidable military array.
"Flatten Chuyun! Conquer all realms!" someone shouted, starting the slogan.
The entire plain instantly resounded with a thunderous roar: "Flatten Chuyun! Conquer all realms!"
This sound persisted, seeming to make the entire heaven and earth tremble.

In the blink of an eye, twenty years passed swiftly like flowing water.

At that moment, a silver glow suddenly shone from within the dense cloud.
A massive silver round moon slowly emerged. Although the glow was dim, it exuded a mysterious power.
The round moon seemed to possess a certain magical power, with beams of silver moonlight piercing the void, shining straight down on a location within the City Lord Mansion.
And that place was precisely where Yuan Ming was in closed cultivation.
At this moment, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged on a meditation cushion, eyes closed and deeply focused.
In his hand, the Moon God Ring emitted a gentle light, resonating with the round moon in the sky.
As the silver-white moonlight power descended, Yuan Ming's entire body was enveloped in a hazy light and shadow.
Those strands of silver-white light transformed into specks of floating light, slowly merging into his body.
His divine soul drifted out from the sea of consciousness, hovering above his head.
The seven spirits, transformed into seven phantoms, coninuously absorbed the moonlight power outside the divine soul, gradually becoming more substantial.

He realized that the destiny of every being was determined by the force created by their words, actions, and thoughts.
And this force was the link connecting them with the universe, the trajectory of their lives.
At this moment, Yuan Ming finally understood why the Great Wish of All Living Beings required advancement to the Realm of Life Witch to practice.
Because only by truly comprehending the destinies of beings can one guide the force of all beings' will with their own grand aspiration.

chapters.title: Chapter 1028 - 993: Yin Moon Body
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming was immersed in the chaotic sounds, yet felt an indescribable sense of detachment.
He longed to wander outside this complex vortex of fate, unwilling to be deeply entangled in it.
As soon as this thought arose, the moonlight power that enveloped him began to retreat like a tide, slowly contracting, ultimately concentrating and gathering towards his brow.
Yuan Ming's mind tightened, and he instantly felt a secret and mysterious power tightly wrapping him.
He immediately focused his spirit, wholeheartedly sensing the power gathering towards him. For a moment, his state of mind seemed to enter a void, where all external disturbances disappeared.
Above White Emperor City, this peculiar change attracted everyone's attention.
"It seems the master is advancing to the Life Witch Realm." In the backyard of the City Lord Mansion, Hua Zhi looked up at the high sky and said with certainty.
"I also felt that powerful Divine Soul power," Lei Yu eagerly echoed.
Meanwhile, in the hall where city affairs were being handled at the City Lord Mansion, Wang Fulong was deliberating with several of the city's cultivators. At this moment, they all stopped their activities in unison, and they came to the center of the yard.
Everyone looked up at the silver moon phenomenon high in the sky, each face filled with delight.
"The City Lord has broken through, and in just twenty-some years, he has reached the Life Witch Realm. Now let's see which other city lords or sects that have been eyeing White Emperor City dare to cause trouble," a middle-aged cultivator in a white scholar's robe exclaimed joyfully.
The others all nodded in agreement.
Wang Fulong and He Xiuwen exchanged a glance, a mix of emotions stirring within them, yet both chose to remain silent.
As the years went by, their hatred and fear of Yuan Ming diminished, and they began to recognize him from deep within, becoming obedient, even a bit reverent.
Especially Wang Fulong, freed from the constraints of the Sunset Sect and without the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce's restraint, Yuan Ming gave him great freedom and support, allowing him to fully commit to managing White Emperor City.
In his heart, he was truly grateful to Yuan Ming.
Without these heavy burdens, although he was busy with White Emperor City's affairs and his cultivation time greatly reduced, his cultivation instead improved.
He Xiuwen, on the other hand, received the promised resources for nurturing from Yuan Ming and was quite diligent in managing the affairs of White Emperor City.
In the northern part of White Emperor City, in a quiet residence, a burly blonde man was staring intently at the sky above the city. He was gripping a communication magic plate, communicating with someone: "City Lord, White Emperor City Lord has broken through to the Life Witch Realm..."
The communication magic plate remained silent for a long time before slowly responding: "Forget it, take our people and retreat."
The blonde man heard this, answered in a deep voice, "Understood."
A trace of reluctance flickered in his eyes, but it was overshadowed by resignation and relief.
...
Just a few miles from here, in a quaint inn, a deep secret room.
A woman in a blue robe stood quietly beside a communication array, a heavy look on her brow as she softly reported the latest happenings of White Emperor City to the spectral figure within the array.
The light in the array flickered, reflecting a dignified and profound face, the City Lord of Yin Mountain.
As he listened to the report from his subordinate, a complex emotion flashed in his eyes, leading him into a long silence.
The woman in the blue robe saw this, feeling apprehensive, and cautiously asked, "City Lord, we have been lurking here for a long time. I'm afraid our identities have already been exposed. Now that the White Emperor City Lord has broken through and his strength has increased, should we temporarily withdraw to avoid his sharpness?"
The Yin Mountain City Lord remained silent for a moment before finally speaking, "No need to withdraw. I will set off immediately, personally going to White Emperor City to offer my congratulations."
At the same time, outside White Emperor City's Transmission Hall, a throng of people filled the area, with two long queues stretching into the distance.
These cultivators were all applying for transmission to leave White Emperor City, their faces filled with anxiety and unease.
At the hall's entrance, several cultivators dressed in black robes embroidered with golden patterns were standing, they were disciples of the Golden Extreme Sect, responsible for guarding the place.
The leader was an elderly man, though advanced in years, his spirit was vigorous, and his tiger-like eyes were bright.
He occasionally glanced towards the Transmission Hall and then looked up at the sky, where the phenomenon continued to draw attention.
A plump woman approached the elder, asking worriedly, "Elder Hong, are we really going to stay here? The one named He from the City Lord Mansion has been secretly investigating us, I'm afraid our background has been completely exposed. If they harbor murderous intentions, we may not be able to withstand it."
"Why should we leave? If they truly understood our details, would they easily make a move? I fear they're currently troubled about how to deal with the forces behind us," Elder Hong laughed coldly, countering.
Upon hearing this, everyone felt relieved, smiles appearing on their faces.
"Alright, let's go back. Report the situation here accurately to Young Master Que Yue, and let him decide the next step," Elder Hong withdrew his gaze, saying lightly.
After finishing his words, he turned and left with the crowd.
...

Yuan Ming sat upright inside, the Moonlight Power at the center of his brow gradually gathered, eventually forming a thumb-sized beam of light that quietly merged into his brow, then vanished without a trace.
With the disappearance of the beam, a faint silver moon mark slowly appeared at Yuan Ming's brow, emitting a soft silver light.
He slowly stood up, the silver moon mark flashed, and his figure became illusory, as though it blended into the surrounding void.
With a single step forward, Yuan Ming's figure transformed into a hazy stream of light, arriving silently at the back courtyard of the City Lord Mansion.
In the back courtyard at this moment, Hua Zhi was delicately holding a refined pastry, tasting its flavors while gazing at the sky, where the gradually dissipating anomaly seemed to have a distinct charm in her eyes.
Meanwhile, Lei Yu sat on a stone bench to the side, head resting on his hands, eyes vacant, seemingly pondering some insoluble problems.
Even though Yuan Ming stood beside them, neither Hua Zhi nor Lei Yu noticed his presence.
"The stealth effect of the Yin Moon Body is indeed unexpectedly good. These two Level 5 Demons couldn't detect even the slightest bit," Yuan Ming thought secretly.
After advancing to a Life Witch, Yuan Ming not only awakened the Yin Moon Body, which cloaks one in an invisible barrier during its activation, obscuring fate to a certain extent and preventing people from instinctively perceiving his existence.
Yuan Ming did not reveal himself to converse with them, but instead, continued walking forward, soon arriving at the administrative hall.
At this moment in the hall, the crowd that had just held a meeting had already gathered, discussing the matter of clearing out spies from various sects and the other eighteen cities left in White Emperor City.
He Xiuwen held a paper documenting the spies' information, displaying it to the crowd for examination one by one.
Upon seeing it, everyone was visibly shocked, including Wang Fulong, who furrowed his brow and said gravely, "How could there be so many?"
"The various sects do not understand our City Lord's strength, mistakenly believing that he was placed here to manage White Emperor City merely due to connections. Thus, they secretly harbor thoughts of supporting puppets and controlling White Emperor City. The City Lords of the other eighteen cities with Heavenly Crane Arrays used to follow Jin Mu's lead. But after Jin Mu's death, they developed rebellious thoughts, wanting to replace and become the head of these nineteen cities, taking over the entire Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range," He Xiuwen explained.
"If we want to clear them all, we may face significant resistance," a middle-aged round-faced cultivator said solemnly.
"What's there to fear? They just don't know the true strength of our City Lord. Once they witness it, they naturally wouldn't dare to harbor any more untoward thoughts," Zheng Heng sneered.
"We still need to conduct thorough investigations, uncovering fully the forces behind these Dark Children, preparing to handle them accordingly," Wang Fulong said cautiously.
Amidst their fervent discussions, they were unaware that Yuan Ming was quietly standing nearby.
His figure remained illusory and ethereal, undetectable by anyone.
His mind moved, and in his Sea of Consciousness, a light gathered, a pale golden eyeball slowly appeared, eventually manifesting at his brow.
This pale golden eyeball, like the Yin Moon Body beneath his form, appeared in an illusory and ethereal state, undetectable by others.
This was precisely the Investigation Divine Power Yuan Ming awakened upon advancing to a Life Witch—the Reincarnation Eye.
The Reincarnation Eye at Yuan Ming's brow spun swiftly, a golden light beam emitted from it, quietly enveloping Wang Fulong.
In the next moment, it was as if a doorway to the depths of time opened in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, scenes flowed like a revolving lantern.
These scenes seemed to condense a century of Wang Fulong's past into a single moment, replaying in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
In the scenes, from an inexperienced youth to a steady middle age, all the events Wang Fulong experienced unfolded as if time were reversing, vividly in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
The closer the scenes were to the present, the more coherent and clear they appeared, as if Yuan Ming personally experienced all of Wang Fulong's encounters, making each person and event feel so real.
The further the scenes moved into the past, the more fragmented and isolated they became, but each image represented a significant moment in Wang Fulong's life.
Yuan Ming withdrew his gaze from his Sea of Consciousness and directed it at an ancient-looking purple copper incense burner on the table.
The incense burner appeared ordinary, only calming the mind during incense burning with no special features.
When Yuan Ming's Reincarnation Eye cast a golden light upon it, fragmented scenes gradually emerged in his Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming carefully reviewed these scenes and discovered they depicted the history of this purple copper incense burner since its refinement.
From its first owner, through every ownership transfer, to every person it had ever contacted, all were displayed in these scenes.
As Yuan Ming intended to delve further into these visions, he suddenly felt something, moved his form, and returned to the secret chamber.
As soon as he stood still, the mysterious Power of Dao descended again, enveloping him like warm sunshine.

chapters.title: Chapter 1029 - 994: The Price
chapters.content:
In an instant, vast streams of mysterious spirit light descended from the sky, softly falling into Yuan Ming's body like gentle rain.
The sensation of being bathed in a hot spring, floating on clouds, once again surged into his heart, making him feel incredibly comfortable.
Nourished by this power, his divine skills also began to undergo subtle changes.
Especially the Life and Death Reincarnation Path divine skill, which, after absorbing a large amount of the Power of Dao, first began to reveal its differences.
A Dao Seal with intertwining black and white light formed in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, its flowing and blending light appeared to have a mysterious resemblance to the Yin Yang Tai Chi Diagram.
However, the boundary between this black and white light was not so clear, and each lacked the presence of Yin-Yang fish eyes, as if it represented a more profound Dao of yin-yang fusion.
Meanwhile, the other Dao Seals within Yuan Ming's body also began to shine under the nourishment of this Power of Dao, embarking on a new round of advancement.
Among them, the progress of the Primordial Dao Seal was particularly remarkable; its light grew increasingly intense, seemingly containing an infinite strength, waiting to erupt completely at some future moment.
As it slowly rotated, it seemed like a bottomless pit, silently absorbing more than half of the falling Power of Dao, like trickling streams flowing into the sea.
With the increasing absorption of the Power of Dao, the power of the Primordial Dao Seal became more apparent, greatly enhancing its devouring capability.
Whenever it operated, the vast suction seemed like a wild wind sweeping through, vaguely appearing as if it would also absorb and devour the surrounding Dao Seals, but ultimately it did not succeed.
When the last of the Power of Dao was fully absorbed, Yuan Ming only felt the flow of energy within his body become smoother, and his cultivation realm stabilized.
Twenty years of hard cultivation were not wasted, but rather brought him abundant gains.
During these twenty years, his Divine Soul Power surged, and his Soul Cultivation Realm advanced by leaps and bounds, further progressing to a higher level.
Meanwhile, his Mana also significantly advanced, now reaching the mid-stage Dharma manifestation realm, exuding an indescribable might with every movement.
Additionally, after years of enlightenment and cultivation, the practice of the Five Elements Dao Fruit achieved modest success.
Within his Dantian, five half-real, half-illusionary gourds formed, shimmering with the light of the five colors—green, red, yellow, white, and black—gently floating like five stars, shining brilliantly.
Only the progress of Body Cultivation appeared somewhat slow, still remaining at the Undying Body Early Stage level.
...
Seven days later, Yuan Ming slowly stepped out of the secret chamber.
Outside, Hua Zhi, Lei Yu, and Wang Fulong, among others, had been waiting for some time, and upon seeing him emerge, they all stepped forward to offer congratulations.
"Congratulations to the City Lord on successfully breaking through, advancing to a higher level," they all said in unison.
Yuan Ming smiled and nodded, responding, "During my retreat, I troubled you all with the burden of responsibilities. The peace in White Emperor City is truly due to your efforts."
"The City Lord praises us too much. We simply followed the governance policies you left, acting according to plan. We do not dare to take credit," Wang Fulong modestly said.
Yuan Ming heard this and lightly smiled, refraining from further words.
His gaze swept over the group, noticing that Hua Zhi and Lei Yu's auras were stable and their cultivation advanced, clearly reaching the Level 5 Peak, just a step away from Level 6, bringing him great comfort.
Meanwhile, although Wang Fulong, He Xiuwen, and Zheng Heng had made some progress, comparatively, they still seemed lacking.
Yuan Ming, after inquiring about the recent situation in White Emperor City and the movements of the Demon Clan, then called upon the Five Elements Child, extracting some rare Spiritual Medicines from the Shura Palace's Spiritual Medicine Garden to distribute as rewards to the group.
After a round of encouragement, the group gradually dispersed.
After everyone had left, Wang Fulong and He Xiuwen stayed behind.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming knew the two must have something important to discuss, so he asked, "Is there still more to discuss?"
"To report to the City Lord, in the past two days, the City Lords of Yin Mountain City, Black Tiger City, White Eagle City, and Luwan City, either personally or through envoys, have sent congratulatory gifts," Wang Fulong stepped forward, clasping his hands.
"Oh? Who came personally?" Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow and asked.
"The City Lord of Yin Mountain City, Long Shan, came in person. However, as you were still in retreat, he stayed in the city for two days and then left. Upon leaving, he also took away the Dark Child left in the city," Wang Fulong reported in detail.
"This is a gesture of allegiance, offering a pledge. Good, accept the gifts from these cities and choose appropriate return gifts from the treasury to demonstrate the reciprocation of courtesy," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
