"The Dark Child from other cities and sects in the city have mostly been withdrawn, but some are still observing. We have begun investigating the backgrounds of these Dark Child, most have been identified and recorded, ready to be cleansed at any time. However, a few remain deeply hidden, requiring further digging," Wang Fulong nodded in agreement and continued.
"No need to rush with these small fry. Is there anything else?" Yuan Ming said, shaking his head.
"In half a month, White Emperor City will host a large-scale auction, jointly initiated by Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce, and over a dozen other chambers of commerce. As organizers, we are responsible for all matters. At that time, various businesses will send many rare items for auction. As the organizers, we have the priority purchase rights to select one piece from these auction items," Wang Fulong considered and said.
In other words, whether or not to prioritize purchasing and what to buy needs Yuan Ming's decision.
"Has the list of auction items been delivered?" Yuan Ming asked.
Wang Fulong nodded slightly, gently turning his wrist, and a catalog emitting a faint ink fragrance appeared in his hand.
He respectfully handed it over and said, "City Lord, this is the list for this auction, please take a look."
Yuan Ming took the catalog and began to read it carefully.
As his gaze moved, his eyes slowly brightened: "Among the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip's auction items, there's unexpectedly a Demon Core of a Level 6 Mountain Turtle. Such a rare item must not fall into others' hands."
"Yes." Wang Fulong nodded in agreement.
Subsequently, Yuan Ming selected his desired items one by one from the auction items of various major chambers of commerce, such as the Golden Phoenix Blood Stone from the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce and the Purple Dew Red Poison Grass from the Penglu Trading House, each being a rare treasure.
Wang Fulong noted them down one by one.
"Is there still enough Spirit Stone in the treasury?" Yuan Ming set down the catalog and asked with concern.
"Rest assured, City Lord, the Spirit Stone required for these auction items is still sufficient in the treasury. Over the years, the tax operations of the City Lord Mansion have been well managed, with considerable profits. Coupled with the output from the Spiritual Medicine Garden and Shura Palace, White Emperor City's treasury has become much more abundant than most cities and some small to mid-sized sects' treasuries." Wang Fulong smiled slightly as he answered.
Yuan Ming found comfort in these words.
After their discussion concluded, Yuan Ming returned to his room.
He took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, burned incense, and possessed Guoguo, sharing the joyous news of successfully advancing to the Life Witch with Xi Ying.
"I thought you would need at least ten more years. I didn't expect you to advance so quickly. Truly a cause for celebration." Xi Ying's voice came from the tripod, tinged with a hint of delight.
After Yuan Ming shared his newfound Divine Skills with Xi Ying, they spoke about the rare items on the list in the Jade Scroll.
"Everything on the Jade Scroll is extremely rare. In these twenty years, with the background of the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce, I have used every connection, yet I couldn't gather even half of the materials. What could be bought was barely a tenth. Even so, all of White Emperor City's earnings in recent years have been almost entirely invested in this." Xi Ying's voice had a hint of helplessness.
"Earlier, Wang Fulong mentioned that in recent years White Emperor City's income has been substantial, the treasury abundant. How is it that you say it's all been spent?" Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised at these words.
"The Spirit Stone in the treasury is what I left to maintain White Emperor City's daily operations, and those amounts are not even a tenth of what has truly been spent in these years. We have poured everything into purchasing the rare items on the list." Xi Ying let out a bitter laugh, explaining.
Only then did Yuan Ming understand that Xi Ying had made such a significant sacrifice for the future of White Emperor City.
"No matter how we increase income and reduce expenditure, the earnings of White Emperor City still seem hard to support such immense expenditures."
Gazing at a few autumn leaves drifting past the window, Yuan Ming, after a moment of contemplation, slowly spoke: "It's time to expand our influence and seek development beyond."
Xi Ying curiously asked, "How do you plan to do that?"
"In the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, how many covet the position of master? Now that our amassed power is strong enough, it's time to strive for dominance. I think we can start by subjugating the remaining eighteen cities of the Heavenly Crane Array." Yuan Ming smiled.
Xi Ying was silent for a moment upon hearing this, seemingly contemplating the feasibility.
After a long while, she said, "Since you've ascended to Life Witch, you indeed can start engaging in this matter. Moreover, I am planning to visit White Emperor City in the near future."
"You're coming to White Emperor City?" Yuan Ming asked with a look of surprise.
"I have found a way to obtain the subsequent cultivation technique of the Moonlight Technique, and perhaps I can concurrently assist you in subjugating the other cities." Xi Ying said.
"That would be wonderful. I eagerly await your return." Yuan Ming said joyfully.
After ending the communication with Xi Ying, Yuan Ming took a deep breath, raised his hand, and swiftly cast a spell. Following that, with a flash of light before him, Shura Palace appeared.
The current Shura Palace was entirely different from before.
The walls were carefully crafted with precious timber, retaining a primitive and solemn blue-grey hue that resonated in harmony with the aura of the World Tree, blending together.
On the eaves, branches spread, and green leaves swayed lightly as if bestowed by nature, adding a unique vitality to Shura Palace.
Entering, one could feel the Spiritual Energy even more concentrated, as if stepping into an immortal realm.
Though the space hadn't undergone much change, the black clouds hovering in the sky and the occasional flicker of electric snakes added a touch of mystery and majesty to Shura Palace.
Strolling at ease, Yuan Ming soon arrived at the location of the World Tree.
This giant tree, though now much reduced in size, still towered majestically, piercing the clouds. Looking up, its lush and layered foliage almost shrouded the entire sky.Chapters first released on novᴇlfire.net
And beneath the shade of the World Tree stood an elegant green bamboo, emanating a faint spirit light, as if surrounded by a halo.

chapters.title: Chapter 1030 - 995: Issuing Orders
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming approached slowly, only to feel a refreshing aura greet him, intangible and formless, yet making him feel relaxed and carefree, with all distractions in his mind disappearing instantly without a trace.
He reached out a hand, gently stroking the bamboo, feeling its warm touch like jade, a nameless joy rising in his heart.
Beside the Bitter Bamboo, flowers competed to bloom, spirit grass was lush and green, all thriving under the protection of the World Tree, each plant uniquely precious, as if a treasure designed by nature for this place.
The Five Elements Child was carefully tending to these spirit plants by the tree, sensing Yuan Ming's arrival, he immediately turned around and respectfully greeted Yuan Ming.
"How is the Bitter Bamboo growing?" Yuan Ming smiled and waved his hand, indicating to the Five Elements Child not to stand on ceremony.
"The Bitter Bamboo has grown to thirteen thousand years old, thriving vigorously," the Five Elements Child replied, with a hint of pride on his face.Follow current novᴇls on novèlfire.net
He then meticulously reported on the situation of other transplanted spiritual medicines, knowing the growth status of each like the back of his hand, Yuan Ming listened and nodded frequently, praising the Five Elements Child for his skill in cultivating spirit plants.
The two chatted while slowly strolling around the World Tree, inspecting the lush landscape of this spiritual medicine area.
Suddenly, Yuan Ming's brow slightly raised, his gaze fell on a figure not far away.
"Why is she here?" Yuan Ming pointed at the figure, somewhat surprised to ask.
Qiu Nu was seen sitting cross-legged, eyes closed while cultivating, her cultivation aura was much stronger than before, already reaching the Late-stage Core Formation level.
"Five years ago, Qiu Nu successfully advanced to Level 4 Spirit Plant Master, Senior Ye Xinyao thought her skills had surpassed her own, so she recommended her here for me to continue mentoring," the Five Elements Child quickly explained.
"In just fifteen years, she became a Level 4 Spirit Plant Master, her talent is indeed extraordinary," Yuan Ming remarked with admiration.
"Not only that, she has been with me for only five years, yet she's already learned most of what I know. If not for the limitation of her cultivation, she might have already become a Level 5 Spirit Plant Master. With such talent, surpassing me is only a matter of time," the Five Elements Child agreed, showing some emotional reflection on his face.
Yuan Ming was even more surprised by what he heard.
It's essential to know that the Five Elements Child, as one transformed from spirit plants, has innate advantages in cultivating spirit plants, yet Qiu Nu can surpass him in this aspect, which cannot merely be explained by her Wood Attribute Heavenly Spirit Root.
Recalling Qiu Nu's innate divine ability to communicate with plants, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel a touch of curiosity.
Generally, the Heavenly Spirit Root provides inherent advantages only in cultivation, but awakening an innate divine ability often indicates a mutation in the spirit root or possessing a special spiritual body.
Originally, Yuan Ming didn't pay much attention to Qiu Nu's situation, upon seeing her have the Heavenly Spirit Root, he entrusted her to Ye Xinyao's tutelage.
Now driven by curiosity, he couldn't help but start wondering whether he had overlooked something back then?
At this moment, Qiu Nu also awoke from her cultivation, saw Yuan Ming and the Five Elements Child before her, and hurriedly stood up to greet them with respect.
Yuan Ming pondered briefly, then once again probed with his divine sense, meticulously examining Qiu Nu's spirit root situation.
A moment later, a look of astonishment appeared on his face.
"Hmm? Your spirit root… although not significantly improved, it seems there indeed has been an enhancement?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"Can a Heavenly Spirit Root also be improved?" Qiu Nu appeared confused upon hearing this, asking in bewilderment.
"Legend has it that above the Heavenly Spirit Root is the Immortal Spirit Root, whose potential is ten times that of the Heavenly Spirit Root. However, the situation of spirit root advancement is extremely rare, let alone for a Heavenly Spirit Root. During this time, have you consumed any Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures?" Yuan Ming explained briefly before asking further.
"No, I've been continuously cultivating near the World Giant Tree, never left nor secretly consumed any spiritual medicine." Qiu Nu mistakenly thought Yuan Ming was suspecting her of stealing spiritual medicines, hurriedly shook her head in explanation:
Yuan Ming frowned slightly, suddenly raised his palm, and slowly infused a stream of the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin into Qiu Nu's body.
Instantly, a strong suction emanated from within Qiu Nu's spirit root, like a giant beast awakened, greedily devouring this power.
Subsequently, her spirit root once again improved, the extent far exceeding before, and even the speed of absorbing spiritual energy doubled.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was enlightened.
He pondered slightly, deciding to continue infusing the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin into Qiu Nu, wanting to explore exactly to what limits her spirit root could absorb.
In no time, Qiu Nu's spirit root had consecutively absorbed thirteen streams of the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin.
When the fourteenth stream of power surged in, the strong suction abruptly vanished, replaced by a mysterious force surging within Qiu Nu's body.
At this moment, spirit light suddenly appeared around Qiu Nu, with the spiritual energy outside rushing into her body like a flood, producing a whistling wind sound.
She was stunned, hurriedly sat cross-legged, running the cultivation technique to regulate the spiritual energy.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming withdrew his palm, quietly observing the changes in Qiu Nu.
After a moment, the spirit light on Qiu Nu's body gradually faded, she opened her eyes, revealing an expression of surprise and joy.
"Lord, my spirit root has truly advanced!" Qiu Nu excitedly stood up, eyes gleaming with excitement.
"Compared to before, how has it changed?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
He too was seeing the legendary Immortal Spirit Root for the first time, wanting to know whether besides faster cultivation speed, it possessed any other special features.
"Now, my connection with Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy has strengthened by several times, and I have also awakened a new Divine Skill!" Qiu Nu replied joyfully.
Before Yuan Ming could speak to inquire, she took the initiative to squat down and gently buried a seed she took from her side into the soil.
Then, she hovered her hand above the seed, and a beam of green spirit light shot from her palm, enveloping the seed within it.
In just the span of a breath, Yuan Ming was astonished to see the seed break through the soil, quickly growing a bud, and blooming in the wind, exuding a rich floral fragrance.
"This Divine Skill is called Green Wood Mysterious Light, and it can forcibly mature Spirit Grass. But each time it is used, a certain amount of lifespan must be sacrificed. One year of lifespan can increase the medicinal efficacy of Spirit Grass by ten years," Qiu Nu explained.
"Not bad, but your lifespan is ultimately limited and should not be overused," Yuan Ming cautioned.
"Rest assured, Master, this is just an ordinary flower, and maturing it only consumed a few days of my lifespan," Qiu Nu quickly said.
Yuan Ming nodded and attempted to inject a wisp of Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power into Qiu Nu's body, but seeing her Spirit Root had stabilized and was no longer absorbing or altering, he stopped.
He gave Qiu Nu some guidance on her cultivation, instructed the Five Elements Child to continue teaching her the knowledge of a Spirit Plant Master, and then left the World Tree, heading to the Extreme Fire Realm.
Within the Extreme Fire Territory, it was sparsely populated, with only two people residing.
One of them was Dian Xiaosan.
When Yuan Ming arrived, he was meditating with closed eyes, practicing a simplified version of the "Moonlight Technique," completely unaware of Yuan Ming's arrival.
Yuan Ming took a careful look at Dian Xiaosan and found that his Soul Power had reached the peak of the Spoken Witch level, just half a step away from the Realm of Life Witch.
He couldn't help but marvel in his heart; the improved "Moonlight Technique" was indeed extraordinarily powerful, sacrificing the ability to possess Divine Skills, but the advancement in realm was truly astonishing.
Of course, such an advancement was just a superficial pretension of incredibleness.
After cultivating this technique, even if one could become a Life Witch, it would be only because of strong Soul Power, with no actual combat ability at all.
Perhaps because he was deeply immersed in the cultivation of the simplified "Moonlight Technique," Dian Xiaosan's practice as a Magic Practitioner had not progressed much, but he was now closer to reaching the peak of Returning to Void.
After a brief inquiry to learn about Dian Xiaosan's cultivation situation, Yuan Ming refrained from additional disturbance and quietly left the place, heading towards the Artifact Refining Hall.
Upon stepping into the hall, the scorching atmosphere immediately made Yuan Ming squint his eyes.
He looked up and saw Xi Hezi sitting in front of the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, with a thoughtful expression on his brow.
Noticing Yuan Ming's arrival, Xi Hezi raised his head, a trace of joy flashing in his eyes, "The timing is just right; I was just about to look for you."
"Could it be that you've encountered some difficulty with the modification of the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod?" Yuan Ming asked with concern.
Before going into closed-door training, he had instructed Xi Hezi to carefully select among his Spiritual Treasures to identify those with the potential to advance to Great Perfection Spirit Treasure.
Finally, Xi Hezi chose the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod.
"This tripod was already close to the Perfect Realm, and after my meticulous modifications over the years, it is nearly perfect. Now, it only lacks the last kind of seventh-level spiritual material to complete its advancement," Xi Hezi shook his head and said slowly.
"Oh? What spiritual material is it?" Yuan Ming asked further.
"This spiritual material is called Nine-Colored Lotus Seed, known for its miraculous effect of endowing intelligence. Of course, other spiritual materials with similar effects can be used as a substitute, but the Nine-Colored Lotus Seed has the best effect," Xi Hezi explained.
"Endowing intelligence? You intend to help this tripod nurture an Artifact Spirit? I remember last time it only required injecting an Artifact Soul," Yuan Ming expressed some surprise.
"The last Spiritual Treasure was already endowed, so I could directly inject an Artifact Soul. But this tripod hasn't been endowed, making it difficult to bear the Artifact Soul I split off," Xi Hezi said with a bitter smile.
Yuan Ming now understood, and he stopped asking further questions, promising to quickly find the necessary spiritual material, and then left the Shura Palace to return to the City Lord's Hall.
"Relay orders to the other eighteen City Lords that they must personally come to White Emperor City to see me in ten days," Yuan Ming summoned Wang Fulong and commanded in a deep voice.
"Master, according to the rules, the City Lords of each city in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range cannot leave the city easily. Publicly ordering them to come might be somewhat inappropriate," Wang Fulong hesitated, showing difficulty in his expression.
"The regulation was originally set for the protection of the Pillar Hongjun. Now that the Ten Thousand Demon Country is weakening, allowing them to leave the city temporarily is no harm. Moreover, do you really think those City Lords adhere strictly to the rules, never leaving the city?" Yuan Ming smiled lightly.
Wang Fulong still appeared hesitant: "But..."
"No need for more words," a trace of coldness flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes, he paused and then said slowly:
"Tell them, in ten days, at least one Dharma manifestation Cultivator should be sent to White Emperor City for an audience. Any disobedient or evasive actions, I will personally visit to replace them with a more competent City Lord."
Wang Fulong was intimidated by the majesty in his words, shuddered all over, but then showed a look of joy, agreed in a single word and hurriedly departed.
Just as Wang Fulong left the hall, a familiar voice suddenly rang out, "Haha, not seen for many years, Brother Yuan has become even more awe-inspiring."
Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows, recognizing it was Wulu's voice.
He slightly closed his eyes, using the Eyes of Golden Flame to survey the surroundings.

chapters.title: Chapter 1031 - 996: Summons
chapters.content:
What surprised Yuan Ming was that even when he fully activated his Eyes of Golden Flame, he still couldn't see Wulu's figure.
"The Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman truly lives up to its reputation." Yuan Ming couldn't help but whisper in admiration.
However, a playful spirit surged in his heart. The silver moon mark on his brow flickered, and his Yin Moon Body was instantly activated. His body vanished like mist into the air, rendering the great hall empty and void of any presence.
It was at this moment that Wang Fulong, who hadn't gone far, suddenly heard a faint noise.
He turned back in confusion, only to see the empty great hall without a single silhouette. A perplexed expression crossed his face, unable to comprehend what had occurred.
Just as he turned to leave, the figures of Yuan Ming and Wulu suddenly appeared before him, a change so abrupt that it nearly startled him into crying out.
Fortunately, Wang Fulong reacted quickly, soon recognizing Wulu. Although filled with numerous doubts, he knew this was not something he could inquire about, so he respectfully bowed and turned to depart.
Yuan Ming and Wulu paid no mind to his reaction, their attention solely fixed on each other.
"Brother Yuan, what divine skill did you just use? I distinctly saw you vanish on the spot, yet I couldn't find you anywhere." Wulu asked curiously, his eyes gleaming with the light of inquiry.
"This is a divine skill I awakened after breaking through as a Life Witch, called the Yin Moon Body. Speaking of which, your Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman is somewhat similar to my divine skill. Why not let me take a look?" Yuan Ming said with a slight smile, extending his palm to Wulu.
Though Wulu was puzzled, he still took out the Stone Talisman and handed it to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming took the Stone Talisman and gently activated it, immediately feeling an invisible force enveloping his entire body, as if wrapped in a transparent barrier.
A flash of understanding crossed his eyes, and then he lifted the invisibility.
"Just as I thought, the invisibility effect of this talisman is entirely identical to my Yin Moon Body." Yuan Ming stated.
"Which means, this Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman was crafted in imitation of the Life Witch's divine ability, and its creator must have been a master Soul Cultivator?" Wulu asked in surprise upon hearing this.
"Very likely." Yuan Ming nodded in agreement.
They exchanged smiles, both filled with curiosity about this mysterious Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman.
Wulu, in particular, kept turning the talisman over in his hands, filled with deep emotion.
Who would've thought that this seemingly ordinary Stone Talisman turned out to be a Soul Cultivator's treasure, which is why he could use it to evade the detection of Dharma manifestation experts.
"Let's not talk about this. You've broken through to Dharma Phase; when did this happen? Why didn't you inform me in advance so I could protect you?" Yuan Ming suddenly changed the topic, scrutinizing Wulu.
"The breakthrough was quite urgent, so I didn't have time to notify you. However, I owe my success in breaking through largely to the Purple Extreme Tai Sui you gave me. By that account, you've indeed helped me greatly. I came this time specifically to repay this kindness." Wulu laughed upon hearing this.
"There's no need to talk about repayment between us." Yuan Ming waved his hand, smiling as he said this.The rightful source is NoveIＦire.net
As they talked, they strolled unknowingly from the great hall to the study.
Inside the study, atop an antique-looking desk, lay the Four Treasures of the Study, with a faint scent of ink lingering in the air.
After they sat down, Yuan Ming began brewing tea.
As boiling water poured into the teapot, a rich fragrance wafted through the room, relaxing the mind.
In this tranquil atmosphere, Wulu began to recount his experiences over the years.
"… Elder Jie Cha led me out of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, claiming to settle an old score with the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Poisons. He then took me deep into the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, where we went through numerous trials. During this time, he used the wondrous power of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui to amend the Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill, ultimately helping me successfully break through to the Dharma Manifestation Realm. Yet, after aiding my breakthrough, he left alone, his whereabouts unknown." Wulu narrated calmly, unfolding the story.
Yuan Ming listened quietly, not doubting what Wulu said.
However, upon hearing of Jie Cha's departure, he sighed lightly: "What a pity. If he were still here, I have some cultivation questions I'd like to consult him on."
"I think Elder Jie Cha might just want to travel alone in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range; he might come to White Emperor City someday. We'll have the chance to meet again." Wulu smiled upon seeing this.
Yuan Ming nodded, not dwelling too much on the matter. The path of cultivation is long, and fate is determined by the heavens; it cannot be forced.
"Let's set aside Elder Jie Cha's whereabouts for now, Brother Yuan; I must remind you of one thing. Over the years, I've discovered several places in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range where Demonic Qi has emerged. Although it may be leftover from the corrosion of the Heavenly Crane Array in years past, we can't rule out the possibility of it being something new." Wulu's expression turned serious, his tone becoming grave.
"What do you mean by that?" Yuan Ming asked, frowning.
"Based on the information I gathered, not only in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range but also in many places in the Chuyun Realm, there are signs of Demonic Qi appearing. The Demon World seems to be striving to break through the domain barriers; perhaps a domain war will erupt in the near future." Wulu continued.
At this point, a look of concern appeared on his face: "During the last domain war, countless cultivators in the Chuyun Realm fell, and even Dharma Phase experts faced nine lives and one death. The power we currently wield is still too weak. If we cannot break through to the Mahayana Realm, not to mention changing the situation, we might not even have the qualification to protect ourselves."
Yuan Ming silently sipped his tea without uttering a word.
The lingering aroma of tea swirled around his tongue, a contemplative expression on his face.
…
Xuanlong City, inside the City Lord Mansion.
"This is outrageous! He's been in office for just a short while, yet dares to boss us around and order us!" City Lord Qu Lixiang angrily slammed the jade scroll on the table, making a crisp sound, seemingly venting his dissatisfaction.
"City Lord, what has happened? Your expression doesn't look very good." At this moment, Deputy City Lord Liu He entered the room, seeing Qu Lixiang's face full of anger, he couldn't help but feel a jolt in his heart, cautiously inquiring.
Qu Lixiang took a deep breath, calming his emotions, then handed the jade scroll to Liu He: "See for yourself. This is from Yuan Ming."
Liu He took the jade scroll, quickly browsing through its contents.
His expression grew increasingly serious, furrowing his brow as he spoke: "He specifically requests us to send Dharma Phase Cultivators, clearly intending to establish his authority over us."
"Hmph, I long suspected this person is deeply cunning and won't be content with his current status. He must have secretly attracted a group of people, wanting to use this opportunity to assert his dominance." Qu Lixiang sneered, a trace of disdain flashing in his eyes.
"Still, we can't let our guard down. This person is ambitious, and if he succeeds, our future won't be easy." Liu He sighed.
"If that's the case, then we'll both go to see what he really wants to do. I estimate other cities will also bring their Dharma Phase cultivators, and there won't just be eighteen Dharma Phases. Together to pressure him, let's see how arrogant he can be! Establish authority? I'm afraid by then it'll be diminishing prestige!" Qu Lixiang's eyes flashed with sharpness.
"The City Lord speaks rightly; we cannot sit idle and await our fate. Let Yuan Ming see, the Lords of the eighteen cities are not ones he can easily manipulate!" Liu He nodded, agreeing.
…
Yin Mountain City, inside the City Lord Mansion.
Long Shan sat in the study, holding the jade scroll in his hand, scrutinizing it over and over, an expression of puzzlement on his face.
In the study, the atmosphere was quite heavy, with the wind outside gently blowing the curtains, seemingly whispering some unknown secrets.
"Brother, seeing your serious expression, what is it that has you puzzled?" Deputy City Lord Meng Jing approached, asking with concern.
"A few days ago, I showed my stance to Yuan Ming, essentially submitting to him. Logically, if he had plans or arrangements, he should inform me. However, apart from summoning the City Lords, there's no other information in this jade scroll, which is truly perplexing." Long Shan lightly tapped the jade scroll in his hand, speaking in a deep voice.
"Maybe, Yuan Ming the City Lord hasn't truly trusted you yet? After all, people's hearts are unpredictable; perhaps he's still observing." Meng Jing heard this, furrowing his brow, pondering for a moment before conjecturing.
"Your conjecture makes sense too. He's summoning the City Lords and requiring Dharma Phase Cultivators presence, clearly wanting to establish authority again. But from eighteen cities, including deputy city lords, at least twenty Dharma Phases will attend. If he doesn't contact me beforehand, how will he subdue everyone then?" Long Shan nodded, showing a thinking expression.
Meng Jing also fell into deep thought, the two silently facing each other, seemingly trying their best to fathom Yuan Ming's intentions.
No matter how they pondered, they couldn't discern any clue.
Eventually, Long Shan sighed, casually tossing the jade scroll aside, showing some helplessness on his face: "Forget it, since he doesn't want to contact me, I'm too lazy to deal with this cold shoulder. When the time comes, you'll accompany me to see what exactly he's plotting."
…
Ten days later, White Emperor City.
Inside the discussion hall, with lanterns just lit, twenty-eight Dharma Phase cultivators sat or stood, arranged in order.
Some were conversing jovially, others whispering quietly, seemingly not placing the upcoming meeting in their minds.
Outside the hall, ancient pines towered, a cool breeze blowing, yet unable to dispel the tension and anxiety deep in Wang Fulong's heart.
He sneaked a glance at the impressive Dharama Phases inside the hall, his palm unconsciously dampened with sweat.
As a Dharma Phase, though he had participated in numerous Dharma Phase gatherings, such an assembly of so many was unprecedented for him.
Moreover, recalling Yuan Ming's stern demeanor during the last instruction, Wang Fulong felt even more apprehensive.
He knew well that the forthcoming meeting would not be easy, and just thinking about the pressure Yuan Ming would face was enough to make him nervous.
"Where is he? Why hasn't he arrived yet?" Wang Fulong turned his head and asked urgently, revealing traces of anxiety in his voice.
Suddenly, a steady voice came from behind him: "Everyone is here?"
Upon hearing this, Wang Fulong turned around, seeing Yuan Ming walking steadily.
"Lord, you're finally here. Everyone is present, all eighteen City Lords without exception, and most also brought along their deputy city lords, totaling twenty-eight people." Wang Fulong immediately composed himself, respectfully answering.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, gesturing to Wang Fulong to step aside, then slowly walked into the hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 1032 - 997: Let's All Join In
chapters.content:
As Yuan Ming entered the hall, the noise within instantly came to a halt, and everyone's gaze simultaneously turned towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming walked lightly towards the main seat in the center of the hall, his gaze casually sweeping over the assembled Dharma Phase Cultivators, a meaningful smile tugging at the corners of his mouth.
The City Lords were all present in their true forms, and to some extent, they believed they were coerced by Yuan Ming to be there, which made their attitudes less pretense than usual.
In the face of Yuan Ming's gaze, some City Lords sneered repeatedly, some remained expressionless, only Long Shan gave him a concealed smile, while the others looked displeased.
Yuan Ming, however, seemed unfazed as he sat calmly on the main seat, composed and at ease.
"I won't say more than necessary. The matter to be discussed today is simple and direct. From today onwards, I will officially take over the Nineteen Cities of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. If any of you wish to continue serving as City Lords, aside from the necessary city operation costs, you must pay ninety percent of your profits as taxes." Yuan Ming's voice was calm and steady, yet it carried an unquestionable authority.
As soon as these words were uttered, they stirred up a thousand waves.
The City Lords were in an uproar, and the hall was filled with clamorous voices, as if they were about to lift the roof off this council hall.
Some City Lords even erupted with Dharma Phase auras in anger, attempting to pressure Yuan Ming into retracting his decree.
Among the crowd, even Long Shan frowned, particularly displeased with Yuan Ming's policy.
"Have you all finished arguing? I haven't finished speaking yet." Yuan Ming seemed oblivious to the crowd's reaction and merely spoke slowly, his voice instantly overwhelming them.
The City Lords immediately fell silent, casting hostile glances at Yuan Ming, eager to see what more he had to say.
"I know you are unwilling, but I am not a tyrant. I can give you a chance. Today, if you can defeat me, I will swear to relinquish control over the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range forever and never interfere in the affairs of the cities. Otherwise, you must swear to follow my orders from now on and never defy them." Yuan Ming spoke calmly.
As soon as these words were spoken, the hall was again filled with an uproar.
"Fine, I'll test you first!" As soon as Yuan Ming's words fell, Qu Lixiang shouted in anger and stood up immediately. His cultivation was the highest among the City Lords, just one step away from the Late-stage Dharma manifestation. Seeing him take the lead, the other City Lords fell silent, shifting their gazes to Yuan Ming, waiting for him to accept the challenge.
Just as everyone was expecting a fierce battle to erupt, Yuan Ming waved his hand and said indifferently, "City Lord Qu, you seem to misunderstand me. I did not mean to challenge you one-on-one."
"Ha, are you afraid?" Qu Lixiang sneered, the corners of his mouth curving into a sardonic smile.
"I just think a one-on-one duel is too much of a waste of time." Yuan Ming smiled slightly and said.
With that, he slowly stood up, his gaze sweeping across the venue, a hint of wild War Intent flashing in his eyes, and he said word by word, "All of you can come at me together."
These words left everyone astonished.
Everyone looked at Yuan Ming in surprise, unsure where he got the confidence to make such a bold statement.
Qu Lixiang laughed angrily instead and snorted, "City Lord Yuan, aren't you afraid of pulling a muscle with such boasting? You really underestimate us!"
Yuan Ming remained unmoved, simply saying, "There's no point in saying more. If you wish to challenge, then follow me outside the city."
He said this and, without caring about the reactions of the crowd, turned and walked out of the hall.
Qu Lixiang snorted coldly and followed closely, the other City Lords and Dharma Phase Cultivators exchanged glances and then rose, trailing behind Yuan Ming without exception.
The group quickly arrived above a vast mountain range outside the city.
Yuan Ming stood in midair, expressionlessly looking at the City Lords, seemingly without the intention to strike first.
"Everyone, strike with all your might and let City Lord Yuan see that we are not the worthless that he can easily handle!" Qu Lixiang encouraged, his whole body surging with mana as he summoned his Dharma manifestation.
Following his call, the Dharma Phase Cultivators all summoned their respective Dharma manifestations.
In an instant, twenty-eight Dharma manifestations appeared simultaneously in the sky, the dispersed mana causing the sky to change color.
The multicolored spirit light, carrying overwhelming momentum, bore straight down on Yuan Ming.
In the face of this immense mana pressure, if it were an ordinary Dharma Phase Cultivator, their Divine Soul might have been quivering in fear.
Yuan Ming merely chuckled dismissively, not even bothering to summon his Dharma manifestation, only a flash of the Dream Butterfly Dao Seal at his brow, directly casting an Illusion Technique.
Just as he made his move, it seemed the Dharma Phase Cultivators were prepared, as they collectively took out a talisman and slapped it onto their brows.
In an instant, a light blue spirit light emerged from each Dharma manifestation, connecting them into lines, linking everyone's Sea of Consciousness.
At this moment, the Illusion Technique descended.
To everyone's surprise, this Illusion Technique had no effect whatsoever.
Under the protection of the light blue spirit light, the Dharma Phase Cultivators instantly broke free from the Illusion Technique's shackles, their eyes regaining clarity.
"It seems you all came prepared today." Yuan Ming's lips curved slightly, offering a light smile, his voice laced with a hint of mockery.
"With City Lord Yuan's ever-changing methods, how could we not be on guard?" Qu Lixiang smiled smugly, a trace of slyness flashing in his eyes.
Before the words were finished, the twenty-eight Dharma manifestations simultaneously performed incantations, and the Dharma manifestations behind them launched an attack at once.
Instantly, the void was ablaze with fire, as if the sky had been ignited. Fierce winds howled, raising waves upon waves on the flat ground... Countless magic spells poured down like a torrential rain, sealing off the space where Yuan Ming was, impenetrably tight.
The next moment, Yuan Ming's figure vanished in the midst of everyone's attack, as if swallowed by the endless firepower, transforming into a mist of blood.
Everyone was astonished, not expecting that one strike could force Yuan Ming into such a situation.
Just as they were stunned, a flash of light appeared in mid-air, and Yuan Ming's figure reappeared.
His body was intact, his clothes fluttering, as if the previous attack had been nothing but a false alarm.
He raised his head to look at everyone, a hint of disdain in his eyes, and spat out two words lightly, "Is that all?"
All the Dharma phase cultivators fell silent immediately, their hearts filled with immense shock.
Their attack just now had combined the Five Elements Power and had included special techniques targeting the physical body and divine soul, yet it seemed they hadn't even scratched Yuan Ming's skin.
"I understand now, it's the Undying Body!" Long Shan suddenly realized, his voice tinged with fear.
Upon hearing this, all the Dharma phase cultivators felt a heaviness settle in their hearts, knowing that Body Cultivation was troublesome. It now seemed Yuan Ming's courage to face many alone stemmed from this.Thɪs updatᴇd by NoveI(F)ire.net
Qu Lixiang saw the morale dropping and hastily shouted, "Don't be intimidated! So what if he has an Undying Body? Body Cultivators are not skilled in group battles. We just need to guard against his Soul Cultivator techniques and swarm him; we might yet defeat him!"
Upon hearing this, everyone knew that there was no turning back now, and they must decide the outcome with Yuan Ming.
Thus, they all rallied their spirits and struck again, the glow of magic spells flickering as they attacked Yuan Ming together.
Yuan Ming, however, had no intention of entangling with them any further.
Then, a glow flashed on his forehead, the silver moon mark looming and fading.
The next moment, he vanished into thin air before everyone's eyes, as if merging into the void.
The multitude of magic spells crashed down wildly but hit nothing.
All the Dharma phase cultivators hurriedly extended their divine sense to search for Yuan Ming's trace, but wherever their divine sense swept, it found nothing, as if Yuan Ming had completely disappeared from the world.
Just at this moment, waves suddenly arose in the void beside them, as if something had broken through the space, yet they could see nothing of it, only feeling their bodies tighten, as if something was tightly binding them, unable to break free.
Not only that, the void around them pressed in simultaneously, completely imprisoning them where they stood.
They couldn't move their bodies, even the divine sense they extended was restricted within an inch around them, unable to extend further.
At this moment, they finally realized that Yuan Ming had reappeared.
Only now, his body had transformed into a towering ancient tree, and what was tightly entwining their bodies were precisely the roots of this tree.
Additionally, Yuan Ming used the World Tree's space-creating ability to confine them individually in small spaces.
This was also the reason their bodies and divine senses were both imprisoned.
Yuan Ming's World Tree transformation, after his continuous nurturing, had reached the Sixth Rank Upper Stage.
This tree was naturally of extremely high rank, effortlessly dealing with these City Lords, who at most, were only Mid-stage Dharma manifestation.
Having imprisoned everyone, Yuan Ming did not continue to attack.
After all, this was not a life-and-death battle; if he killed everyone, he couldn't explain it to Daoist Mu.
Though the City Lords were imprisoned, they were still trying to find ways to break free from the shackles.
But soon, they found they were utterly helpless against Yuan Ming's divine skill.
And the inability to communicate or contact the outside world only deepened their fear within.
"City Lord Yuan, I concede defeat. From now on, Yin Mountain City is willing to obey your commands, offering ninety percent of the earnings as tax!" Soon, the first to surrender appeared, and it was Long Shan.
He had already planned in his heart and had expressed his stance to Yuan Ming earlier. Now seeing the unfavorable situation, he naturally stood up immediately to demonstrate that his position had not changed.
With Long Shan being the first to stand up, the other City Lords, already intimidated by Yuan Ming's thunderous methods, also followed suit, expressing their willingness to submit under Yuan Ming.
Even the previously most arrogant Qu Lixiang lowered his head at this time, saying no more.
As the saying goes, circumstances are more powerful than people. In the face of absolute strength, all resistance is futile at any time.
To reach their current level of cultivation and position, they were by no means die-hard fools. Flexibility is necessary for longevity.
Soon after, everyone returned to the City Lord's Hall and took their seats. The hall was utterly silent, with no one daring to whisper or murmur, the atmosphere vastly different from before.
Yuan Ming once again sat on the main seat, looking at the City Lords below who dared not meet his gaze, and nodded in satisfaction.
"Soon, I will have someone bring the contract. Once you all sign, you may leave at your convenience." He waved his hand, his voice carrying an undisputed authority.

chapters.title: Chapter 1033 - 998: Elixir Ownership
chapters.content:
In the crowd, Long Shan hesitated for a moment, but eventually gathered the courage to step forward.
From his seat, Yuan Ming cupped his hands in salute, his voice carrying a touch of sincerity and helplessness: "City Lord Yuan, I have something to report to you. We do not covet private gain; in fact, we are forced by the powers behind us. Every year, a large portion of the city's income has to be tribute to the Upper Sect as a cost of protection. Otherwise, the Upper Sect can send someone to replace us at any time."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's brows slightly furrowed, and he gazed intensely at Long Shan: "Tribute? To whom do you have to pay tribute?"
"We city lords appear to have infinite glory, but in fact, we are puppets of those major forces. Almost all the profits from the city's revenue every year have to be completely tributed to the Upper Sect. It is the price we must pay for protection," Long Shan took a deep breath and said slowly.
Yuan Ming listened quietly, with deep thought in his heart.
He understood that the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range was rich in resources, naturally attracting countless forces' covetousness.
However, these forces want to manage these cities indirectly, thus supporting puppet city lords to profit from it.
"So how much profit did you use to tribute to the Upper Sect?" Yuan Ming asked in a deep voice.
"Almost all the profit from the revenue books has to be tributed. However, we would also find ways to falsify the books, squeezing out some profit from it," Long Shan hesitated for a moment, then whispered.
"All of it?" Yuan Ming was taken aback, as he thought the ninety percent profit he collected was already quite high, not expecting there was something higher.
He couldn't help but curiously ask: "Then where do your cultivation resources come from?"
Long Shan gave a bitter smile and said, "The Upper Sect issues some cultivation resources monthly according to the standards for Dharma manifestation cultivators. Besides, we also think of other ways to barely maintain the cultivation needed."
Yuan Ming nodded, his heart understanding.
It seemed these city lords used to exhaust all means for cultivation resources.
He swept his gaze across everyone and said in a deep voice: "The previous rules, I'll not care for now. But from now on, each city only needs to pay nine-tenths of the profit to me. Falsifying accounts will not be tolerated anymore. I will personally supervise this matter."
Upon hearing this, Long Shan looked troubled, hesitating as he said, "But... City Lord Yuan, although one-tenth of the profit is more than before, if someone from the Upper Sect comes, how should we respond?"
"Let them all come to me. I fear no cultivator below Mahayana. Besides, I am the Master of the Demon Mountain Range, a position personally appointed by Daoist Mu. The other several Great Mahayana Ancestors will likely give Daoist Mu face and will not easily bother us," Yuan Ming said with a slight smile.
The city lords exchanged a few glances, suddenly relieved.
With Yuan Ming's words, even if those from the Upper Sect come for questioning, they can all point their fingers at this person. If anything changes later, they can simply revert to the original state.
Yuan Ming looked at the expressions of the city lords and said slowly: "I have a suggestion. Would you be willing to hear me out?"
He paused for a moment, seeing everyone nodding in agreement, then continued: "I am willing to share an additional one-tenth of profit with you, but on one condition: You and your subordinates need to worship the Nether Moon God and help me gather Desire Power. This matter is purely voluntary, I will not force anyone."
Upon hearing this, a flash of surprise appeared in the city lords' eyes.
Long Shan was the first to rise, cupping his hands as he said: "City Lord Yuan is magnanimous, how could we decline? We are willing to worship the Nether Moon God and provide Desire Power for the city lord!"
The other city lords followed suit, rising one by one, with none expressing refusal.
In their view, worshiping the Nether Moon God was merely nominal, not affecting cultivation while allowing more profit, truly a win-win.
The Great Hall of the City Lord was filled with harmony, continuous laughter, and joy.Thɪs updatᴇd by novel✶fire.net
Soon, in this pleasant atmosphere, the eighteen city lords signed agreements with Yuan Ming, completely boarding Yuan Ming's warship.
...
A few days later, the auction was held as scheduled.
White Emperor City was bustling beyond imagination, full of prosperity, with countless cultivators gathering from all directions, streets bustling with people and carriages flowing endlessly.
The shops of all kinds were dazzling, exotic beasts, magical treasures, spiritual medicine—all available, breathtaking to behold.
However, amid this jubilant atmosphere, a more sensational news exploded like a thunder during the auction event—the Nineteen Cities of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range formally united, jointly forming the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, and a grand founding ceremony would be held half a year later, to which all major sects of the cultivation world would be invited to witness.
Once this news was released, it caused a huge uproar.
Like a whirlwind sweeping through clouds, the news spread rapidly, not only throughout the entire Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range but also beyond the mountain ranges, reaching every corner of the Chuyun Realm.
All major forces, upon hearing this news, were shocked.
Those forces supporting the puppet city lords in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range were particularly enraged, hastily sending urgent messages to the cities they controlled, desiring to uncover the truth of the matter.
Surprisingly, their messages fell like stones into the sea, receiving no response at all.
All major forces immediately convened emergency meetings to discuss countermeasures.
After intense discussions, they finally decided to take initiative, publicly stating they would send envoys to the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range to attend the founding ceremony of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals.
In this turmoil, the Heavenly Saint Academy, Taixuan Sect, and Bright Moon Palace were undoubtedly the most notable forces.
As leaders in the cultivation world, they acted as joint leaders, leading the way to the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, undoubtedly adding solemnity and grandeur to this founding ceremony.
The discussions in the outside world did not affect the tranquility of White Emperor City.
The auction continued smoothly in an atmosphere of harmony.
Finally, the auction concluded perfectly without any unexpected incidents.
...
Two months later, Yuan Ming used the two sixth-level Demon Pills obtained at the auction as a catalyst to successfully refine two Dharma Manifestation Pills.
These two elixirs were crystal clear, emitting a faint spirit light, seemingly containing endless powers of heaven and earth.
As for the ownership of these two Dharma Manifestation Pills, Yuan Ming had already made a decision in his mind.
However, he also understood that the allure of the Dharma Manifestation Pill was immense, and those who desired them were definitely more than two.
Now, Yuan Ming was no longer the solitary figure he was when he first arrived at Dongji Sea.
A group of loyal followers had gathered around him, some were believers brought from Dongji Sea, while others were cultivators recently recruited under his command, all of whom had become indispensable allies.
Among them, the believers brought from Dongji Sea were led by Hua Zhi, Vajra, Lei Yu, and Dian Xiaosan.
They had gone through storms with Yuan Ming, shared many difficult moments together, and long became comrades through life and death.
And another batch of followers were centered around Wang Fulong, He Xiuwen, and Zheng Heng, many being cultivators of the Sunset Sect, recruited by Wang Fulong over time, and now becoming capable generals under Yuan Ming's command.
When Yuan Ming announced the decision to bestow the two Dharma Manifestation Pills upon Hua Zhi and Dian Xiaosan, the scene erupted with a wave of reactions.
Numerous cultivators displayed looks of surprise and doubt, whispering among themselves.
Hua Zhi's strength was formidable, and her gift was extraordinary, this fact was undisputed.
As Yuan Ming's spirit pet, it was only natural for her to receive a Dharma Manifestation Pill.
In everyone's eyes, Dian Xiaosan was merely an alchemist, and with his age advancing, even with the aid of a Dharma Manifestation Pill, the chances of breaking through to the Dharma Manifestation Realm were exceedingly slim.
Therefore, the cultivators including Wang Fulong voiced their objections to Yuan Ming, hoping to vie for the opportunity of the second Dharma Manifestation Pill.
"I am well aware of your concerns. However, this Dharma Manifestation Pill inherently belongs to Dian Xiaosan. I assure you, he will surely succeed in breaking through to the Dharma manifestation stage." Yuan Ming spoke with a steady voice, his words firm and undeniable.
The group led by Wang Fulong exchanged glances, unwilling but seeing Yuan Ming's resolute attitude, had to give up.
In their hearts, they pondered the chasm between the Returning to Void Stage and the Dharma manifestation stage in the cultivation path; numerous geniuses had fallen here, what distinguishes Dian Xiaosan? They feared this Dharma Manifestation Pill was destined to go into waste.
Yuan Ming did not offer further explanation, waved his hand, and everyone departed, leaving only Hua Zhi and Dian Xiaosan.
When the Dharma Manifestation Pills were handed to them, a light of joy flickered in their eyes.
"Master, rest assured, Hua Zhi will surely meet expectations and break through to the Dharma manifestation!" Hua Zhi pledged confidently, her eyes gleamed with determination.
Dian Xiaosan appeared somewhat uneasy, looked down at the Dharma Manifestation Pill in his hand, hesitantly saying, "This Dharma Manifestation Pill is so precious, with my ordinary talent, I'm afraid I cannot carry this responsibility, it might be better left to others."
"Fellow Daoist Dian, you need not worry. Since I have given this pill to you, it means I trust you can break through. If you lack confidence in yourself, then trust me this once, how about that?" Yuan Ming smiled gently, saying this.
Upon hearing this, gratitude filled Dian Xiaosan's eyes.
Yuan Ming extended a hand, his five fingers rapidly transformed into green-gray tree vines, gently wrapping around the wrists of Dian Xiaosan and Hua Zhi.
"With the power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin, I shall assist you in refining your physical body and Mana, do not resist."
Upon hearing this, the two immediately sat cross-legged, closed their eyes, and focused their minds.
The next moment, a rich life force flowed into them, like the water of a hot spring, infiltrating their flesh and blood.
Hua Zhi was extremely sensitive to wood attribute spiritual power, and as this force entered her body, she nearly lost her composure and nearly revealed her true form.
But she quickly steadied her mind, calmed down, and carefully felt the transformative influence of the power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin on herself.
While Dian Xiaosan experienced a different type of extreme shock.
He felt his rather aged body, under the nourishment of the power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin, radiate newfound life vitality.
His dry, yellow hair turned shiny black, his withered skin became swollen, and black oily substances seeped from his pores.
Even more incredible, his Mana within the Dantian also became purer under the influence of this power, impurities were gradually cleared away.
This process lasted an entire day and night, until noon the next day, Yuan Ming slowly retracted the vines of the World Tree.
At this time, some areas on Hua Zhi's body revealed the true form of tree vines, covered with enchanting large flowers, exuding a rich life aura.
Whereas Dian Xiaosan had undergone a transformation, albeit his appearance had not changed significantly, his aura and temperament were completely different as if he became a new person.

chapters.title: Chapter 1034 - 999: Becoming an Artifact Spirit
chapters.content:
"Truly a sight to behold, unimaginable... Such an improvement can only be attributed to the effects of a seventh-level elixir like the 'Nine-Transformation Leopard Transformation Pill,' wouldn't you say?" Dian Xiaosan exclaimed in amazement.
"This is only the refinement of the body and Mana. Your Divine Souls haven't reached the standard for breaking through to the Dharma manifestation stage. They, too, need refining." Yuan Ming observed the two for a moment and remarked.
Upon hearing this, Hua Zhi and Dian Xiaosan were taken aback, exchanging puzzled glances.
"Master, may I ask if Divine Souls can also be refined?" Hua Zhi blinked her bright eyes and curiously inquired further.
Yuan Ming remained silent, and with a thought, a Dao Seal on his Nascent Soul suddenly shone brightly.
In the next instant, a black-and-white rune Dao Seal flew out from his Dantian, transforming into a colossal Tai Chi yin-yang pattern that hovered above the two's heads.
Before the two could react, the Tai Chi yin-yang pattern began to rotate slowly, and two gentle lights emerged from the white portion, entwining around their bodies.
Under the cover of these lights, Hua Zhi and Dian Xiaosan's forms rapidly shrank, turning into two babbling infants in the blink of an eye.
As the white light rotated, their bodies gradually grew, transforming from infants to children, then from children to youths, finally returning to their original forms.
This process took only a few brief moments.
They seemed to have experienced a cycle of reincarnation, being reborn anew.
Their eyes went from complex to bewildered, from bewildered to awakened, then from awakened to chaotic, ultimately returning to clarity.
This soul refining lifted the burdens from their hearts, making them forget all worries and troubles, leaving them pure-hearted, like newborn infants, with crystal-clear souls untainted.
Feeling an unprecedented sense of ease and freedom, they both showed relieved smiles.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming gently waved his hand, and the Dao Seal of the Life and Death Reincarnation Path retracted slowly.
The recent soul refining was the doing of the awakened Wheel of Life Divine Power from this Dao Seal.
Additionally, he had also awakened the Death Wheel Divine Power, emitting a faint black light capable of annihilating an enemy's Divine Soul directly.
"Now that your minds are pure, you can focus on your cultivation in seclusion," said Yuan Ming, guiding them to a secret chamber in the City Lord Mansion for seclusion training.
...
Within a little over half a month, above the City Lord Mansion, two beams of Dharma manifestation light shot up into the sky, their imposing presence once again shaking the entire city.
After taking the Dharma Manifestation Pill, both Hua Zhi and Dian Xiaosan lived up to expectations, successfully stepping into the Dharma manifestation stage.
Especially Dian Xiaosan, who was not initially considered promising, yet with the fortune of breaking through to the Dharma manifestation stage, he made progress in the Soul Cultivation path too, cultivating the simplified version of the "Moonlight Technique" to the sixth level and successfully entering the Realm of Life Witch.
This event left Wang Fulong and others with immense admiration for Yuan Ming, reaching the point of reverent worship.
They were convinced that it must have been some nature-defying Secret Technique employed by Yuan Ming to help Dian Xiaosan break through the shackles of the Dharma manifestation stage.
Many cultivators, stuck at the bottleneck of the Dharma manifestation stage for years, saw hope for a breakthrough and followed Yuan Ming even more fervently, hoping to receive his guidance and assistance one day.
At this moment, in a newly built hall within the Extreme Fire Realm of the Shura Palace, Xi Hezi and Senior Kong were intently focusing around a scarlet Three-legged Round Tripod.
This towering tripod stood tall, with intricate patterns interwoven, unique runes flickering, and had twelve openings around the furnace's body, unmistakably the legendary Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod.
At that moment, the hall doors opened slowly as Yuan Ming escorted Dian Xiaosan, who had recently broken through to the Dharma manifestation stage, stepping inside.
Yuan Ming was about to speak when his gaze fell on Senior Kong, his eyes flashing with surprise and suspicion.
It had been a long time, and Kong seemed different from before.
He still maintained Yuan Ming's appearance, but there wasn't the slightest sense of illusion, seeming no different from an ordinary person.
Yuan Ming could almost glimpse through his exterior, faintly seeing the bones and flesh within.
Seemingly unaware of Yuan Ming's scrutiny, Kong looked at Dian Xiaosan, "Dian Xiaosan, the path of cultivation is arduous. Advancing to the Dharma manifestation stage is a long-cherished wish that many cultivators seek yet find difficult to attain. Are you prepared to become the Artifact Spirit of this Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod?"
"Senior, my mind is made up, and I will not change my resolve." Dian Xiaosan nodded, speaking with determination.
Yuan Ming watched everything unfold without showing any signs of surprise.
The whole story had long been told to him by Kong.
The reason Kong imparted the simplified version of the Moonlight Technique to Dian Xiaosan, elevating his Soul Power to the level of a Life Witch, and asked Yuan Ming to help him break through to the Dharma manifestation stage, was for one purpose: to nurture a seventh-level Alchemist.
In the Chuyun Realm, sixth-level Alchemists were few, maybe twenty or thirty, but seventh-level Alchemists, as far as Yuan Ming knew, were only three, located at the Heavenly Saint Academy, the Taixuan Sect, and the Bright Moon Palace.
In Alchemy, the gap between the sixth and seventh level was greater than the sum of the gap from level one to level six, and those who could break through had exceptional talent in the Alchemy Dao.
Dian Xiaosan had good talent in Alchemy, but merely good. With conventional methods, the possibility of advancing to a seventh-level Alchemist was nearly impossible. After much thought, Kong devised an unconventional approach, achieving seventh-level Alchemist status through being an Artifact Spirit.
The Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod is a Pill King Pavilion Inheritance object, used by countless Alchemy Masters. When this tripod reaches Great Perfection as a Spirit Treasure, there is a high probability of awakening the True Meaning of Alchemy.
As a sixth-level Alchemist, Dian Xiaosan, by relying on this True Meaning of Alchemy, would certainly advance in his Alchemy Technique, having the opportunity to glimpse the realm of a seventh-level Alchemist.
"In past life, everyone desired for Artifact Spirits to cultivate diligently to free themselves from the shackles of a Spiritual Treasure and transform into human form. It's rare to see someone like you willing to turn from human to Artifact Spirit," Xi Hezi remarked, shaking his head with a smile.
"My life's goal is the Alchemy Dao, with no other pursuits. However, my aptitude is limited. Without a fortuitous encounter, a sixth-level Alchemist is my zenith, and a seventh-level is beyond reach. Now that the opportunity presents itself, how can I miss it?" Dian Xiaosan's demeanor was filled with resolve.
"I will say upfront; this method isn't foolproof, with only a forty to fifty percent success rate. Even so, are you resolute?" Kong asked.
"I will not regret it. For this endeavor, I've already shamelessly used a Dharma Manifestation Pill, and the expenses on Soul Cultivation have been immense. Even if I fail, I will harbor no resentment," Dian Xiaosan answered honestly.
"Good!" Kong raised his hand, injecting a surge of pure Mana into the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod.
The crimson pill furnace trembled slightly, emitting twelve different colors of light, dazzling and magnificent.
The top lid of the pill furnace floated gently upwards, with smoke swirling inside.
A flash of determination and anticipation appeared in Dian Xiaosan's eyes. Without hesitation, he leapt in, sitting cross-legged inside the pill furnace.
With a "clang," the lid fell heavily, sealing Dian Xiaosan in the depths of the pill furnace.
Immediately, rays of light shot up from the ground, and an extremely intricate array gradually emerged.
Yuan Ming observed carefully and discovered that this array was ingeniously combined from the refining, capturing spirit, and melding spirit arrays.
Though the individual arrays were not of high grade, their combination reached the sixth-level magic array.
When the light of the array completely enveloped the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, Kong's figure flickered and he drifted above the crimson pill furnace.
Sitting cross-legged in the void, his hands quickly shifted spell formulas, and a surging desire power erupted from him, transforming into a blinding white light that rapidly merged into the pill furnace below.
The twelve streams of Earth Fire within the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod surged out, tightly enveloping the furnace body.
The temperature inside the grand hall rose sharply, scorching waves billowed.
Suddenly, a heartrending howl resonated from within the pill furnace, soul-stirring.
With one's body as food, refining flesh and blood, merging with the divine soul, this process was so brutal and painful that even someone like Yuan Ming, who had suffered much hardship, couldn't help but furrow his brow and show a look of compassion upon hearing the howl.
Fortunately, the pain didn't last long. With a soft "puff," the dreadful howl abruptly ceased.
Immediately, the light inside the pill furnace intensified, a blurred bloody light spread from within, quickly covering the entire furnace.
A faint red shade gathered over the twelve-colored Earth Fire, as if stained with fresh blood.
Subsequently, rune inscriptions began to surface one after another on the furnace body, glowing with a subtle light, as if conveying some ancient secret.
The moment the thirty-sixth rune condensed, all runes resonated with each other, forming a brand new rune array.
At the same time, a prolonged "buzz" sounded from within the pill furnace. The roaring flames swiftly retracted, and the blood light on the furnace was wholly absorbed, merging into the furnace body.
Everything returned to tranquility, the light of the array on the ground gradually dimmed, but only the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod continued to emit residual warmth, oscillating with waves of ripples.
"How did it go?" Yuan Ming stepped forward and asked.
Before Kong could respond, a virtual light suddenly floated out from the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, rapidly condensing into a human figure—Dian Xiaosan.
"It's a success. I have fused with the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod. This treasure has now condensed thirty-six runes, becoming a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure," Dian Xiaosan said with a smile.
"Have you awakened the True Meaning of Alchemy?" Yuan Ming further inquired.
"It doesn't seem so..." Dian Xiaosan closed his eyes to sense, then shook his head with a pale face.
Yuan Ming felt a thud in his heart. He and Kong put in painstaking efforts with the aim of creating a seventh-level alchemist, but if the True Meaning of Alchemy couldn't be awakened, all their efforts would be in vain.
"The casting is not yet over. Yuan Ming, take out the Eight-Colored Lotus Seed!" Kong's voice rang in Yuan Ming's ears like morning bell evening drum, pulling him from his contemplation.
Yuan Ming came back to his senses. With a gentle twist of his wrist, a delicate lotus seed appeared in the palm of his hand.
The lotus seed emitted eight-colored spirit light, resembling a miniature rainbow, shimmering with astonishing spiritual energy.
Yuan Ming had spent considerable effort searching for the Nine-Colored Lotus Seed during this time, but unfortunately, he hadn't found it and only found the Eight-Colored Lotus Seed.
Though the Eight-Colored Lotus Seed wasn't as perfect as the Nine-Colored Lotus Seed, it still had the effect of transforming spiritual objects, albeit with a smaller chance.
Yuan Ming tossed it up, and the Eight-Colored Lotus Seed transformed into a streak of flowing light, flying into the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod.
Under the high heat steaming, the lotus seed quickly vaporized into eight-colored spiritual qi, weaving into the body of the tripod like threads.
"Merge into the tripod and carefully comprehend," Kong's timely voice advised, like a guiding light for the lost.
The Artifact Spirit that Dian Xiaosan had become didn't hesitate at the words, merging into the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod.
He seemed to step into another realm, witnessing various scenes of pill refining from the tripod's past.
These scenes flitted past his eyes like a running horse lamp, each imbued with profound alchemy.
Dian Xiaosan's mind immersed in it, forgetting the distractions of the outside world, wholeheartedly comprehending.
He observed every detail and every change carefully, as if engraving the alchemy of the tripod deep in his heart.
Kong continued his casting, streams of desire power poured into the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, with the surrounding void echoing hazy sounds, as if deities and buddhas were chanting scriptures, or countless people were shouting.
Yuan Ming displayed an expression of astonishment but did not speak to disturb.
After an unknown length of time, rays of seven-colored spiritual light suddenly shot out from the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, gushing forth an intangible power.
Under the effect of this power, the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod completed another advancement, a Pill Treasure True Intent condensed, perfectly merging with Dian Xiaosan's Artifact Spirit consciousness.Follow current novᴇls on novel·fire·net
With the fusion completed, the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod quaked violently, its size rapidly shrinking.
Eventually, it transformed into a colorful tripod the size of a palm, quietly floating in the air, emitting a faint spiritual light.
The Artifact Spirit that Dian Xiaosan had become once again floated out above the pill furnace.
This time, there was no hint of regret on his face, replaced by uncontrollable joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1035 - 1000: Seeking Refuge
chapters.content:
"It succeeded! I've comprehended the true intent of the Pill Treasure, and I've already touched the threshold of a seventh-level alchemist. With this sliver of true intent, I've even glimpsed the scenery beyond that door. I believe that after some time of deep cultivation and hard work, I will be able to break through the bottleneck and officially step into the realm of a seventh-level alchemist," Dian Xiaosan said excitedly.
"Congratulations, Fellow Daoist, your efforts have finally paid off." Yuan Ming relaxed upon hearing this.
Once things had settled here, Yuan Ming bid farewell to everyone. Xi Hezi and Void stayed behind to continue assisting Dian Xiaosan in perfecting the fusion with the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod.
Before long, Yuan Ming's figure appeared above the Flower Garden Wilderness. He arrived under the towering World Tree to meet with the Five Elements Child.
"Can this eight-colored lotus seed also be grafted onto the World Tree?" Yuan Ming took out another treasured eight-colored lotus seed and gently handed it to the Five Elements Child.
"If the Innate Bitter Bamboo can be cultivated, this eight-colored lotus seed is naturally no problem." The Five Elements Child took the lotus seed and said confidently.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was naturally delighted.
At this moment, the void beside him suddenly fluctuated, and Void's figure appeared out of thin air.
He looked at Yuan Ming with a teasing smile in his eyes: "You, always so resourceful, never miss a chance to utilize the World Tree."
"Make the best use of everything, why not?" Yuan Ming replied with a smile.
"Your idea isn't wrong, but the spiritual power contained in this World Tree is ultimately limited. It has become the foundation of the Shura Palace. If overused, the Shura Palace would lose hope in advancement, which would be more than an offsetting loss," Void reminded.
"Did you see through that as well?" Yuan Ming was moved.
"Of course, although this World Tree appears lush and full of life, it is essentially a dead object, completely different from the World Tree in your Dantian," Void said.
"I also wish to reduce the use of this World Tree, but with the imminent disaster, I have to sacrifice it for now," Yuan Ming said rather helplessly.
"It's yours, think it through carefully," Void said.
"Thank you for your guidance, senior. I have another matter to ask. The secret technique you used to help Dian Xiaosan, powered by Desire Power, was quite mysterious. I'm curious, what kind of divine skill was that? It seemed quite similar to the Great Wish of All Living Beings. Could it be that you also know the Great Wish of All Living Beings?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"That is the Fengtian Secret Technique, and it relies on the Stealing Heaven Tripod to be cast. It can enhance one's luck, somewhat similar to the Great Wish of All Living Beings, but also very different," Void explained.
"Enhance luck? There's such a divine skill!" Yuan Ming looked surprised.
"Your mastery of the Stealing Heaven Tripod is not enough. Once you break the restriction near the golden hall inside the tripod, you can uncover its true secrets," Void said slowly.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming grew even more curious.
He began to plan in his mind, preparing to summon the other city lords to White Emperor City to use the power of the Four Mountains Linked Seal to jointly break the seventh-level restriction of the golden hall.
"Kid, are you already plotting how to break the restriction of the golden hall?" Void seemed to see through his thoughts and smiled slightly.
"Senior's insight is indeed sharp. I do have this plan," Yuan Ming admitted with a smile.
"Don't say I didn't warn you, but to break the restriction of the golden hall, the power of the Four Mountains Linked Seal alone is far from enough. Your array formation cultivation needs to reach at least the seventh level to stand a chance," Void's words carried an unfathomable meaning.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's smile gradually froze, and he said bitterly, "What Senior said is absolutely correct. I also wish to elevate my array formation cultivation to the seventh level, but unfortunately, with my potential, it seems it would be impossible in a lifetime."
He had a clear understanding of himself, and the tactic of spirit possession for comprehension was obviously not feasible either.
All these years in the Chuyun Realm, Yuan Ming had never heard of anywhere having a level 7 array master.
As Yuan Ming calmed himself to ponder, a sudden bright idea struck, bringing inexplicable joy to his heart: "Since senior has mentioned it, you must know something. Could it be that senior knows where to find a level 7 array master?"
Void looked at him, a flash of appreciation in his eyes, yet he did not directly answer and remained silent for a long while before slowly saying, "Recently, you've collected a number of Dharma manifestation stage believers, and the amount of Desire Power is quite considerable. Since that's the case, let me point you the right path."
"Please enlighten me, senior!" Yuan Ming became extremely excited and urgently pressed for answers.
Void smiled slightly, but did not explain, only hinting: "You might want to ask Wulu, perhaps he can bring you considerable gains."
As soon as he finished speaking, before Yuan Ming could ask further, Void's figure had already transformed into blue smoke and vanished.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming shook his head with a smile, yet his heart was filled with anticipation.
He turned and left the Shura Palace. Upon returning to the City Lord Mansion, he heard Wang Fulong's voice outside the door:
"City Lord, someone claiming to be an old acquaintance from Dongji Sea has come to see you."
"An old acquaintance from Dongji Sea?" Yuan Ming felt a burst of surprise.
"I have arranged for them to be received in the main hall. Would you like to meet with them?" Wang Fulong continued to inquire.
"Let's go have a look."
After Yuan Ming finished speaking, he stood up and left for the guest hall with Wang Fulong.
...
As he stepped into the guest hall, Yuan Ming immediately saw the woman sitting beside the table.
She was dressed in a deep black robe, as profound as ink, her entire aura cleverly concealed, and her face covered with a thin veil, making her appear mysterious and strange.
Such attire, under ordinary circumstances, would inevitably draw suspicion.
Yuan Ming's cultivation had long surpassed that of ordinary people, and through the faint black mist, he easily captured the fluctuations deep within the woman's divine soul. With a slight smile, he already knew the identity of the other party.
"Wang Fulong, you go ahead and attend to your tasks," Yuan Ming softly instructed. After Wang Fulong left, only he and the woman in the black robe remained in the hall.
The woman slowly rose, her black robe gently swaying in the wind, and she gracefully performed a salutation towards Yuan Ming, her voice soft and slightly trembling: "City Lord Yuan, I am Yu Xi, a friend of your old acquaintance, specifically here to seek refuge."
"Yu Xi? That name is quite distinctive, but I remember you prefer to use the name Yun Luo, don't you?" Upon hearing this, a hint of teasing flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes, and he chuckled lightly.
Upon hearing his words, the woman was slightly taken aback, then gently removed her veil, revealing a lovely face now tinged with a bit of embarrassment and helplessness. It was none other than Yun Luo Fairy, who had not appeared for a long time.
"City Lord Yuan, your insight is indeed exceptional, this little disguise is truly insignificant before you," Yun Luo Fairy sighed, speaking in a low voice.
"Yun Luo Fairy, it has been a long time, how have you been?" Yuan Ming asked with a smile, his tone filled with concern and curiosity.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, unlike you, who are now the master of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, enjoying limitless glory, I am in a shabby state. After parting at Dongji Sea, I thought I could peacefully cultivate, but unexpectedly..." Yun Luo Fairy gently shook her head and sighed.
Her words were filled with bitterness and helplessness.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel moved, and he asked warmly: "Yun Luo Fairy, I fear your visit this time is not only for reminiscing, is it?"
Yun Luo Fairy looked up at Yuan Ming, a hint of determination and decisiveness flashing in her eyes: "That's right, I've come to seek refuge with Fellow Daoist Yuan. However, I am not alone, but with nearly half of our Su Nu Sect disciples. Just, I wonder if Fellow Daoist Yuan dares to shelter us?"
"Yun Luo Fairy, you have indeed presented me with a challenge. However, since I, Yuan Ming, am the master of this Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, I'm certainly not afraid of any challenge. I just want to know, what kind of trouble have you encountered that has caused you to leave your home and come to seek refuge with me?" Yuan Ming laughed heartily upon hearing this.
Upon hearing this, Yun Luo Fairy's smile gradually faded and was replaced by a heavy expression.
She took a deep breath and slowly said: "We have been pursued by Sect Master Si Rong, and the remaining disciples are currently hiding in Beihai City, not daring to show their faces. Only I managed to sneak here with all my effort."
Saying this, her voice was already somewhat choked.
"Yun Luo Fairy, first tell me your experiences in detail, and then I will consider whether to shelter you." Yuan Ming said in a heavy tone, seeing her situation.
Upon hearing this, Yun Luo Fairy sighed again, recalled for a moment, and began to speak:
"Back then, after I broke through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, I returned to the Central Continent, originally not planning to return to the Su Nu Sect, thinking it was just fine to protect my clan and peacefully cultivate.
