In fact, I did indeed cultivate peacefully for many years afterward, but ultimately could not escape from the pursuit by the Su Nu Sect…"
Later, Sect Master Si Rong of the Su Nu Sect, accompanied by her Dharma manifestation Stage lover, arrived at Yun Luo Fairy's hiding place, shattering her originally peaceful life.
Over the years, Yun Luo Fairy had secretly been selling Dan Recipes from the Pill King Secret Manual, and accumulated a large sum of Spirit Stones.
She used this money to refine a extremely powerful defensive Spiritual Treasure, the Taiyi Five Smoke Luo.
With this treasure, Yun Luo Fairy defended against their attack and managed to escape.Newest update provided by novel(ꜰ)ire.net
"Did Qin Meiniang from the Su Nu Sect also participate in the pursuit?" Yuan Ming's eyebrows slightly furrowed, his tone carrying some concern.
"I only learned about Qin Meiniang's whereabouts after returning to the Su Nu Sect. She mysteriously disappeared soon after breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, and her whereabouts remain unknown. Si Rong, having lost her support, felt unsupported, which is why she set her sights on me." Yun Luo Fairy gently shook her head and replied.
"Then what's the situation with those Su Nu Sect cultivators you brought along?" Yuan Ming continued to ask.
"I took advantage of Si Rong's opportunity of leaving to search for me, and quietly returned to the Su Nu Sect. I knew the sect was filled with unrest, so I took the chance to gather a group of cultivators who were already dissatisfied with Si Rong's leadership of the sect. We hit it off immediately, and decided to leave the sect and seek a new path together." Yun Luo Fairy laughed, with a bit of self-satisfaction.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, you truly won't take even a slight loss, Si Rong must be going mad after discovering her home was robbed?" Yuan Ming joked upon hearing her words.
"When is that woman not mad? But this time did touch her sore spot, thus the pursuit became more ruthless afterward. Many disciples following me couldn't escape and even after admitting fault and expressing willingness to return to the sect, they were still killed by her." Yun Luo Fairy said.
After speaking, she turned her wrist, and half of the "Pill King Secret Manual" floated in her palm, offered with both hands to Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, as long as you are willing to shelter us, this half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual' is yours," Yun Luo Fairy said, her expression somewhat unnatural.
"It seems the trouble you encountered is not small." Yuan Ming frowned slightly, feeling a bit surprised.
He knew very well what this half of the "Pill King Secret Manual" meant to her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1036 - 1001: Direct Confrontation
chapters.content:
"Si Rong's lover is indeed not simple; he is not only an outstanding Dharma Phase Cultivator but also an Inner Elder of Taixuan Sect with overwhelming power. His influence is enough to stir the entire Taixuan Sect," Yun Luo Fairy sighed lightly.
Her voice carried a faint trace of unease as her gaze fell on Yuan Ming, seemingly probing his reaction.
Yuan Ming's face remained as calm as still water, his eyes neither surprised nor fearful, as though the name of this Taixuan Sect Elder meant nothing special to him.
"I can promise to shelter you, but the condition is that all disciples of Su Nu Sect must worship the Nether Moon God," Yuan Ming said indifferently.
"Are you not worried about stirring up trouble because of this? After all, he is a powerful elder within Taixuan Sect," Yun Luo Fairy frowned slightly, seeming a bit puzzled.
"Since I dare to promise, I naturally have countermeasures. Some risk isn't enough to make me retreat," Yuan Ming chuckled.
"What specifically does worshipping the Nether Moon God require us to do?" Yun Luo Fairy's concern lessened slightly, she asked again.
"Daily prayers to the Nether Moon God, contributing Desire Power is adequate. Occasionally, you might need to help the Moon Sect with some tasks," Yuan Ming explained.
"Is that all?" Yun Luo Fairy was somewhat in disbelief; such requirements seemed much easier than they had imagined.
"Given your cultivation level, there indeed isn't much you can do. Peaceful prayer is the best assistance," Yuan Ming said.
Yun Luo Fairy frowned in thought for a moment and asked again, "Do we need to do those... customary things we once excelled at?"
"Since you've decided to defect, presumably you're unwilling to repeat the same mistakes. If I let you continue as before, how would it differ from Si Rong?" Yuan Ming chuckled lightly, retorting.
Upon hearing this, Yun Luo Fairy's last trace of doubt evaporated, and she looked at Yuan Ming gratefully, whispering, "Thank you, Fellow Daoist Yuan."
Yuan Ming smiled and shook his head, receiving from Yun Luo Fairy the half portion of the "Pill King Secret Manual," marking the conclusion of the transaction.
He casually flipped through the secret manual; although the Dan recipes were extremely precious, to him, they were no longer essentials.
When his gaze landed on a recipe named "Three Flowers and Five Qi Pill," a gleam flashed in his eyes.
This ability to condense Three Flowers and Five Qi is exclusive to Mahayana cultivators, yet this elixir allows Dharma Phase Cultivators to temporarily possess Mahayana power, making it an invaluable life-saving item.
Just as Yuan Ming intended to study this recipe carefully, Yun Luo Fairy suddenly took out a Communication Magic Plate; upon looking at the message, her face changed dramatically.
"What's wrong?" Yuan Ming noticed her unusual expression and asked.
"Si Rong has already brought pursuers to Beihai City; our sanctuary has been exposed and is now surrounded, the situation is very critical," Yun Luo Fairy said anxiously.
"No matter, I'll go with you to have a look," Yuan Ming's expression didn't change much, he said calmly.
After speaking, a phantom figure appeared beside him, the Artifact Spirit of the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod—Dian Xiaosan.
He handed the half portion of the "Pill King Secret Manual" to Dian Xiaosan and then, accompanied by Yun Luo Fairy, left the reception hall for the Transmission Hall at the City Lord Mansion.
As soon as the two arrived at the Transmission Hall, Wulu's figure emerged from a Teleportation Array.
Seeing Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy approach, Wulu couldn't spare further questions and hurriedly followed them into the Array.
In a flash, the Great Array activated, lights flickered, and the three figures disappeared simultaneously, transmitted to Beihai City.
Arriving at Beihai City's Transmission Hall, Wulu simply questioned Yun Luo Fairy a few times before understanding the whole story.
As soon as the trio stepped out of the City Lord Mansion doors, they sensed fierce waves of mana emanating from the north of the city, like a storm was brewing.
They stretched their forms, transforming into three beams of light racing towards the source of the turbulence.
In the north of the city, suspended above a serene and elegant garden villa, several figures confronted each other in the air, the atmosphere tense.
On one side, Si Rong wore a pink palace dress and stood with a burly, iron-bearded elder, the Su Nu Sect's Sect Master and the powerful Taixuan Sect Elder.
On the other side, about seven or eight cultivators, led by a brocade-robed youth, the Beihai City Lord Lu Jianxing.
Though superior in numbers, their aura was clearly suppressed by the opposing side.
"Elder Zhong, as an elder of Taixuan Sect, your conduct is overly domineering, not considering our Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals. Fighting and capturing disciples of other sects in my Beihai City, isn't this provoking our boundaries?" Lu Jianxing locked his brows and questioned sternly.
"City Lord Lu, you misunderstand. The matter arose abruptly, leaving no time to inform you. After this, our Su Nu Sect will surely offer generous gifts in gratitude, hoping you'll spare us grace and overlook the matter," Si Rong stepped forward with a polite gesture, smiling.
Lu Jianxing's expression softened slightly, ready to speak, but the iron-bearded elder sneered, "Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals? Humph, when did this third-rate force emerge? I've never heard of it. We're here solely to capture the defected disciples of Su Nu Sect; it's not related to anyone else, best you don't interfere."
Lu Jianxing's face immediately darkened, his gaze sweeping towards the courtyard below.
There, over a hundred Su Nu Sect disciples were trapped under a net-shaped Spiritual Treasure, unable to move like livestock. He hesitated, considering whether to send a message to White Emperor City for reinforcements.
Just then, Yuan Ming, Yun Luo Fairy, and Wulu arrived.
"Who dares cause chaos here?" Yuan Ming bellowed like a bell and drum, reverberating across the sky.
Seeing this, Lu Jianxing's eyes filled with joy, his heart settling somewhat.
Si Rong saw Yun Luo Fairy, irritation flashed in her eyes, but her gaze turned wary upon seeing Yuan Ming.
Meanwhile, the burly iron-bearded elder squinted his eyes slightly, gave Yuan Ming a once-over, and didn't regard him seriously.
"Su Nu Sect's Si Rong, at your service, City Lord Yuan," Si Rong stepped forward to greet, saying.
Yuan Ming, however, ignored her, his gaze directly bypassing her, landing on the bearded old man.
"White Emperor City Lord, I've long admired your name, and today I finally see you. Truly, your presence is extraordinary." The bearded old man walked to Si Rong's side, protecting her behind him, and said with a cold smile.
"Undeserved praise. Who might you be?" Yuan Ming curved his lips into a smile, speaking without any courtesy.
"Elder Zhong Tuhu of the Taixuan Sect." Upon hearing this, the bearded old man's eye twitched slightly as he replied coldly.
Yuan Ming pretended to think, "Oh," then quickly said, "I've never heard of you."
"You..." At Yuan Ming's words, anger surged fiercely in Zhong Tuhu's eyes.
"No matter who you are, causing trouble on the territory of my Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, have you considered the consequences?" Yuan Ming asked sternly.
"Consequences? Why, do you intend to make a move against me?" Zhong Tuhu laughed angrily and asked.
With a shout, Yuan Ming's aura burst forth, transforming into an overwhelming pressure that spread over everything: "So, do you want to leave on your own, or shall I force you out?"
Yun Luo Fairy witnessed this scene, and a complex emotion arose in her heart.
Originally, she had sought Yuan Ming out of desperation, hoping only to seek protection and find a place for her fellow disciples to settle.
Unexpectedly, it had led to a direct confrontation between Yuan Ming and Zhong Tuhu.
She felt a deep fear towards the great Taixuan Sect.
From the bottom of her heart, she didn't want Yuan Ming to conflict with the other side just because of her.
But it was too late to regret now.
Together with her apology to Yuan Ming, a strange sentiment rose within her.
In times of crisis, having someone stand up for her felt incredibly good.
It's just a pity that Yuan Ming held no romantic feelings towards her.
The other people, witnessing the scene, all retreated to a distance for fear of being caught in the aftermath of the fight.
Under Yuan Ming's mountain-like heavy aura, Si Rong's face turned pale instantly, and she involuntarily took a step back, with a hand then resting on her shoulder to offer some support.
"Good lad, such guts. I'd like to see how capable you are!" Zhong Tuhu sneered, his eyes glittering with a cold light.
He suddenly raised his left arm, and beneath his sleeves, lights of blue, red, gold, green, and black burst forth, entwining around his arm, rapidly expanding, and transforming into a massive multicolored giant hand.
This giant hand radiated a powerful five-element aura, as if capable of tearing through the void.
Yun Luo Fairy saw this and was stunned, hurriedly reminding, "Be careful, this is the Taixuan Sect's Five Elements Sword Arm Divine Skill!"
Her voice carried a thread of tension, clearly apprehensive about this skill.
As soon as she finished speaking, the giant multicolored hand opened abruptly, with its fingertips unleashing five incredibly solid strands of sword qi colored blue, red, gold, green, and black.
These sword qis pierced through the void like five massive dragons, roaring towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming had already seen through its secret, dodging swiftly like an elusive specter at the moment the sword qi erupted.
Though potent, the five strands of sword qi couldn't even touch the hem of his garments.
The residual sword qi flew onward, striking the city walls and battlements several hundred meters away, causing them to collapse instantly.
Amidst the dust, the Five Elements Sword Qi circulated and shredded the collapsing battlements continuously until they turned to dust.
The people of Beihai City, seeing this, were stunned, unable to imagine the consequences if the blow had landed on them.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ Nov3lFɪre.ɴet
They looked towards Yuan Ming with eyes full of fear and reverence.
Yet Yuan Ming seemed unaffected, not even turning to glance back.
His gaze locked onto Zhong Tuhu, not showing fear, surprise, nor disdain.
His eyes held only the focused and calm gaze of a predator upon its prey.
This gaze made Zhong Tuhu, a veteran of countless battles, feel a thrill of fear.
A touch of dread arose in his heart, and he thought to himself, "What is this boy's background that makes him so difficult to deal with?"
He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his unease, and with another grasp of his five fingers.
In the void, the Five Elements Sword Qi reformed, transforming into a sharp arc and slashing towards Yuan Ming.
Yet Yuan Ming seemed prepared.
He inwardly activated the Primordial Dao Seal, and above everyone's heads, a cluster of lights formed, a gigantic seven-colored vortex appeared out of thin air.
This vortex radiated a devouring force, seemingly capable of swallowing everything.
The five-element sword qi, upon contacting the seven-colored vortex, abruptly veered off its trajectory, drawn by that terrifying devouring force, uncontrollably flying into the vortex and disappearing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1037 - 1002: Prelude
chapters.content:
"What kind of Divine Skill is this?" Zhong Tuhu was greatly alarmed upon seeing this.
He had never encountered such a strange and powerful Divine Skill, and couldn't help feeling a bit flustered inside.
Yuan Ming, however, didn't give him any chance to catch his breath.
He raised his hand and pressed downward, causing the seven-colored vortex to bear down on Zhong Tuhu.
The devouring power of the Primordial Dao Seal surged, locking onto Zhong Tuhu's five-colored arm, and began to tear at it crazily.
Zhong Tuhu was shocked and attempted to retract his arm, only to find that the force seemed to have a mind of its own, clamping onto his arm, making it impossible to move.
"Not good! This time I might be planted by this kid!" he thought panic-stricken.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming activated the Emotion Manipulation Seal.
In the void before him, a giant hand glowing with enchanting seven-colored light appeared out of thin air, fingers clenched, reaching for Zhong Tuhu.
Zhong Tuhu, having never seen such a bizarre attack method, panicked and hurriedly waved his hand, summoning a bronze square shield the size of a palm.
This bronze square shield, which he had relied on for years as a Protective Spirit Treasure, lit up with the inscribed golden-armored god pattern, causing a massive Immovable Ming King's Protective Dharma Image to materialize out of nowhere, enveloping him and shielding his entire body.
Yuan Ming, however, seemed oblivious to the protective Dharma image, calmly continued to clench his giant hand.
The Outer Soul Hand conjured by his Emotion Manipulation Seal had accumulated twenty years' worth of potency, and he was eager to test it out.
In the next moment, the seven-colored giant palm penetrated the Immovable Ming King's Protective Dharma Image effortlessly, seizing Zhong Tuhu in its grip.
This scene stunned everyone present; they could hardly believe their eyes.
This protective Dharma image, one of Zhong Tuhu's famous skills, was broken through so easily!
Zhong Tuhu felt a surge of chaotic emotions explode in his Sea of Consciousness, losing control and plummeting from the sky.Find the newest release on novel·fire·net
The five-colored palm formed by the Five Elements Sword Qi also instantaneously shattered, dispersing into chaotic streams.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming tightened his grip.
The seven-colored giant palm seemed to penetrate Zhong Tuhu's body, its light delving into him. Zhong Tuhu's emotions spiraled out of control, his eyes rolled back, and he fainted.
"How is this possible?"
This cry of astonishment came not only from Si Rong and the accompanying disciples of the Su Nu Sect but also from seasoned cultivators like Lu Jianxing, who all wore shocked expressions.
Though they had long known of the City Lord's extraordinary prowess, what was displayed now far exceeded their expectations.
Yuan Ming did not attempt to kill Zhong Tuhu but merely grabbed him casually, intending to confine him inside the Shura Palace.
At that moment, a sudden change occurred!
A black light screen appeared out of nowhere, rapidly expanding into a black Spiritual Domain with a diameter of a hundred zhang, enveloping Yuan Ming tightly within.
The light emanating from within was not an ordinary mana fluctuation, but a unique and strong Soul Power, frightening to the heart.
Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows slightly, intending to mobilize mana to resist, but suddenly perceived something strange.
This domain wasn't a simple mana field, but a unique and mighty Soul Power fluctuation.
This wasn't a Spiritual Domain, but a soul domain!
Yuan Ming was startled; the instant he realized it, an indescribable wave of emotion surged in his Sea of Consciousness.
Countless voices seemed to echo in his ears—arguing, talking, cursing, congratulating, mingling—sounds chaotic and varied, as if he had fallen into an intangible red dust.
Each voice seemed to tug at his Seven Emotions and Six Desires, as though echoing his experiences across countless past lives.
Under this intense emotional barrage, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul momentarily stalled, struggling to break free.
Wulu and others saw this, and their expressions changed drastically; they hadn't anticipated such a turn of events and found themselves unable to react in time.
At this moment, among the Su Nu Sect disciples guarding that net-shaped Magic Treasure below, an otherwise unremarkable woman's body surged with seven-colored flowing light, transforming into a massive seven-colored giant palm, reaching toward Yuan Ming high in the sky.
The giant palm bore a striking resemblance to Yuan Ming's Outer Soul Hand, yet it was even larger, infused with an ocean-like immense Desire Power.
Before anyone could react, the giant palm had already pierced through Yuan Ming's body.
The moment he was impaled by the seven-colored giant palm, Yuan Ming felt as if his Sea of Consciousness had exploded.
Chaotic emotions surged like a tidal wave, the immense Desire Power fiercely assaulting his Divine Soul, almost causing him to lose control over his body.
In this critical moment, the Stealing Heaven Tripod mark on his arm suddenly lit up, releasing a tremendous suction force.
The Desire Power invading his Sea of Consciousness, like grains of sand swept by a great wave, was swiftly absorbed by the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul suddenly relaxed, his mind quickly recovering.
Immediately, he activated the Stealing Heaven Tripod, channeling his own Desire Power, and let out a thunderous shout.
An immensely powerful wave of Divine Sense erupted from him, crashing outward like a storm.
The soul domain enveloping him was instantly torn open by this force.
Yuan Ming's eyes were as sharp as torches, scanning below, revealing a sudden bright yellow glow on the ground, radiant like the rising sun.
Immediately, four middle-aged men dressed in wide-sleeved yellow robes stepped out slowly from the halo, their garments fluttering in the wind as if they were deities descending from the heavens.
As soon as the four landed, they quickly formed a Dharma Seal, their figures scattering to create a mysterious formation.
The four were dressed identically, with no difference in height, body type, or weight. Even more astonishingly, their appearances were like mirror reflections, exactly the same.
Their techniques were skillful, and almost at the same moment, the Dharma Seals were formed in their hands, and they all shouted in unison, "Suppress!"
As the shout fell, strands of yellow light rose from beneath their feet, like summoned Spiritual Snakes, swiftly intertwining to form a massive yellow Spiritual Domain.
This Spiritual Domain was like a huge golden dome, enveloping Yuan Ming within.
The moment the Spiritual Domain formed, an indescribable pressure descended from the sky, akin to Mount Tai pressing down, catching Yuan Ming off guard.
Yuan Ming attempted to shift his position, but the pressure followed him like a shadow, making escape impossible.
Ultimately, Yuan Ming was slammed hard onto the ground by the overwhelming pressure.
With a thunderous crash, the ground instantly caved in, forming a massive deep pit, and Yuan Ming's figure was shrouded in dust.
When the dust cleared, Yuan Ming was seen supporting himself with his hands on the ground, his clothes clinging tightly to his muscular back, his bulging muscles displaying his tremendous power.
He let out a thunderous roar, activating his Qi-Blood Power, and forcefully standing up under the heavy pressure.
However, the oppression of the Spiritual Domain did not cease.
Instead, a denser ochre halo poured down from above the Spiritual Domain, surging like a waterfall.
The power contained in this halo was strong enough to create visible distortions in the void.
Yuan Ming, amidst it all, seemed clad in thousand-pound heavy armor, his whole body trembling greatly, yet he couldn't break free from this restraint.
He tried to mobilize his internal mana, but under this heavy pressure, the movement of mana became exceptionally difficult.
At this moment, a crimson flame flashed before Yuan Ming, followed by the sudden appearance of a Taoist in a fire-red robe, with eyebrows as crimson as flames.
This person was the Red Eyebrow Taoist Yuan Ming had seen before.
With a lift of his hand, crimson firelight flashed from his sleeve, and a scarlet iron chain instantly pierced through Yuan Ming's chest.
Yuan Ming felt a fiery burning sensation spreading throughout his body, severely hindering the flow of mana at the wound on his chest.
He attempted to activate his Undying Body to heal the wound, yet the scarlet iron chain seemed to possess a mind of its own, continuously burning the wound, making healing extraordinarily difficult.
Under this dual oppression, much of Yuan Ming's strength was suppressed.
He struggled to stand upright, but felt the space pressure like a giant mountain on his shoulders, forcing him almost to one knee.
Upon seeing this, Wulu was filled with both shock and fury.
He flicked his wrist, and a purple Poison Banner flew out of thin air, unfurling in mid-air.
From the banner wafted purple poison mist, and five Poisonous Dragons, flowing with purple-green Poison Liquid, flew out, ferociously attacking the four yellow-robed men and the Red Eyebrow Taoist.
Just as the Poison Dragons were about to strike, a figure suddenly flashed out, blocking in front of them.
It was the female disciple of the Su Nu Sect who had previously unleashed the Seven-colored Giant Palm.
With a wave of her hand, the Seven-colored Giant Palm reappeared, reaching for the oncoming Poison Dragons.
The Poison Dragons spewed dark green smoke, clashing with the Seven-colored Giant Palm, instantly producing a series of sizzling sounds.
Under the corrosive poison smoke, the Seven-colored Giant Palm became riddled with holes, yet it stubbornly withstood the attack from the Poison Dragons.
Seeing this, the female disciple frowned slightly, clearly surprised by the power of the Poison Banner.
The Red Eyebrow Taoist coldly reminded her on the side, "That seems to be the long-lost Ten Thousand Gods Poison Banner, be cautious."
The female disciple's face revealed a look of realization, and she suddenly made a gesture with one hand, softly chanting, "Seven Emotions Prohibition!"
As her voice fell, strands of Desire Power containing the Power of Seven Emotions surged from her body, rapidly condensing into a seven-colored Talisman in the void.
This Talisman emitted a faint radiance, as if containing some mysterious power, swiftly flying towards the Seven-colored Giant Palm and merging with it.
The giant palm, fused with the Seven-colored Talisman, immediately displayed dense runes on its surface, which shimmered with a subtle glow, exuding powerful Sealing Power.
The giant palm charged towards the smoke spewed by the Poison Dragons, and indeed, its corrosion speed slowed significantly.
Subsequently, the Seven-colored Giant Palm grasped fiercely, firmly seizing the five Poisonous Dragons within its grip, unable to escape.
Wulu, witnessing this, was about to continue his tactics, but his expression suddenly froze.
He was astonished to find that the Sealing Power transmitted through the Ten Thousand Gods Poison Banner had affected him, immobilizing him and preventing further action.
In the distance, Yun Luo Fairy, seeing this scene, had an expression of extreme dismay.
She finally understood that these people were clearly targeting Yuan Ming, and her presence as Yun Luo Fairy was evidently not significant enough to warrant such a grand ambush.
Her arrival had undoubtedly become the pretext these people used to plot against Yuan Ming.
Yun Luo Fairy hesitated, contemplating whether to risk her own life to save Yuan Ming, but considering the disparity between her power and theirs, she couldn't help but feel a wave of helplessness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1038 - 1003: Chuyun Scum
chapters.content:
As Yun Luo Fairy hesitated, the Red Eyebrow Taoist suddenly shook his arm, and a striking red light burst from his palm, rapidly spreading along the chain and rushing into Yuan Ming's chest.
In the next moment, a flash of red light appeared in Yuan Ming's chest, as if a red sun had risen there, radiating ten thousand beams of light so intense that people's eyes couldn't open.
Yuan Ming's face immediately showed immense pain that was hard to suppress.
He clenched his teeth tightly, mobilizing all his mana, trying to control the intense red light blooming in his chest.
However, the power of that red light was incredibly strong, as if it was about to tear his chest open directly.
Seeing he couldn't suppress it, Yuan Ming suddenly raised his head and shouted angrily to the crowd outside: "Quickly leave!"
The cultivators in the City Lord Mansion, including Lu Jianxing, saw this and dared not hesitate for a moment, immediately flying away toward the outside of the city.
Along the way, they shouted loudly for the people in the city to stay away from this area to avoid undeserved disaster.
A deafening "boom" resounded throughout heaven and earth!
The intense red light exploded suddenly, transforming from a red sun into a sea of fire sweeping across half of the city.
The sea of fire seemed to have its own spirit, crazily devouring everything around it, turning houses, streets, and trees into ashes. Under the strong explosion blast, within a range of a thousand feet, houses collapsed in ruinous disarray.
Despite Yuan Ming's warning and the hard-earned few seconds, many cultivators and city citizens couldn't escape in time, being engulfed by the soon-to-explode red light.
Those who couldn't escape in time, both cultivators and citizens, were instantly turned to ashes under the impact of the sea of fire and the explosive airwave, leaving not a single trace.
Although the cultivators of the City Lord Mansion and Yun Luo Fairy fled in panic, the aftermath of the explosion still relentlessly impacted them, showing expressions of unspeakable terror on everyone's face.
And Wulu's figure, amidst the deafening roar, had disappeared without a trace.
Lu Jianxing, as the City Lord of Beihai City, watched helplessly as a significant part of his city was destroyed, even unable to feel the pain and hatred, more overwhelmed by shock and fear.
Only at this moment did he finally recognize the identities of those people.
"Fire Wing Immortal! Seven Spirits Daoist! Four Directions God of Death!" Lu Jianxing exclaimed with a tremor in his voice, unable to hide his shock.
Upon hearing this, the faces of the other cultivators instantly turned as pale as paper.
In the Chuyun Realm, each of these names was infamously notorious, all great demons of the Three Realms Sect.
Among them, the Red Eyebrow Taoist Fire Wing Immortal was at the peak of Dharma manifestation stage, his cultivation unfathomably deep.
The Seven Spirits Daoist was a peak Life Witch, mysterious and enigmatic.
And the Four Directions God of Death, named after the east, south, west, and north, although all four were late-stage Dharma manifestation cultivators, if combined, their strength was not inferior to peak Dharma manifestation cultivators.
These great demons seemed indifferent to the terrified reactions of the Beihai City cultivators, their gazes focusing on the center of the explosion, seemingly searching for something.
Fire Wing Immortal's eyes flashed with red light, penetrating the rising smoke and airwave, attempting to find Yuan Ming's trace.
Yet, having searched back and forth several times, he still found nothing.
"How's it, is he dead?" South Killer asked, his voice carrying a hint of uncertainty.
"Such an explosion's power definitely means dead beyond dead." North Killer said with certainty, a cruel smile showing on his face.
"I don't think so," West Killer shook his head in disagreement, his eyes showing a hint of caution.
"I doubt he lived," East Killer sneered, appearing unconcerned about Yuan Ming's survival.
At this moment, the Seven Spirits Daoist calmly spoke: "According to intelligence, this guy has cultivated the Undying Body and the Yin Moon Body. If true, then he won't die so easily. Likely hiding near us now, be careful not to fall into an ambush."
His words had just fallen when suddenly, South Killer and North Killer lunged forward, their chests pierced by thick roots of the World Tree, their life force rapidly draining away.
Their faces showed fear, their skin began turning grey-white, their bodies collapsing, transforming into a stream of sand, rapidly flowing toward the distance.
As they fled over distances of ten feet, two black cracks suddenly appeared before them in the void, like abyssal mouths appearing out of nowhere, gaping to swallow both.
"Seven Emotions Prohibition!" Seven Spirits Daoist shouted fiercely, two seven-colored talismans, each a foot high, flew out, moving toward the two spatial cracks.
At the moment the Seven Emotions Prohibition flew out, the Seven Spirits Daoist's vision went black, his divine power sealed, a piercing ringing filled his ears, all sensing methods lost their function.
His heart warned fiercely, immediately roaring: "Seven Emotions Breaking Order!"
With the roar, a Seven Emotions Willpower burst from him, forming into a sword-shaped talisman.
This talisman spun in the air before directly thrusting into his chest.
The instant the Seven Emotions Breaking Order entered his body, the Seven Spirits Daoist's vision brightened, his hearing returned to normal, the ringing disappeared.
Seeing the situation in front of her clearly, her heart tightened reflexively.Content originally comes from n͟o͟v͟e͟l͟f͟i͟r͟e͟.net
South Killer's body had already disappeared, while North Killer was being held up by East Killer and West Killer, clearly rescued by their combined efforts.
Meanwhile, not far from the crowd, a figure in a blue robe silently stood, coldly watching them.
The chilling aura emanating from the figure made everyone present involuntarily shiver.
"You're indeed not dead!"
The Fire Wing Immortal frowned, seeing Yuan Ming completely unharmed, without even a scratch, a surge of inexplicable dread arose in his heart.
"Ladies and gentlemen, why, exactly, have you ambushed here intending to kill me?" Yuan Ming's voice was as cold as frost, questioning.
"Because you should not exist in this world!" North Killer shouted in anger.
"Hand over South Killer, or we will repay blood with blood!" West Killer was equally furious, his voice brimming with killing intent.
As they spoke, yellow halos flashed on their bodies, as hot as flames, seemingly ready to charge forward desperately.
"Calm down, don't let anger cloud your judgment." East Killer calmly stopped the two, his sinister gaze tightly fixed on Yuan Ming as if trying to see through him.
"Killing him is useless, it's just a clone." The Seven Spirits Daoist slowly spoke.
Hearing this, North Killer and West Killer's anger slightly subsided.
The Seven Spirits Daoist pondered for a moment, then turned to Yuan Ming and said in a deep voice, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, your methods are indeed extraordinary. Today, unless we pay a heavy price, we fear it will be difficult to defeat you. But if we end up hurting each other, it will not benefit either side. Why don't you hand over the World Tree, and we can leave, how about it?"
"The World Tree, is it the Three Realms Sect that wants it, or is it the Demon World that seeks it?" Yuan Ming asked indifferently.
"It's indeed sought by the Demon World." Seven Spirits Daoist admitted frankly.
"I see. All of you are renowned powerhouses, with illustrious reputations in the Chuyun Realm, yet why are you willing to submit to the demon clan, to be driven by them?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but chuckle upon hearing this.
"You have yet to witness the true power of the demon clan..." Seven Spirits Daoist sighed lightly, a trace of complex emotions flashing in his eyes.
"The cultivators of the Chuyun Realm are living too comfortably now, having long forgotten the harshness and danger of this world. If you awaken sooner, with your ability, you might consider joining our Three Realms Sect to achieve great things together." Fire Wing Immortal couldn't help but persuade.
Just then, on the other side of the open space, a ripple suddenly appeared in the void, and the figure of Wulu holding the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman reappeared.
He shouted to Yuan Ming, "Brother Yuan, there's no need to waste words with these guys any longer, I'll lend you a helping hand, let's quickly slaughter them!"
"Brother Wulu, just watch the battle from the side. If I can't even handle these few remnants of the Three Realms Sect, how can I talk about leading the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals and holding onto the position of 'Master of Demon Mountain Range'?" Yuan Ming waved his hand, grinning.
After finishing his words, Yuan Ming lightly raised his palm and waved it forward.
Suddenly, Seven Spirits Daoist, Fire Wing Immortal, and the remaining Four-direction Killing Gods were surrounded by cracks in the void. Countless roots and vines of the World Tree shot out like sharp arrows toward them.
"I'll do it!" Fire Wing Immortal shouted, seeing this.
Seven Spirits Daoist hesitated not a bit, raised her hand to grab at the void, and a seven-colored palm appeared out of thin air, tightly grasping the bodies of East Killer, West Killer, and North Killer.
Then, her figure flashed with a burst of seven-colored radiant light and disappeared without a trace, leaving only the Fire Wing Immortal alone.
Facing Yuan Ming's attack, rather than being afraid, Fire Wing Immortal laughed loudly, eyes burning with intense war intent.
"Burn!"
He shouted, and two scorching Flame Runes flashed in his eyes.
His skin instantly turned crimson, waves of heat rolled off his body, and his long hair stood on end, like a raging fiery lion.
Immediately, fierce flames burst from around him, boiling with heat as they swiftly expanded, morphing into a gigantic fireball hundreds of feet tall.
The Fire Emperor's True Intent erupted from the fireball, like the blazing sun of the Nine Heavens, unleashing unparalleled scorching power.
The roots and vines of the World Tree that were attacking him ignited in roaring flames as soon as they neared the fireball, turning into ashes.
The Fire Wing Immortal arrogantly scanned his surroundings but did not spot Yuan Ming, his brow furrowing slightly.
He immediately waved his sleeve, and the massive fireball suddenly detached from his side, rushing toward Wulu like thunder.
Wherever the fireball passed, the void seemed to ignite, and the air was filled with a scorching scent.
The overwhelming Fire Emperor's True Intent instantly enveloped Wulu, making him feel an indescribable heat.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming had quietly broken through the void, sending the Asura Palace into the Void Turbulence.
He himself merged into the Flower Garden Wilderness of the Asura Palace, becoming one with the World Tree.
In the next moment, the World Giant Tree shook violently, numerous void portals appeared around it, and countless tree roots pierced into them, disappearing deep into the void.
Outside, under the suppression of the Fire Emperor's True Intent, Wulu couldn't escape the fireball's heat.
He felt the moisture in his body evaporating rapidly, his skin shrinking, his blood seeming to boil, turning his entire body crimson, clearly unable to hold on much longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1039 - 1004: Miscalculation
chapters.content:
At the critical moment, in the void ahead of Wulu, an enormous root system of the World Tree suddenly pierced through the void, carving an astonishing trajectory from top to bottom.
The root system emitted unique spatial power fluctuations, tearing the void, forming a vast space fissure that stretched across the front of the fireball.
The fireball plunged into the space fissure, becoming stuck, unable to advance or retreat for the moment.
The tearing force within the space fissure continuously acted upon the fireball, growing stronger and stronger.
With a loud "boom," the fireball's red light surged violently and exploded.
The bursting firelight expanded a hundredfold in an instant, consuming the area of several hundred zhang.
Wulu quickly retreated, narrowly avoiding danger.
The exploding firelight shredded the void already torn by the World Tree, forming a black vortex at the explosion's center, collapsing inward for over a dozen breaths before gradually shrinking until it disappeared.
Simultaneously, not far from the Fire Wing Immortal, dozens of World Tree roots pierced out of thin air, releasing unique spatial fluctuations.
These roots flailed wildly around him, carving complex patterns crisscrossing chaotically.
Soon after, dozens of chaotic space fissures appeared in the void outside the Fire Wing Immortal, lunging towards him.
The Fire Wing Immortal furrowed his brows, about to cast a spell to break the situation, when suddenly, darkness enveloped him, and all his senses vanished instantly.
Just as the dozens of space fissures were about to close in, seemingly about to touch the Fire Wing Immortal, his body suddenly flew sideways, passing through the central area squeezed by two space fissures.
His movement was extremely unnatural, as if pulled abruptly by an invisible strange force, barely avoiding the attack from the space cracks.
Yuan Ming saw this and furrowed his brow slightly, closing his eyes and beginning to focus entirely on sensing.
He knew that the scene just now must have been the work of the Seven Spirits Daoist, and just as he was preparing to pursue, he saw the Seven Spirits Daoist, holding a silver umbrella, appearing out of thin air outside the Shura Palace.
The silver umbrella twirled rapidly, emitting silver light from its surface, isolating the surrounding void turbulence outside.
"Seven Emotions Prohibition!" the Seven Spirits Daoist cried out softly, raising his hand and waving.
The next moment, a seven-colored talisman condensed like a spiritual butterfly, fluttering gracefully and flying into the Shura Palace.
As soon as the talisman entered, the spiritual power of the Shura Palace was instantly sealed, its ability to traverse the void stripped away, like a giant beast bound, falling from the void turbulence, revealing its towering, solemn true form.
At the same time, a huge fireball like a blazing sun rapidly skimmed across the sky, carrying the momentum of incinerating everything, and heavily smashed toward the Shura Palace.
"Break for me!" the Fire Wing Immortal roared furiously, his voice shaking the heavens and earth.
Yuan Ming watched, his thoughts moving, and countless World Tree root systems erupted wildly, wrapping around the Shura Palace like giant green pythons, forming what seemed to be an indestructible ball of vines.
"Boom!" An earth-shattering roar reverberated, causing the void to tremble.
The massive fireball slammed hard onto the vine ball, the explosive firelight like blooming flame flowers engulfing the entire Shura Palace within.
Amidst the reflection of the firelight, everyone's figures appeared vague and blurry.
Before the firelight extinguished, a dazzling golden light suddenly shot out from the blazing sea of flames, like the first ray of light at dawn, piercing through the bonds of darkness.
Within the golden light appeared a golden bell treasure, standing erect in mid-air, exuding a solemn and mysterious aura, heading straight for the Fire Wing Immortal.
The Fire Wing Immortal clapped his palms fiercely, the crimson light in his palms flourishing, and in the void, two gigantic flaming hands condensed immediately, one on the left and one on the right, like two mighty flaming beasts, grim and majestic, holding back the golden bell.
Within the flaming hands was contained the terrifying power of the Fire Emperor's True Intent, with searing flames and fierce firepower, seemingly intending to burn the golden bell to ashes.
However, this golden bell was extraordinary indeed.
This treasure was a spiritual treasure refined by Xi Hezi using Golden Sun Divine Iron through secret technique, and no matter how the flames burned, its color remained unchanged, like an indestructible golden fortress.
At this moment, an abrupt flash of red light from within the golden bell sent a red stele hurtling out, carrying the momentum of thunder, crashing fiercely toward the Fire Wing Immortal.
The Fire Wing Immortal hurriedly dodged, but within sight, a sudden radiant seven-colored light burst forth from the golden bell, manifesting a seven-colored giant hand, which came down fiercely upon him.
This palm carried immense power, as if capable of shaking the heavens and earth.
The Fire Wing Immortal showed a look of shock, preparing to resist with all his might.
Just at this moment, the seven-colored giant palm of the Seven Spirits Daoist suddenly emerged from the side, intercepting it.
The two seven-colored hands collided in the air, producing an ear-splitting roar.
At the moment of collision, within the Outer Soul Hand, an ancient small tripod appeared—it was the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
As soon as the Seven Spirits Daoist's seven-colored giant palm clutched the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the Willpower of Seven Emotions contained within it was swallowed up like a whale absorbing water, causing the seven-colored giant palm to collapse and dissipate instantly.
With no obstacle left, Yuan Ming's Outer Soul Hand landed unimpeded upon the Fire Wing Immortal's crown.
A torrent of Willpower surged into his Sea of Consciousness like a flood, continually assaulting his Divine Soul.
"Ah..."
The Fire Wing Immortal's face immediately displayed an expression of pain, crying out miserably.
Under the assault of the Willpower, his Divine Soul felt as if slashed by thousands of sharp blades, the agony relentless and overwhelming.
At this moment, Yuan Ming spread his arms open, and with a push into the void, a silver light sphere the size of a palace appeared, enveloping the entire Fire Wing Immortal.
This light sphere acted as a barrier separating all things, completely isolating Fire Wing Immortal from the outside world.
Upon seeing this, Seven Spirits Daoist's complexion changed slightly, and it was impossible to intervene now.
Meanwhile, the Soul Destroying Sword appeared out of thin air, descending silently from the void like a specter, carrying a chilling cold intent, directly targeting Fire Wing Immortal's life.
On the sword's blade, the five runes of Yin Erosion, Shattering Soul, Curse, Frenzy Blood, and Annihilation suddenly lit up, weaving into an intricate rune formation from which a Soul Destruction True Intent burst forth, turning into a sharp black sword light that swiftly pierced into Fire Wing Immortal's body.
The moment the sword light descended, it seemed as though a pitiful scream echoed through the air, but it halted immediately.
Under the sword light, Fire Wing Immortal's body showed no external injuries, yet his expression turned hollow in an instant, as if he had lost his soul.
At this moment, a figure of a stern-looking girl appeared out of nowhere, her gaze coldly catching Fire Wing Immortal for a moment, then transforming into a beam of light and returning to the Soul Destroying Sword.
This was the Artifact Spirit of the Soul Destroying Sword, who struck at the critical moment to sever Fire Wing Immortal's Divine Soul in one blow.
Though Fire Wing Immortal's body suffered no damage, the once-powerful Divine Soul within his Sea of Consciousness had turned to dust, leaving only sparse residual souls floating about.
Seeing this, the Dao Seal of Life and Death Reincarnation Path on Yuan Ming suddenly illuminated, with a massive black and white Tai Chi Diagram emerging overhead.
With a thought, he activated the Wheel of Life Divine Power, which absorbed the drifting residual souls and swallowed them into the white light.
These residual souls, though weak, were extremely precious cultivation resources for Yuan Ming who practiced the Life and Death Reincarnation Path.
After completing all this, Yuan Ming waved his hand, and the red stele flew back, suppressing Fire Wing Immortal's corpse before collecting it.
His actions were clean and efficient, without the slightest bit of hesitation.
When Seven Spirits Daoist, along with East Killer, West Killer, and North Killer, arrived beside the silver space, they happened to witness Yuan Ming eliminating Fire Wing Immortal.
All of their expressions changed, showing signs of urgency.
Their original plan was to seize the World Tree, yet they hadn't anticipated encountering such a formidable opponent, clearly making this mission a significant failure.
"You three, break this silver space immediately!"
Seven Spirits Daoist shouted loudly, their voice filled with urgency and tension.
Being a Life Witch Soul Cultivator, though possessing strange methods, they lacked the destructive power compared to Magic Practitioner and Body Cultivation.
To break the seemingly fragile silver space, it had to rely on the other three.
Feeling heavy-hearted, East Killer, West Killer, and North Killer dared not delay for a moment.
The three quickly approached each other, touching palms, and began to cast a secret technique.
A faint light started emanating from them, and their aura began to merge.
The next moment, a burst of light shot skyward from the trio, rushing towards the Nine Heavens.
Instantly, turbulence stirred in the high sky, with fierce winds blowing.
A powerful pressure descended, twisting the surrounding space.
Amidst the muffled rumbling, gales roared and colossal meteorites were summoned forth from the Nine Heavens above.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on novel·fiɾe·net
These meteorites gathered in the void into one enormous black meteorite, carrying a destructive power as they carved a dazzling red flame trail across the sky, fiercely crashing onto the silver space.
"Boom!" A resounding explosion echoed!
The silver space violently trembled under the impact of the black meteorite, ultimately shattering and crumbling into specks of silver light that dispersed into the void.
The blazing black meteorite, after a slight pause in its descent, continued unabated, heading right towards Yuan Ming.
Within the shattered silver space, there was another silver light sphere, half the size, enveloping Yuan Ming.
The black meteorite hit the silver light sphere with a loud "bang", then bounced off and fell to the side.
This meteorite summoning secret technique, prided by the Four-direction Killing Gods, was formidable enough to instill fear even in a Peak of Dharma cultivator.
However, with South Killer suppressed by Yuan Ming, the remaining three could not fully unleash the secret technique's power.
They watched in dismay as the silver light sphere, carrying Yuan Ming's form, vanished into the Void Turbulence like a ghost, ultimately disappearing from their sight.
West Killer, infuriated beyond measure, couldn't help but curse loudly, "How many space treasures does this guy have? How can he escape so easily every time?"
His voice echoed in the void, filled with helplessness and resentment.
Seven Spirits Daoist's face turned ashen, knowing if Yuan Ming wasn't eliminated this time, he would surely become a great threat in the future.
In a flicker of movement, she resolutely pursued into the Void Turbulence through a yet-to-close space rift.
West Killer and North Killer followed closely, enraged, rushing into the unknown realm.
Seeing this, East Killer wanted to stop them but was already too late, sighing, he gritted his teeth and followed in.

chapters.title: Chapter 1040 - 1005: Knowing the Times
chapters.content:
After Seven Spirits Daoist and others entered the Void Turbulence, they found themselves amidst chaos and void, as if in another world.
Shortly after entering the Void Turbulence, they saw Yuan Ming standing quietly inside a silver light sphere.
His face appeared even more mysterious and unfathomable under the illumination of the light sphere, looking at them mockingly, his eyes filled with disdain and provocation.
Seven Spirits Daoist's heart tightened, instantly calming down.
He knew the situation was dangerous, but it was too late to escape.
The space rift behind them had closed, while countless roots of the World Tree pierced the void from the front, striking towards them.
Seven Spirits Daoist waved his hand, and the seven-colored giant palm and seven-colored talisman flew out simultaneously, using both the Seven Emotions Great Handprint and the Seven Emotions Prohibition together.
While blocking the attack of the World Tree roots, he also attempted to seal the roots' Spiritual Power.
East Killer shouted, and West Killer and North Killer quickly gathered beside him, the three standing back to back, Protective Treasure Light flickering, jointly casting magic to resist the tidal assault.
However, the World Tree had the power to penetrate the void, and its numerous roots were dense as hemp, awe-inspiring at a glance.
Despite the considerable strength of East Killer and the others, they were overwhelmed by the overwhelming roots, unable to fully withstand them.
In just a brief moment, each was hit by the roots, their bodies swaying.
Seven Spirits Daoist, being careless, was tightly entwined on the arm by a creeper that silently appeared behind.
The creeper greedily sucked his vitality, his arm shriveling rapidly as if all life force had been drained.
Just as Seven Spirits Daoist was about to use the Seven Emotions Breaking Order to break free, Yuan Ming's figure flashed out from the silver light sphere, appearing in front of her in an instant.
Yuan Ming clenched his right arm into a fist, and slammed it fiercely towards the chest of Seven Spirits Daoist.
Seven Spirits Daoist had no way to avoid it and had to take the blow head-on.
A muffled "boom" sounded, her chest caved inward under Yuan Ming's fist, an invisible barrier emerged, blocking the punch, but she was still sent flying, and a jade pendant hanging at her waist shattered into powder upon impact.
"Don't disperse!"
East Killer shouted lowly, bringing the other two to quickly gather beside Seven Spirits Daoist, guarding her in the center.
At this moment, Yuan Ming did not continue pursuing but watched them from afar, wearing a strange smile.
Seeing this, Seven Spirits Daoist felt alarmed, sensing an inexplicable crisis but unable to determine its source.
Yuan Ming's lips moved faintly as he slowly uttered two words: "Shared Fate!"
As soon as the words fell, he suddenly raised his fist, his Qi Blood Power surged violently, and slammed into his own chest.
This sudden act of self-violence left Seven Spirits Daoist and the others stunned, completely unable to comprehend Yuan Ming's intentions.
With a loud "bang," Yuan Ming's body exploded instantly, splattering flesh and bones in a blood mist inside the silver light sphere.
Almost simultaneously, the bodies of Seven Spirits Daoist and the Three Killing Gods burst apart in a series of explosions, blood light scattering in the Void Turbulence.
The next moment, within the silver light sphere, Yuan Ming's shattered bones reconnected, and the scattered flesh rapidly amalgamated; under the mysterious power of the Undying Body, his physical form swiftly reassembled.
Meanwhile, under the impact of the Shared Life Divine Power, although Seven Spirits Daoist and the Three Killing Gods did not perish on the spot, they were gravely injured, their breath weakening.
Yuan Ming looked at their broken bodies, a smug smile playing at the corner of his lips.
With a wave of his hand, the Shura Palace instantly expanded a hundredfold, spreading into the surrounding void.
Its ability to traverse the void activated, gradually becoming virtual and transparent, enveloping the shattered bodies and collecting them into the Shura Palace.
Subsequently, Yuan Ming imprisoned them within a Level 6 Magic Array inside Yin Capital City, and he himself returned to the Shura Palace, arriving outside of the Extreme Fire Realm.
There, a towering red stele stood, suppressing the robust body of a Red Eyebrow Taoist beneath.
The stele was the Xi He Tablet, and the taoist was the Fire Wing Immortal.
Upon Yuan Ming's arrival, Xi Hezi's figure lightly flew out from the red stele, like a wisp of smoke, elusive.
"The Divine Soul within this person has completely vanished, and the Nascent Soul has begun to dissipate. Though I intervened to stabilize the Nascent Soul, the effect is minimal. Had you arrived a step later, he would likely be beyond salvation." Xi Hezi sighed lightly.
"Thank you, elder, for your assistance." Hearing this, Yuan Ming cupped his hands in gratitude.
Then, with a thought, a black and white Tai Chi Diagram appeared above his head, slowly rotating, white light flickering, gradually condensing into a vague figure, the Divine Soul of the Fire Wing Immortal.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, a gentle force holding the Divine Soul of the Fire Wing Immortal, gently sending it back into his body.
As the Divine Soul returned, the dissipating Nascent Soul of the Fire Wing Immortal gradually stabilized.
A moment later, his eyelids trembled slightly, and he slowly opened his eyes.
When he saw Yuan Ming standing right in front of him, Fire Wing Immortal's eye twitched slightly, but he quickly regained his composure.
He was well aware of his current predicament; the Soul Destroying Sword was piercing through his Dantian, pressing against the Nascent Soul, and any slight movement could lead to a catastrophe.
"It seems that Seven Spirits Daoist and the others also failed to succeed; ultimately, you managed to escape anyway..." Fire Wing Immortal sighed softly, his tone revealing a hint of helplessness.
"Escape? Haha... You are far too pessimistic. Those few are currently imprisoned elsewhere, and their situation may not be much better than yours." Yuan Ming laughed upon hearing this and shook his head.
Upon hearing this, Fire Wing Immortal's body stiffened, and he tightly fixed his gaze on Yuan Ming, attempting to discern some clue from his expression.
Yuan Ming's face displayed only ease and naturalness, with no trace of deceit.
"Fellow Daoist, your skills are impressive; I concede. Kill or cut, as you please." Fire Wing Immortal sighed deeply, finally resigning himself to fate.
"If I truly wanted to kill or cut, why would I bother saving you? You now have two choices: either submit to me or die once more." Yuan Ming smiled.
"Having died once, I do not wish to die again. Since Fellow Daoist Yuan has given me this opportunity, I naturally cannot ignore the circumstances. I choose to submit. Tell me, should we establish a Divine Soul Contract or plant a Forbidden Seal?" Fire Wing Immortal hesitated momentarily before sighing in response.
Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised by the other's cooperation.
"No need to be tense; establishing a contract is too cumbersome. I only need to plant a Divine Soul Rune within you. From then on, you must worship the Nether Moon God, pray daily, and provide me with Desire Power." He smiled slightly.
Later, Yuan Ming planted the Soul Descent Rune in Fire Wing Immortal and sealed a portion of his Mana.
After explaining some information about the Nether Moon God, he took him to Yin Capital City.
...
In the south of Yin Capital City, a desolate courtyard appeared especially bleak.
Seven towering stone pillars, like the fingers of ancient gods, pierced the sky. Chains entwined with blue-purple lightning connected them, forming a mysterious circular Array.
At the center of this Array, Seven Spirits Daoist meditated with eyes closed, fully focusing on Breathing Control, attempting to soothe his wounds.
The Four-direction Killing Gods occupied the northeast, south, and west, respectively, casting Magic together. Strong fluctuations of Mana rippled through the air around them as they tried to break the Forbidden Array.
Among them, South Killer, the first person captured by Yuan Ming, had the lightest injuries at the moment.
Radiant beams erupted from each of their bodies, soaring into the skies, seemingly trying to tear through the firmament.
Above Shura Palace, the Void began to tremble violently, with flashes of crimson light as if swarms of meteorites were converging here like shooting stars.
"Stop it all."
With a gentle wave of his hand, Yuan Ming made Shura Palace move skillfully through Void Turbulence, as though it was Virtualized.
The meteorites summoned by the joint efforts of the Four-direction Killing Gods quickly dissipated in the Void, unable to lock onto their position, while East Killer, West Killer, and North Killer wasted the Mana they had worked hard to consolidate.
Yuan Ming waved his hand once more, and runes on the stone pillars of the Array gleamed brightly. Giant Thunderbolt Whip locks extended from the pillars, furiously striking at the Four-direction Killing Gods.
Amidst the crackling sound of thunder, the electrical light within the Array scattered, and sparks flew.
The Killing Gods, already heavy with injuries, were beaten until they howled in anguish, compelled to cease their efforts.
Seven Spirits Daoist, seeing Fire Wing Immortal trailing behind Yuan Ming, had a glimmer of surprise in his eyes: "Fire Wing Immortal, you're still alive?"
"Cough, cough, I did die once but was brought back to life." Fire Wing Immortal coughed lightly twice, his voice slightly weak.
"So, you've betrayed the Three Realms Sect?" Seven Spirits Daoist's tone unveiled coldness.
"You can call it whatever you like. I've died once, and this life is now my own, no longer tied to the Three Realms Sect." Fire Wing Immortal said flatly.
Yuan Ming did not wish to hear more of their entangled disputes, so directly asserted: "Say no more; you, like Fire Wing Immortal, have two choices: either submit or die."
"City Lord Yuan, you really don't understand the consequences of opposing the Demon World. Actually, you now have two choices: either join the Three Realms Sect and submit to the Demon Clan, or..." Seven Spirits Daoist sneered.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NoveI-Fire.ɴet
Before she could finish, "bang bang" explosion noises rang out once again.
Yuan Ming did not hesitate to employ Shared Life Divine Power, causing his Physical Body to self-destruct.
Seven Spirits Daoist and the three Killing Gods except for South Killer then had their bodies explode, almost entirely losing fighting capability.
This visage stunned both South Killer and Fire Wing Immortal.
By the time Yuan Ming's form re-gathered and restored, Fire Wing Immortal was still in shock.
South Killer looked at Yuan Ming as if observing a monster.
With a gentle hand wave, Outer Soul Hand appeared out of thin air, and a seven-colored Giant Palm, like a mountain range, reached into the bodies of the Four-direction Killing Gods; the overwhelming Desire Power crushed their Divine Souls, with the Nascent Soul sealed within, unable to move.
As for Seven Spirits Daoist, being a Soul Cultivator, ordinary Nascent Soul sealing techniques were minimally effective against her.
Thus, Yuan Ming concentrated his mind, forming a Desire Power cage out of nothing, firmly imprisoning Seven Spirits Daoist's Divine Soul within, like being trapped in an Endless Abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 1041 - 1006: Subordinates
chapters.content:
"Earlier I was too impatient, now everything has settled. What is your decision?" Yuan Ming's voice was calm as water, yet carried an undeniable authority.
East Killer bit his lip, a hint of unwillingness flashed in his eyes, but eventually, he spoke in a low voice, "I... I admit defeat, willing to submit."
Seeing this, West Killer and the others did not insist further, lowering their heads to show submission.
"Your methods are indeed surprising, but to want me to submit is still somewhat lacking. Today's defeat was merely my momentary carelessness; we shall meet again someday." Seven Spirits Daoist remained unmoved, speaking indifferently.
Before his voice fell, the Divine Soul Power within her Sea of Consciousness suddenly erupted, interacted with the Desire Power, transformed into a seven-colored light, and exploded instantly. The intense Soul Power fluctuation swept out like a storm but quickly dissipated without a trace.
Seven Spirits Daoist's body swayed a few times and eventually fell powerlessly to the ground. Seeing this, Yuan Ming slightly furrowed his brows and gently said, "So it was just a soul splitting..."
Afterward, he turned to the others, inquiring about the planning process of this attack. Learning that it was Su Wu's instigation from behind, Yuan Ming wasn't surprised. He had also planted marks within the Divine Souls of the Four-direction Killing Gods to ensure they could not betray him. Then, he had Fire Wing Immortal inform them about the matter of worshipping the Nether Moon God and confined them all within Yin Capital City, temporarily restricting their activities.
Once everything was arranged, Yuan Ming maneuvered the Shura Palace through the Void Turbulence and returned to Beihai City.
Inside Beihai City, Lu Jianxing and Yun Luo Fairy and others had already detained Si Rong, Zhong Tuhu, and the Su Nu Sect disciples and elders they brought along. When Yuan Ming's figure reappeared in front of everyone, they gathered around him.
"Are you alright?" Wulu stepped forward, carefully examining Yuan Ming, and upon seeing no apparent injuries, he breathed a sigh of relief.
Yuan Ming shook his head with a smile, indicating he was fine.
"What about Seven Spirits Daoist and the others?" Wulu waited for a long time but didn't see anyone else appear, he couldn't help but ask curiously.
"I've already suppressed them," Yuan Ming said easily.
"Suppressed? Which one?" Yun Luo Fairy asked somewhat surprised.
"None of them escaped, all suppressed," Yuan Ming replied with a smile, then briefly narrated their situation.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on novel⟡fire.net
Hearing this, everyone fell into a prolonged silence. The news was so shocking that they found it hard to believe. Seven Spirits Daoist, Fire Wing Immortal, Four-direction Killing Gods, these were all legendary cultivators known in their regions, yet together they couldn't defeat Yuan Ming and were instead entirely suppressed by him.
This battle carried far more significance than Yuan Ming's previous suppression of eighteen City Lords, securing the position of Master of Demon Mountain Range. After a while, Lu Jianxing came to his senses and sincerely praised, "City Lord Yuan, this battle should be proclaimed across the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range to deter all petty villains and make them dare not harbor treacherous thoughts again!"
Yuan Ming nodded, not objecting. He raised his hand, directly grabbing Zhong Tuhu.
"You... you can't kill me... I am an elder of Taixuan Sect, I am..." Zhong Tuhu's voice was filled with terror as if he saw the Grim Reaper descending.
Yuan Ming, however, showed no expression. He reached out, pressed Zhong Tuhu's head, his eyes flashing with cold light, staring into the other's eyes. Zhong Tuhu's pupils instantly expanded as if swallowed by an invisible force; his gaze lost focus, and his shouting came to an abrupt halt under this force.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes, beginning to forcibly Soul Search. Moments later, a hint of a cold smile appeared on his face. It turned out this incident was indeed Zhong Tuhu's instigation, colluding with members of the Three Realms Sect, targeting him in a surrounding kill action. The entanglement between Yun Luo Fairy and Su Nu Sect was merely an excuse he used.
Yuan Ming withdrew his gaze, his palm suddenly exerted force, while a strand of Divine Soul Power quietly submerged into Zhong Tuhu's body. With a "bang" sound, Zhong Tuhu's head exploded like a ripe watermelon, blood splattering, and his Divine Soul being annihilated in an instant.
Lu Jianxing was shocked and couldn't help but remind, "City Lord Yuan, this Zhong Tuhu holds a high position within Taixuan Sect, and his relationship with Young Master Que Yue is quite unusual. Killing him like this might bring trouble."
Yuan Ming heard this, his face showing no surprise.
He said indifferently, "Isn't it just Young Master Que Yue, he's not Taixuan Sect's Sect Leader, no need to be so alarmed. If he wishes to seek revenge, then I would welcome it."
Lu Jianxing heard this and wanted to say something, but remembering the fate of Seven Spirits Daoist and the others, he realized he'd still been underestimating the Master of Demon Mountain Range. He shook his head helplessly and closed his mouth.
At this moment, Yun Luo Fairy glanced at Si Rong and the others bound at the side and hesitantly asked, "Yuan... City Lord, how should they be dealt with?"
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and said, "They are from your Su Nu Sect; naturally, I'll leave it to you to handle. But for convenience, let's suppress them in Shura Palace first."
Yun Luo Fairy heard this, a hint of delight appeared in her eyes, and she hurriedly thanked him. Si Rong already seemed drained of all spirit, looking defeated, with empty eyes, unresponsive to external stimuli.
Afterward, Yuan Ming glanced at the devastated Beihai City and spoke to Lu Jianxing, "City Lord Lu, this time they came targeting me, causing unprovoked disaster to your Beihai City, I'm truly sorry."
Lu Jianxing heard this, first feeling surprised, then he spoke fearfully, "City Lord Yuan, such words are too estranged. The nineteen cities of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range share the same branch and are inseparable. Regardless of other cities, my Beihai City respects you and White Emperor City, willing to serve loyally. This companionship through hardship means little."
Yuan Ming was moved upon hearing this.
He solemnly said, "Fellow Daoist Lu, your sincere words indeed touch the heart. Then, I'll trouble you to handle the aftermath and quickly repair Beihai City. White Emperor City will soon send people over to help; all expenses required will be covered by the White Emperor City treasury."
Lu Jianxing was overjoyed upon hearing this, and quickly cupped his fists, saying, "Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Yuan, I will do my utmost."
Then, Yuan Ming bid farewell, and brought all the disciples of the Su Nu Sect into the Shura Palace.
He, along with Wulu and Yun Luo Fairy, headed to the City Lord Mansion, and returned to White Emperor City via the Teleportation Array.
Upon returning to White Emperor City, Yuan Ming immediately summoned Wang Fulong and instructed him to properly settle the disciples of the Su Nu Sect brought by Yun Luo Fairy.
Wang Fulong quickly accepted the order and his figure swiftly disappeared from outside the palace.
However, Yun Luo Fairy did not leave with him but stayed in the hall, seemingly having more to say.
She had followed Yuan Ming around, witnessing with her own eyes his domineering presence as he slew in all directions and strategized, causing waves to stir in her heart once again.
Her gaze towards Yuan Ming became more and more entranced, as if a pool of spring water was flowing within, filled with inexplicable meaning.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, do you have anything else to discuss?" Yuan Ming noticed that Yun Luo Fairy had not left, and asked.
His voice was calm and distant, seemingly unaware of the complex emotions in Yun Luo Fairy's eyes.
Yun Luo Fairy was slightly startled, then concealed her inner disappointment and regained her composure.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, I wish to formally join the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals with the disciples of the Su Nu Sect." She took a deep breath and said seriously.
"Previously, all you asked for was a place of refuge, and I have already agreed. You and your disciples only need to cultivate in peace, there's no need to worry about more." Yuan Ming was somewhat puzzled upon hearing this.
"You may not know, Fellow Daoist Yuan, although you promised to protect us, you only let us pray daily and occasionally do some chores. Over time, it inevitably causes unease in the disciples' hearts and is not conducive to cultivation. I want the Su Nu Sect to become a part of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals and face the future together with you." Yun Luo Fairy gently shook her head and explained.
Yuan Ming suddenly realized that Yun Luo Fairy wanted the Su Nu Sect to truly become his subordinates, rather than just being guests under his protection.
"Alright, I agree to your request. I will formally issue an order later, appointing you as an elder of this alliance, to manage White Emperor City alongside Wang Fulong. As for the disciples of the Su Nu Sect, they can be arranged by you personally." Yuan Ming nodded in agreement after a brief contemplation.
"Thank you for your kindness, Fellow Daoist Yuan. Yun Luo will not disappoint your trust." Yun Luo Fairy was excited upon hearing this and quickly bowed in gratitude.
Her voice was filled with gratitude and respect, as if she had already fully aligned herself under Yuan Ming's command.
Yuan Ming calmly accepted this salute, then personally wrote the letter of appointment and handed it to Yun Luo Fairy to give to Wang Fulong.
Wulu, seeing this, wisely prepared to take his leave as well: "Brother Yuan, since everything is settled, I will return to continue my cultivation."
"Hold on, Brother Wulu, I have one more inquiry. Do you have any news about a Seventh Level Array Master?" Yuan Ming suddenly called out to Wulu, his expression becoming somewhat serious.
"Brother Yuan, do you have a need for this? I do have some leads on a Seventh Level Array Master." Wulu was slightly taken aback, then replied candidly.
"I have recently encountered a powerful restriction that requires elevating my array formation cultivation to the seventh level to break. You know my aptitude, without guidance from a skilled master, I fear it will be difficult to make a breakthrough." Yuan Ming explained, a bit surprised in his heart.
Although there had been hints previously, he didn't expect Wulu to actually have a lead on a Seventh Level Array Master.
"I see, I can help get in touch. However, he may currently be preoccupied with other matters and may not be able to come immediately." Wulu nodded, showing understanding.
"As long as he can be invited, that would be great. If his situation is particularly difficult, you can also tell him that I am willing to lend a hand, as a gesture of my sincerity." Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief.
"Alright, I will convey your message to him." Wulu nodded in agreement.
After bidding farewell to Wulu, Yuan Ming turned and entered the Shura Palace to begin organizing the Fire Wing Immortal and others.
Unlike Wang Fulong and the others, the Fire Wing Immortal and the Four-direction Killing Gods belonged to the Three Realms Sect, notorious for their past evildoings, so Yuan Ming did not let them out for work.
While the Soul Descent Rune alone could ensure their loyalty, Yuan Ming added another layer of security by transforming them into Tree Puppets using the branches of the World Tree.
In this way, their physical bodies were also under Yuan Ming's control, making it impossible for them to betray him.
Yuan Ming also lifted the mana restrictions on them and ordered them to continue their cultivation.
He himself then used the Stealing Heaven Tripod to possess the body of the Fire Wing Immortal, and comprehended the Fire Emperor True Intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1042 - 1007: Winds Rising over Qing Ping
chapters.content:
Evergreen Island.
The ancient banyans towered on the island, beneath them, Daoist Mu sat quietly by the stone table, holding a black stone that shimmered like stars.
His eyes were fixed on the chessboard, as if pondering the mysteries of heaven and earth.
Opposite him, Nangong Xian'er sat gracefully and dignified, her gaze also following the transformations of the chess game, not daring to be even slightly negligent.
"...It's said that Seven Spirits Daoist's Divine Soul has collapsed, Fire Wing Immortal and the Four-direction Killing Gods have all fallen into Yuan Ming's hands. After that, he even killed Zhong Tuhu, and then..." a cultivator in a black robe whispered, reporting the information that had been sent back from the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
At this moment, a gleam of light flashed in Daoist Mu's eyes. He raised his hand and gently placed a stone, the sound of the stone touching the board rang sharply and crisply, like a Jade Pearl landing on the board, clear and pleasant.
Nangong Xian'er gazed at the chessboard, her willow-leaf-like eyebrows slightly furrowed, as if considering how to counter this exquisite move.
"Senior's chess skills are extraordinary; this move is profound and far-reaching, I find it hard to withstand," after a long time, Nangong Xian'er sighed softly, shook her head, and gently placed the piece back into the basket.
Daoist Mu smiled slightly, turned his gaze to a disciple standing by, and said slowly, "The newly established Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals deserves some gesture from Evergreen Island, prepare a generous gift and send it over."
"Senior, should Xian'er personally lead the group to the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals?" Nangong Xian'er asked, her beautiful eyes shifting, soft lips parting.
Daoist Mu shook his head, his eyes deep, as if he could penetrate the void: "No need, since Yuan Ming has already shown his prowess, leave the matter of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range to him. We need only watch and wait."
"Senior Mu hasn't taken this much interest in a person for many years," Nangong Xian'er mused silently, her bright eyes flickering.
…
Within the Taixuan Sect, in a small pavilion built against the mountain, several cultivators were sitting together, whispering as if discussing something.
"Have you all heard about the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range incident?" one of them sighed.
"Oh? Are you referring to the deeds of the White Emperor City Lord in Beihai City? He single-handedly defeated Seven Spirits Daoist and a group of strong individuals; his strength is truly astonishing," another responded.
"Indeed, there's even a rumor circulating outside, naming him the top below Mahayana Realm, seemingly not an idle rumor," another agreed.
"Hmph, the top below Mahayana Realm? Isn't that a bit of an exaggeration? As far as I'm concerned, no matter how strong he is, he might not surpass the Young Master or senior brother," a thin-faced cultivator dismissed with a twist of his lips.
"Senior brother might hold his own, but the Young Master..." another shook their head and said no more.
At this moment, a sound of footsteps approached, and everyone looked up to see Young Master Que Yue coming over with a few attendants.
The discussions abruptly ceased, and everyone fell silent.
Young Master Que Yue's expression was cold and resolute, as if he hadn't heard the conversations, he merely glanced indifferently at them and continued onward.
However, his hearing was excellent, having already heard those words, his heart surged with anger.
Upon returning to his quarters, Young Master Que Yue dismissed his subordinates with a wave and sat alone at the table, taking out a book to peruse.
The more he read, the more restless he became, until he finally slammed the book onto the table, shattering it along with the objects upon it.
"Useless!" he cursed angrily, the darkness of his expression seemingly about to drip water.
Right then, there was a sudden knock at the door.
Young Master Que Yue paused, then regained his composure, asking in a deep voice, "Who is it?"Thɪs novelꜰire.net
"It's me."
A familiar voice responded, causing Young Master Que Yue to pause, then he rose and opened the door.
A man in a cyan robe stood at the doorway, his appearance was clear and elegant, with hair tied high and a long beard divided into three strands, his clothes fluttering, his eyes serene.
"Senior brother, why are you here?" Though Young Master Que Yue felt uneasy, he forced a calm demeanor and asked.
The man in the cyan robe did not answer his question but directly asked, "Que Yue, is Zhong Tuhu your man?"
Young Master Que Yue's heart tightened, realizing he could no longer hide it, reluctantly admitting, "Yes, he is my man."
The cyan-robed man heard this, his brow furrowing as he spoke sternly: "Que Yue, though you've been arrogant in the past, you've never stepped out of bounds, and I, along with our master, have always protected you. But if you dare to collude with the remnants of the Three Realms Sect, not even I or our master will spare you!"
"Senior brother jests, how could I possibly conspire with those remnants? You must be mistaken," Young Master Que Yue replied with a quick smile.
The cyan-robed man gave him a deep look, said nothing more, nodded, and turned to leave.
After he left, Young Master Que Yue's expression turned dark once again.
He hit the desk forcefully, a mix of anger and apprehension flashing in his eyes.
"Truly a waste!" he muttered angrily, his heart full of wariness and resentment toward that man.
…
Half a year later, in White Emperor City.
Yuan Ming slowly walked out of Shura Palace, a faint smile on his face.
After half a year of secluded enlightenment, he had initially comprehended the Fire Emperor True Intent, with outstanding results.
Although he wanted to continue his arduous cultivation, considering the days, the day of the Alliance Ceremony was approaching. Wang Fulong had also sent messages urging him multiple times, so he had to pause his training and come out to participate in this grand ceremony.
In the City Lord Mansion, Yuan Ming found Wang Fulong.
