Upon seeing Yuan Ming, Wang Fulong's eyes immediately showed a look of relief, as if finding a backbone.
"My lord, you have finally come out of seclusion!"
Wang Fulong let out a long breath, his voice carrying a hint of excitement: "The teams from all major sects have basically settled in White Emperor City to participate in the ceremony. This is the list, please have a look."
With that, he respectfully handed over a Jade Scroll.
Yuan Ming took the Jade Scroll, glanced over it lightly, and asked: "Who is leading the team from Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce?"
Over the past six months, although Xi Ying had not proactively contacted him, she mentioned last time that she would make a trip back to White Emperor City. Perhaps she would take this opportunity to bring people from the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce.
Wang Fulong understood Yuan Ming's concern and shook his head, saying: "The team leader is the Fifth Elder, Xu Na, from Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce. Lady Xi Ying is not on the visitor list reported."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming frowned slightly, a trace of unease rising in his heart.
He pondered whether to take the initiative to contact Xi Ying and inquire about her situation.
Just then, Wang Fulong's voice sounded again, interrupting his thoughts: "My lord, there is something that I must report to you. The leader sent by Taixuan Sect this time is the Swordsman Qing Ping. Upon his arrival, he specifically asked to meet with you. What do you think..."
"Oh? Where is he now?" Yuan Ming snapped back to reality and asked.
"He is currently staying in the Heavenly Sword District," Wang Fulong immediately replied.
"Did he mention the reason for wanting to see me?" Yuan Ming thought for a moment and asked again.
"No, after I told him you were in seclusion, he didn't insist further and hasn't left his room since he settled in," Wang Fulong shook his head.
Yuan Ming lowered his head, pondering over the intention of Swordsman Qing Ping.
After learning that Young Master Que Yue harbored hostility towards him, he deliberately gathered a lot of intelligence about Taixuan Sect.
Among them, aside from the Mahayana Realm Taixuan Sect Leader, the one who caught his attention the most was this Swordsman Qing Ping.
It is said that Swordsman Qing Ping is a swordsmanship genius, and as the saying goes, "The wind arises from the end of the green grass," he also came from humble beginnings. When he first entered the Taixuan Sect, he was just an Outer Disciple, and the main Cultivation Technique he practiced was merely the introductory Sword technique of Taixuan Sect.
It was precisely with this ordinary Sword technique that he forged ahead, advancing from Qi Refinement to Dharma manifestation, never replacing his main Cultivation Technique, even innovating on his own and refining this Sword technique to an extraordinary level.
Later, the Sect Leader of Taixuan Sect took him in as a Direct Disciple, and since then, the Sword technique inherited in Taixuan Sect has been named after him, known among Taixuan Sect disciples as the "Qingping Sword Technique."
In terms of status and strength within Taixuan Sect, Swordsman Qing Ping surpasses Young Master Que Yue.
There are even rumors that Xizhuang Yuan, one of the Guardians, once sparred with him, with neither able to overcome the other.
In his mind, Yuan Ming secretly speculated that the purpose of Swordsman Qing Ping's visit was most likely related to the matter concerning Zhong Tuhu.
However, judging by his demeanor, it didn't seem like he was here to hold him accountable.
Regardless of his intentions, Yuan Ming felt no fear.
"Since he hasn't sought me out after, then let's not meet," Yuan Ming quickly made up his mind.
Wang Fulong acknowledged with a nod and said no more.
Yuan Ming glanced over the list again, seeing that those from Bright Moon Palace and Heavenly Saint Academy were just elders of early-stage Dharma manifestation, he didn't look any further.
He instructed Wang Fulong to continue preparations for the ceremony, then left on his own to attempt to contact Xi Ying.
To his surprise, just as he sent the message, he received a reply from Xi Ying.
"You've come out of seclusion?" In the Void Communication Array, Xi Ying's face gradually became clear, and the softness and determination between her brows brought warmth to Yuan Ming's heart.
"The Alliance Ceremony is in the next two days. I specifically came out of seclusion to handle matters. How about you? Didn't you say you were planning to come back last time? When exactly will that be?" Yuan Ming asked softly.
Xi Ying shook her head slightly, a trace of helplessness crossing her face: "I initially planned to use the opportunity of the Alliance Ceremony to return, but some unexpected events occurred recently, which delayed the plan. As for when I will return, I find it hard to determine now."
"What kind of unexpected event? Do you need my help?" Yuan Ming frowned upon hearing this, his tone revealing worry.
"You've already helped me a lot. Ever since your heroic deeds in Beihai City spread, life here has been much better, and no one bothers me about the matter of the Heavenly Destiny's Daughter anymore, saving me a lot of effort." Xi Ying looked at him, her beautiful eyes carrying a hint of a smile.
"You still haven't told me, what trouble did you encounter?" Yuan Ming's lips curved slightly, but his heart still concerned about her troubles.
"Actually, it's not too serious, just that the people from Bright Moon Palace discovered I had been cultivating the Moonlight Technique and wanted to take me back for questioning. Fortunately, Daoist Mu vouched for me, and now I've officially joined Bright Moon Palace. Soon, I'll be able to get the mnemonic for the Eighth Layer of the Moonlight Technique, which is a blessing in disguise." Xi Ying took a deep breath and slowly explained the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1043 - 1008: The Shattering of a Legend
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's initially anxious heart finally eased a bit upon hearing Daoist Mu speak up.
"The Bright Moon Palace is the foremost Soul Cultivator sect in Chuyun. Being accepted as a disciple there will undoubtedly bring great benefits to your future cultivation. You need not rush back; I have nothing urgent here, so focus on your cultivation with peace of mind," Yuan Ming said with a smile, genuinely happy for Xi Ying.
"I haven't forgotten my promise to you. However, the Bright Moon Palace is very strict, and I may need to find a way to teach you the mnemonic of the Eighth Layer of the Moonlight Technique," Xi Ying said with a bright smile.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, indicating she need not worry too much, "I need to focus all my efforts on breaking through to Mahayana, and I cannot spare the time for soul and body cultivation. Even if you give me the mnemonic, I wouldn't be able to divide my focus to practice it concurrently."
"Then let it be as you wish. If you need anything, do not hesitate to tell me," Xi Ying responded decisively with a nod.
After chatting for a while longer, they ended their communication.
Yuan Ming stood in the courtyard of the City Lord Mansion, gazing at the drifting clouds in the sky, his thoughts churning as he pondered something.
...
Three days later.
The inaugural ceremony of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals was grandly held at the central grand hall of White Emperor City.
Yuan Ming, the newly appointed Alliance Hierarch of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, slowly ascended the jade stone-paved steps and entered the grand hall under the gaze of countless cultivators.
As he took his seat on the throne that symbolized the position of the Alliance Hierarch, the atmosphere of the entire hall instantly became solemn and respectful.
Below him, eighteen city lords stood in two rows. Once Yuan Ming was seated, they all turned and bowed deeply towards him.
"Welcome, Alliance Hierarch!"
Their voices boomed like thunder throughout the hall, reverberating beyond the towering eaves, echoing across the universe.
Even though they were not physically present, those who were privileged to witness the ceremony understood the weight and significance of such a gathering.
Yuan Ming's gaze swept over the city lords and then towards everyone present, calmly announcing, "From today onward, the Ten Thousand Demon Nineteen Cities unite as one. Together, we form the Immortal Alliance, guarding the Ten Thousand Demons, suppressing the hordes of demons, safeguarding the Human Clan, and becoming the barrier of Chuyun."
His voice was not loud, but it resonated crystal clear in the ears of all present, like metals striking against stones, resonant and powerful.
Upon hearing this, the eighteen city lords called out once again, "Alliance Hierarch's noble spirit, we will unite our efforts, becoming the barrier of the Human Clan and the shield of Chuyun!"
Their voices intertwined with Yuan Ming's words, forming a powerful surge that reverberated throughout the hall.
This surge seemed to carry a magical energy, making everyone present feel their hearts surge with passion and their blood boil with excitement.
"For the barrier of the Human Clan, for the shield of Chuyun!"
"For the barrier of the Human Clan, for the shield of Chuyun!"
"For the barrier of the Human Clan, for the shield of Chuyun!"
The Returning Void cultivators of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals also joined in, their voices merging into a torrent, roaring like ocean waves, instantly spreading throughout the entire city.
The rest of the cultivators in White Emperor City, hearing these voices, were even more thrilled, stepping out of their cave mansions and into the streets, looking up at the towering hall, filled with reverence and pride.
In that moment, all their voices transformed into earth-shaking howls: "May the Immortal Alliance prosper forever, may Chuyun flourish forever!"
The howling surged like a fierce storm across White Emperor City, even causing the distant mountain ranges to seem to tremble.
The representatives from various forces who came to witness the ceremony felt the overwhelming aura of fervor, and couldn't help but slightly change their expressions.
Some were secretly shocked, marveling at the cohesion and influence of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, while others sneered, considering it merely the blind fervor of a disorganized crowd.
But regardless, in this situation, none dared to voice opposition.
Even a sound of doubt would likely be drowned out by this fervent atmosphere and besieged by the masses.
Soon, the ceremony proclaiming the establishment of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals concluded.
Each major force stepped forward in turn, presenting long-prepared congratulatory gifts.For more chapters visit net
Whether precious or unique, these gifts all displayed the goodwill and respect towards the establishment of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals.
The order of gift presentation was based on the size of the force.
Those appearing first were minor forces with only a single or a couple of Dharma cultivators in charge.
Although their gifts weren't particularly outstanding, they were nonetheless heartfelt.
Yuan Ming showed little concern for these gifts, as his gaze remained fixed on the not too distant Swordsman Qing Ping.
The man dressed in a plain cyan robe, with a serene face, had been meditating with eyes closed since the beginning, seemingly unconcerned about everything around him.
His presence, like a clear stream, was particularly striking in the bustling grand hall.
Just then, a familiar voice suddenly rose from below, drawing Yuan Ming's attention as he looked over.
"Extreme East Sea Domain, Dongji Palace, congratulates the establishment of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, presenting three ten-thousand-year-old spiritual medicines, wishing the Immortal Alliance prosperity forever, wishing Chuyun flourishing forever."
In the grand hall, Huangfu Jue spoke the congratulatory words respectfully, handing a jade box to Wang Fulong, who was in charge of accepting gifts.
Even after all these years, Huangfu Jue had yet to break through the Dharma Manifestation Realm. His cultivation was not even noteworthy in the grand hall, lacking the qualifications to sit with the Dharma representatives of other forces.
After Huangfu Jue, the representatives of Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond also came forward to present their gifts one by one.
Yuan Ming glanced at them, not very familiar, so he did not pay much attention.
In his heart, he kept thinking about the Qing Ping swordsman who was sitting with eyes closed, resting.
And Huangfu Jue never dared to lift his head to look at Yuan Ming.
His heart was filled with trepidation and remorse, afraid to remind Yuan Ming of the encounter in the Extreme East Sea Domain back then.
After all, in terms of geographic location, the Extreme East Sea Domain borders the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. With the current scale of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, they could easily crush the three major forces of the Extreme East Sea Domain with a mere gesture.
If Yuan Ming remembered the past enmity of being hunted, and anger arose, those three major forces would be in great jeopardy.
But with the formation of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, they could not refuse to come, or else it would be a self-destructive path.
Huangfu Jue sat in his position, his mind incessantly flashing with scenes of meeting Yuan Ming back then, filled with trepidation, remorse, and a mix of envy and jealousy.
At the upper seat, Yuan Ming's gaze quickly shifted from the Qing Ping swordsman.
With his current cultivation and status, he no longer bothered with the minor issues like those of the Extreme East Sea Domain.
In fact, he benefitted from the events of that time.
Furthermore, his enemies now were far beyond the level of early-stage Dharma manifestation. Bickering with these small forces would only make him seem narrow-minded.
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, most of the forces present had already offered their gifts, leaving only the Taixuan Sect, Bright Moon Palace, and Heavenly Saint Academy, the three top-tier forces, yet to make a move.
Heavenly Saint Academy sent an elderly man with white hair and beard, who, seeing everyone's gaze gathered, coughed lightly, about to rise.
"Wait." At this moment, the Qing Ping swordsman, who had been resting with closed eyes, suddenly spoke, slowly opening his eyes, looking directly at Yuan Ming.
He supported his sword with one hand, stood tall, and slowly rose, bowing towards Yuan Ming: "I've heard of Fellow Daoist Yuan's exceptional skill, with unmatched swordsmanship. Qing Ping humbly wishes to seek guidance with the sword in his hand, may I have the honor?"
Upon these words, the hall erupted in astonishment.
The crowd's expressions varied, looking at Yuan Ming, eager for his response.
Yuan Ming smiled slightly, and stood up unhurriedly, a glint of battle intent in his eyes: "How could I, Yuan, refuse Fellow Daoist Qing Ping's invitation?"
Their eyes met, sparks seemed to fly.
The next moment, their figures almost simultaneously vanished into thin air, leaving only a silhouette behind.
Beyond the hall, suddenly came several deafening explosive sounds.
Everyone hurried out of the hall, only to see countless tree vines emerging from the void in the distant sky, like giant dragons twisting in the air, attempting to cover the whole firmament.
Beneath those tree vines, countless sword lights shot upwards like meteors across the sky, instantly severing the vines, turning them into flecks of green light dispersing in the air.
Red and green spirit lights whirled and circled in the air, transforming into countless spells falling like rain.
And those numerous sword lights converged into a gigantic sword of blue light, striking head-on.
In just a few breaths, Yuan Ming and the Qing Ping swordsman crossed swords several times.
The aftershocks of their battle spread out, causing the void for a hundred miles around to vibrate, forcing even Dharma manifestation strong practitioners within hundred feet nearby to keep their distance.
The whole sky was filled with interlacing spirit lights and sword lights, dazzling beyond compare, so much so that even their figures became indistinguishable.
The crowd could only infer the development of the situation through the traces of their exchanges and the characteristics of their moves.
As time passed, the great sun in the sky gradually sank westward, dusk quietly arrived.
The once stalemated battle suddenly shifted.
A thunderous crash was heard, and the sword lights in the sky instantly vanished without a trace, as if the verdict had been decided.
Immediately after, the figures of Yuan Ming and the Qing Ping swordsman reappeared before everyone.
Yuan Ming's clothes were slightly tattered, yet his stance remained as firm as a pine tree, whereas the Qing Ping swordsman's breath was chaotic, and a thin line of blood appeared at the corner of his mouth.
He saluted towards Yuan Ming, his voice slightly hoarse: "I lost."
Upon these words, the hall erupted in astonishment once more.
The crowd's eyes widened, hardly believing their ears.
The Qing Ping swordsman's name resounded like thunder in the Cultivation World, having achieved the peak of Dharma manifestation, he challenged various major sects alone, asking for sword duels, rarely defeated.
Yet today, at this grand opening of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, the myth of invincibility was finally shattered.
Although the crowd did not witness every detail of the battle personally, this result alone spoke volumes.
That night, representatives of various forces sent messages back to their sects, detailing the shocking scenes that unfolded at the ceremony.
At the end of these messages, they all unanimously added a sentence—
"First under Mahayana, Yuan Ming, rightfully deserves the title!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1044 - 1009: Statue
chapters.content:
The night grew deeper, and the courtyard of the City Lord Mansion was bathed in hazy moonlight.
Yuan Ming dismissed his subordinates, sat alone on a stone bench, and gazed at the bright full moon.
A gentle breeze swept by, and the figure of Swordsman Qing Ping suddenly appeared in the courtyard.
He wore a fluttering blue robe, silhouetted against the moonlight, appearing mysterious and profound.
He walked to the opposite of Yuan Ming, and the two sat facing each other.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, as if he had expected Swordsman Qing Ping's arrival.
With a gentle flick of his sleeve, two exquisite wine cups appeared on the table, shimmering with a faint light, seemingly containing some kind of mystical power.
"I've long heard that Fellow Daoist Qing Ping's Ming Ding Wine Gourd holds the finest wines under the heavens. I wonder if I could have the fortune to taste some tonight." Yuan Ming's voice floated leisurely.
Swordsman Qing Ping smiled faintly, took down the wine gourd from his waist, and with a light sweep of his sword finger, it opened in response, releasing two streams of fine wine, transforming into rays of light and landing in the cups.
The wine sparkled under the moonlight, emitting a subtle fragrance that was intoxicating and enchanting.
They raised their cups, exchanged a smile, and drank it all in one go.
The wine flowed down their throats, sweet and mellow, seemingly washing away worries and bringing a sense of serenity.
Setting down his cup, Swordsman Qing Ping suddenly spoke, "I lost today, and I have accepted it."
His voice carried a hint of loneliness, but even more so, it carried a sense of acceptance.
"Though your sword moves are sharp, you have no means to counter Soul Cultivators. I won by chance, nothing more," Yuan Ming said modestly.
"You're mistaken. I have fought with the cultivators of Bright Moon Palace; although their Soul Cultivation Divine Power can affect me, they are still no match for my sword, and they cannot withstand my Sword Light. In all the world, there is only one who can beat me with Soul Cultivation Divine Power, and that is Xizhuang Yuan. Now there is you, Fellow Daoist." Swordsman Qing Ping shook his head and said.
When Yuan Ming heard such praise, he remained inwardly clear.
He knew clearly that while he had achieved much in soul cultivation, he could not compare to Xizhuang Yuan of the Bright Moon Palace.
Yet his three elements of Soul Body Technique were cultivated simultaneously, with numerous methods at his disposal. Today's defeat of Swordsman Qing Ping was due mostly to being countered by his Soul Cultivation Divine Power, and his inability to cope with Yuan Ming's endless techniques.
"Fellow Daoist, you sent me a voice transmission after the battle and set up this meeting tonight, not just to flatter me, I presume?" Yuan Ming no longer wished to exchange pleasantries, speaking frankly.
Swordsman Qing Ping remained silent for a moment upon hearing this, then sighed softly.
He lifted his head and looked at the bright moon, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes.
"I acted today because of matters in Beihai City." He slowly began, his voice carrying a trace of helplessness and determination.
Yuan Ming nodded, having anticipated this point for some time.
"Zhong Tuhu is from the Taixuan Sect, and the matter in Beihai City was his fault first. Your handling was reasonable; neither I nor the Taixuan Sect will become your enemy because of it," Swordsman Qing Ping clarified his stance.
"You make it sound easy. Had I not been strong enough, I would have fallen in Beihai City. Such a deep hatred cannot be resolved by simply saying you won't be my enemy." Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, stubbornly holding his ground.
"I know there is resentment in your heart, but I sincerely hope you can give me face and let this matter rest. Naturally, I am willing to offer some resources and benefits as compensation," Swordsman Qing Ping said.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brow, pondered for a moment, then finally nodded.
"I can agree with you, but if someone from your sect troubles me again, I will not hold back," he coldly said.
"Of course, I will remind them once I return," Swordsman Qing Ping replied immediately.
With the matter settled, Swordsman Qing Ping did not linger and left hurriedly.
Under the moonlight, the courtyard returned to silence, leaving only Yuan Ming sitting alone on the stone bench, gazing at the bright moon with flickering eyes.
...
A few days later, in the early morning.
Yuan Ming had just bid farewell to the representatives of various forces and was preparing to return to his place of seclusion for deep cultivation.
At this moment, Wulu hurried over with a mysterious smile on his face.
"Brother Yuan, look whom I have brought." Wulu said, stepping aside to reveal the person standing behind him.
Yuan Ming looked carefully and was instantly taken aback.
The person's face was unfamiliar, but there was a familiar aura between his brows.
He scrutinized for a moment before realizing, "Yan Jue? No, you're Jie Cha!"
"I heard you were asking Wulu about the Seventh-level Array; are you interested in learning from me?" Jie Cha smiled slightly, nodded at Yuan Ming, and took the initiative to speak.
"Indeed, is Senior Jie Cha the Level 7 Array Master that Wulu knows? What price must I pay to invite you to teach me?" Yuan Ming questioned eagerly upon hearing this.
"The price? How about helping me reclaim the Three Realms Immortal Boat?" A sharp light flickered in Jie Cha's eyes as he spoke in a deep voice.
"This... I fear it might be somewhat difficult. The Three Realms Immortal Boat is likely in the hands of the Demon World now. If I were to go, it might be a journey of no return. Senior, it would be better to choose another request." Yuan Ming smiled wryly and shook his head.
"Naturally, I'm not asking you to go now. The Demon Clan will eventually drive the Three Realms Immortal Boat to attack Chuyun. When that time comes, I will find a way to seize the Immortal Boat. You only need to lend a hand then." Jie Cha smiled faintly and said.
"I see, Senior, rest assured, I will agree to this condition." Hearing this, Yuan Ming agreed without hesitation.
He deeply understood that Jie Cha's strength was unfathomable, and if he could receive his guidance, it would definitely propel him further in the path of arrays.
...
Three years later.
Under the meticulous guidance of Jie Cha, Yuan Ming's proficiency in formations soared, advancing rapidly, and soon he entered the ranks of a Level 7 Array Master.
This achievement left even Jie Cha awestruck, marveling repeatedly at Yuan Ming's incredible talent.
But Yuan Ming knew well that behind this was the aid of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Every seven days, he would borrow the magical power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, possessing Jie Cha's body, learning Jie Cha's array expertise in the most direct way possible.
This marvelous learning method allowed Yuan Ming to progress swiftly in the way of arrays, navigating it with ease.
Becoming a Level 7 Array Master didn't mean Yuan Ming could easily wield any Seven-level Magic Array.
The way of arrays is profound and mysterious; every Seven-level Magic Array contains the life's work and wisdom of a Level 7 Array Master.
Even with Yuan Ming's vast knowledge, he needed to study meticulously to truly grasp the secrets within.Google seaʀᴄh novel•ﬁre.net
Therefore, after becoming a Level 7 Array Master, Yuan Ming spent another two years, diligently studying, and finally mastered the seven-level array belonging to the Breaking Formation Skill within the Four Mountains Linked Seal — the Supreme Returning Formation.
In the realm of arrays, Four Mountains Wanderer is undoubtedly at the pinnacle, and the breaking array he developed, named the Supreme Returning Formation, can reverse array constructs, forcing them to disassemble and revert to their most original state.
However, this array requires an immense amount of Mana to operate, and Yuan Ming alone cannot sustain it.
So, upon mastering the Supreme Returning Formation, Yuan Ming immediately gathered Wang Fulong and others, sealed their five senses, and led them once again into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Standing once more before the canyon, Yuan Ming looked at the golden hall, formed the Four Mountains Linked Seal, and saw countless golden lines flow out from the Breaking Formation Seal, intertwining in mid-air, rapidly forming a massive formation.
Immediately after, Yuan Ming instructed everyone to pour their Mana into the formation.
In an instant, streams of Spiritual Power, carrying different hues and colors, soared and converged into the formation.
The stagnant formation began to operate, with the integrated Spiritual Power spinning rapidly, and eventually transforming into a gigantic Tai Chi Roulette.
Raising his hand, Yuan Ming pointed, and the Tai Chi Roulette slowly pressed toward the golden hall.
The invisible barrier outside the hall lit up with frosty white spirit light, obstructing the Tai Chi Roulette.
Under the rotational pressure of the Tai Chi Roulette, the frosty white spirit light was constantly disintegrated and devoured, merging into the roulette.
However, no matter how much disappeared, more spirit light surged from the void, persistently blocking the roulette.
At this moment, Yuan Ming carefully observed the frosty white spirit light. With his knowledge of the Seven-level Magic Array, he finally discerned the operation logic of this invisible Forbidden and quickly found a way to break it.
Through his continuous manipulation, the Tai Chi Roulette gradually gained the upper hand, with the frosty white spirit light retreating step by step.
After an unknown amount of time, ultimately accompanied by a soft popping sound, the Forbidden outside the golden hall shattered completely, turning into nothingness.
Yuan Ming felt a surge of joy, and cautiously stepped forward, discovering no more obstacles in his way.
He immediately released Wang Fulong and others from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, then quickly returned to the outside of the golden hall, and, with an excited heart, slowly pushed open the door of the hall.
As the door opened, one by one, incense and candles inside the hall lit up; in the flickering candlelight, a gray human-shaped statue was revealed in front of Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming gazed in astonishment at this statue, discovering that besides it and the incense and candles, there was nothing else inside the hall.
The statue resembled a man, with a face almost identical to Xi Ying's, only differing slightly in physique.
Looking at the statue, an inexplicable emotion surged in Yuan Ming's heart, as if drawn by some mysterious force, he involuntarily moved forward.
At this moment, a soft sound suddenly came beside him.
He turned his head to see that Void had somehow appeared beside him, their gaze also fixed on the statue.
"This statue is actually the corpse of the creator of the Stealing Heaven Tripod," Void stared at the statue, a touch of distant memories in their eyes.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was swept by a wave of surprise.
"Why does his appearance resemble Xi Ying? Could it be... is he Xi Ying's ancestor?" he asked, puzzled.
"Humph, of course not. He has reached the pinnacle of the Soul Cultivator path, able to change his appearance at will. Anyone who sees him would see the form of their most beloved," Void gently shook their head and sighed.
Yuan Ming realized suddenly, but felt something was off, though it eluded him at the moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1045 - 1010: Questions
chapters.content:
"My understanding of him isn't actually profound. The Stealing Heaven Tripod is considered his final creation, and because of this, in my eyes, he is a white-haired elder, and perhaps this is his true form." Kong continued to recall the past.
Yuan Ming listened to Kong's narration, and couldn't help but feel a surge of unexplainable reverence.
He suddenly thought of a question: "So, by placing his corpse here, does it mean the Stealing Heaven Tripod is actually his coffin?"
Kong nodded slightly, with a hint of complex emotion flashing in his eyes: "Perhaps, I can't guess his true intention. But one thing is certain, although he has already passed away, this corpse retains a trace of the divine. You only need to respectfully bow before him and can ask any question, and he will answer. The premise is that you must offer corresponding Desire Power as compensation, otherwise he won't speak."
Yuan Ming was taken aback upon hearing this, finding this method of obtaining answers somewhat familiar.
He looked thoughtfully at Kong, who seemed to have guessed his thoughts, and smiled faintly: "That's right, it was through his power that I answered those questions for you back then."
Yuan Ming didn't regard Kong lightly because of this. Instead, he felt grateful.
After all, without Kong's guidance, he couldn't have received the help of this statue.
"May I ask where the Earth Element Stone is now?" Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, tidied his garments, and respectfully bowed toward the statue.
Before he could finish speaking, Kong interrupted: "There's no need to ask him this question. I previously promised to help you repair the Stealing Heaven Tripod. I already know the whereabouts of the Earth Element Stone; it is in Nine Kings Lake."
Nine Kings Lake, this name wasn't unfamiliar to Yuan Ming.
Though it's located in the distant Central Continent, for him now, the distance isn't an issue.
Since Kong had already informed him of the Earth Element Stone's location, Yuan Ming felt no need to ask further.
He pondered for a moment and thought of another question.
"Please help me identify the location of cultivators or spiritual treasures containing the Water Emperor, Earth Emperor, and Gold Emperor True Intent." Yuan Ming respectfully requested from the statue.
As soon as he spoke, the statue in the hall suddenly showed movement.
It slowly raised its head, and unexpectedly, two faint rays of spirit light shone from its hollow eyes, directly illuminating Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming suddenly felt a sensation of being watched by a mysterious power, startling him.
However, what further surprised him was that at this moment, the Primordial Dao Seal within his Dantian suddenly began to operate autonomously, emitting a faint glow.
"This technique's future achievements are immeasurable, you should cultivate it well." The statue suddenly spoke while pointing to Yuan Ming's Dantian.
Yuan Ming was greatly shocked, hurriedly extended his Divine Sense to inspect, only to find that there was no life force present on the statue.
"Senior Kong, are you certain he has truly passed away?" He couldn't help but feel puzzled, turning to look at Kong.
"He absolutely cannot be alive; I personally witnessed his sitting transformation and handled the last step of his body transforming into the statue, without a doubt!" Kong now also showed a look of astonishment.
Yuan Ming looked at the statue before him, feeling uncertain.
Though he doubted whether the creator of the Stealing Heaven Tripod still resided in the human world, the statue indeed showed no signs of life, this he could not be mistaken about.
After all, he possessed the World Tree, making his perception of life force extremely sharp.
The statue, however, seemed to take no notice of Yuan Ming and Kong's surprise, continuing to mechanically respond to Yuan Ming's question.
"For your question, a thousand Vow Power Pills are required as the price for answers." The statue's tone was cold and stiff, void of any emotion.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming frowned.
Since the establishment of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, the number of his believers rapidly increased, resulting in the accelerated generation of Vow Power Pills—a pill can be condensed almost every day.
However, the consumption of Vow Power Pills was equally immense.
To enhance the strength of the Nether Moon Sect, he recently invested almost without regard to cost, now having only slightly over a hundred Vow Power Pills left in his possession.
"Can you make an exception? Or just inform me of the location of a cultivator possessing Emperor-level True Intent?" Yuan Ming hesitated, pondering on how to gather those thousand Vow Power Pills.
The statue remained silent for a long while, seemingly contemplating Yuan Ming's request.
After a lengthy pause, it finally spoke again: "The thousand Vow Power Pills can be paid in installments over a maximum of ten years."
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this.
Though needing many Vow Power Pills, ten years' duration is certainly feasible.
He had already decided to immediately adjust the expenditure plan for Vow Power Pills upon returning, striving to fill this debt sooner.
"There are twenty-seven suitable cultivators or spiritual treasures, the list is as follows..." The statue instantly absorbed the hundred Vow Power Pills from Yuan Ming's hand, its eyes flashing with spirit light for a moment, then reported the desired answers one by one.The most update n0vels are published on novｅlfire.net
Yuan Ming focused his mind, memorizing every piece of information provided by the statue.
He couldn't help but marvel; also, that thousand Vow Power Pills were certainly not spent in vain.
The list given by the statue not only detailed the specific positions of each person or spiritual treasure but also included their general information.
What truly surprised Yuan Ming was the realization that the Chuyun Realm had so many cultivators or spiritual treasures possessing Emperor-level True Intent.
He initially estimated the number to be less than ten, but now it seemed the actual figure exceeded twice his estimate.
Yuan Ming memorized all the information, then after a brief contemplation, selected three of the easiest targets.
He again looked at the statue, showing respect, and slowly bowed, then asked: "Dare I ask, Senior, what extraordinary qualities does 'Primordial True Skill' possess?"
The statue remained motionless, like a lifeless object.
The spirit light in its eyes quickly faded away, as if it had never been awakened.
"Before you pay off a thousand Vow Power Pills, he won't answer any questions." Kong reminded.
His expression calmed at this moment, he looked down at Yuan Ming's Dantian: "Moreover, this statue has high standards. Since the 'Primordial True Skill' can elicit a reaction from its corpse, it shows this skill is extraordinary. The number of Vow Power Pills needed for an answer to your question would be considerable."
Yuan Ming nodded, realizing this point himself. His previous question was merely to test if the statue would show any other special reactions.
Since the test proved futile, he could only suppress his doubt for now and turned to leave the grand hall.
...
Ten Thousand Demon Country.
In a quiet seclusion room, Wu Yu sat cross-legged quietly, forming seals with her hands as demonic power surged, circulating her cultivation technique to heal the injury from her failed Mahayana breakthrough.
The seclusion room was softly lit, the air filled with a faint scent of spiritual medicine.
As time passed, Wu Yu's complexion gradually improved, but her cultivation had yet to restore to the peak of Dharma manifestation.
The failure of that Mahayana breakthrough caused irreparable harm to her foundation, which she understood could not be fully recovered in a short time.
She closed her eyes in contemplation, a trace of worry rose in her heart.
Uncertain when she might finally exit this seclusion room and see the light of day again.
What would the state of Ten Thousand Demon Country be like then?
Just as she sighed inwardly, the seclusion room's door opened slowly, yet no one stepped out.
This strange occurrence tightened Wu Yu's heart, she immediately gathered demonic power, vigilantly focusing on the door.
"Who's there? Great Sun Glaze Flame, is it you?" Wu Yu shouted, her voice tinged with tension.
The seclusion room remained silent with no response.
Her Divine Sense quickly scanned the entire room, finding no trace of anyone.
This eerie scene left Wu Yu even more unsettled, barely daring to breathe.
At this moment, Wu Yu suddenly noticed the Ju Mang Taoist Pearl placed not far away had vanished into thin air, replaced by a white jade porcelain bottle.
Startled, she immediately cast a spell with a gesture, her fox tail's shadow swept toward that direction but hit nothing.
The door of the seclusion room then slowly closed again, the light sound like a thunderclap to Wu Yu's ears.
She instantly stood up, quickly walked to the door, checked the Forbidden seals carefully, confirmed they were undamaged, and looked back inside.
The room was silent as if nothing had happened.
Wu Yu knew clearly that the Ju Mang Taoist Pearl had indeed disappeared, and that white jade porcelain bottle was no illusion.
She walked up to the porcelain bottle, cautiously probing its contents with her Divine Sense.
Inside the bottle was an elixir, exuding a rich fragrance, evidently a high-grade elixir meant to heal the foundation.
Staring at the elixir, waves surged in Wu Yu's heart.
She recalled notes she saw years ago, a myriad of possible names flickered in her mind.
"Nine Infant? Or…" she murmured quietly, her expression hard to decipher.
She knew this elixir didn't appear without cause, there must be a deeper meaning behind it.
On the other side, Yuan Ming had already casually walked out of the Demon Emperor Hall.
Using the invisibility ability of the Yin Moon Body, he left without alerting anyone.
He fiddled with the Ju Mang Taoist Pearl he had just acquired, his heart filled with emotion.
Thinking of Wu Yu whom he just saw, he couldn't help but sigh softly.
The once formidable Wu Yu who pressured him was no longer his match after failing a Mahayana breakthrough.
He could have taken the Ju Mang Taoist Pearl directly, but thought it over and left a bottle of elixir to heal the foundation instead.
He knew though Wu Yu's cultivation was damaged, her influence in Ten Thousand Demon Country remained substantial.
If she could recover her cultivation soon, she might stabilize the situation in Ten Thousand Demon Country a bit.
Currently, Ten Thousand Demon Country's demon kings rule independently, splitting into factions and fighting one another, making the situation increasingly unstable.
Though this conflict benefits the Human Clan, Yuan Ming understood that if turmoil in Ten Thousand Demon Country escalated excessively, it would inevitably affect the stability and productivity of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
Therefore, a chaotic yet not overly chaotic Ten Thousand Demon Country was Yuan Ming's ideal.
While contemplating the future of Ten Thousand Demon Country in his mind, he quickly flew, racing toward the nearest city.
Having obtained the Ju Mang Taoist Pearl containing the Wood Emperor's True Intent, next, he would venture outside the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, seeking other targets mentioned by the statue.

chapters.title: Chapter 1063 - 1028: Sealing
chapters.content:
As soon as Yuan Ming spoke, he immediately attracted everyone's attention.
Sima Changqin and Young Master Que Yue stopped in their tracks, and the teams from Heavenly Saint Academy and Taixuan Sect also came to a halt.
Nan Shangfeng also showed a look of confusion as he gazed at Yuan Ming.
"What do you mean by this?" Xizhuang Yuan raised an eyebrow and asked, with a hint of displeasure in his tone.
"Xi Ying is my Daoist companion, she cannot go with you." Yuan Ming's tone was firm, and he was unwavering.
Upon hearing these words, Sima Changqin's eyes flickered, while Young Master Que Yue's face darkened, jealousy flashing in his eyes.
The people from Evergreen Island and the Puppet Immortal also stopped in their tracks, looking curious, wanting to see what would unfold.
"Xi Ying is a disciple of Bright Moon Palace and should naturally act according to her sect. You say she is your Daoist companion, does that make it so?" Xizhuang Yuan sneered, looking at Xi Ying.
The latter opened her mouth, seemingly with something hard to express, unable to speak.
Seeing this, veins slightly throbbed on Yuan Ming's forehead.
"In that case, let's speak through strength." He had long been dissatisfied with Bright Moon Palace imprisoning Xi Ying, and at this moment, his anger was hard to suppress.
With that, with a thought in his mind, the Five Elements Dao Fruit Seal in his Dantian suddenly lit up, and mana surged in.
The Water attribute rune representing the Water Emperor True Intent shone brightly, emitting a unique aura from his body.
Within thousands of miles, Water attribute spiritual power madly gathered, the wind and snow raged, and cold air surged, turning the entire wilderness into what seemed like an ice and snow world.
The blue flying silkworms within a few hundred feet of Yuan Ming's vicinity suddenly froze, encased in frost, turning into countless large hailstones, falling one after another.
As soon as they hit the ground, the flying silkworms shattered into powder without a drop of blood spilled.
Seeing this, everyone's expressions changed drastically.
The people of Bright Moon Palace, except for Xi Ying, had their Protective Treasure Light instantly form ice crystals, which shattered into powder within a few moments, scattering all over the ground.
Then, a faint frost appeared on them, as if they were about to be frozen.
Xizhuang Yuan's face changed suddenly, and with a wave of his hand, a deep black Spiritual Domain enveloped the disciples of Bright Moon Palace.
"Fire Fire Costume!" he shouted in a low voice.
In the Spiritual Domain, flames flickered, and suddenly a set of crimson opera robes appeared on everyone's body, embroidered with fire dragon patterns, fiery and gorgeous, seeming to repel all coldness.
With the robe on, the piercing cold indeed disappeared without a trace, and the frost on their bodies melted gradually under the roasting flames.
Xizhuang Yuan saw this and breathed a slight sigh of relief, just as he was about to look at Yuan Ming, he saw him raise his palm, making a twisting gesture in the void.
In the next moment, the howling wind intensified outside the Spiritual Domain, forming a storm vortex that shot straight to the sky.
A cold air stronger than before gathered, and the wind and snow accumulated outside the black Spiritual Domain, forming a small mountain of ice cones over ten feet tall.This content belongs to novel_fіre.net
In the vortex like a demon dragon, extremely cold air continuously poured down, like splashing water on the ice mountain.
The black Spiritual Domain was covered with frozen cracks, and those hiding within, except for Xi Ying, had their Fire Fire Costumes shattered under the assault of cold air.
Xizhuang Yuan's corner of the eye twitched, and he waved his hand fiercely, causing the black Spiritual Domain to expand tenfold and extend beyond the ice mountain.
The onlookers saw this and retreated, avoiding the suddenly enlarged Spiritual Domain.
Once the Spiritual Domain expanded beyond the ice mountain, Xizhuang Yuan spoke again: "Void Stage Costume!"
As soon as the words fell, silver light flashed on a few people, and a costume woven with silver threads appeared on them.
The silver light of the costume surged, and their figures vanished from the ice mountain, only to appear beyond it the next moment after piercing through the void.
However, as soon as they appeared, they felt a sudden halt in their breathing, as an indescribable heavy pressure emerged in the surrounding void, as if the heavens and earth were solidified.
Xizhuang Yuan looked up abruptly to see a giant cyan-gray palace appearing above at some unknown time, wavering between the real and the illusory, indistinct, yet exuding a mighty oppressive force.
The shadows of the palace enveloped the people of Bright Moon Palace, making their figures stiff, nearly immobilized.
This is when a cyan-gray tree root reached out from the void behind Xi Ying, lightly brushed against her Void Stage Costume, which tore open with a "hiss" as silver light flowed.
The tree root immediately wrapped around Xi Ying's body, pulling her back into a silver light gate.
Before anyone could react, the silver light gate disappeared with Xi Ying into the void.
The giant cyan-gray palace also dissipated, as if it had never appeared.
The immense spatial pressure, like an invisible giant hand grasping tight, suddenly loosened, making the people of Bright Moon Palace feel their chests lighten and that suffocating oppressive feeling vanish.
They all took a deep breath, as if surfacing from deep water, reborn anew.
Xizhuang Yuan's face was ashen, staring intently at Yuan Ming, angrily shouting: "Return the person!"
Yuan Ming merely glanced at him, dismissively flicked his sleeves, and turned away, leading his people farther away.
Seeing this, Xizhuang Yuan's eyes were ablaze with fury, nearly breaking through his reason, and his figure flashed as he was about to step forward to stop them.
"Don't chase after her." At this moment, Nan Shangfeng stopped her first.
Xizhuang Yuan glared at him, asking word by word, "What did you say?"
"Don't forget your purpose for being here. The main task is important, Xi Ying is inconsequential. The Palace Master has placed a soul-binding spell on her; even if she's taken away, she won't reveal any secrets. Taking care of the main business is paramount," Nan Shangfeng frowned and transmitted sound.
The Puppet Immortal merely watched Yuan Ming's figure gradually disappear into the wind and snow from afar, a hint of surprise flashing in his eyes, but he said nothing more and turned to leave the scene.
Sima Changqin, Young Master Que Yue, Swordsman Qing Ping, and others had complex expressions and also all flew away.
...
Yuan Ming led Wang Fulong and several others constantly forward in a flying escape, only to find that more and more blue light spots appeared in the wind and snow ahead, almost as dense as the snow itself.
Not wanting to waste time on these insects, he promptly offered the Shura Palace. With everyone inside, he activated the spatial power of the Shura Palace, flashing in the void as they hurried forward.
Within the Shura Palace, in a separate courtyard Yuan Ming had prepared early on for Xi Ying, the two finally met alone.
They sat opposite each other, poured a cup of tea, and for a while, the silence lingered. Only the glint of moisture in their eyes revealed the deep emotions within.
"You've grown much stronger all these years." It was Xi Ying who first broke the silence.
"Compared to your expectation?" Yuan Ming asked with a smile.
"Far beyond my expectations. These years must have been hard?" Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming smiled at her words, recounting his experiences over the years and the achievements he'd now made to Xi Ying bit by bit.
Xi Ying also shared her situation over the years with Yuan Ming. Both listened intently, fearing to miss any detail of each other's past, feeling deeply emotional.
Compared to Yuan Ming's turbulent experiences, Xi Ying had always been under the control of the Bright Moon Palace. Though her days were dull and monotonous, they gave her heart much peace, greatly accelerating her cultivation speed, now reaching the mid-stage Life Witch.
"I..."
At this point, Xi Ying's words suddenly halted, as if something had locked her throat, unable to continue speaking.
Then, she raised her hand, pointing to her mouth, and shook her head.
Yuan Ming immediately understood that Xi Ying had been under some sort of interdiction, preventing her from speaking certain things.
Nonetheless, Yuan Ming also knew she wanted to explain why she hadn't shared the eighth layer of the Moonlight Technique with him, so promptly he gestured with his hand.
"I know you definitely have your reasons, no need to blame yourself." Yuan Ming comforted.
Xi Ying sighed at his words and nodded her head.
"Why has the Bright Moon Palace come to the Wentian Secret Realm this time... Can you talk about this?" Yuan Ming tentatively asked.
Xi Ying gave a bitter smile, shaking her head wordlessly.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was neither surprised nor disappointed, and with a smile said, "Then let's not talk about these things, I have a gift for you."
Saying this, he rotated his wrist, taking out a green crescent moon ring, placing it in Xi Ying's hand.
Upon seeing this, Xi Ying's eyes lit up, and she picked it up to carefully scrutinize, asking somewhat uncertainly, "Is this the Moon God Ring?"
Yuan Ming nodded, saying.
"Such a precious item should stay by your side." Xi Ying quickly said.
"My current cultivation focus is on breaking through to the Mahayana Realm, mainly as a Magic Practitioner. Not practicing Soul Cultivation temporarily, plus with no follow-up technique for the Moonlight Technique, keeping the Moon God Ring with me would be like casting pearls before swine. I'd rather give it to you." Yuan Ming pondered a bit and added.
With these words, Xi Ying finally accepted it.
In fact, after reaching the mid-stage Life Witch, her cultivation speed had noticeably slowed down, and the Moon God Ring would greatly aid her.
"Xi Ying, the Bright Moon Palace should have a lot of information about the Demon World, this shouldn't be in the interdiction range, right?" Yuan Ming asked.
"That's no problem, what do you want to know?" Xi Ying asked.
"I want to know some intelligence about the Returning Ruins; the Bright Moon Palace is the closest to the Returning Ruins, so the intelligence should be the most accurate." Yuan Ming quickly said.
"The Demon World is using the Returning Ruins as a breakthrough point, invading massively there. The offensive has become more fierce. According to the experiences of previous realm wars, the days when the Demon World fully tears the void passage and descends upon Chuyun Realm are likely not far away." Xi Ying nodded and said.
"How much time do you estimate is left?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
"No more than ten years, the Returning Ruins will break." Xi Ying pondered for a moment and gave an answer.
Yuan Ming's eyes tightened upon hearing this and inwardly steeled himself to find the Fire Origin Spiritual Object quickly to refine the Enlightenment Pill, striving to break through to the Mahayana Realm before the realm battle arrives.
"This time entering the Wentian Secret Realm, do you have something you wish to find that I could help with?" Yuan Ming gathered his mood, looked at Xi Ying, and with a smile inquired.
"If possible, help me find a Yin Soul Flower, it's an essential spiritual medicine missing for refining the Nine Yin True Soul Pill, which will greatly help me break through to the late-stage Life Witch." Xi Ying thought for a moment and said.
"Leave that to me." Yuan Ming showed a confident smile, patting his chest and said.
His voice had just fallen, and his brows furrowed again.
"What's wrong, is there something happening?" Xi Ying saw his strange expression and quickly asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1046 - 1001: The Eight Sufferings
chapters.content:
A few days later, within the borders of Daze Country, the wind and rain were as gloomy as dusk.
The rain poured down in torrents, pelting the eaves of the dilapidated temple with large raindrops, making a crisp "pitter-patter" sound, as if the sky was venting endless sorrow.
At this moment, on the horizon, three tunneling lights pierced through the dark clouds, like meteors streaking across the sky, finally landing steadily in front of the temple's weathered gate.
"Brother Cao, this place is desolate; why don't we go directly to River City? Why stop here?" A female cultivator with peach-blossom cheeks frowned at the surroundings and asked puzzledly.
"Junior Sister, the person we rescued mentioned that the situation in River City is unclear, and there may be demons running amok. Although this temple is in disrepair, it lies outside the city and sees few visitors, making it a suitable place for us to temporarily take shelter." The leading man in black said softly.
Beside him, a long-faced male cultivator nodded in agreement.
So the three of them walked into the temple, but their steps instantly became stiff.
In the main hall, a clay statue covered in dust and cobwebs stood solemn and mysterious.
It was a statue of a female Daoist, her eyes slightly opened, her expression dignified, invoking awe in onlookers.
This statue seemed to have been chopped by swords and knives, covered with sword cuts and knife marks, as if it had endured a fierce battle, appearing somewhat battered and incomplete.
At this moment, a man in blue stood silently before the statue, looking up as if searching for something.
His silhouette appeared so lonely and desolate, as if he didn't belong to this world.
Brother Cao looked at the man before him with vigilance.
Before landing, he had used his divine sense to probe the temple, confirming it was empty. Only then had he landed confidently, yet now a mysterious man suddenly appeared.
Although this man exuded not the slightest aura of mana, Brother Cao dared not be careless.
After many years of cultivation, he understood that many people in this world concealed profound abilities, some even able to conceal their aura entirely, appearing as ordinary mortals.
"We are disciples of the West Valley Sect in Shanglong Country. We didn't know that a senior was meditating here. We apologize for the intrusion and ask for your forgiveness." Brother Cao cupped his hands in a respectful salute.
The man in blue heard the words, turned around slowly, and his gaze calmly swept over Brother Cao and his companions.
"West Valley Sect? A name I've never heard. What is the cultivation level of the patriarch in your sect?" he asked lightly.
Brother Cao was startled and quickly replied, "Senior, our sect's patriarch, Master Qi Yang, is a Returning Void Great Power, renowned throughout the land."
The West Valley Sect in Shanglong Country, neighboring Daze Country, was considered a significant sect, quite reputable. Yet this man in blue appeared to know nothing about it, surprising Brother Cao.
He thought to himself that although the man in blue seemed ordinary, his calm demeanor in front of cultivators like them suggested he was a high individual deeply concealing his capabilities.
"A Returning Void Great Power? Very well, you mentioned outside that River City had become a den of demons. What is going on?" the man in blue asked with a gentle smile.
Brother Cao was even more shocked upon hearing this.
This man in blue seemed unaware of the situation in River City, confirming he wasn't from Daze Country.
After a moment's thought, he took a deep breath and explained the recent events in Daze Country: "Senior may not know this, but we also knew little about the situation in River City. During a recent training excursion, we inadvertently rescued several individuals from an evil cultivator's cave mansion. One of them was from Daze Country, who told us that a sect called 'Yuxuan Sect' had appeared in Daze Country, quickly expanding its influence. Within merely a few months, it reached the point where everyone believed in it."
"It seems that a soul cultivator intends to use Daze Country as a springboard to gather believers and expand its power. But what does this have to do with River City becoming a demon lair?" the man in blue asked Brother Cao, curiosity evident in his brows.
"The path of soul cultivation is not forbidden, but the rise of a new power always raises doubts. According to that Daze Country resident, Yuxuan Sect used human sacrifice as a ritual, selecting a city as the sacrificial site. River City is their next target. The three of us traveled thousands of miles to prevent this human sacrifice." Brother Cao pondered for a moment, then spoke slowly.
"Aside from that man's words, do you have any other evidence?" the man in blue nodded and asked again.
"No, which is why we intended to use this place as a base to secretly investigate, verify the truth, and plan our next move." Brother Cao said honestly.
"Oh? What do you think, fellow Daoist? Is this matter true or false?" the man in blue suddenly raised his head to look behind them.
Brother Cao and his companions were startled, quickly turning around to see an elderly man in flowing robes walking slowly through the rain— their master, Xu Yousan, a late-stage Nascent Soul cultivator.
"Master, what brings you here?" Brother Cao asked in surprise.
"I followed you discreetly upon hearing about it. That person's words should be true, but Daze Country is usually isolated, and little news reaches Shanglong Country. Whether Yuxuan Sect exists, I am also unsure." Xu Yousan shook his head slightly.
Brother Cao couldn't shake the feeling that his master's attitude seemed somewhat respectful.
"Do you recognize me?" The man in blue also noticed this and promptly asked.
"Junior has poor eyesight, though unable to recognize senior's true face, this junior is the direct disciple of Master Qi Yang and possesses the Heavenly Yang Divine Eye, capable of discerning spiritual power fluctuations. Senior's Mana is immeasurable, your cultivation must certainly surpass ours." Xu Yousan respectfully replied.
The man in the blue robe nodded slightly upon hearing this, then directly asked, "Do you know which Dharma manifestation cultivators exist in Shanglong Country and Daze Country?"
"Reporting to senior, Shanglong Country has Immortal Ning Yu of the Green Jade Sect and Zhi Yan Fairy of Perch Phoenix Valley, two Dharma manifestation great powers. As for Daze Country, there is only Elder Eight Sufferings of the Upper Cloud Sect." Xu Yousan hurriedly answered, not daring to slacken.
"Have your master find a way to contact those two Dharma manifestation cultivators to come here to see me." The man in blue spoke lightly after listening.
"Senior, my master is only at the Returning Void Realm, how could he compel those two Dharma manifestation great powers?" Xu Yousan was troubled upon hearing this.
The man in the blue robe smiled slightly, casually tossing out a pitch-black token, engraved with the words "Ten Thousand Immortals."
He said lightly, "With this token, they will naturally come. Tell them my surname is Yuan."
Upon receiving the token, Xu Yousan's face changed instantly, and he asked in a trembling voice, "The Ten Thousand Immortals Token, surname Yuan... Are you possibly that legendary figure...?"
In the present-day Chuyun Realm, the only one who possesses the Ten Thousand Immortals Token and carries the surname Yuan, instilling respect in Dharma manifestation cultivators, is that legendary figure.
The man in the blue robe, who was Yuan Ming, smiled and nodded, confirming Xu Yousan's guess.
Overwhelmed with excitement, Xu Yousan quickly and deeply bowed to Yuan Ming, then turned to leave to carry out Yuan Ming's orders.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming turned his gaze to the three remaining disciples, speaking gently, "Since you three have a fateful connection with me, if you have any doubts in your cultivation, feel free to speak openly, and I can offer some guidance."
...
Elsewhere, deep within the Upper Cloud Sect, the mountains layered lushly, shrouded in mist.
Behind a silent bamboo forest, a simple ancient cave mansion was faintly visible, within which an elder with white hair and beard sat in a lotus throne, meditating with closed eyes.
His face was etched with wrinkles, his eyes carried a faint sorrow and melancholic expression, as if lamenting the misfortune of the world's beings.
His body was tightly entwined with circle after circle of thorns, their sharp tips piercing deeply into his skin, yet no fresh blood flowed from the wounds, instead emitting a faint white spirit light, adding an ethereal quality to his weathered visage.
Suddenly, the elder's face twisted, and the right half swiftly transformed, eventually taking on the appearance of a woman.Check latest chapters at novᴇlfire.net
Her eyes gleamed with madness, her mouth curving into an eerie smile.
"It's not enough! Eight Sufferings, you are too timid! How can the Desire Power collected from just one Daze Country help you and me reach the Realm of Life Witch!" She shrieked, her voice dripping with frenzy and urgency.
Slowly opening his eyes, Elder Eight Sufferings glanced at the woman and said calmly, "Be patient, Shanglong Country has Immortal Ning Yu and Zhi Yan Fairy, two Dharma manifestation great powers presiding. If we act rashly, it will only arouse their suspicion. If we anger them, we won't even be able to hold onto Daze Country."
Upon hearing this, a trace of unwillingness flashed in her eyes, but she quickly regained calmness.
She understood that she could now only inhabit Elder Eight Sufferings' body, relying on his power to achieve her goals.
"Then find a chance to secretly kill them! The blood and essence of Dharma manifestation cultivators can certainly advance your Bloodthorn Compassionate Life Technique greatly!" She tempted.
"I said, don't rush. You have no physical body now, and can only reside within me, you must heed my mind. Otherwise, I don't mind erasing your residual soul completely." Elder Eight Sufferings frowned, but his voice remained calm.
"If you're not afraid of damaging your Nascent Soul and dropping in cultivation, by all means, try!" She retorted with a laugh, her voice full of taunting and disdain.
Despite the irritation in his heart, Elder Eight Sufferings felt helpless.
A hundred years ago, an accident caused him to become entangled with this madwoman from the Three Realms Sect.
Though his cultivation was profound, he couldn't completely shake off this madwoman's interference.
He took a deep breath to calm his mind, then transmitted a command outward.
Soon, a female cultivator with a charming figure came quickly, bowing respectfully to Elder Eight Sufferings.
The female cultivator was Ji Kanqing, Elder Eight Sufferings' closed-door disciple.
Seeing Elder Eight Sufferings' half-male, half-female appearance, she was not surprised, merely lowering her head to inquire, "Master, you called for me?"
"Kanqing, go retrieve the Qi-Blood and Desire Power obtained from the last blood sacrifice in Luowan City." Elder Eight Sufferings nodded, instructing.
Ji Kanqing bowed in acknowledgment without questioning further, then turned and left.
However, just as she turned around, a thunderous shout erupted from outside the cave mansion: "Eight Sufferings! Get out here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1047 - 1012: Thunderous Methods
chapters.content:
Elder Eight Sufferings frowned, raising his hand to form a seal.
Suddenly, the thorns around him transformed into spirit light, merging into his body.
At the same time, the right half of his face rapidly returned to its original form.
He stood up, flashed, and arrived outside the Cave Mansion.
In midair, a burly man with coarse eyebrows, eight feet tall and clad in jade armor, stood with arms crossed, looking coldly at Elder Eight Sufferings who appeared before him.
"Ning Yu, what madness is this, coming to my Upper Cloud Sect?" Elder Eight Sufferings' expression slightly darkened as he directly questioned.
"How dare you ask! My direct disciple was murdered in River City, and when I arrived, I discovered it was your subordinates' doing! You must give me an explanation for this!" Immortal Ning Yu's face was ashen, glaring in fury, pointing at Elder Eight Sufferings.
"My subordinates? Who exactly? If this is true, I will certainly give you an explanation." Elder Eight Sufferings' brows furrowed tightly, he said in a deep voice.
"The perpetrator was already slain by me, how would I know his name?" Immortal Ning Yu snorted coldly.
"So you have no evidence, yet you accuse my subordinate of killing your disciple based on mere hearsay? Ning Yu, aren't you bullying me too much!" Elder Eight Sufferings couldn't help but sneer coldly.
Just then, a crisp female voice suddenly echoed: "I advise you, Fellow Daoist Eight Sufferings, not to act rashly, but to properly explain to Ning Yu. Otherwise, I will have to preside over justice."
Everyone turned towards the voice, only to see a female cultivator, garbed in red like fire, with a valiant demeanor, slowly revealing herself beside Immortal Ning Yu.
It was Zhi Yan Fairy from Perch Phoenix Valley.
Upon seeing her, Elder Eight Sufferings' anger instantly dissipated by more than half, replaced by an inexplicable doubt.
At this moment, the right half of his face suddenly transformed, revealing the appearance of a woman.
That woman's face twisted, grinning hideously, she said: "Fool, can't you see? They have already discovered our plot!"
Immortal Ning Yu and Zhi Yan Fairy's expressions turned grave immediately.
Immortal Ning Yu spoke in a deep voice: "Water Jelly Immortal, it's you!"
"Ning Yu, Zhi Yan, don't spout nonsense! I have nothing to do with this woman!" Elder Eight Sufferings' expression changed, shouting angrily.
"Eight Sufferings, stop making excuses. The Soul Cultivation Method on you was clearly given by Water Jelly Immortal. You dare to collude with the Three Realms Sect demons to cultivate such a wicked art! If we hadn't stumbled upon it by chance, you would have completely deceived us!" Zhi Yan Fairy said coldly.
"It's pointless to say more, since you both know our secret, don't think of leaving alive!" Water Jelly Immortal chuckled sinisterly, saying.
"Do you think we would fear you? We've long heard of your divine skills, able to split souls and reside in others' bodies. Yet in this state, you can only exert less than thirty percent of your power. Even with Eight Sufferings' help, you are not our match!" Immortal Ning Yu showed a flash of fear in his eyes, yet still gritted his teeth and insisted.
"Oh? Is that so? What if my true body is here?" Water Jelly Immortal smiled coldly.
Upon hearing this, the three present were instantly filled with uncertainty and suspicion.
Elder Eight Sufferings widened his eyes, watching his mouth utter those words while his heart was filled with dread.
At this moment, Immortal Ning Yu and Zhi Yan Fairy suddenly felt a chill behind them, as if something was approaching them.
They instinctively wanted to turn around, but a powerful force fixed them in place.
"Turn around, look into my eyes!" A charming female voice rang out behind them, filled with undeniable power.
The two were shocked in their hearts, but their bodies turned involuntarily.
When they clearly saw the person behind them, their faces changed drastically—standing behind them was none other than Elder Eight Sufferings' closed-door disciple, Ji Kanqing!
At this moment, Ji Kanqing had completely transformed, her mouth curled with a cold smile, her eyes flashing with contempt.
As Immortal Ning Yu and Zhi Yan Fairy met her gaze, they instantly fell into an illusion, their bodies stiffening and unable to move.
"What a waste!" Ji Kanqing shouted angrily, spitting at Elder Eight Sufferings, her eyes full of disgust.
She raised her hand, and the soul splitting entity residing in Elder Eight Sufferings' physical body instantly exited, transforming into a ghostly light entering her palm.
Recalling the past, Elder Eight Sufferings thought he had risked his life for a narrow victory, yet it was merely an illusion she meticulously wove.
She exploited Elder Eight Sufferings' greed and fear, making him willingly cultivate the Bloodthorn Compassionate Life Technique.
This method was actually a secret skill for refining a clone; once Elder Eight Sufferings cultivated to the Realm of Life Witch, he would become her puppet, a mere pawn in her hand.
However, the cultivation of this method was arduous, requiring the devouring of a large amount of Qi-Blood and Desire Power, so Ji Kanqing dared not act openly, only cautiously manipulating everything from the shadows.
She thought her plan was flawless, but unexpectedly, it was abruptively discovered by Immortal Ning Yu and Zhi Yan Fairy today.
Unwilling in her heart, yet helpless, she could only personally appear, subduing Immortal Ning Yu and their group with her thunderous means.
Fortunately, this was within the Daze Country, where Upper Cloud Sect was already under her secret control, ensuring the news wouldn't spread.
She planned to appear in the guise of Immortal Ning Yu, to resolve the trouble while simultaneously annexing Shanglong Country.
But Ji Kanqing knew in her heart that time was pressing.
She couldn't control the thoughts of Dharma manifestation; if any other Dharma manifestation tried to contact Immortal Ning Yu and his group, her identity would be completely exposed.
Just as she was planning her next move, a chilling sensation suddenly crept into her heart.
She turned her head abruptly, only to see a man in a blue robe standing mid-air, with a sincere and radiant smile on his face.
"Got you." As Yuan Ming's words fell, countless runes burst from Immortal Ning Yu and Zhi Yan Fairy, quickly coalescing into a formation that trapped Ji Kanqing and Yuan Ming within it.
Ji Kanqing's face instantly turned gloomy. She only then belatedly realized that she had fallen into a trap specifically aimed at her.
...
An hour later.
Within the main hall of Upper Cloud Sect, Yuan Ming sat on the sect master's throne, gently rubbing a sphere encircled by the roots of the Undying Tree.
Sealed within that sphere was the Nascent Soul of the renowned Water Jelly Immortal of the Three Realms Sect — Ji Kanqing.
In the Three Realms Sect, two immortals were famous throughout the lands: one was Fire Wing Immortal, whose Fire Emperor True Intent was feared across the wilds.
The other was this Water Jelly Immortal, who wielded the Water Emperor True Intent, equally awe-inspiring.
And Yuan Ming targeted her specifically because of this Water Emperor True Intent.
According to the information revealed by the statue, Yuan Ming had long been aware that Ji Kanqing was hiding in Daze Country.
The intel also mentioned that this woman was extremely cautious, fleeing elsewhere at the slightest sign of trouble.
Therefore, Yuan Ming dared not act rashly and cleverly used the chance encounter with Xu Yousan at the ruined temple to lure Immortal Ning Yu and Zhi Yan Fairy.
This plan was meticulously crafted by Yuan Ming after thoroughly inquiring about their situations.
He cleverly utilized the old acquaintance relationship between Elder Eight Sufferings and Immortal Ning Yu to naturally force Ji Kanqing to show herself.
And on Immortal Ning Yu and Zhi Yan Fairy, Yuan Ming had already secretly placed formation devices, which he could instantly activate with a thought to trap Ji Kanqing.
"This time, thank you both for your righteous assistance." Yuan Ming felt grateful in his heart, looking down with eyes full of appreciation.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan is too kind. It is an honor for us to help Fellow Daoist capture this Water Jelly Immortal." Immortal Ning Yu smiled, though still somewhat intimidated by the Water Jelly Immortal, she appeared very carefree on the surface.
Zhi Yan Fairy was more forthright, her eyes shining with admiration, she said to Yuan Ming, "Fellow Daoist, your skills are extraordinary, having previously subdued Fire Wing Immortal alone, dealing with this Water Jelly Immortal naturally poses no challenge. We merely assisted from the sidelines and are not worthy of mention."
Yuan Ming smiled slightly, lightly turned his palm, and took out two bottles of elixirs, treasures personally refined by Dian Xiaosan.
He handed the elixirs to the two and said, "I sincerely appreciate your help this time. If there is a need in the future, feel free to find me in White Emperor City. Consider these two bottles of elixirs as a token of my gratitude."
Immortal Ning Yu accepted the elixirs, his gaze involuntarily shifting to the side where Elder Eight Sufferings was sealed with power.
He hesitated for a moment and opened his mouth to ask, "I wonder what plans Fellow Daoist has for handling this Elder Eight Sufferings?"
Yuan Ming's eyes were calm, he said casually, "Elder Eight Sufferings was beguiled by the Water Jelly Immortal, but ultimately, he couldn't escape the calamity of greed. He shall be spared death, but not punishment. I will take him back to White Emperor City to face consequences alongside the Water Jelly Immortal."
In a few words, he decided the fate of this Dharma manifestation Cultivator.
"And what about Upper Cloud Sect and Daze Country, Fellow Daoist, what plans do you have?" Immortal Ning Yu nodded and asked again.
"Considering the distance from the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range and the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals having no expansion intent, I leave Daze Country and Upper Cloud Sect in your care. I only hope you swiftly eradicate the remnants of Yuxuan Sect to bring peace to the people and cultivators here." Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and said.
Having said this, Yuan Ming stood up, politely declined Zhi Yan Fairy's invitation to visit Perch Phoenix Valley.
With a flick of his sleeve, he encompassed Elder Eight Sufferings into the Shura Palace and then gracefully left.
...
Central Continent, Tian Guang Mountain Range, towering mountains shrouded in mist.
"Thief, halt!" A thunderous voice shattered the tranquility of the mountains.
Two tunneling lights intertwined in the firmament, one chasing the other, swift as shooting stars.
Within the front tunneling light, a middle-aged male cultivator with a goatee appeared smug, glancing back with a mocking smirk.
"Jiang Wenjian, how can your Escape Technique compare to mine? This Sky-splitting Golden Mace is destined to elude you." He chuckled, his words full of provocation.
Enveloped by the trailing tunneling light, Jiang Wenjian's face turned grim upon hearing this.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs novᴇlfire.net
He gritted his teeth, performed a hand gesture, mana surged out, causing his tunneling light to accelerate, closing in.
"Hmph, my Golden Sword Sect has gone all out; even with your supreme skill, don't hope to leave Tian Guang Mountain Range with the Sky-splitting Golden Mace!" Jiang Wenjian spat coldly.
The middle-aged male cultivator laughed heartily, his figure suddenly transformed into a fleeting shadow, dramatically increasing his tunneling speed, swiftly widening the gap with Jiang Wenjian.
At this moment, another tunneling light suddenly sped forward from ahead, disrupting the pursuit.
From the tunneling light emerged a middle-aged scholar in a green robe, with three strands of long beard flowing, exuding an elegant demeanor.
He paused mid-air upon noticing the commotion, his gaze darting between the two.
Seeing this, Jiang Wenjian's eyes flashed with joy, and he promptly called out, "Fellow Daoist, quickly lend me a hand! The man with the goatee ahead is Mo Kongkong, he has stolen our sect's prized treasure. If Fellow Daoist helps us, Golden Sword Sect will surely reward you generously!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1049 - 1014: Sanctuary
chapters.content:
Inside the Demon Emperor Hall, the atmosphere was solemn and awe-inspiring.
The Black Bear King led a group of demon soldiers, who neatly bowed in respect, paying homage to Wu Yu seated at the main seat.Follow current novels on N0veI.Fiɾe.net
"Your Majesty, an urgent message has arrived from the clansmen at Dragon Ridge. The demon bear, which has been dormant in Black Wind Gorge for many years, has awakened and been demonized due to the erosion of Demonic Qi. It was originally a Level 5 Great Demon, and now, after demonization, its strength is almost approaching Level 6, posing a great threat." At the behest of the Black Bear King, a demon soldier stepped forward and reported in a deep voice.
"Is there anything else?" Wu Yu slightly raised her eyebrows, gently nodding her head, and asked faintly.
Another demon soldier continued to report, "In the vicinity of Phoenix Mountain, Demonic Qi is rampant. Over a dozen demon beasts have been demonized, and they are fighting among themselves. It is estimated that within a few days, a Level 5 demon beast will be born. Fortunately, these demonized demon beasts have not yet spread outward."
"As for the situation at Old Hei Lin, the demonized demon beasts appeared not long ago and have already been eradicated by the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, without troubling our clansmen," another demon soldier added.
The group of demon soldiers reported the situation of demon beasts' demonization in various parts of Ten Thousand Demon Country one by one. After listening, Wu Yu's expression remained unchanged, seemingly without any worries.
"Your Majesty, if the demonized creature in Black Wind Gorge is not stopped, it may lead to catastrophe. Please allow me to handle it," the Black Bear King stepped forward, cupped his hands, and said.
"There is no need for you to intervene in this matter. Just perform your duties of inspection well," Wu Yu glanced at him and said indifferently.
"As you command." The Black Bear King hesitated slightly but eventually nodded in compliance.
Wu Yu slightly raised her eyes and looked at the group of demon soldiers, softly saying, "Regarding the demonization of demon beasts, you only need to sincerely pray to the Ten Thousand Demon Emperor, and the Demon Emperor will naturally protect you."
Her voice was soft yet full of power, seemingly possessing a certain magic, gradually calming the initially anxious demon soldiers.
"As you command!" the group of demons responded in unison.
After the demon soldiers retreated with the Black Bear King, Wu Yu slowly got up and stepped into the inner chamber of the grand hall.
There stood a black statue towering solemnly, the embodiment of the Nether Moon God.
Wu Yu looked at the statue with a complex expression, clasping her hands in front of her chest and began to sincerely pray.
Her Vow Power slowly infused into the statue, and soon after, she received a response from the Nether Moon God.
