Feeling more relieved after receiving the response, Wu Yu continued praying, steadily generating Vow Power.
A moment later, a projected image appeared in her mind.
In the image, deep within Black Wind Gorge of Dragon Ridge, the nearly Level 6 demonized bear demon was instantly slain by a massive green sword light that appeared out of nowhere, dying a miserable death.
"Thank you," Wu Yu expressed her heartfelt gratitude after seeing the image, exhaling gently.
Then, she quietly continued to pray for another hour before lowering her clasped hands.
At this moment, a stream of light appeared beside her, forming the figure of the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
"It seems you have indeed let go of the Demon Clan's dignity. Remember the time you even fought to the death, yet now you ask for his help without any hesitation," the Great Sun Glaze Flame spoke with a hint of mockery in the tone.
In response, Wu Yu's expression remained as calm as water, faintly saying, "As long as I can protect the Ten Thousand Demon Country and shelter my clansmen, I am willing to pay any price."
The Great Sun Glaze Flame sighed upon hearing this and said no more.
At this moment, Wu Yu lightly turned her wrist, and a blue jade piece appeared in her palm.
On the jade piece, golden characters the size of rice grains emerged one by one, forming a directory of Spiritual Medicine.
After glancing at it, she communicated with the clan members.
Soon, a demon soldier hurriedly arrived, holding a purple square box.
The Spiritual Medicine listed on the directory was inside the box.
Wu Yu once again approached the Nether Moon God Statue and prayed sincerely.
A moment later, golden and silver lights gathered to form a Light Gate.
Guided by an invisible force, the purple box flew into the Light Gate and disappeared.
Seeing this, Wu Yu's expression remained calm, as if she had long been accustomed to this.
...
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming stood quietly beside the White Jade Lotus Platform.
He waved his hand lightly, as if plucking strings in the void, and the purple box appeared dreamlike before him.
At this moment, his aura was as heavy as a mountain and as vast as the sea, and his cultivation had evidently reached the pinnacle of the late Dharma manifestation Stage.
Twenty years ago, with the power of the gray statue, he finally found the Earth Element Stone and placed it within the Array of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Since then, the Divine Skill of the Stealing Heaven Tripod to transmit items was restored.
Beside him, on the other side of the White Jade Lotus Platform, stood a statue identical to the statue of the Ten Thousand Demon Emperor of the Demon Clan, continuously receiving Vow Power from the Demon Clan.
As early as fifty years ago, under Yuan Ming's wise governance, the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals had attained high prestige. Wu Yu voluntarily sought out Yuan Ming and expressed her willingness to worship the Nether Moon God.
For such a submission from a Dharma Phase Cultivator, Yuan Ming gladly accepted and agreed immediately.
Since then, Wu Yu led the Demon Clan of the Ten Thousand Demon Country to provide Yuan Ming with Vow Power, striving to restrain the demon cultivators of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, avoiding conflicts with the cultivators of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals.
Yuan Ming promised to protect the Demon Clan of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, ensuring that the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals would not target them.
Yuan Ming did not harbor much malice toward the Ten Thousand Demon Country. Although he knew they had previously colluded with the Demon World and the Three Realms Sect, they had now been abandoned by the Demon World and could not become a significant threat, so he did not dwell on it.
As long as the Ten Thousand Demon Country behaved themselves and provided him with Desire Power, he didn't mind protecting them.
In fact, Wu Yu's choice to side with Yuan Ming was out of desperation.
The Electric Roc King and the Flame Wolf King were dissatisfied with her rule and had treacherous intentions. Overthrowing her rule was imminent.
To stabilize the rule of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, Yuan Ming enticed and killed the Electric Roc King, Flame Wolf King, and Green Snake King, these three demon kings who were hostile to the Human Clan.
Originally, Wu Yu only intended to use Yuan Ming to get rid of the Electric Roc King and the Flame Wolf King, but Yuan Ming did not act entirely according to her wishes and also eliminated the Green Snake King.
This action significantly weakened the Ten Thousand Demon Country, making it difficult for them to stir up trouble in the future.
Since then, the Ten Thousand Demon Country indeed became much more low-key and behaved more honestly.
After leaving the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming arrived at the City Lord Mansion and summoned Wang Fulong.
He handed over the batch of spiritual medicine he had just obtained to Wang Fulong, instructing him to pass it to Dian Xiaosan, who was in seclusion refining pills, to refine a pill known as the "Five Elements Rejuvenation Pill."
This elixir significantly aids Nascent Soul cultivators in breaking through to the Returning to Void Stage.
In the main hall, Wang Fulong looked up at Yuan Ming seated high above, feeling a trace of awe in his heart.
As time passed, he did not feel that Yuan Ming became more approachable; instead, he felt that his majesty grew heavier and more unfathomable.
The Yuan Ming before him seemed like the embodiment of the source of all laws; just a glance made the mana inside him restless, as if Yuan Ming could absorb his mana completely with just a raise of his hand.
"With Fellow Daoist Dian Xiaosan's alchemy technique and these spiritual materials and spiritual medicine, they should be able to refine nearly nine elixirs. Soon, the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals will have a few more Returning to Void Stage cultivators," Wang Fulong said with a slight smile after regaining his composure after examining the spiritual medicine Yuan Ming gave him.
"How many Returning to Void Stage cultivators are there in the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals now?" Yuan Ming nodded and asked.
"There are currently 120 Returning to Void Stage cultivators, and 28 Dharma Phase cultivators," Wang Fulong replied respectfully.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, gesturing for him to continue.
Wang Fulong carefully glanced at him, seeing that there were no other instructions, he continued: "At the Moon Sect, among the Soul Cultivators, there are 260 Soul Witches, 98 Illusion Witches, 22 Love Witches, 15 Sleeping Witches, and already four Spoken Witches."
Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, showed a trace of satisfaction in his eyes.
Over the past sixty years, he continuously distributed Vow Power Pills to the Nether Moon Sect members and mobilized vast resources to aid their cultivation; now, this force was quite considerable.
These soul cultivators were not ordinary believers; they had converted from being magic practitioners, and their strength could not be underestimated.
Yuan Ming was also aware that aside from White Emperor City and the Moon Sect, the situation of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals was very complex, with loose internal management and numerous problems.
It was currently relying on his powerful strength to suppress and prevent significant conflicts from breaking out within the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals.
Should anything happen to him, the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals might immediately fall apart.
However, Yuan Ming did not have high expectations of these people. As long as they could provide a stable flow of Desire Power, he would be satisfied.
He did not care too much about other matters.
"Is there any news about Xi Ying at Ming Yue Palace?" Yuan Ming suddenly asked.
Wang Fulong was momentarily stunned but quickly understood that Yuan Ming was inquiring about Xi Ying, and hurriedly responded: "Daoist Xi Ying is highly valued in Ming Yue Palace and has been in closed-door cultivation in a forbidden area for years. It is said that she has been designated as a candidate for Goddess by the Bright Moon Palace Master."
Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, couldn't help but frown slightly, a wave of worry rising in his heart.
Previously, Xi Ying had mentioned wanting to give him the Eighth Layer cultivation technique of the Moonlight Technique, but since then, Xi Ying had been out of touch, and even the cultivation technique had not been sent.
When he tried possession, he found that Xi Ying's Three Corpse Avatars were sealed, and Guoguo was taken away. His connection with Xi Ying had been severed.
If he hadn't learned from the Stealing Heaven Tripod gray statue that Xi Ying was safe, he would have already gone to Ming Yue Palace to demand her return.
Seeing Yuan Ming's grim expression, Wang Fulong couldn't help but feel nervous, his forehead beaded with cold sweat.
He could feel Yuan Ming's mana affecting him more and more, almost unbearably so.
At this moment, Yuan Ming returned to his senses, noticed Wang Fulong's distress, and said indifferently, "You may go about your work."
Relieved, Wang Fulong bowed and quickly exited the main hall.
Looking at Wang Fulong's departing figure, Yuan Ming couldn't help but chuckle.
The reason Wang Fulong behaved in such a manner was entirely due to the power of the Five Elements Dao Fruit he cultivated.
This Five Elements Dao Fruit ranked among the top three Great Divine Powers, with extraordinary might.
Although he had already cultivated four Dao Fruits, the Gold Element Dao Fruit was not completed yet, so he could not fully suppress the oppression of the Five Elements Dao Fruit, resulting in its leakage.
With Wang Fulong's cultivation level, naturally, he felt immense pressure in his presence, and those with lower cultivation could not even get close.
Fortunately, the True Intent of the Golden Emperor was about to be fully comprehended, and by then he would be able to perfectly control the Five Elements Dao Fruit, preventing any uncontrollable pressure from occurring.

chapters.title: Chapter 1050 - 1015: Sacrifice
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming stood up, emanating a dazzling yellow halo all around him, resembling the first rays of sunrise.
His figure gradually merged with the ground, transforming into a stream of light, swiftly retreating deep underground.
In an instant, he was standing before the towering Pillar Hongjun.
The previously ravaged Pillar Hongjun had regained much of its splendor under the nourishment of the repair array, no longer requiring the full support of Yuan Ming's World Tree.
At this moment, the Heavenly Crane Array operated increasingly smoothly, as if it were the natural rhythm of heaven and earth.
Yuan Ming's gaze was sharp; after a quick survey, he didn't linger.
He once again deployed his Escape Technique, his figure like a fish swimming through the earth, soon arriving above a vast Magma Lake.
On the surface of the lake, the crimson magma rolled continuously, resembling blazing flames, with hot waves rushing against him, accompanied by the suffocating scent of sulfur.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, instantly enveloped by a layer of red light membrane, completely isolating the scorching Magma Power from his body.
With a swift movement, like an arrow, he shot towards the depths of the magma. Traversing layers of scorching magma, he finally reached the bright red magma region deep within.
The temperature of the magma here was incredibly high, even Yuan Ming, endowed with the Fire Emperor's Will, felt an indescribable heat piercing his bones.
Although the heat couldn't harm him, the sensation of being scorched by flames was unpleasant.
The surrounding void twisted and deformed under the high temperature of the magma, occasionally revealing spatial cracks that vanished like black lightning in the void.
Within this scorching magma, an enormous azure-gray palace floated, appearing solemn and mysterious.
A huge array formed by virtual light emerged around the palace, enveloping it.
The rolling heat waves attracted by the array gathered into huge circular fire rings surrounding the palace, presenting a spectacular scene.
This palace precisely was the Shura Palace that Yuan Ming placed here.
Drawing on the Earth Fire's power for tempering, the Shura Palace was now enveloped in a crystalline glow, emitting dazzling seven-colored light, like a hundred-tempered treasured blade about to emerge, radiating strong vibrations, bearing the semblance of a Three Realms Immortal Boat.
Yuan Ming circled the Shura Palace slowly, satisfaction evident in his eyes, a subtle smile playing on his lips.
He opened his mouth towards the void and asked, "How is it going, how's the refining?"
As his words fell, a graceful figure appeared out of nowhere, it was exactly Xi Hezi.
She sighed gently and said, "The power of the Earth Fire is indeed strong enough, I have already refined the outer shell of the Shura Palace once. But the deeper regions are yet to be refined, and now the problem is still the same, my materials are insufficient."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but frown slightly.
Over the years, he had almost poured all the resources of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals into the refining of the Shura Palace, aiming to forge it into another Magic Treasure with attack power comparable to the Three Realms Immortal Boat.
He originally thought that pouring all resources into it should at least have succeeded by sixty to seventy percent by now, but it seems far from it.
"Don't just say you're anxious, I'm quite anxious too. In my opinion, you'd better do as I suggested last time." Xi Hezi continued.
"That's not feasible." Yuan Ming recalled Xi Hezi seriously suggesting him to seize materials and resources last time and couldn't help but shake his head.
"Why wouldn't it be feasible? With your current influence and strength, as long as you don't provoke the Three Giant Sects, which sect in the Chuyun Realm can stop you? Just rob twenty or thirty medium-sized sects like the Golden Sword Sect in one go, and the resources should be roughly sufficient." Xi Hezi said indifferently.
"To do as you suggest, I'm afraid it won't be long before I can no longer have a foothold in the Chuyun Realm." Yuan Ming sighed, smiling bitterly.
In fact, Yuan Ming had not dismissed the idea of seizing resources.
After all, it was indeed one of the effective ways to accumulate wealth quickly.
"Oh, even if ordinary sects' items cannot be plundered, can one or two not be taken from evil sects like the Three Realms Sect? Besides, the Chuyun Realm is vast, since ancient times cultivators have fallen numerous times, their Cave Mansions were not all explored. Those undiscovered Cave Mansions surely contain many rare items." Xi Hezi's words carried a hint of teasing.
Xi Hezi's words struck Yuan Ming like a spring hitting a rock, waking him instantly.
For ordinary people, finding hidden Cave Mansions was like searching for a needle in a haystack, requiring luck.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ ɴovelfire.net
However, for Yuan Ming, it was a different matter entirely.
He held a gray statue that knew all things in heaven and earth; asking it for the location of those yet undiscovered Cave Mansions could readily reveal this information, and resources and wealth would naturally flow in.
The more Yuan Ming thought, the more feasible it seemed, bringing joy to his heart.
However, compared to these external matters, his foremost concern remained the cultivation of the Five Elements Dao Fruit.
Currently, what he most needed to comprehend was the Golden Emperor True Intent.
"About the resource matter, I already have plans; you just focus on refining the Shura Palace." Yuan Ming collected his thoughts and spoke to Xi Hezi.
"Alright." Xi Hezi responded, then turned to inspect the array.
Yuan Ming returned to the City Lord Mansion and stepped into the great hall.
He waved his hand, and the Sky-splitting Golden Mace hovered in midair, shimmering with dazzling golden light.
Then, he took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, performed an incantation, and bright lights flickered on its body with a hundred Forbidden brightening in succession, as if stars dazzling.
Yuan Ming took out Black Incense, lit it, and placed it inside the tripod.
Wisps of smoke rose, and his Divine Soul quietly detached, directly possessing the Sky-splitting Golden Mace.
He used his Divine Soul Power to delve deeply into the Golden Emperor True Intent contained within.
Instantly, the Sky-splitting Golden Mace's golden light intensified, transforming into a beam reaching the Nine Heavens.
At the same time, the Five Elements Dao Fruit within Yuan Ming operated autonomously, and the other four colors of light emanated from him, intertwining with the golden light into a dazzling five-colored light, enveloping the entire main hall.
Throughout the City Lord Mansion, the five-colored light shot straight to the sky, causing everyone to stop and look.
The cultivators who were busy couldn't help but pause and look towards the direction of the main hall.
Their eyes reflected the kaleidoscope, faces showing expressions of reverence and aspiration.
Wang Fulong watched this scene from afar, his heart filled with deep emotion: "Such talent, such speed of growth, even those guardians may find him hard to match."
Within the City Lord Mansion and throughout the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, the cultivators who knew some insider information all felt the same.
Over the years, no matter what powerful demon beasts appeared in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, they all fell at the hands of the City Lord.
This instilled unwavering confidence in Yuan Ming among the members of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals, as if he could now stand shoulder to shoulder with Mahayana cultivators.
...
At this moment, at the edge of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, within a secret underground space.
A vast underground cavern came into view, where blazing bonfires burned incessantly, illuminating the surroundings brightly, as if daylight had arrived.
The cavern walls lined with pitch-black Stone Pillars. They were linked in a peculiar formation, forming a giant Array occupying several acres, appearing solemn and mysterious.
At the center of the Array, a circular Magic Pattern Array Map lay quietly, with profound patterns flowing across it, emitting astonishing waves of magic power.
If Yuan Ming were present, he would recognize at a glance that this Large Magic Array was the Breaking Realm Transfer Array that once appeared atop Chaotian Peak in the Chang Chun Temple on Yunhuang Continent.
However, differing slightly from the past, the center of this Array's Magic Pattern Array Map now included a Blood Sacrifice Pool.
The Blood Sacrifice Pool spanned several dozen yards, with churning blood water, stinking and nauseating.
At this moment, around the Blood Sacrifice Pool stood a group of figures clad in voluminous Black Robes, led by a handsome young scholar with a gloomy composure.
His eyes cold, he waved his finger, directing a team of warriors in Demon Armor to drive hundreds of restrained demon beasts to the Blood Sacrifice Pool's edge.
Those demon beasts' eyes were hollow, having lost their former ferocity, moving obediently like trained dogs toward the Blood Sacrifice Pool, jumping in, immediately swallowed by the blood light without a trace of their remains.
With the final batch of demon beasts sacrificed, the Array suddenly shook violently.
In the Blood Pool, blood light erupted instantaneously, shooting beams all around the Stone Pillars, lighting up each blood-colored rune, as if awakening ancient magic.
At this time, above the Magic Pattern Array Map, light mist intertwined, space began to oscillate violently, as if pressed by an invisible force, gradually collapsing into a huge black hole.
Within the black hole, flashing lights followed, revealing a spacious space passage several dozen yards in size.
At the other end of the passage appeared a desolate, scarlet desert, upon which stood densely packed Demon Soldiers in armor, arrayed like a mighty army about to march, imposing and solemn.
As soon as the space passage stabilized, large swathes of pure black Demonic Qi surged forth, rapidly permeating this wide underground space.
The young scholar raised his head, inhaling the Demonic Qi deeply, a satisfied smile appearing on his face.
At this moment, in the space passage amidst intertwined lights, shadows traversed like meteors across the sky, figures continuously emerging from the Demon World, finally landing steadily on this unfamiliar land.
Once everyone settled, five imposing Dharma-Phenomenon Stage Demon Lords emerged with hundreds of Demon Soldiers in harmonious armor, exuding tremendous momentum.
Once they fully appeared, a more intense tide of Demonic Qi surged, persistently flowing.
Until the space passage slowly closed under the push of Demonic Qi, returning to the chaotic state of interwoven light mist.
"Greetings to the Reincarnation Demon Lord."
The five Dharma-Phenomenon Stage Demon Lords and hundreds of Demon Soldiers simultaneously saluted, their voices earth-shattering, expressing their respect towards the scholar-like Reincarnation Demon Lord.
"It's merely an Avatar Puppet; no need for formalities. You are new here, first sense the surroundings and adapt.", the Reincarnation Demon Lord slightly nodded and said calmly.
"Yes." All responded in unison, not daring to show the slightest negligence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1051 - 1016: Emerging from Seclusion
chapters.content:
At this moment.
A Demon Lord with a face as dark as ink and eyes as crimson as blood stepped forward, licking his scarlet lips, his eyes gleaming with greed: "Reincarnation Demon Lord, the spiritual energy of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is so dense, there must be many creatures nurtured within. I boldly request to go out hunting. If I can replenish my Qi-blood, my strength will certainly rise to another level, allowing me to serve you better in the future."
"Mo Rong, you are here not to satisfy personal desires, but to scheme and plan for the major affairs of the Demon World. If you dare to defy orders and act recklessly, don't blame me for disregarding our ties." The Reincarnation Demon Lord snorted coldly upon hearing this, his voice exuding an undeniable authority.
As he spoke, a powerful aura suddenly erupted, oppressing everyone to the point where they could barely breathe.
"Please calm your anger, Reincarnation Demon Lord. I was just speaking casually, I wouldn't dare act foolishly." Mo Rong felt the pressure and was startled, quickly lowering his head.Thɪs updatᴇd by novel·fire.net
"Recently, the power of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals has been growing, making our situation in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range increasingly difficult. This space is shielded by a forbidden barrier to hide our presence. If anyone acts without authorization, leading to the exposure of our movements, we will all face disaster and will surely suffer severe punishment from the Yan Emperor." The Reincarnation Demon Lord nodded and continued.
Upon hearing these words, everyone lowered their heads in agreement, not daring to voice any dissent.
"Yun Mei, you will be responsible for contacting the Ten Thousand Demon Country and trying to bring them to our side." The Reincarnation Demon Lord turned his gaze to a woman and instructed.
The woman was tall and graceful, her features similar to the Human Clan, but her ears were somewhat pointed, and her pupils were as deep blue as the sea.
She wore a short white bone armor, with large swathes of alabaster skin appearing particularly dazzling against the demonic aura. She was both beautiful and valiant, exuding an exotic charm.
"The Ten Thousand Demon Country has already declined to such a state. Is there really a need to recruit them?" Yun Mei frowned slightly, asking in confusion.
"Though the Ten Thousand Demon Country no longer holds its former glory, its past splendor still commands respect. Just as the centipede does not topple when it dies, they still have considerable foundations worth our effort." The Reincarnation Demon Lord smiled faintly, explaining.
Hearing this, Yun Mei nodded and said no more.
"Since you've just arrived here, take a break and acclimate for now. I'll first go and have some contact with the Ten Thousand Demon Country, and then leave it to you," the Reincarnation Demon Lord continued.
"I'll go with you. I don't feel at ease about those guys from the Ten Thousand Demon Country," Yun Mei said.
"Too many people will lead to complications and increase the risk of exposure. I alone will suffice, you need not worry about safety. We have our people within the Ten Thousand Demon Country who will cover for us." The Reincarnation Demon Lord chuckled lightly, shaking his head.
With that, the Reincarnation Demon Lord's figure blurred, seemingly merging into the surrounding demonic aura, vanishing in an instant into the depths of the earth.
...
Three days later, White Emperor City.
In the main hall of the City Lord Mansion, a golden beam of light suddenly shot up into the sky, piercing through the heavens, reaching the highest skies.
The clouds above the sky were stirred by the golden light, churned into a massive vortex, with lightning and thunder inside, as if the divine might was descending.
Within the vortex, spiritual energy surged violently like tidal waves, creating a deafening roar.
At the same time, in the main hall, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged, his hands forming seals, as five-colored lights of green, red, yellow, gold, and blue surged from his palms, weaving into a magnificent tableau.
These five lights represented the supreme true intent of the Wood Emperor, Fire Emperor, Earth Emperor, Gold Emperor, and Water Emperor of the Five Elements.
He took a deep breath, clenched his palms sharply, and the five-colored true intents instantly returned to his body, merging into his Dantian, forming a splendid five-pointed star seal.
The five tips of the five-pointed star were inscribed with runes of the Five Emperors' true intents, connected to each other, endlessly cycling, forming a mysterious pattern of the Dao.
With the condensation of the Five Elements Dao Fruit Seal, the five-colored lights transformed into massive light pillars, shooting straight into the sky, resonating with the vortex above.
The vortex, under the agitation of the five-colored light, grew even more intense, beginning to frantically draw from the Five Elements Spiritual Power between heaven and earth.
Above White Emperor City, the skies changed colors, with rainbow lights covering the entire sky.
The Five Elements Spiritual Power from the depths of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range seemed to be summoned, surging towards the sky above the City Lord Mansion, turning the massive vortex into a kaleidoscope of colors, like a grand feast of heaven and earth.
The cultivators and citizens of the city looked up in astonishment, their faces showing expressions of wonder.
They had never witnessed such a magnificent heavenly phenomenon, as if the entire White Emperor City had fallen into a fantastic dream.
The converging Five Elements Spiritual Power gathered above the City Lord Mansion into a colossal five-colored light pillar, descending like a divine miracle, enveloping Yuan Ming's body.
The vast spiritual energy flooded into his Dantian, as if to engulf him.
Yuan Ming felt a stir in his heart, circulating his mana, beginning to absorb the spiritual energy with all his might.
Simultaneously, the Five Elements Dao Fruit Seal operated on its own, frantically absorbing and storing the incoming Five Elements Spiritual Power.
At this moment, a tremendous power of the Dao descended from the heavens, far more concentrated than any time he had condensed a Dao seal before.
The five runes on the Five Elements Dao Fruit lit up simultaneously, voraciously devouring the power of the Dao like hungry beasts.
Yet even with its full absorption, the Five Elements Dao Fruit Seal couldn't completely digest this vast power of the Dao.
It was at this time that the Primordial Dao Seal within Yuan Ming began to operate again, black and white lights flickering, devouring the power of the Dao like a bottomless pit.
In the beginning, the Five Elements Dao Fruit Seal had the home-field advantage, absorbing at a noticeably faster and more efficient rate.
However, it wasn't long before the Primordial Dao Seal caught up, and the two gradually reached a stalemate.
Moments later, all the power of the Dao was completely divided between them.
The Primordial Dao Seal subsequently grew much larger, its might becoming even more formidable.
Suddenly, an incredibly powerful force of attraction emanated from the Primordial Dao Seal, pulling the originally floating Dao Seals in the dantian towards it.
The newly formed Five Elements Dao Fruit, however, remained as steady as a mountain, completely unaffected by this force.
Yuan Ming was startled and was about to investigate when the Dream Butterfly Dao Seal, closest to the Primordial Dao Seal, suddenly lost control, crashing into the Primordial Dao Seal and being engulfed by it.
"What's happening?"
Yuan Ming was alarmed, and before he could react, the All Living Beings Dream Seal, Transplanting Technique Dao Seal, and Zhu Rong Heart Technique Dao Seal also successively lost control, crashing into the Primordial Dao Seal one by one, all being devoured.
Yuan Ming's face turned exceedingly grim, as he hurriedly moved the other Dao Seals out of the dantian, thus avoiding them from meeting the same fate.
After continuously devouring four Dao Seals, the Primordial Dao Seal seemed to have replenished its power and surprisingly expanded to nearly double its size.
It flickered with black and white light and actively moved towards the Five Elements Dao Fruit Seal.
Yuan Ming felt a tightness in his heart and hurriedly attempted to move the Five Elements Dao Fruit Seal out of the dantian as well.
Unexpectedly, the Five Elements Dao Fruit Seal seemed to have a mind of its own, resisting Yuan Ming's pull, fearlessly taking on the Primordial Dao Seal head-on.
At the instant the two collided, Yuan Ming's dantian shook intensely.
But to his surprise, the power of the Five Elements Dao Fruit was incredibly strong, not only resisting the devouring force of the Primordial Dao Seal but even shaking it intensely.
The two engaged several times, yet the Primordial Dao Seal was always unsuccessful.
In the end, it had no choice but to reluctantly stop, distancing itself from the Five Elements Dao Fruit and settling down calmly, no longer causing trouble.
Seeing them finally calm down, Yuan Ming couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief, but his curiosity about the Primordial Dao Seal only grew stronger.
He wanted to understand why it wanted to devour other Dao Seals, and why it had the ability to do so?
He closed his eyes to focus, and unexpectedly felt a strong intent within it.
This feeling was like a starving person craving food, desperately yearning for the power of the Dao, seeming to want to devour other Dao Seals containing the power of the Dao because the power of heaven and earth was insufficient for its needs.
At that moment, Yuan Ming suddenly remembered the words mentioned by that gray statue; if the Primordial Dao Seal could be fully nourished to its fullest potential, it might exhibit a horrifying Divine Skill, its power possibly surpassing that of the Five Elements Dao Fruit.
He calmed the turmoil in his dantian, meditated for a moment, waited for his mind to settle, and then slowly got up, stepping out of the great hall.
Outside the hall, sunlight poured down, a gentle breeze blew, and it was a place of tranquility and peace.
Yuan Ming could clearly feel that outside the great hall, it was quite lively, and many people were eagerly waiting.
He pushed the door open and immediately saw Wang Fulong, Hua Zhi, Vajra, Lei Yu, Wulu, and Yun Luo Fairy among others.
These people could now be called the pillars of White Emperor City, with nearly everyone gathered except for Zheng Heng and He Xiuwen, who were sent to Dongji Sea to spread the Moon Sect.
Yuan Ming knew that all these years, he was never stingy with these loyal followers, doing his utmost to nurture them and help them improve their strength.
It seems that their cultivation has all advanced now.
Wang Fulong, Yun Luo Fairy, and Wulu had all reached the mid-stage Dharma manifestation, but their advancement speed was slightly inferior to that of Hua Zhi.
Hua Zhi may not be the strongest in terms of combat power, but her progress was the greatest, and she had now advanced to the sixth rank upper stage, enough to be considered a Demon King level powerhouse in the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
This naturally benefited from Yuan Ming channeling the power of ten thousand wood origin through the World Tree to help her improve her strength.
As for Lei Yu and Vajra, their cultivation remained at a standstill with no breakthroughs.
Vajra was on the path of Body Cultivation, making advancements inherently difficult, especially when cultivating an Undying Body.
Yuan Ming was not surprised by this, knowing that he himself had undergone countless hardships before coincidentally breaking through his bottleneck.
Lei Yu's situation was somewhat different; her innate talent was never outstanding, and reaching Level 5 was already her limit.
Yuan Ming once gathered a sixth-level Demon Pill for her, refined it into a Dharma Manifestation Pill, and against everyone's objections, let her consume it. Unfortunately, it ultimately did not go as hoped.
Lei Yu felt deeply guilty about it, but Yuan Ming did not blame her, merely saying that the opportunity had not yet come.
"Congratulations to the City Lord on successfully leaving seclusion!" Everyone saw Yuan Ming walk out of the great hall and stepped forward to pay their respects.

chapters.title: Chapter 1052 - 1017: Five Locations
chapters.content:
Wang Fulong observed carefully, noticing that the oppressive aura previously emanating from Yuan Ming had completely dissipated, as if he had returned to the way he was when they first met.
"The celestial phenomena just now was merely caused by my cultivation of a secret technique, which shouldn't have worried you all," Yuan Ming said calmly, his gaze slowly sweeping across everyone's faces.
"Master, I was never worried. I know it must have been the celestial phenomena drawn by your increased divine might," Hua Zhi was the first to break the silence, her voice crisp and clear.
As soon as she spoke, everyone smiled, and the atmosphere became much more relaxed.
"Exactly, only she is so carefree to the point of not worrying about the Master," Vajra muttered, though a smile was on his face.
"You wretched monkey, what are you muttering about!" Hua Zhi's brows furrowed, glaring angrily.
Seeing this, Vajra rolled up his sleeves, looking ready for a fight.
The two bickered back and forth, quarreling incessantly.
Yuan Ming, seeing this, smiled and reached out, placing a hand on each of their heads, stopping their antics, while instructing, "That's enough. There's nothing here; you can all go about your tasks."
Everyone replied in agreement and left.
Only Vajra and Lei Yu hesitated to leave, seemingly wanting to speak.
"What's the matter? You two still have something on your mind?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I... I have been stuck at the peak of the Body of Wanxiang for a long time, unable to break through," Vajra hesitated for a moment before finally speaking, his tone full of helplessness.
"I... I want to go out and train, maybe I might find a breakthrough," Lei Yu stammered as he spoke.
He remembered that wasted Dharma Manifestation Pill, feeling a wave of regret in his heart.
"Regarding your paths to promotion, I have indeed considered many options, but I don't have a good strategy just yet. However, I'm about to go on a trip, so you both can come along perhaps you might encounter an opportunity for a breakthrough," Yuan Ming said after pondering for a moment.
Hearing this, Vajra and Lei Yu were overjoyed and quickly expressed their gratitude.
After they left, Yuan Ming returned alone to the grand hall, and with a quick motion, entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
He came before the gray statue and bowed respectfully.
"I want to know, in the Central Continent or Extreme East Sea Domain, where there might be outposts of sects or undiscovered remains or Cave Mansions? Preferably those containing abundant Spiritual Medicine and immortal materials," Yuan Ming quietly asked the gray statue.
"Such places indeed exist," the gray statue was silent for a moment before slowly speaking.
"So, may I ask where exactly they are located?" A hint of joy appeared in Yuan Ming's heart as he quickly inquired.
"One hundred Vow Power Pills per location," the gray statue said slowly.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming, without hesitation, brought out the pre-prepared Vow Power Pills, counting five hundred and offering them with both hands.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NoveI[F]ire.net
Five gray talismans gracefully flew out from the statue's mouth, gently landing in Yuan Ming's palm.
On each talisman was inscribed a small arrow, pointing in different directions.
With a thought, the Shura Palace emerged from the underground lava, heading straight toward the southwest direction of White Emperor City.
After half a day of swift travel, an ordinary-looking black mountain came into view.
Though the mountain appeared inconspicuous, it exuded an ancient and mysterious aura.
Just then, a talisman suddenly emitted a bright gray light, vibrating, with its arrow pointing directly at the black mountain.
A gleam of joy flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes as he murmured, "It seems this is the place."
With a thought, his vast Divine Sense surged forth like a tide, enveloping the entire black mountain.
Soon, his Divine Sense penetrated the superficial layer of the mountain, discovering a hidden cultivator's Cave Mansion within.
The Cave Mansion was quite large, faintly exuding an ancient aura.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt a surge of joy within.
The Chuyun Realm was vast and boundless, burying untold relics and cultivator Cave Mansions awaiting discovery.
These Cave Mansions might hide countless precious Magic Treasures and secret techniques.
His figure moved, diving underground, swiftly reaching the entrance of the Cave Mansion.
He saw that the Cave Mansion was surrounded by a thick layer of yellow light screen, filled with spirit light, frequently flashing with the phantoms of mountain peaks.
At a glance, Yuan Ming recognized this as a Sixth-level Array—the Thousand Peaks Shaking Mountains Array.
For the current Yuan Ming, this Sixth-level Array posed no threat.
He didn't bother to break it but directly employed the Five Elements Dao Fruit Divine Power.
Five streams of spirit light soared from above his head, transforming into a thick five-colored thundercloud that enveloped the entire Cave Mansion.
Yuan Ming cast a spell, and rumblings echoed across the sky.
Masses of Gui Water Divine Thunder, Bing Fire Divine Thunder, Yimu Divine Thunder, Earth God Thunder, and Metal God Thunder descended fiercely onto the Thousand Peaks Shaking Mountains Array.
These seemingly ordinary Five Elements Divine Thunder actually contained the Five Emperors' True Intent, bearing incredible power.
Under the bombardment of the Five Elements Divine Thunder, the Thousand Peaks Shaking Mountains Array was almost instantly shattered, turning into a void.
Yuan Ming quickly sealed the subsequent Five Elements Divine Thunder to prevent the cave mansion from being blasted apart.
He suppressed his excitement, after all, he had only unleashed fifty percent of the Five Elements Dao Fruit's power, yet achieved such an astounding effect.
Yuan Ming's figure moved, flying into the cave mansion, his Divine Sense spreading out, examining every corner of the cave mansion thoroughly.
When he saw the inside of the cave mansion clearly, his brows slightly furrowed.
It turned out that the owner of this cave mansion used to be a Dharma manifestation Cultivator, leaving behind many precious magic treasures and secret techniques.
To an ordinary cultivator, this would be unimaginably great fortune, but to the current Yuan Ming, these things were no longer of much value.
His current vision and strength had long surpassed these ordinary magic treasures and secret techniques, and even their value could not compare to the one hundred Vow Power Pills in his hand.
Yuan Ming did not feel disappointed by the meager harvest last time, as treasure hunting is a mix of fate and luck, and it's impossible to succeed every time.
He willed it, and the World Tree inside his Dantian gently swayed, soon a giant silver sphere appeared out of thin air, like a bright moon in the sky, encompassing the entire cave mansion.
"Move!" Yuan Ming whispered the spell.
With a blink, the silver sphere had appeared within the Shura Palace's Extreme Fire Realm.
The cave mansion along with the surrounding soil was completely moved to this place.
Underneath the black mountain, a gigantic spherical space unexpectedly appeared, as if dug out by an invisible hand.
"What is this?" Xi Hezi happened to be there and asked in surprise.
"A cave mansion, it contains many spiritual materials. Sort through them and see what can be used," Yuan Ming said casually, then dispersed the silver sphere and gently tossed the cave mansion to the ground.
Before Xi Hezi could respond, Yuan Ming had already turned to leave, eager to pursue the second treasure location pointed out by the gray statue.
...
Several days later, Yuan Ming finally reached his destination.
This place was also a predecessor's cave mansion, surrounded by a protective array, whose intricacy far surpassed that of the Thousand Peaks Shaking Mountains Array.
However, the Five Elements Dao Fruit is the ultimate principle of the universe, countering all Five Elements Divine Techniques.
Though strong, the array crumbled within mere moments under the bombardment of the Five Elements Dao Fruit's power, revealing the true face of the cave mansion behind.
Yuan Ming glanced briefly, realizing the value of this cave mansion was similar to the last one, evidently another unprofitable venture.
But he paid no mind, storing the cave mansion into the Shura Palace, then continued to the third destination.
The third destination was also a cave mansion but was much older than the ones seen before.
From the arrangement inside, its owner seemed to be a highly cultivated Great Demon.
This time, Yuan Ming's luck seemingly improved, with numerous treasures in this Great Demon's cave mansion, even a space spiritual treasure similar to the Shura Palace, its value far exceeding one hundred Vow Power Pills, almost compensating for the losses of the previous two times.
"I said my luck wouldn't always be bad," Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction, collecting everything inside the cave mansion, and promptly continued to the fourth destination.
This fourth destination was quite remote, taking Yuan Ming half a month to reach.
It was also located deep underground, and upon arrival, Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly.
"Something's wrong, this is demonic energy!" he murmured to himself.
This place also had restrictions, nearly reaching the level of a Seventh-level Magic Array, and the presence of demonic energy added a sense of eeriness and danger.
Yuan Ming dared not be careless, quietly shielding his presence, silently sneaking nearby, performing the Circular Light Technique, attempting to peer inside.
But the demonic energy's restriction was exceptionally strong, and the Circular Light Technique couldn't penetrate its interior.
"I must see who's playing tricks inside!" a hint of coldness glinted in Yuan Ming's eyes as he once again utilized the Five Elements Dao Fruit Divine Power.
This time, the Five Elements Dao Fruit did not transform into thunderclouds but into a huge five-colored light screen, enveloping the demonic energy restriction.
As soon as the five-colored light screen spread out, the demonic energy restriction immediately exuded black light, flickering intensely, seemingly resisting external forces.
Inside the underground space, Yun Mei and others were resting, suddenly sensing a strong external force disturbance, they abruptly opened their eyes, faces showing suspicion.
"What happened?" a Demon Lord appearing as an old woman asked gravely.
Another Demon Lord quickly cast the spell, merged into the Black Cloud Formation, exploring the outside anomaly.
Soon he understood the situation, and upon seeing the five-colored light screen, fear appeared on his face.
"What is this five-colored light screen? Could it be that the Reincarnation Demon Lord has been discovered!" The Demon Lords panicked, at a loss.
Just then, a series of deafening blasts sounded from outside, the five-colored light screen exposing dazzling thunder light, torrents of Gui Water Divine Thunder, Bing Fire Divine Thunder cascading down, pounding the Black Cloud Formation.
Although the Black Cloud Formation was extremely exquisite, in the face of the relentless bombardment from the Five Elements Dao Fruit, cracks soon appeared.
The figures of the Demon Clan under the illumination of the five-colored thunder light appeared increasingly anxious and uneasy.
"To think so many Demon Clan gathered here! That central formation is the Breaking Realm Transfer Array, it seems the congregation of Demon Clan here has a significant connection with this array." Yuan Ming's gaze penetrated through the five-colored light screen, unveiling the mystery inside the underground space.
He whispered lightly, the Five Elements Dao Fruit activated once more, countless Five Elements Divine Thunder crashing down like divine retribution, fiercely striking at the Demon Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1053 - 1018: Shocking News
chapters.content:
Heart-wrenching screams echoed one after another as hundreds of demons turned to ashes under the thunderous power of the Five Elements Divine Thunder in an instant.
As for the old hag Demon Lord, luck was not on her side, as she was struck critically by a dozen groups of Five Elements Divine Thunder, her soul annihilated, dying on the spot.
Outside the five-colored light screen, Yuan Ming made a grasping motion in the void, and the corpse of the old hag Demon Lord vanished into thin air, appearing beside him the next moment.
Although the old hag's vitality had perished, demonic energy still lingered within her body, and seven or eight runes hovered in her Dantian, shining brightly, these were the Dao Seals she comprehended in life.
Yuan Ming's eyes gleamed with brilliance, and he gently pressed his right hand onto the old hag's Dantian, activating the Primordial Dao Seal.
The Primordial Dao Seal could devour his own Dao Seal, but whether it could devour others' was unknown; if it could, that would be wonderful.
As he focused his mind, a seven-colored vortex rose from his Dantian, rapidly enveloping those seven or eight Dao Seals.
These Dao Seals whirled around in the vortex, seemingly trying to break free from their constraints, but unfortunately, the power of the Primordial Dao Seal far exceeded theirs and soon devoured them one by one.
After devouring these Dao Seals, the Primordial Dao Seal emitted a joyful humming sound, its size visibly increased, and its power surged accordingly.
"It really can; what a pleasant surprise," Yuan Ming rejoiced in his heart.
It is known that forging a single Dao Seal consumes immense effort and time, and under the current circumstances, he had no leisure to spare.
Now that he knew devouring others' Dao Seals could enhance his own, he only needed to keep hunting and killing demons.
However, Yuan Ming was not one to kill wantonly; slaughtering innocents for cultivation was something he truly loathed.
But with the domain war on the horizon, and the demon clan's invasion of Chuyun Realm an inevitability, killing demons then would be justified as an act of justice.
Within the five-colored light screen, the remaining four Demon Lords, seeing the death of the old hag Demon Lord, grew increasingly terrified. They couldn't see the outside situation, only felt an overwhelmingly powerful force crushing towards them.
The four unleashed their methods, whether Divine Skills or Spiritual Treasures, assaulting the five-colored light screen together. Yet, this screen, derived from the Five Elements Dao Fruit, was extraordinarily strong, effortlessly blocking all their attacks and remaining unshaken.
Seeing this, Yun Mei spat out a Silver Banner, which expanded with the wind, spewing silver light from its surface, instantly enveloping her, making her escape into the void.
"Space Divine Power?"ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ N0veI.Fiɾe.net
Yuan Ming's gaze tightened. This Space Divine Power did not belong to the Five Elements, hence wasn't restrained by the Five Elements Dao Fruit, allowing it to penetrate the five-colored light screen.
However, the Five Elements Dao Fruit, ranking third on the heavenly list of unparalleled Divine Skills, wasn't something Space Escape Techniques could easily break.
With a wave of Yuan Ming's sleeve, Spirit Light surged on the five-colored light screen, transforming into a field of Five-Colored Spiritual Light, instantly merging into the surrounding void.
Just as Yun Mei was about to escape the screen, she sensed a disturbance ahead in the void, with a vast wave of Five-Colored Spiritual Light surging toward her like a tidal wave.
She was startled and tried to dodge but couldn't in time. Her whole body was blasted by the Five-Colored Spiritual Light, pushed out of the void.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's heart sneered, enhancing the power of the Five Elements Dao Fruit's Divine Power. The Five Elements Divine Thunder, several times denser than before, crashed down, instantly engulfing the demons.
Although these demons possessed decent strength, before Yuan Ming's Five Elements Dao Fruit Divine Power, they were like ants, quickly annihilated.
This woman's physical body had been destroyed, leaving only the Nascent Soul intact.
It was apparent that Yuan Ming had deliberately held back, not delivering the fatal blow outright.
Yuan Ming stepped into the five-colored light screen, his hand gently raised, as if an invisible force was guiding.
The demons' corpses floated toward him, orderly arranged before him like fallen leaves returning to their roots.
These demons were already dead, and their Dao Seals were about to disperse into nothingness.
Not daring to delay, Yuan Ming immediately used the Primordial Dao Seal, a dazzling seven-colored vortex slowly opened in his palm, engulfing all the corpses.
As the seven-colored vortex spun, one by one, Dao Seals shot out from the demons' bodies, streaking like meteors across the night sky, finally merging into the vortex.
Among these hundreds of demons, aside from the three Demon Lords, many were elites who, though not Demon Lords, had forged Dao Seals. These Dao Seals were also devoured by the vortex.
Before long, forty or fifty Dao Seals were absorbed into it.
The Primordial Dao Seal emitted a heaven-shaking roar, celebrating this bountiful harvest.
Its size doubled, its power multiplied, akin to a beast having just feasted, brimming with strength.
A more grandiose seven-colored vortex appeared around Yuan Ming, spanning hundreds of feet, like a miniature domain.
This seven-colored vortex not only refined nature's spiritual energy but also mercilessly absorbed and refined mountains and earth.
The seven-colored vortex spun faster and faster, its center like an abyss, vaguely on the verge of forming a Spiritual Domain.
Observing the scene before him, Yuan Ming couldn't help but smile.
"Is it finally time to condense a Spiritual Domain?" he murmured to himself.
Yuan Ming had long comprehended the Five Emperors' True Intent, and his mana had reached the peak of Dharma manifestation, just a step away from the Mahayana Realm.
Logically speaking, he should have long begun to condense the Spiritual Domain, at least forming a prototype.
However, his Spiritual Domain has been slow to condense, and now he finally shows signs of taking this step.
The characteristics of this Seven-Colored Spiritual Domain are identical to the Primordial Dao Seal, specializing in refining, anything entering it will be mercilessly drained of its Spiritual Power.
"I had thought I would use the Five Emperors' True Intent as the foundation to construct the Spiritual Domain, but now it seems my foundation is still the Primordial True Skill. This Seven-Colored Spiritual Domain shall be named the Primordial Spirit Domain," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
At this moment, a faint voice broke the silence.
It turned out to be Yun Mei's Nascent Soul begging for mercy.
Her Nascent Soul was also within the Primordial Spirit Domain, rapidly losing all its Demonic Qi, and the once robust Nascent Soul was quickly shriveling up, soon to be completely refined.
With a wave of his hand, Yuan Ming dispelled the Primordial Spirit Domain, allowing Yun Mei's Nascent Soul to catch a breath.
"Fellow Daoist, I am willing to submit to you, offering all my wealth. You can plant a Forbidden within my Nascent Soul; I will not resist. I am proficient in dozens of Secret Techniques of the Demon World and am willing to offer them all to you to expand your knowledge. I can also tell you many arrangements the Demon World has made against the Chuyun Realm. Reporting this would definitely earn you great merit..." she pleaded.
Yun Mei did not come from a major force in the Demon World; she was merely a capable Loose Cultivator.
This time, she was forcibly conscripted to the Chuyun Realm and had little desire to risk her life.
The crushing execution by Yuan Ming just now had utterly shattered her psychological defense.
At this moment, all she wished for was to survive, even if it meant becoming a slave to the Human Clan.
But Yuan Ming sneered, unmoved.
He reached out to seize Yun Mei's Nascent Soul, ready to perform the Soul Searching Divine Ability.
"Fellow Daoist, you are unaware, we serve under the Yan Emperor's command, infiltrating the Chuyun Realm. To prevent us from leaking information upon capture, the Yan Emperor had set a Soul Lock Forbidden in our Divine Souls. If someone forcibly soul searches us, the Forbidden will activate, disintegrating our souls..." Yun Mei hurriedly said upon seeing this.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows twitched at her words but decided to give it a try anyway.
He executed the Soul Searching Divine Ability, and a large amount of black Qi surged into Yun Mei's Nascent Soul.
As Yun Mei said, her Nascent Soul and Divine Soul indeed had a Forbidden placed upon them.
If she were forcibly soul-searched, the Forbidden would fiercely resist, threatening to take Yun Mei's Divine Soul with it in mutual destruction.
Yuan Ming's mind shifted, retracting the Soul Searching Divine Ability, coldly looking at Yun Mei, he said, "Is that so? In that case, tell me everything you know."
"I am willing to tell you everything I know..." Yun Mei rejoiced upon hearing this, quickly speaking.
But even before she could finish her words, Yuan Ming raised his hand with a wave.
Yun Mei only saw darkness before she fell into a deep sleep.
A golden light flashed on Yuan Ming's forehead, then a pale golden eyeball emerged, radiant like a star, casting a golden light to envelop Yun Mei's Nascent Soul.
This was precisely Yuan Ming's Reincarnation Eye Divine Power, seemingly able to penetrate all illusions and see the essence of things.
In his Sea of Consciousness, scenes flowed like water, each one clearly presenting Yun Mei's past experiences, as if recounting a vivid historical scroll.
Although the Soul Lock Forbidden was powerful enough to block the Soul Searching Divine Ability, it appeared powerless against Yuan Ming's Reincarnation Eye, any Forbidden was unable to stop this incredible power of retrospection.
Yuan Ming quietly browsed Yun Mei's memories, deepening his understanding of the Demon World.
His gaze suddenly lingered on a scene, seeing the Yan Emperor seated high in the Demon Hall, summoning countless Demons, their faces brimming with zeal and anticipation, swearing to launch an attack on the Chuyun Realm once the Wentian Secret Realm opens.
"The opening of the Wentian Secret Realm is just a matter of the last twenty years, yet the Demon World plans a full-scale invasion then..." Yuan Ming frowned, unease rising within him.
Though he resided in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range all these years, he had been keeping a close eye on the skirmishes between the Chuyun Realm and the Demon World.
The confrontation between both sides mainly occurred in the far north of the Chuyun Realm at the Returning Ruins, but they were small-scale conflicts, and the Demon World had been unable to stage a full-scale invasion.
Yuan Ming knew that for a true assault on the Chuyun Realm, the Demon World first had to fully break through the realm barriers.
And the Chuyun Realm had been doing everything possible to fortify its barriers against an invasion from the Demon World.
According to news from Daoist Mu not long ago, the realm barrier at the Returning Ruins was relatively stable, secure for a hundred years.
Why would the Demon World choose to launch a total offensive when the Wentian Secret Realm opens? Had they devised some clever strategy, or was the Yan Emperor's speech merely a bluff? Yuan Ming fell into thought.
Moments later, he took out a green Communication Token left by Daoist Mu when he departed, allowing them to keep in touch at all times.
Yuan Ming organized the gathered intelligence, omitting the part about the Reincarnation Eye Divine Power, reporting instead that it was extracted through coercion from Yun Mei, and then transmitted it.
Subsequently, Yuan Ming continued to delve into Yun Mei's memories.
He witnessed the scene of the Demons being teleported underground here, and the Avatar Puppet of the Reincarnation Demon Lord going forth to contact the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
What shocked him even more was the message relayed by the Reincarnation Demon Lord's puppet two days ago, claiming they had reached a preliminary agreement with the Ten Thousand Demon Country, agreeing once again to join forces to confront the Human Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1054 - 1019: Secret
chapters.content:
"The Ten Thousand Demon Country, how truly reckless." A trace of coldness flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes as he once again activated the Primordial Dao Seal, instantly enveloping Yun Mei's Nascent Soul within the seven-colored vortex.
Under the refinement of the seven-colored vortex, Yun Mei's Nascent Soul quickly vanished without a trace.
Yun Mei, as an elite of the Demon Clan, had condensed six Dao Seals, one of which, the Water Dao Seal, was particularly powerful, entwined with the true meaning of the Great Dao.
These six Dao Seals and the trace of the true meaning of the Great Dao were all devoured by the Primordial Dao Seal, enhancing its power once again.
Yuan Ming checked the storage magic tools of the Demon Clan and couldn't help but show a look of joy.
These Demon Clan members were indeed exceptionally wealthy, especially the five Demon Lords. The treasures in their storage magic tools combined were far more than what he had previously found in the three cave mansions.
Yuan Ming collected all his gains into the Shura Palace and handed them over to Xi Hezi for processing.
He did not linger in this place; with a flash of his figure, he transformed into a green rainbow, heading straight for the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
...
Deep within the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge, in a secret chamber of the Demon Emperor Palace.
Wu Yu sat upright, hands clasped, holding a verdant round orb, the Ju Mang Taoist Pearl containing the Wood Emperor's True Intent.
She meditated with closed eyes, fully focused on comprehending its mysteries.
As time passed, her expression grew increasingly grave.
Finally, she slowly opened her eyes and sighed softly, "Alas, it really isn't possible. I truly don't know how Yuan Ming... Lord Nether Moon God managed to comprehend the Wood Emperor's True Intent with this object in just three months."
Before her voice had faded, a misty voice came from the side, "Oh, you wish to comprehend the Wood Emperor's True Intent? Then let you experience it firsthand."
Wu Yu's color changed suddenly and just as she intended to stand, she found her legs numb and powerless.
She looked down and was instantly shocked out of her wits.
She saw that her legs had already turned into green wood at some unknown time, and this change was spreading upward at a visible rate.
Not only that, the floor and even the walls of the entire secret chamber instantly transformed into wood, as if she was in a lush forest.
In just a few breaths, the entire secret chamber had completely transformed into a wooden room, and except for her head, the rest of Wu Yu's body had turned into wood, unable to move.
At this moment, a green light flashed, and Yuan Ming's figure appeared in front of Wu Yu out of thin air.
"Lord Nether Moon God, why are you here?" Wu Yu asked, relieved after recognising the newcomer.
Yuan Ming did not answer, but merely raised his hand toward Wu Yu's head, clearly intending to perform a Soul Search.
Just then, a wall of the secret chamber shattered with a loud crash, and a dazzling glazed fire shot in.
The fire contained an intensely scorching heat, and the entire secret chamber instantly felt like a lava purgatory, even the woodenized chamber seemed to show signs of regressing.
"Great Sun Glaze Flame!" Yuan Ming's face showed a hint of joy upon witnessing this.
Over the years, he had visited the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge twice, but he never encountered this mysterious heavenly fire. Unexpectedly, today it revealed itself on its own accord.
He waved his sleeve, and seven-colored light spread instantly, forming a Primordial Spirit Domain that enveloped the entire secret chamber.
The glazed flame entered the Spirit Domain and was immediately disassembled, slowly being devoured by the domain.
Outside the secret chamber, the Great Sun Glaze Flame was dumbfounded.
Heavenly fire is an extraordinarily special existence in the world, inherently possessing the true meaning of the Great Dao, perfectly integrated with its own flames, considered as a physical manifestation of the Great Dao's true intent.
Since the true meaning of the Great Dao cannot be destroyed, it can at most be suppressed, and likewise with heavenly fire.
However, the seven-colored Spirit Domain before her could refine and absorb a Great Sun Glaze Flame, which was beyond her imagination.
With a heart full of terror, the Great Sun Glaze Flame immediately turned and tried to escape.
Yuan Ming's voice leisurely reached her ears, "Since you're here, why leave?"
As his words fell, the range of the Primordial Spirit Domain expanded explosively, doubling in size, firmly trapping the Great Sun Glaze Flame within.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame instantly felt a tightness in her body, unable to move an inch.
Moreover, a profound and mysterious true meaning of the Great Dao invaded her body, preventing her from harnessing her heavenly fire power.
Even the Great Sun Glaze Flame had a feeling that if Yuan Ming willed it, her body would collapse like the previous glazed flames, completely refined and absorbed by the seven-colored Spirit Domain.
"What do you intend?" The Great Sun Glaze Flame glared at Yuan Ming, her heart in a surge of terror, yet she struggled to remain calm.
Yuan Ming appeared oblivious to her, strolling again to Wu Yu's front, raising his hand to perform the Soul Searching Technique.
Moments later, he lowered his arm, and a brilliant golden light shot from his brow, the Reincarnation Eye.
Earlier, when probing Yun Mei's memories, the Reincarnation Eye manifested a formidable probing ability, far exceeding the Soul Searching Technique.
The golden light enveloped Wu Yu, revealing images of her past in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
She came from an insignificant branch of the Fox Clan, meeting a tragic fate of orphanhood at an early age.
On the subsequent path of cultivation, she displayed remarkable talent, leading her branch to rise and ultimately becoming the leader of the entire Fox Clan.
Several thousand years ago, under the leadership of White Emperor City Lord Jin Mu, the Human Clan's cultivators launched a massive attack on the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge, pushing the Ten Thousand Demon Country to the brink of destruction.
At this critical juncture, Wu Yu awakened the long-inherited Demon Emperor bloodline within the Fox Clan, single-handedly repelling Jin Mu and rescuing the Ten Thousand Demon Country from disaster.
Afterward, endorsed by various clans, she ascended to the throne as Empress, shouldering the responsibility of leading the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
As Empress, Wu Yu was not content with the status quo; she harbored a persistent desire to break the Heavenly Crane Array.
After prolonged deliberation and planning, she decided to ally with the Demon World and the Three Realms Sect, but unfortunately, it ultimately ended in failure.
After Yuan Ming took control of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, the Ming Yue Cult gradually rose to prominence.
After extensive investigation, Wu Yu confirmed that Lord Nether Moon God was indeed Yuan Ming.
After considerable thought, she decided to negotiate with Yuan Ming to seek another path for the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
Yuan Ming continued probing Wu Yu's memories, his brows gradually raising.Original content can be found at novel_fіre.net
Over the decades, Wu Yu had been in seclusion in the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge, attempting to recover from hidden injuries incurred during her previous attempt to break through to the Mahayana Realm.
Regarding the collusion between the Ten Thousand Demon Country and the Demon World, she was truly unaware and had not participated in it.
He pondered briefly, then turned the Reincarnation Eye towards the Great Sun Glaze Flame to investigate its past experiences.
Compared to Wu Yu's rich and colorful experiences, the history of the Great Sun Glaze Flame seemed much simpler.
It was born above the Nine Heavens, gradually growing by absorbing the Great Sun Essence day after day.
Thousands of years ago, with the help of the last Demon Emperor of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, the Great Sun Glaze Flame took form and descended to the surface.
To repay the debt to the Demon Emperor, it promised to safeguard the Ten Thousand Demon Country up to this day.
In the memories of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, there was also no trace of collusion with the Demon World.
Thus, it seemed someone else was responsible for the contact with the Reincarnation Demon Lord's puppet.
With a wave of his hand, Yuan Ming dispersed the Primordial Spirit Domain, and the Wood Transformation Divine Ability on Wu Yu was also lifted.
"Lord Nether Moon God, what was the meaning of your actions just now?" Wu Yu exchanged a glance with the Great Sun Glaze Flame and cautiously asked.
Yuan Ming did not conceal anything and truthfully recounted to both women how he obliterated Yun Mei and others and learned about the collusion between the Reincarnation Demon Lord's puppet and the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
"Lord Nether Moon God, this is absolutely impossible! Although I'm not particularly talented, I know what can and cannot be done. The Ten Thousand Demon Country has in no way colluded with the Demon World again!" Wu Yu's expression changed as she defended.
"I trust in your character. If you had truly participated in this, you wouldn't be standing here and talking to me now." Yuan Ming spoke with a calm tone.
"May Lord Nether Moon God see clearly." Wu Yu, with cold sweat dripping down her back, bowed her head respectfully.
"Although this matter doesn't involve you, the fact of the Demon Clan penetrating the Ten Thousand Demon Country again is a reality. I'll give you three days to investigate this matter; if you can't uncover the truth, I'll handle it my way. If it causes significant casualties, don't blame me for being ruthless." Yuan Ming continued.
"Rest assured, Lord Nether Moon God, I will immediately investigate this matter and give you a satisfactory response." Wu Yu hurriedly said, turning and leaving in haste.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame intended to follow but was halted by Yuan Ming.
"What instructions does Lord Nether Moon God have?" The Great Sun Glaze Flame looked toward Yuan Ming, eyes flickering with vigilance.
"No need to be tense. In the Three Realms Immortal Boat back in the day, although we fought to the death, each with our own purposes, it didn't count as a true grudge. Besides, thanks to your power, I managed to break through to the Undying Body." Yuan Ming chuckled softly.
With that, he raised his hand, inviting the other party to sit on the stone bench opposite him.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame heard this, feeling slightly more at ease, and sat somewhat awkwardly on the stone bench.
"Indeed, this is our first calm conversation. I still don't know how you should be addressed?" Yuan Ming spoke as if chatting with an old friend.
"If it's no bother, you may call me Liu Li." The Great Sun Glaze Flame replied.
"Alright, Fellow Daoist Liu Li, no need to be overly formal—there's no one else here, just call me Yuan Ming." Yuan Ming said with a smile.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame paused slightly, hesitantly asking, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, what is it you wish to discuss?"
"Fellow Daoist Liu Li, I don't like beating around the bush. Would you be willing to accompany me on my journey?" Yuan Ming asked bluntly.
"You've advanced to the Undying Body; my assistance is now limited." The Great Sun Glaze Flame furrowed her brow slightly, puzzled.
She appeared calm, but inside, her emotions surged violently.
As the purest form of the Great Sun Essence Fire, the Great Sun Glaze Flame is indeed highly beneficial for body cultivation, but the Qi-Blood of the Undying Body has reached a refined state, no longer needing further refinement.
Nevertheless, the energy required to elevate the realm of the Undying Body is immense, making the Sun Fire contained within the Great Sun Glaze Flame a mere drop in the ocean.
However, the Great Sun Glaze Flame harbors a secret: it contains a trace of the Sun Origin within. If someone can refine it, they would gain an opportunity to receive a baptism of Great Sun Essence.
This would be an enormous boon for body cultivation, potentially elevating a practitioner by a whole Great Realm directly.
Yet, throughout history, few have been able to suppress the Great Sun Glaze Flame, let alone refine it.
Therefore, this secret remained unknown.
At this moment, the Great Sun Glaze Flame couldn't help but secretly speculate: Could it be that Yuan Ming's Seven-Colored Spirit Domain can refine me? Has he discovered this secret, prompting his invitation?

chapters.title: Chapter 1055 - 1020: Six Paths of Reincarnation
chapters.content:
In the midst of the Great Sun Glaze Flame's wild thoughts, Yuan Ming spoke again, "Fellow Daoist Liu Li, you need not worry. I wish to borrow your strength to refine a Spiritual Treasure, and help one of my subordinates break through. This shouldn't be a difficult matter for you."
"Fellow Daoist Yuan's request, I should indeed try my best to assist. However, the Ten Thousand Demon Country faces internal and external troubles now, and I need to stay here to assist." Upon hearing this, the Great Sun Glaze Flame felt somewhat relieved, but still made a troubled expression.
"The assistance the Ten Thousand Demon Country can offer Fellow Daoist Liu Li is likely quite limited, right? I plan to explore the various Secret Realm ruins of the Chuyun Realm next, including the Wentian Secret Realm... among them, there might be treasures that can quickly enhance your Cultivation." Yuan Ming smiled as he spoke.
Upon hearing this, a trace of interest flashed in the eyes of the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
"You don't need to rush to respond, take a few days to think it over. Alright, you may leave now." Yuan Ming continued.
"Then I will take my leave." The Great Sun Glaze Flame said, turning to exit the secret chamber.
Afterward, Yuan Ming closed his eyes in the secret chamber, quietly awaiting news from Wu Yu.
Wu Yu did not disappoint, soon uncovering the ins and outs of the situation.
It turned out that the ones in contact with the Reincarnation Demon Lord's Puppet were the newly appointed Flame Wolf King, Electric Roc King, and Green Snake King—three Demon Kings.
"So it was them..." Yuan Ming did not show a hint of surprise. These three Demon Kings had always been at odds with Wu Yu, coveted the Demon Emperor position for a long time, and their collusion with the Demon World was expected.
"Where are they now?" Yuan Ming asked.
"On the territory of the Fire Wolf Clan." Wu Yu replied, simultaneously retrieving a map Jade Scroll.
"No need for that, I'll be right back." Yuan Ming waved his hand, smiling.
He was familiar with the terrain and landscape of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, immediately enveloped in Golden Light, turned into a dazzling golden beam, and headed straight northwest.
This golden tunneling light was called Vertical Earth Golden Light, derived from the Five Elements Dao Fruit, containing the Golden Emperor True Intent, its speed far surpassing Lei Yu's Thunder Escape.
...
Deep within the Fire Wolf Clan, in a secret chamber shrouded by layers of Forbidden, four figures stood silently.
They were the newly appointed Flame Wolf King Yan Li, Electric Roc King Zong Hong, Green Snake King Yu Lin, and the scholar possessed by the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
Yan Li was exceptionally burly, with scars crisscrossing his cheeks and arms, akin to ferocious centipedes, making him appear more menacing.
Originally the Great Elder of the Fire Wolf Clan, his reputation within the clan was already high, and he took on this heavy responsibility after the former Wolf King perished.
Though Zong Hong was a female demon, she showed no sign of weakness, appearing to be only a teenage girl, but the occasional coldness in her eyes was enough to instill fear.
As for Yu Lin, she was a voluptuous woman, exuding a captivating charm with every move.
Yet, in this secret chamber, her charm seemed somewhat inappropriate.
The new Demon Kings, although remarkable, were inferior in both power and demeanor compared to the past three Kings who dominated the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
"Lord Demon, the situation has been basically investigated. Wu Yu is currently in closed cultivation in the Demon Emperor Hall, hasn't appeared for over ten years, and should still be recovering from the Dao Foundation damage while impacting the Mahayana Realm." Yan Li's voice broke the silence of the secret chamber.
"The Mahayana Realm is not an easy breakthrough. Our Demon World resources exceed the Chuyun Realm by tenfold, yet over the years, Mahayana strong people are only a dozen or so. Wu Yu failed to impact Mahayana, and his Original Demon Power has depleted at least eighty percent; it would take two or three hundred years to recover." The Reincarnation Demon Lord nodded slightly as he said this.
Upon hearing the Demon World has several Mahayana strong people, the bodies of Yan Li and the other two demons trembled, showing a look of reverence, their resolve to side with the Demon World even stronger.
Observing the expressions of the three demons, the Reincarnation Demon Lord curled a satisfied smile and continued to ask, "And the Great Sun Glaze Flame? Any news?"
"That Heavenly Fire disappeared after the battle in White Emperor City, it's speculated that it may have left Ten Thousand Demon Ridge." Zong Hong hesitated and answered.
"No. According to my intel, the Great Sun Glaze Flame is closely related to your Ten Thousand Demon Country, and has a deep connection with Wu Yu, surely hiding behind the scenes now. To eliminate Wu Yu, one must first prepare to suppress the Great Sun Glaze Flame." The Reincarnation Demon Lord shook his head and said.
"Lord Demon's might should surely suppress the Great Sun Glaze Flame without issue, right?" Yu Lin concealed a smile, her eyes glimmering as she spoke.
"Naturally, no harm. However, if I act to suppress the Great Sun Glaze Flame, I will be occupied. Wu Yu has other Demon Kings at his side, and then I must rely on the three of you to deal with them." The Reincarnation Demon Lord chuckled lightly.
Upon hearing this, the three Demon Kings felt somewhat uneasy but still said in unison, "Rest assured, Lord Demon, we shall meet your expectations!"
Just then, the secret chamber's golden light flashed, and a figure appeared out of thin air.
It was Yuan Ming!
"What are you plotting here? How about letting me join in?" Yuan Ming's voice was calm and cold, instantly tightening the hearts of Yan Li and the others.
Yan Li's expression drastically changed, a trace of fear in his eyes.
Over the years, Yuan Ming's reputation grew stronger, defeating over a dozen City Lords in succession, killing the Three Realms Sect's Seven Spirits Daoist, Fire Wing Immortal, Four-direction Killing Gods, and easily defeating Swordsman Qing Ping, making him a formidable figure in the realm.
Zong Hong and Yu Lin also changed their expressions, instinctively wanting to retreat.
However, in this secret chamber, where could they retreat to?
"So you are the one below Mahayana, the first Dharma manifestation, Yuan Ming?" The voice of the Reincarnation Demon Lord echoed in the chamber, his gaze deep as he looked Yuan Ming up and down.
Only then did the three great demon kings, Yan Li, Zong Hong, and Yu Lin, remember the presence of such a powerful figure from the Demon World standing beside them. They quickly moved closer to the Reincarnation Demon Lord, inadvertently forming a circle that trapped Yuan Ming in the center.
"The first Dharma manifestation, I dare not claim such a title. I am indeed Yuan Ming, and I have long admired your great name. I had not the chance to meet you during the Heavenly Crane Array incident, but now I am finally able to fulfill my wish." Yuan Ming, unconcerned, slightly cupped his hands toward the Reincarnation Demon Lord and smiled faintly.
"I am quite impressed by the skills of Fellow Daoist Yuan. But I am curious how you came to know that I was here?" The Reincarnation Demon Lord asked with a slight smile.
Yuan Ming glanced at the three demons, Yan Li, and a meaningful smile formed at the corner of his mouth. He spoke slowly, "Naturally, someone informed me."
Upon hearing this, the Reincarnation Demon Lord's expression slightly changed.
Since infiltrating the Fire Wolf Clan, only the new trio, including Yan Li, were aware of his presence.
"Lord Demon, we have never betrayed you and wouldn't dare reveal your whereabouts!" The three demons, including Yan Li, were quick to explain with drastic changes in their expressions.
"I naturally trust the three of you. Fellow Daoist Yuan, there's no need to sow discord here," the Reincarnation Demon Lord dismissed with a wave of his hand, speaking in a deep voice.
"I never said these three told me. Surely you did not come to the Chuyun Realm alone, Reincarnation Demon Lord?" Yuan Ming chuckled lightly.
Hearing this, the Reincarnation Demon Lord's expression turned uncertain.
He was secretly on alert, knowing that Yun Mei and others' hiding place was extremely secretive, protected by exquisite forbidden spells, which even the arrival of Mahayana strong people might not locate.
