Could it be that Yuan Ming was indeed so extraordinarily skilled that he had discovered their hiding place?
As the Reincarnation Demon Lord weighed his options internally, Yuan Ming's expression shifted, and he suddenly waved his sleeve.Official source is novel⦿fire.net
The walls, ceiling, and floor of the chamber instantly revealed five-colored spiritual light, linking together to envelop the entire chamber.
Suddenly, a blood-red shadow appeared in front of the wall, forced back repeatedly by the five-colored spiritual light.
This blood-red shadow had no aura, even as it revealed itself, a search with Divine Sense would detect nothing unusual.
"The Reincarnation Demon Lord is truly skilled. Without my advancement to Life Witch, I could not have detected this Blood Shadow's presence," Yuan Ming praised.
"What divine skill is this? It actually confines my Heavenly Wood Avatar!" The Reincarnation Demon Lord eyed the five-colored spiritual light around him with a grave expression.
"Given your extensive knowledge, Reincarnation Demon Lord, you can't recognize such a small divine skill?" Yuan Ming chuckled softly and waved his sleeve again.
The surrounding five-colored spiritual light thickened rapidly, surging like a tide, submerging the entire chamber.
Under the cover of the five-colored spiritual light, Yan Li and the other two demons suddenly felt their demonic power become sluggish and their bodies stiff and numb, as if bound by an invisible force.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord also felt bound all over, his expression changing as he said, "Mastering the Five Elements Power, this is the Five Elements Dao Fruit!"
Upon hearing this, Yan Li's expression changed drastically. Flames of demon energy erupted from his whole body, his figure swelling severalfold like inflating, steel-bristling beast hairs sprouted on his skin, and rock-like muscles emerged beneath the skin.
In an instant, Yan Li transformed into a ten-zhang-long scarlet giant wolf with six legs on its ribs, a more formidable presence than during the great battle in the Fire Rock Desert, almost reaching the Level 6 Peak.
The six-legged giant wolf let out a furious roar, charging at Yuan Ming with unstoppable momentum.
Zong Hong and Yu Lin also made a decisive move, revealing their true demon clan forms—a giant lightning bird and a massive green python—pouncing on Yuan Ming from left and right.
Facing this scene, Yuan Ming remained calm, pinching a spell with a single hand, his figure dissipating like light smoke, leaving not a trace.
The three demons' attacks surged forward but only caused the void to tremble, meeting each other unexpectedly and causing them to stumble back.
At this moment, the five-colored spiritual light on the walls suddenly intensified, like falling brilliant stars, transforming into huge Five Elements Divine Thunder, speeding towards the three demons.
The large-bodied forms of the three demons were immediately engulfed by countless Five Elements Divine Thunder.
In the chamber, the deafening roar was earth-shattering, the void seemed torn, and five-colored spiritual light spilled from the rifts, dazzlingly beautiful.
In just a few breaths, the Five Elements Divine Thunder dissipated, revealing the forms of the three demons, who appeared ragged, their auras on the brink of collapse.
Yan Li's powerful six legs were blown away without a trace, Zong Hong's agile wings were broken, and Yu Lin's graceful form was more than half gone.
The three new demon kings, originally commanding great strength, now resembled flickering lamplight in the wind, hanging by a thread.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming's form quietly appeared in a corner of the chamber, paying no further attention to the three demons, his gaze turning to face the other side.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord stood in place, enveloped in blood light, like a blood-soaked war god, completely unharmed by the Five Elements Divine Thunder.
Within the blood light, six black holes faintly appeared, swirling as if leading to another world, exuding a mysterious aura.
"This is indeed the divine skill of the Reincarnation Demon Lord—the Six Paths of Reincarnation. Truly extraordinary," Yuan Ming remarked with a smile at the corners of his mouth, speaking softly.
"It is indeed the Five Elements Dao Fruit. I never expected you to cultivate such divine skill and integrate such powerful Five Elements True Intent. It seems you will be a major obstacle for us in conquering the Chuyun Realm," the Reincarnation Demon Lord said slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1056 - 1021: Devouring
chapters.content:
"So, you intend to eliminate me, Yuan? Let's see if you have the capability." Yuan Ming sneered coldly, raising a single hand to cast a spell.
A beam of grayish-blue light flew out from his sleeve, transforming into a miniature palace, precisely the Shura Palace.
On the palace, blue light swirled and instantly enveloped the three demon kings, including Yan Li.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord's expression changed slightly, ready to intervene. However, within the four walls, numerous Five Elements Divine Thunder bolts fired out, more overwhelming than before, like a storm assaulting the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
Helpless, the Reincarnation Demon Lord momentarily abandoned Yan Li and the Three Demons, forming seals with both hands; six black holes quickly appeared amidst the blood light, suspended around his body, spinning rapidly.
Those Five Elements Divine Thunder bolts, though ferocious, were devoured one by one by these six black holes, not displaying any power.
However, the Five Elements Dao Fruit ranks third on the Creation Heaven List, and its might is extraordinary.
Yuan Ming flicked his fingers repeatedly, and countless sword-like five-colored beams surged from the walls, scattering like drizzling rain upon the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
These five-colored Sword Qi, although not as violent as the Five Elements Divine Thunder, were more abundant and denser.
Even though the six black holes tried their best to devour them, some Sword Qi penetrated through and pierced the Reincarnation Demon Lord's body.
The five-colored Sword Qi was incredibly sharp, piercing through the Reincarnation Demon Lord's Protective Spiritual Light, which tore like paper. Instantly, dozens of bloody holes appeared, and the Dantian was also pierced, causing rapid weakening of his aura.
In the next moment, blood color emanated from the Reincarnation Demon Lord's body; he swiftly transformed into a blood light, darted into one black hole, and out from another, with his injuries healed and aura restored to its original state.
"It seems this is the subtlety of Reincarnation True Intent..." Yuan Ming marveled inwardly, but his hands did not stop, conjuring more five-colored Sword Qi to continue attacking the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord formed seals with his hands, the six black holes flew to the top of his head, overlapping and instantly enlarging tenfold.
Subsequently, streams of blood-colored flames shot out from the black holes, forming a blazing sea of blood-colored fire around the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
The five-colored Sword Qi striking the blood-colored fire sea rapidly dimmed, their light dissipating and becoming formless.
A trace of surprise flashed across Yuan Ming's face.
He could clearly sense the power of the blood-colored flames, knowing that what burned was not spiritual power, but something more obscure, though he could not determine it at the moment.
While pondering, Yuan Ming waved his sleeve, releasing dozens of yellow lights, transforming into dozens of spirit beans.
In a flash, dozens of Yuan Ming's clones appeared, propelling their Dharma Power, collectively rushing towards the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
Yet, the Reincarnation Demon Lord sneered, altering the spell in his hands.
From the blood-colored fire sea, dozens of blood-colored tongues of flame shot out, piercing through Yuan Ming's clones like sharp swords.
The spiritual light on the clones rapidly dimmed, soon unable to maintain their form, reverting to spirit beans.
The blood flames did not recede, still coiling around the spirit beans.
Wrinkles swiftly emerged on the beans, which withered and eventually decayed into ash.
"So, that's it. Your blood flames burn the life span, huh?" Yuan Ming finally sensed it clearly.
"Indeed, this is the Reincarnation Fire of the Six Paths Reincarnation Divine Power, capable of burning the life span of all things. Today, let's see whose power is stronger, my Reincarnation Fire or your Five Elements Dao Fruit!" The Reincarnation Demon Lord said coldly, continuing to form seals with his hands.
The blood-colored fire sea suddenly expanded, hundreds of blood flames shot out, striking various parts of the chamber, instantly ablaze.
The five-colored spiritual light within the chamber swiftly dimmed under the burning of the blood flames, becoming thin and seemingly about to be completely consumed.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, flexing his five fingers, sending out five beams of colored light from above his head, transforming into five massive gourds.
"Freeze!"
As he uttered a low command, a wave of Five Elements True Intent spread out.
Everywhere it passed, nature's spiritual energy instantly froze, and even the blood-colored flames ceased moving, as if time itself had halted at that moment.
This was the ultimate Divine Skill of the Five Elements Dao Fruit, freezing everything containing Five Elements Power apart from the caster Yuan Ming.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord's body also contained Five Elements Power, hence he was frozen, unable to move.
Startled, he attempted to gather all the mana within his body to breach the forbidden constraint; however, his eye caught sight of Yuan Ming in the distance, who opened his mouth to spit. A black sword beam shot out, arriving before him in the blink of an eye.
In the next moment, the Reincarnation Demon Lord sensed immense pain in his divine soul, unable to react before his consciousness plunged into endless darkness.
"If you were here in person, I would be three parts fearful. But now, you're merely a clone, so why should I be afraid?" Yuan Ming said with a faint smile, flicking his fingers, as if an invisible force was guiding in the void.
Only to see the Soul Destroying Sword enveloping the Reincarnation Demon Lord's corpse, like a meteor streaking through the night sky, swiftly flying over.
He closed his eyes and focused, utilizing the Reincarnation Eye, from which a brilliant golden light shot out, shining straight onto the corpse.
The golden light pierced through layers of mist, uncovering the past hidden within the cycles of reincarnation.
In mere moments, he discerned the origins and history of the body.
It turns out this person's name is "Cao Zian", a Dharma Phase Cultivator of the Cold Crow Sect in Yu Country, Central Continent.
The Cold Crow Sect traditionally belongs to the Evil Path, having close ties with the Three Realms Sect and countless connections with the Demon World.
The cultivation technique primarily practiced by Cao Zian is a method originating from the Demon World called the "Holy Blood Technique".
Unbeknownst to him, this "Holy Blood Technique" was actually imparted by the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
Though this technique is incredibly mysterious, and cultivation proceeds relatively smoothly, once the practitioner reaches a certain realm, they gradually become a puppet of the Reincarnation Demon Lord, subject to his whims.
Not long ago, when the Reincarnation Demon Lord descended upon this world, he selected Cao Zian and directly performed a parasitic body seizing.
The reason the Demon World dispatched them to this place aligns with Yun Mei's previous statements, aiming to carry out a sneak attack on the rear of the Cloud Realm during future domain wars.
As for whether the Demon World will launch a surprise attack when the Wentian Secret Realm opens, the Reincarnation Eye has not discerned a trace.
Additionally, Yuan Ming discovered from the Reincarnation Demon Lord's memories several other secret bases of the Demon World in the Cloud Realm.
"This Reincarnation Eye truly proves useful, sparing me the trouble of consulting the gray statue for divinations in the future," Yuan Ming thought to himself, his gaze falling again on the corpse of the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
The Divine Soul within this corpse had been completely vanquished by the Soul Destroying Sword, leaving only the Nascent Soul that has yet to dissipate, with five Dao Seals revolving around it.
Three of these are the Blood Dao Divine Powers attached to the "Holy Blood Technique", specifically, the Blood Dragon Skill, the Blood Poison Demon Cloud, and the Blood Essence Dharma Eye.
The Blood Dragon Skill and Blood Poison Demon Cloud are both attack divine abilities, while the Blood Essence Dharma Eye is a control divine ability, capable of embedding one's Qi-Blood into another person's body, thereby controlling it—quite arcane.
As for the remaining two Dao Seals, they are two powerful Fire Attribute attack divine abilities.
Yuan Ming focused his mind, the Primordial Dao Seal slowly operating, devouring these five Dao Seals one by one.
The five Dao Seals contain considerable Power of Dao, enhancing the strength of the Primordial Dao Seal significantly, emitting an even more solid seven-colored spiritual light, its aura more ferocious, once again pouncing toward the Five Elements Dao Fruit Seal.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ ⓝovelFire.net
The two Dao Seals clashed, intertwining and refusing to yield.
While the Five Elements Dao Fruit can still resist the devouring of the Primordial Dao Seal, it is evidently struggling much more than before.
"It seems if the Primordial Dao Seal continues to grow, it will eventually devour the Five Elements Dao Fruit someday..." Yuan Ming thought to himself in worry.
The Five Elements Dao Fruit is currently his most powerful divine skill, and its devouring could have disastrous consequences.
Yet, the Primordial Dao Seal possesses boundless potential and cannot be deliberately constrained in growth.
As Yuan Ming was contemplating solutions, the Primordial Dao Seal abruptly ceased its attack on the Five Elements Dao Fruit, instead projecting a seven-colored spiritual light, drawing the Reincarnation Demon Lord's Nascent Soul into the Dantian.
The seven-colored vortex reappeared, tightly enveloping the Nascent Soul, beginning a fierce refinement.
Within the devouring of the seven-colored spiritual light, the Reincarnation Demon Lord's Nascent Soul gradually shattered, transforming into a chaotic spirit light absorbed by it.
Amidst the spirit light, a blood-red Dao Seal shadow remained.
This Dao Seal, hexagonal and resembling a wheel, harbors six black holes, exuding faint True Meaning of Dao.
"So this is the legendary Six Paths of Reincarnation Seal!" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, briefly pondering before understanding the origin of this Dao Seal shadow.
The scholar puppet before him, devoid of life, yet capable of unleashing the unparalleled Six Paths Reincarnation divine skill, must have had the Reincarnation Demon Lord deploy a secret technique, translocating the Power of Reincarnation onto this puppet.
Now the puppet is destroyed, yet the residual Power of Reincarnation within remains, coalescing into this illusory Dao Seal.
The Primordial Dao Seal lunged like a ravenous wolf, the seven-colored vortex tightly enwrapping the blood-red wheel-shaped seal, attempting to consume it.
The blood-red wheel, despite its lack of power, possessed a remarkably resolute will to resist, rivaling the Five Elements Dao Fruit. Though trapped by the Primordial Dao Seal, its refinement process was exceedingly slow.
"Six Paths of Reincarnation, indeed an unparalleled divine skill, its might comparable to the Five Elements Dao Fruit. Yet it's merely a shadow and ultimately cannot withstand the devouring force of the Primordial Dao Seal," Yuan Ming mused inwardly.
Indeed, as time passed, the blood-red wheel, under the fierce assault of the seven-colored vortex, gradually lost its resistance, ultimately being entirely consumed.
With the refinement of the Six Paths of Reincarnation Seal, the power of the Primordial Dao Seal seemed to break through a certain limitation, undergoing a transformation.
It expanded vigorously, radiating a dazzling five-colored brilliance, with the surrounding void resounding with the choral sounds of Dao, as if celebrating the transformation of this divine skill.
Yuan Ming hastily closed his eyes to sense the changes in the Primordial Dao Seal, soon revealing an expression of delight.
With a thought, he activated the Primordial Dao Seal.
The seven-colored vortex reappeared, but this time rotated in reverse.
As the vortex roared, one Dao Seal after another was ejected from it—the very ones devoured earlier.
"Huh, those devoured Dao Seals can actually be restored?" Void's voice carried a hint of surprise.
"Not restored, rather the Primordial Dao Seal did not thoroughly refine these Dao Seals, merely incorporating them," Yuan Ming explained.
"I see, this Primordial Dao Seal truly is marvelous," Void couldn't help but exclaim.

chapters.title: Chapter 1057 - 1022: Reward
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming closed his eyes and carefully sensed the Dao Seals, a look of even greater delight appearing on his face.
These Dao Seals now not only appeared more solid than before, but their might also surpassed the past.Chapters first released on noᴠelfire.net
Even more astonishing, those Dao Seals that he hadn't personally refined were able to establish a mental link with him, allowing for effortless control.
Dao Seals are considered a medium for communicating the Power of Dao, and even if the master falls, a consciousness would remain within.
This is because Dao Seals are closely linked to the Power of Dao, making them nearly impossible to be fully refined.
The reason Yuan Ming could master the All Living Beings' Dream Seal was because, over the long years, the original owner's consciousness had completely dissipated.
However, the Primordial Dao Seal could easily erase the original consciousness within the Dao Seal, claiming it as its own.
This ability is truly breathtaking, no wonder the gray statue urged him to cultivate this Divine Skill well.
At this moment, a flash of Blood Light appeared on the Primordial Dao Seal, shooting out a blood-colored Reincarnation Seal, which was the Six Paths of Reincarnation Seal.
Compared to before, this blood-colored wheel was much clearer, no longer in an illusory state.
Like the other Dao Seals, this blood-colored wheel also established a mental connection with Yuan Ming, allowing for effortless control.
"The Six Paths of Reincarnation can actually be used by me!" Yuan Ming was overjoyed and decided to try activating this Reincarnation Seal.
In an instant, a massive blood-colored wheel manifested behind him, its six black cavities resembling deep vortices, slowly rotating.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes to sense the pulsation of this blood-colored wheel, and soon understood the mysteries of the Six Paths Reincarnation Divine Power.
Similar to the Five Elements Dao Fruit, this Six Paths of Reincarnation was a Divine Skill interwoven with several True Intents, including the six types of Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, and Yang, making it richer than the Five Elements Dao Fruit.
However, due to its attributes, this Divine Power was particularly effective in restraining the Physical Body and Mana, but somewhat mediocre in its effectiveness on the Divine Soul.
"I see, if I can incorporate some True Intent aimed at the Divine Soul into it, this Six Paths Reincarnation Divine Power would be perfect." Yuan Ming nodded slightly, then gathered the Reincarnation Seal and stepped onto a plain within the Shura Palace.
There lay Yan Li, Zong Hong, and Yu Lin, the Three Demons, their auras extremely weak, and they gazed at Yuan Ming with deep terror in their eyes.
Lei Yu and Vajra were also there, standing guard beside the Three Demons.
Seeing Yuan Ming appear, Lei Yu and Vajra bowed to him silently.
Yuan Ming activated the Reincarnation Seal again, and with a wave of his hand, the remnants of the Three Demons were effortlessly drawn into a black cavity of the blood-colored wheel, only to emerge unharmed from another cavity.
Curiously, although the bodies of the Three Demons had been restored, their demonic power was sealed, leaving them incapable of moving.
"The effect of the Six Paths of Reincarnation in healing physical injuries is truly extraordinary, far surpassing the demonic power of the Undying Tree Demon." Yuan Ming marveled.
"The Six Paths of Reincarnation! How can you possess this Divine Skill?" Yan Li looked at Yuan Ming in shock, eyes filled with disbelief.
Without answering, Yuan Ming raised a hand, and from his palm shot out three black rays, instantly penetrating the minds of the Three Demons to begin a Soul Search.
Yan Li's expression immediately became dazed and motionless.
The same happened to Yu Lin and Zong Hong.
In just a few breaths, he withdrew his hand.
"I see." A look of sudden realization appeared on Yuan Ming's face.
Originally, he only intended to probe the current deployment of the Three Demons, but instead inadvertently discovered a more startling secret.
The reason these newly risen Demon Kings unhesitatingly allied with the Demon World was not only to overthrow Wu Yu and seize control of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, but because they had been secretly plotted against by the Demon World, their lives were firmly under its control, forcing them to obey.
In the bodies of the Three Demons, there had been Gu Worms implanted, these worms parasitizing their Divine Souls.
Should anyone activate a spell, the Divine Souls of the Three Demons would be instantly drained.
And the one controlling the life and death of the Three Demons was precisely the mysterious Di Huo of the Fire Wolf Clan.
According to Yan Li's memories, Di Huo's identity was enigmatic, with intricate ties to the Demon Clan and the Three Realms Sect.
"Wu Yu's investigation never mentioned this Di Huo, it seems he's been hiding deeply; it might be worth a meeting." Yuan Ming gained some interest in Di Huo.
As Yuan Ming ceased the Soul Search, the consciousness of the Three Demons returned.
"Alliance Leader Yuan, we did not willingly ally with the Demon World, but were coerced into doing so. Now we have repented and are determined to serve you diligently in the future, please spare our lives!" Yu Lin knelt to the ground, tears streaming down as he pleaded sorrowfully.
Zong Hong, seeing this, quickly lowered his head in submission, beseeching for a sliver of life.
"Alliance Leader Yuan, as the Nether Moon God, you need believers to help expand the sect. We are willing to convert to the Moon Sect and offer our Desire Power as a testament of loyalty," Yan Li also spoke up.
"Since you are willing to submit, I am naturally pleased. However, the Gu Worms implanted in you by the Demon World must be removed for me to accept you with peace of mind," Yuan Ming said calmly.
"Does Alliance Leader Yuan have a way to destroy these Gu Worms?" Hearing this, a trace of joy flashed in Yan Li's eyes, and he hastily asked.
"I have an idea; it can be tried. As for whether you survive or not, that will depend on your own fate," Yuan Ming smiled lightly.
Yan Li's hopeful expression froze, and just as he was about to speak, Yuan Ming waved his hand, and an invisible force immobilized the Three Demons, rendering them voiceless.
Yuan Ming beckoned, and Yan Li floated in front of him.
With a flick of his finger, he touched Yan Li's forehead, and his Divine Sense immediately probed within.
Inside Yan Li's Divine Soul, a black worm was parasitizing, leech-like in appearance, illusory and ethereal, clearly a soul body.
"Is this the Gu Worm from the Demon World?"
Yuan Ming's heart stirred, and his Divine Sense locked onto the black worm. With a flick of his finger, a fierce Soul Destroying Sword Energy shot out, accurately piercing the black Gu Worm.
Over the years, Yuan Ming's Cultivation had advanced significantly, reaching a state of mastery over the True Intent of Soul Destruction.
The black Gu Worm was shattered into pieces by the Soul Destroying Sword Energy, dispersing into dots of black light.
Surprisingly, Yan Li's Divine Soul was not significantly damaged.
Yuan Ming felt a slight surprise and was about to use the Life Witch Divine Ability to restore Yan Li's Divine Soul when he suddenly noticed that the scattered black light began to slowly merge into Yan Li's Divine Soul.
In an instant, Yan Li's Divine Soul turned pitch black, then suddenly ignited with black flames, turning to ashes in a blink, even burning Yuan Ming's probing Divine Sense.
"So the Gu Worm from the Demon World has such a peculiar nature," Yuan Ming thought to himself, yet his face showed no sign of shock.
He knew well that since the Gu Worm came from the Demon World, it must have extraordinary traits.
With the dissipation of Yan Li's Divine Soul, his Nascent Soul also began to slowly disintegrate, along with the nine Fire Attribute Dao Seals attached to it disappearing one by one.
These Dao Seals were all impressive Divine Skills, which Yuan Ming naturally wouldn't let slip by.
With a thought, the Primordial Dao Seal began to operate on its own, devouring each dispersing Dao Seal.
Zong Hong and Yu Lin, though their bodies were confined and unable to move, could see this scene clearly.
The two women showed deep pleading in their eyes, but Yuan Ming seemed not to see them.
After a brief contemplation, he flicked his finger again, and a Soul Destroying Sword Energy shot out, penetrating into Yu Lin's Divine Soul, slicing the black Gu Worm in two.
This time, Yuan Ming did not retract the Soul Destroying Sword Energy; instead, with a casual wave of his hand, the sword energy transformed into a black vortex, enveloping the two halves of the Gu Worm and smashing them into pieces of black light.
The black vortex spun rapidly, holding every strand of black light tightly, leaving no chance for any to escape.
Amazingly, the deadly black fire did not ignite again, yet Yu Lin's Divine Soul was nearly collapsed under the agitation of the Soul Destroying Sword Energy.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming hurriedly activated the Life Witch Divine Ability, attempting to restore her Divine Soul.
Unfortunately, Yu Lin's Divine Soul was too severely damaged, even the Life Witch Divine Ability could not completely save it.
"What a pity."
Yuan Ming murmured indifferently to himself, then with a thought, he refined and absorbed the Dao Seals within Yu Lin's Nascent Soul.
He turned his gaze towards the last person, Zong Hong, with a hint of coldness in his eyes.
Lei Yu's lips moved slightly, as if he wanted to say something, but was stopped by Vajra with a raised hand.
Vajra gently shook his head at him, with a look of unprecedented solemnity on his face.
Lei Yu saw this and had to close his lips tightly, saying no more.
Yuan Ming raised his hand, and the third Sword Energy shot out, precisely cutting towards the black Gu Worm inside Zong Hong.
Under the Sword Energy, the Gu Worm was instantly sliced into two parts, and then the Sword Energy transformed into a vortex, utterly extinguishing the black light formed by the Gu Worm.
With the previous experience with Yu Lin, this time the Soul Destroying Sword Energy caused relatively light damage to Zong Hong's Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming quickly performed the Life Witch Divine Ability, restoring Zong Hong's Divine Soul.
"You have good fortune, getting another chance at life. Cherish it well and live properly in the future." Yuan Ming waved, releasing the constraints on Zong Hong's body with a hint of a smile on his face.
Zong Hong looked at Yuan Ming with eyes full of terror, nodding repeatedly, not daring to utter a word.
"This Zong Hong is handed over to you. Arrange a place for her and let her soon become a believer of the Nether Moon God, contributing her Desire Power." Yuan Ming turned to Lei Yu and Vajra, instructing.
Vajra was about to speak, but Lei Yu spoke first, "Rest assured, master, leave this matter to me."
Yuan Ming nodded and was about to leave.
Lei Yu, however, hesitated slightly and then asked, "Master, could the Electric Roc King be bestowed to me?"
"Bestow it to you? What do you want this demon for?" Yuan Ming turned back, puzzled.
"Master, you know I have a Secret Technique that allows me to break through the bottleneck of my Cultivation with the power of Dual Cultivation. This Electric Roc King, being powerful in Cultivation, is the perfect subject for me to practice this Secret Technique on," Lei Yu explained.
Yuan Ming understood upon hearing this.
This secret technique was bestowed upon Lei Yu by him long ago, requiring a similar demon beast to practice.
Now with Zong Hong's assistance, Lei Yu indeed had a considerable chance of breaking through to Level 6.
"Are you willing to follow Lei Yu?" Yuan Ming looked at Zong Hong, asking calmly.
Zong Hong immediately nodded, her voice trembling as she replied, "I am willing, I am willing!"
Yuan Ming slightly frowned, inwardly wondering: Why is Zong Hong so afraid of me?
"Since she is willing, she's yours to handle." He waved his hand, saying to Lei Yu.
"Thank you, Master!" Lei Yu rejoiced, quickly expressing his gratitude.

chapters.title: Chapter 1058 - 1023: Old Friends
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's figure flickered as he exited the Shura Palace and entered the secret chamber outside.
His divine sense spread out, instantly covering the entire territory of the Fire Wolf Clan.
In his perception, every member of the Demon Clan in the Fire Wolf Clan was clearly visible, including those two sixth-level demons.
At this moment, they were cultivating in seclusion at their respective training grounds, with several Dao Seals condensed on their bodies, emanating waves of Dao power.
Yuan Ming's eyes narrowed slightly, and a strong killing intent surged in his heart.
He wanted to strike and kill these two great demons, seize their Dao Seals, and feed them to the Primordial Dao Seal.
"Yuan, control your mind!" At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded, like a great bell resonating in Yuan Ming's heart.
Yuan Ming's body trembled, and his eyes regained clarity.
He asked somewhat confusedly, "What happened to me just now?"
"You were controlled by the Primordial Dao Seal," the voice sounded again, as a figure appeared in the nearby void.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming felt a shiver in his heart.
"Although the Primordial Dao Seal is powerful, capable of plundering others' Dao Seal divine skills, the more formidable the skill, the harder it is to control. The Primordial Dao Seal is full of killing intent from the Heavenly Dao. In the world, I have seen countless divine skills, and none have a stronger killing intent. You must be careful and always remain aware of your state when using it, lest your mind be controlled by it," the voice said gravely.
After hearing this, a sense of fear lingered in Yuan Ming's heart.
Recalling the previous scene, he was indeed influenced by the killing intent of the Primordial Dao Seal and nearly made a wrong decision.
"I understand, thank you for the reminder, senior." Yuan Ming took a deep breath, calming the agitation in his heart.
The figure nodded and disappeared in a flicker.
Yuan Ming stood there silently for a moment, then transformed into a beam of golden light and flew away.
Soon, he arrived at the peak of a mountain outside the territory of the Fire Wolf Clan.
Here stood a secluded courtyard, which was Di Huo's residence.
At this moment, the courtyard was empty, and Di Huo was not there.
Yuan Ming spread his divine sense and quickly found the location of the study.
He pushed the door open and saw several large bookshelves inside, filled with various books.
Many books had slightly curled edges, indicating that the owner often perused them.
In the center of the study was a redwood desk, with no books on it, only a sheet of white paper.
A smiling face was drawn on the paper with thick ink.
The ink had not yet dried, evidently just recently drawn.
"Could it be that Di Huo had already anticipated my arrival and deliberately left this drawing to provoke me?" Yuan Ming frowned slightly, his divine sense sweeping through every corner of the courtyard but failing to find any valuable clues.
The aura within the courtyard had all been erased, like an untouched pure land, leaving no trace to follow.
However, Yuan Ming was not surprised. He closed his eyes, focused his mind, and activated the Reincarnation Eye. A golden light shot from his brow, gently landing on the white paper.
The Reincarnation Eye could not only peer into the secrets of cultivators but also trace the history of objects.
In Yuan Ming's sea of consciousness, images gradually emerged, depicting the entire process of the white paper's creation, circulation, and eventual arrival in Di Huo's hands.
Yuan Ming delved deeper, and the scenes swiftly shifted, freezing at a recent event.
Di Huo sat inside, intently writing something, then suddenly lifted his head, looked into the distance, and a mysterious smile played on his lips.
He then took out the white paper and casually drew a smiling face on it.
"It seems Di Huo indeed noticed my arrival, but how did he find out?" Yuan Ming pondered with doubts.
From the scenes, Di Huo hadn't used any detection secret techniques, and given his mediocre cultivation, Yuan Ming was confident he could easily detect it with his divine sense.
The images continued to flow. After drawing the smiley face, Di Huo made gestures with his hands, and his entire body was suddenly engulfed in gray flames.
The flames burned fiercely, as if to devour everything, and Di Huo's skin quickly melted away, revealing another face.
That face, Yuan Ming knew all too well. It was none other than his former close friend.
Little Emperor Liu Tianming!
Yuan Ming's body froze, his eyes round in shock, feeling as if struck by thunder.
"Di Huo is actually Liu Tianming! How could Liu Tianming be connected to the Demon Realm?" Yuan Ming's mind was in turmoil, thoughts swirling chaotically.
During the war between the Demon Realm and the Cloud Desolate Alliance years ago, Liu Tianming mysteriously disappeared. Could it be that he was captured by the Demon Realm back then?
Liu Tianming had average cultivation talent, so why would the Demon Realm want to capture him?
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, barely calming his thoughts, entered the Shura Palace, took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, lit the Black Incense, and attempted to possess Liu Tianming.
However, this possession attempt ended in failure.
"Why is this happening? Could it be that Liu Tianming's divine soul power surpasses mine?" Yuan Ming frowned, his heart filled with even more questions.
From the current situation, it seemed that Liu Tianming was no longer the Liu Tianming of the past.
Yuan Ming remained silent for a moment, deciding not to continue probing, but instead left the Shura Palace and headed straight for the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge.
Two days later, Yuan Ming returned to the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge.
Wu Yu, hearing that the three Demon Kings and the Reincarnation Demon Lord had all fallen at the hands of Yuan Ming, was shocked and her awe for Yuan Ming deepened.
She proactively offered a large batch of supplies as compensation for the previous oversight.
Naturally, Yuan Ming did not reject such a good thing and unceremoniously accepted these supplies, which were all invested into the refining of the Shura Palace.
He also searched the bodies of the Reincarnation Demon Lord, Yan Li, and Yu Lin, obtaining quite a few resources. Together with the compensation from the Ten Thousand Demon Country, it was enough to raise the power of the Shura Palace by a notch.
Yuan Ming did not stay long at the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge and quickly left the place.
Wu Yu watched Yuan Ming's tunneling light gradually go afar, her expression complex and indescribable.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame did not stay at the Ten Thousand Demon Ridge, but instead chose to follow Yuan Ming.
With the loss of the Great Sun Glaze Flame's protection, the power of the Ten Thousand Demon Country was undoubtedly weakened somewhat further.
Fortunately, the strength of the Fire Wolf Clan and the other two clans had also greatly declined, so the situation in the Ten Thousand Demon Country would remain stable for a long time.
...
Two years later, in Feng Country on the Central Continent, the Lingqi Mountain Range rose majestically.
This mountain range was crimson like fire, as if the blood of the earth, and the water in the lakes and rivers within was also crimson, exuding a strong iron smell, making people shudder.
The Lingqi Mountain Range was extremely rich in iron, copper, and Five Metal Ore Veins, originally rare treasures in the world. However, these ore veins were intertwined and chaotic, making mining as difficult as climbing to the heavens, so few dared to venture here.
Due to the Five Metal Ore Veins, the Primordial Magnetic Power within the mountain range surged violently, disturbing nature's spiritual energy, causing the climate here to be exceptionally harsh, with winds, rain, and thunder continuing throughout the year, as if the wrath of heaven constantly descended.
In the depths of the mountain range, clouds were dense, spanning tens of thousands of miles, as black as ink and coal, with rolling thunder deafeningly roaring.
Dazzling lightning like Flood Dragons leaped out of the sea, occasionally striking the ground, instantly charring it black, as if doomsday had arrived.
At the summit of a towering mountain peak at the heart of the range stood Yuan Ming, Vajra, and Zong Hong side by side, their gazes focused on the midair.
Several thick bolts of lightning poured in from all directions, forming a thunderous area hundreds of feet in circumference, overwhelming and astonishing.
Within the lightning area, a gigantic purple-black flying bird could be vaguely seen, swallowing lightning with boundless might.
Every now and then, it exposed a feather or claw, all entwined with dazzling lightning, like a divine bird controlling the thunder, making others revere it.
"Master, do you think Lei Yu can successfully break through this time?" Vajra asked in a deep voice, with a touch of concern.
Zong Hong, hearing this, also turned her gaze to Yuan Ming, her eyes flickering with anticipation.
Yuan Ming's gaze was deep, as if he could penetrate the lightning to directly see the soaring purple-black bird, and he slowly spoke:
"It's not much of a problem; Lei Yu's accumulation has long been ample. Now, with fellow Daoist Zong Hong's help, his Bloodline Power is already stimulated. As long as he can endure this Thunder and Lightning Body Refining process, the Level 6 realm is not far away."
Zong Hong, hearing these words, secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
She had joined the Moon Sect, and was now a Daoist companion with Lei Yu, thus considered a member of Yuan Ming's faction.
She knew well that she hadn't yet received Yuan Ming's complete trust; helping Lei Yu break through to Level 6 was her pledge of allegiance.
If Lei Yu failed to break through, her days would likely become difficult.
"That's good; if he doesn't break through soon, he'll be left behind by us," Vajra said with a hearty laugh, his voice filled with boldness.
Although Vajra was no different from before, his aura was increasingly heavy, standing there like a towering mountain, intimidating people.
Over the past two years, with the help of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, he had broken through to the Undying Body realm, and his Blood Explosion Divine Ability also condensed into a Dao Seal, greatly increasing his strength.
Just as the three were talking, the thunderclouds in the midair suddenly became agitated, and dozens of thick bolts descended directly onto the peak.
Two of the bolts happened to sweep across the area where the three were standing.
Zong Hong's body flickered with Thunder light, easily deflecting the incoming lightning.
Yuan Ming's body glowed with seven-colored light, and any lightning that got close to him was automatically absorbed and converted for his use.
As for Vajra, he stood with his arms crossed, and the lightning sweeping across his body passed through him as if striking empty space, without causing him any harm.
Originally a White Ape from the Demon World, Vajra's physical body was naturally incredibly powerful, and now with the Blood Explosion Divine Ability empowering him, his strength had reached an astonishing level.
Even when facing Dharma manifestation cultivators, he showed no fear, and could even win a battle.
"The Demon Clan truly has an inherent advantage in body cultivation," Yuan Ming's gaze skimmed over Vajra's body, then looked into the midair.Original content can be found at novel✶fire.net
The thunderclouds in the sky rolled more fiercely, with more and more lightning converging, and the lightning area in the midair continued expanding, soon covering half of the heaven's head.
Time passed by little by little, and soon another hour had gone by.
At this moment, the Heavenly Spiritual Energy within a thousand miles was suddenly drawn, surging like tides, continuously pouring into the thunderstorm area.
A sharp long cry pierced the sky, shaking the four directions.
A figure shot out of the lightning area, and it was the newly broken-through Lei Yu.
At this moment, Lei Yu's demonic power had greatly increased, his body swelling more than twice the previous size, covered with dense and complex Thunder and Lightning Spiritual Patterns, especially on his wings, seemingly covered with two dazzling Thunder and Lightning Wings, frightening to behold.

chapters.title: Chapter 1059 - 1024: The Opening of the Ask-Heaven Realm
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's eyes flashed with golden light, observing carefully.
Within Lei Yu's wings, a faint pair of lightning-shaped wing patterns emerged, with the power of Dao swirling around them, clearly two pieces of thunder and lightning Dao Seals.
"Judging by the fluctuation of the power of Dao, these seem to be speed-type Dao Seals. I wonder what the specific effects are?" Yuan Ming thought to himself, about to call Lei Yu down for questioning.
Just then, Lei Yu, in mid-air, suddenly flapped its wings. A bolt of lightning streaked across the sky, and its massive body vanished without a trace, with not even a hint of its presence detectable.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, feeling uncertain and doubtful.
Since he broke through to the Life Witch realm, his Divine Sense's range had reached nearly ten thousand miles. Could Lei Yu have escaped out of this range in an instant?
As Yuan Ming pondered, a flash of lightning suddenly appeared, and Lei Yu's figure reappeared out of nowhere. However, it couldn't stabilize its shape and crashed heavily into the mountain below.
With a loud "boom," the mountain instantly collapsed, rocks flying everywhere, burying Lei Yu in a pile of rubble.
Fortunately, it had advanced to Level 6, and its body, tempered by thunder and lightning, became extremely resilient. Although it looked a bit awkward from the collision, it wasn't seriously injured.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming waved his sleeve, a surge of yellow light spread, suspending all the collapsed rocks, revealing the buried Lei Yu.For original chapters go to novel·fıre·net
Lei Yu struggled to flap its wings and fly up, transforming into a human shape, landing beside Yuan Ming, and explained awkwardly, "I just tried a new divine skill and couldn't stabilize my form."
"Is it the thunder and lightning Dao Seals in your wings?" Yuan Ming looked at Lei Yu's arms, seeing the faintly appearing thunder and lightning Dao Seals emanating a mysterious aura.
Lei Yu nodded, and after transforming into a human form, the pair of thunder and lightning Dao Seals clearly appeared within his arms.
He excitedly explained, "This is the Electric Light Dao Seal. After activation, I can enter an electric light state and fly with thunder escape speed for a long time."
"Maintain the Thunder Escape state for a long time!" Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows, showing a look of surprise.
Beside him, Zong Hong and Vajra also looked surprised, knowing well the intricacies of escape techniques.
Escape techniques convert the body into a spiritual power state through secret techniques, allowing for rapid movement.
The Thunder Escape Technique is particularly special. The power of thunder and lightning is extremely violent. Ordinary cultivators can only maintain a transformed thunder and lightning state for a very short time, at most a few breaths.
However, Lei Yu could continuously maintain the Thunder Escape state, meaning his speed would reach an astonishing level, even Mahayana cultivators would be left in the dust.
"In your current electric light state, how far can you travel?" Yuan Ming curiously asked.
"I should be able to escape seven or eight million miles, but the power of thunder and lightning within me would be exhausted and would take a long time to recover." Lei Yu estimated and replied.
"A remarkable divine skill. Your current power is still shallow, making it difficult to fully wield the power of the Electric Light Dao Seal. If you can advance to the Seventh Level, the entire Chuyun Realm will be under your feet." Yuan Ming nodded approvingly and then said.
Rei Yu was thrilled upon hearing this, seemingly already envisioning himself spreading his wings, appearing majestically in various parts of the Chuyun Realm.
However, he was also aware that breaking through to Level 6 was only achieved with much support, and reaching the Seventh Level was still far out of reach for him.
"I will work hard to cultivate, striving to improve my power." Lei Yu returned to his senses, took a deep breath, and said.
Yuan Ming nodded in encouragement, then asked in detail about Lei Yu's other divine skills.
After breaking through Level 6, Lei Yu's Thunder Peng bloodline further awakened, greatly advancing his control over thunder and lightning, and attack divine skills like Destruction Thunder also became much more powerful.
Yuan Ming was quite satisfied with this. Lei Yu had been lagging for years, but now he had finally caught up.
Suddenly, something caught his attention. He gently flipped his hand, and a crescent-shaped Jade Talisman, shining with spirit light, appeared in his palm.
"The century is up, the Wentian Secret Realm is about to open, quickly gather at Evergreen Island." The voice of Daoist Mu came from the Jade Talisman, steady and timeless, as if crossing the boundaries of space and time.
"Senior, I will set off for Evergreen Island immediately. However, Senior, may I bring companions along?" Yuan Ming promptly replied.
Daoist Mu's voice sounded again, "You may, but the Secret Realm quotas are limited, you can only bring up to four followers, not one more. Also, you are not allowed to conceal others within space spiritual treasures, including the Stealing Heaven Tripod. When the Secret Realm opens, Fellow Daoist Bing Lan and I will examine each person, so do not harbor any wishful thinking."
"I understand, and will definitely comply." Yuan Ming respectfully replied, feeling secretly relieved.
After ending the communication, a tinge of undisguisable joy appeared on Yuan Ming's face.
With a grand gesture, an imposing palace suddenly appeared in mid-air, none other than the Shura Palace.
"Everyone, come on up. We will first return to White Emperor City and select some people." Yuan Ming said aloud.
Vajra and the others leapt into the Shura Palace one after another, Yuan Ming performed a spell, the spirit light on the Shura Palace shimmered, and in the next moment, it disappeared from its original location, appearing a thousand miles away.
In the past two years and more, Yuan Ming had been exploring everywhere, searching for ancient cave mansions, eradicating many evil sects, and even destroying several hidden strongholds of the Three Realms Sect.
He went through great hardships, barely collecting enough resources to comprehensively refine the Shura Palace.
Now, the Shura Palace possesses almost eighty percent of the power of the Three Realms Immortal Boat and has the miraculous ability of spatial teleportation.
Each teleportation can easily cover over a thousand miles.
Yuan Ming had gradually accustomed himself to steering the Shura Palace to travel, which relieved Lei Yu from the cumbersome travel duties.
The only flaw was that despite being re-refined, the Shura Palace still had not birthed an Artifact Spirit, unable to move and attack autonomously.
On this matter, Xi Hezi was also helpless, as the Shura Palace was completely different from ordinary Spiritual Treasures, and the Artifact Soul she had extracted was indeed difficult to control such a Divine Artifact.
The only solution to this problem might be to emulate Dian Xiaosan's fusion with the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, and find a Dharma manifestation Cultivator to refine it into the Artifact Spirit of the Shura Palace.
However, this method was too cruel, and unless someone volunteered, Yuan Ming was unwilling to do it easily.
As for those captured Three Realms Sect Cultivators, Yuan Ming did not trust them much. Even if he refined them into Artifact Spirits, he would not feel secure letting them control the Shura Palace.
Therefore, Yuan Ming could only put this matter aside for now, hoping that one day the Shura Palace could autonomously give birth to an Artifact Spirit and advance into a true Divine Artifact.
...
Three days later.
Yuan Ming arrived soaring with the wind, reaching the majestic White Emperor City.
He first activated the concealed Array within the city, enshrouding the Pillar Hongjun in a mysterious spirit light to ensure its utmost safety.
Then, he released everyone from the Shura Palace, including the mortals, allowing them to stay in this prosperous city.
Next, Yuan Ming gathered everyone and announced an exhilarating piece of news in the deliberation hall of White Emperor City.
"Everyone, the Wentian Secret Realm is about to open, and I can only take four companions with me on this journey, chosen from among you Dharma manifestation Cultivators."
Upon hearing this, the Dharma manifestation Cultivators were all overjoyed, faces alight with excitement.
They came forward to sign up one by one, eager to follow Yuan Ming to the legendary Secret Realm.
The Wentian Secret Realm is said to be one of the most mysterious secret realms in the Chuyun Realm, reputed as the number one secret realm in Chuyun.
It is said to be filled with countless rare Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, with supreme divine objects that can assist Cultivators in breaking through to the Mahayana Realm.
The few Mahayana strong people of the Chuyun Realm almost all obtained opportunities in the Wentian Secret Realm, successfully breaking through the shackles of their realms.
To Yuan Ming's subordinates, while obtaining the opportunity to break through to Mahayana may be out of reach, merely accompanying Yuan Ming into the Secret Realm would almost certainly guarantee a breakthrough of a small realm.
If one could luckily seize the chance to break through all the way to the peak of the Dharma manifestation, they would become a powerful presence whose strength surpasses most.
Yuan Ming watched the eager crowd signing up and silently pondered over the candidates.
Just then, Wulu's voice suddenly reached his ears through sound transmission.
"Brother Yuan, could you also grant me a spot in the Wentian Secret Realm?" Wulu's voice carried a trace of embarrassment.
Yuan Ming slightly glanced over at Wulu in the crowd, finding his face indeed showing a hint of awkwardness and anticipation.
Seemingly worried that Yuan Ming might reject him, Wulu further explained, "Senior Jie Cha once told me that the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Poisons had also entered the Wentian Secret Realm. His Ten Thousand Poison Three Treasures and Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill were obtained from a Death Poison Swamp in the secret realm. It is said there is also a treasure there that assists those cultivating the Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill to advance to Mahayana. The Ancestor of Ten Thousand Poisons missed it in his time, and I am seeking this entry to retrieve it."
"Brother Wu Lu, there's no need to say more. Even if you hadn't mentioned, I had already reserved a spot for you." Yuan Ming slightly smiled, cutting off Wulu's words through voice transmission.
Wulu was slightly taken aback, a look of emotion flashing in his eyes, but soon he revealed a hint of guilt, transmitting to Yuan Ming, "Brother Yuan, actually, when I broke through to the Dharma manifestation and came to White Emperor City to find you, a large part of the reason was for this spot. Having not clearly explained it to you, I feel a constant guilt in my heart."
"No worries, this matter judges actions, not intentions. Moreover, whether in the Yunhuang Continent or in the Chuyun Realm, you've aided me greatly. This spot was rightfully yours from the start." Yuan Ming shook his head, smiling indifferently.
Wulu heard Yuan Ming's words; his feelings of being moved grew stronger.
And Yuan Ming nodded smilingly towards him, signaling him not to mind.
Then, he slowly spoke, deciding the candidates: "Hua Zhi, Vajra, Wulu, and Wang Fulong, you four will accompany me this time."
Hearing their names called, Wang Fulong's face immediately lit up with joy, and although others felt some disappointment, none objected to Yuan Ming's decision.
After all, Hua Zhi and the others were the earliest followers of Yuan Ming, with significant contributions, and during this time, Wang Fulong had been responsible for many of Yuan Ming's subordinate affairs, working tirelessly, so choosing him was well-deserved.
Wang Fulong, however, did not think so himself.
He was once an enemy of Yuan Ming, even sending people to scheme against him. Though he eventually submitted, he always felt uneasy in his heart.
He never expected Yuan Ming to be so magnanimous, disregarding past grievances and awarding him such a precious slot, which moved him to tears of gratitude and deepened his admiration and loyalty to Yuan Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 1060 - 1025: Returning the Zither
chapters.content:
Under Yuan Ming's command, Wulu and the other three each busied themselves, preparing for the impending journey.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming alone sought out the Three Realms Sect cultivators who were imprisoned and found Fire Wing Immortal among them.
He closed his eyes, focusing his mind, and activated the mysterious Reincarnation Eye, delving once more into Fire Wing Immortal's memory.
During the previous interrogation, Yuan Ming had already obtained valuable intelligence about the Wentian Secret Realm from Fire Wing Immortal's memory.
It was a secret realm shrouded in mist, into which the first Sect Hierarch of the Three Realms Sect, Gongshu Lingren, had once ventured, leaving behind his artifact refining inheritance, waiting for a destined person to inherit it.
Gongshu Lingren, a name renowned among the artifact refiners of the Chuyun Realm, was once the foremost artifact refiner there, and the value of his inheritance was naturally immeasurable.
Upon learning this, Yuan Ming's heart could not help but swell with strong interest.
However, Fire Wing Immortal's memory did not contain detailed records of the specific location of the inheritance site.
The map that recorded the location had always been held by the Three Realms Sect leaders, with the previous holder being the Black Emperor, and it was now likely in the hands of Su Wu.
The entrance to the Wentian Secret Realm was extremely secretive, and even though the Three Realms Sect had the map, they had never succeeded in obtaining the inheritance.
The most direct manifestation of this was that the Sect Hierarch token of the Three Realms Sect— the Three Realms Immortal Order, had never revealed its true face to the world.
This order was a magic treasure of Dao Treasure level, possessing the divine skill to confine everything.
It is said that after it was refined, Gongshu Lingren had activated it a few times, showcasing its immense power.
But afterward, he concealed the Three Realms Immortal Order along with his inheritance in the Wentian Secret Realm.
The Seven Emotions Prohibition of the Seven Spirits Daoist was crafted in imitation of this treasure.
Yuan Ming delved into the memories of Fire Wing Immortal and others a second time, attempting to extract more detailed intelligence about the site of the inheritance.
However, after some effort, he still came up empty, feeling a bit disappointed in his heart.
At this time, Hua Zhi and the others had completed their preparations.
Yuan Ming had to temporarily set aside his thoughts and led them into the Shura Palace.
In a flash, the group disappeared from their original place, rushing towards Evergreen Island.
...
On the coast of the South Sea, the azure waves stretched endlessly, and above the sea, a majestic palace floated into existence, like a mirage.
Yuan Ming led Hua Zhi and the others out of the palace, his eyes sharp as he identified the direction ahead.
Then he gently waved his hand, and the Shura Palace vanished without a trace. The group switched to relying on their physical bodies for flying escape, rushing towards Evergreen Island.
The place where the Great Mahayana Ancestor resided was undoubtedly extraordinary, and Yuan Ming dared not act rashly.
He fully understood that using the flying escape technique with the physical body was not only a form of respect for the Great Mahayana Ancestor but also a reverence for the path of cultivation.
After flying for merely a few hundred miles, the group saw ahead, floating on the sea, an enormous flower basket, as grand as an island.
Within the flower basket, the blossoms were as brilliant as a brocade, filled with fragrance; the elegant floral scent mixed with the salty sea breeze, making one feel refreshed.
Among the clustered flowers, Nangong Xian'er gracefully emerged, her figure light, like a fairy descending to the mortal world.
"The Ancestor anticipated Fellow Daoist's arrival recently and specially ordered me to wait here." Nangong Xian'er flew into the air, smiling sweetly at Yuan Ming, her voice melodious and pleasant.
"Have the other fellow Daoists already arrived?" Yuan Ming cupped his hands in thanks, then asked.
"You are the first to arrive," Nangong Xian'er shook her head slightly, speaking softly.
At her words, Yuan Ming nodded slightly, feeling somewhat surprised.
He followed Nangong Xian'er onto the flower basket and continued advancing towards Evergreen Island.
Along the way, the two exchanged cultivation insights; Nangong Xian'ar was enthusiastic yet measured, and Yuan Ming responded fluently, their conversation gradually growing in volume.
Hua Zhi and the others remained silent, eyes following noses, noses following hearts, not daring to slack in the slightest.
After some time, they saw in the distance smoke and clouds swirling on the sea ahead, dimly revealing a gargantuan banyan tree extending its crown, like a rising sun in the clouds, exuding an awe-inspiring aura.
As the flower basket plunged into the smoke and clouds, the surrounding spiritual energy suddenly became dense, as though they were immersed in an ocean of spiritual energy.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, only to feel the spiritual energy pouring into his body, making each inhalation and exhalation faster than cultivating for two hours under normal circumstances.
The Hua Zhi and others behind him were even more stunned, instinctively accelerating the pace of absorbing spiritual energy, and after walking just a short distance, their cultivation had notably improved.
"This place is where the Ancestor resides, and after countless years, the concentration of spiritual energy is naturally extraordinary. You are new here, freely absorb, but remember not to overdo it, lest your meridians become clogged and disrupt important matters," Nangong Xian'er observed with a smile, offering a reminder.
Yuan Ming had strong self-control and naturally would not be tempted by the spiritual energy before him.
He sighed inwardly, recalling how he used to worry about spirit veins in his past cultivation, and now seeing Nangong Xian'er and others with such superior cultivation environments, it's no wonder the disciples of the Mahayana Sect often outperform others.The source of this content ɪs N0v3l.Fiɾe.net
Before long, the flower basket reached the shore, and Yuan Ming and his group stepped onto Evergreen Island.
Amidst the mist, the island appeared flourishing with flowers and grass. Spirit fog pervaded the air, and a strong sense of life surged forward.
Yuan Ming felt as though his lifespan was subtly increasing, but he knew it was merely an illusion from absorbing a large amount of life energy. He quickly settled his mind and followed Nangong Xian'er onward.
Passing through the mountain forest, they arrived at a blue lake in the island's center, where they boarded another small boat.
On the boat, a Returning to Void Cultivator had been waiting for some time. Once everyone was aboard, he gently swung the oar, and the boat slowly left the shore.
Midway through the journey, the surrounding mist gradually dispersed, and a sudden cold wind arose on the lake surface.
Yuan Ming was surprised to find snowflakes drifting in the sky, falling sparkling and crystalline onto his shoulder.
He was amazed because it was not winter, so how could the island's climate be so peculiar?
Nangong Xian'er noticed Yuan Ming's surprise and explained, "Elder Bing Lan is currently reminiscing with the ancestor on the island. This sudden wind and snow might be the handiwork of the elder."
Yuan Ming suddenly understood, but then he remembered something, and his expression darkened with a surge of unease in his heart.
The falling snow was everywhere, and when they reached Lake Heart Island, they saw it covered in a light layer of snow, a world clad in silver.
Yet the central banyan tree seemed divinely protected, with no trace of frost or snow on its branches, which was astonishing.
The group walked under the banyan tree, seeing from afar Daoist Mu and Elder Bing Lan sitting opposite each other, a chessboard placed on a stone table, both absorbed in their match.
Daoist Mu looked calm and composed, while Elder Bing Lan was frowning deeply, clearly pondering intensely.
Noticing the group's arrival, Elder Bing Lan immediately relaxed his frown, gently smiled, and with a wave of his hand, disordered the chessboard.
"Xian'er is back," Elder Bing Lan said with a warm and kind voice.
At this moment, Elder Bing Lan's complexion was ruddy, vastly different from when he was previously injured by the Reincarnation Demon Lord, clearly indicating he had recovered.
Seeing Elder Bing Lan's playful gesture, Daoist Mu shook his head helplessly and then flicked his fingers, causing the black and white chess pieces to fly into the air and automatically fall into the chess pot.
His gaze then went past Nangong Xian'er, landing on Yuan Ming.
"Hmm, not bad. In such a short time, you've comprehended the Five Emperors' True Intent and cultivated the Five Elements Dao Fruit. You haven't wasted my efforts on you," Daoist Mu said, a hint of appreciation flashing in his eyes.
"Thank you, elder, for your guidance," Yuan Ming responded respectfully, bowing.
Elder Bing Lan also looked at Yuan Ming, nodded slightly, and said, "You must be Yuan Ming? No wonder Fellow Daoist Mu values you so highly. With such talent, you're indeed rare in the Chuyun Realm, and Sima Changqin's defeat by you was not unjust."
"That battle was fortunate for me, truly. In terms of strength, I might not surpass Fellow Daoist Sima," Yuan Ming humbly replied.
His words showed respect to Elder Bing Lan without expressing any hostility towards Sima Changqin.
"The victor becomes king, the loser a bandit. On future battlefields, the Demon Clan won't speak of fairness," Elder Bing Lan shook his head and said.
Yuan Ming nodded silently, fully agreeing.
Elder Bing Lan then shifted his tone to a more gentle one.
"The enmity among you young ones is not my concern. However, the Phoenix Ancient Zither, which I personally bestowed upon Changqin, would greatly weaken him if lost. With the Demon Clan ready to strike, and war imminent, I hope you'll return the zither to Changqin out of respect for me."
"Elder, you're too kind. The grudge between Sima Changqin and me is nothing but banter. Once he arrives, I will return the zither to him. As for those hundred pieces of sixth-level spirit wood, let's not mention them again," Yuan Ming said, appearing magnanimous despite feeling somewhat unwilling.
The grudge between him and Sima Changqin ran deep, and returning the zither was akin to aiding the enemy. He certainly wouldn't hand it over for nothing and would seek some benefit in return.
But he had to show respect to the Mahayana, and with so many present, Yuan Ming believed Elder Bing Lan wouldn't let him suffer a loss.
At this moment, Daoist Mu spoke up, "To know shame and then be brave. If Sima Changqin easily retrieves the zither, his mindset will inevitably be lacking in the future."
"Fellow Daoist Mu is quite right. However, with war pressing and the Heavenly Saint Academy's resources all committed to the frontlines, gathering a hundred pieces of sixth-level spirit wood quickly is challenging. How about this: I propose a cultivation technique as compensation; what do you think?" Elder Bing Lan nodded slightly and said.
"Everything is up to the elder's decision," Yuan Ming replied respectfully, despite feeling somewhat dissatisfied.
Elder Bing Lan smiled faintly, raised his hand, and countless words flowed into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, quickly forming into a profoundly mysterious cultivation technique.
"This technique is called 'One Qi to Three Pure Ones,' ranked seventh on the Creation Heaven List. It should suffice to match those hundred pieces of sixth-level spirit wood," Elder Bing Lan said calmly.
Yuan Ming's eyes brightened, and he was overjoyed in his heart.
He had long envied this technique when he saw Su Wu perform it, and now he unexpectedly obtained the complete technique from Elder Bing Lan.
Any technique ranked on the Creation Heaven List is a priceless treasure. Although the hundred pieces of sixth-level spirit wood were valuable, they were still slightly inferior to 'One Qi to Three Pure Ones.'
"Thank you, elder, for bestowing the technique," Yuan Ming's grievances vanished, and he respectfully bowed to Elder Bing Lan.
Afterward, he took out the Phoenix Ancient Zither, presented it with both hands, and handed it over to Elder Bing Lan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1061 - 1026: Higher Realms
chapters.content:
"There are still some two hours before everyone's arrival. You go ahead and settle down on the island with your people. Take this opportunity to comprehend this technique. Once everyone is gathered, I will send someone to call you," Daoist Mu nodded slightly, expressing satisfaction with Ancestor Bing Lan's arrangement, and said.
Yuan Ming had no objections in his heart and respectfully bid farewell to the two Great Mahayana Ancestors. Then, under the guidance of Nangong Xian'er, he arrived at the arranged residence.
He closed the door, sat cross-legged, and eagerly began to comprehend this profound cultivation technique.
Although "One Qi to Three Pure Ones" and "Planting Beans into Soldiers" are both clone techniques, they are vastly different.
This method requires the caster to first leave a divine skill mark on others and then consume their own mana to summon a clone with strength equivalent to their own body.
This clone can borrow any divine skills from the body. However, the price is heavy—during the clone's existence, the body will temporarily lose the power of the borrowed divine skills.
Moreover, once a divine skill is borrowed by the clone, it cannot be returned until the clone disappears.
The most mystical aspect of this method is that it can forcibly raise the upper limit of the divine skills.
For example, Yuan Ming's current magic, which only affects the Returning Void Realm, when used by the summoned clone, can even affect the Dharma Manifestation Realm.
Even if those divine powers were not originally capable of being cultivated to the Dharma manifestation Stage, Yuan Ming could forcibly enhance their power and even cause unexpected transformations in the divine skills.
Yuan Ming was immersed in comprehension for several days but still couldn't find the knack for entry.
He pondered deeply and finally decided to use his usual method.
He contacted the people staying in White Emperor City and taught them the method of "One Qi to Three Pure Ones," ordering them to comprehend it together in hopes of mastering the essentials soon.
Thus, he could possess them, learning from their insights.
In the days that followed, Yuan Ming didn't leave his quarters, dedicating himself fully to comprehending the cultivation technique.
Daoist Mu also never sent anyone to disturb him, allowing him to cultivate without distraction.
Half a month later, one morning, there was a sudden knock on Yuan Ming's door.
He slowly opened his eyes, sensing someone was coming with a message.
"Master Yuan Ming, the other Masters have arrived. The Ancestor has commanded me to inform you to meet at the Lake Heart Island," a young man's respectful voice sounded.
The door opened with a "bang," and Yuan Ming stepped out of the house, looked at the young cultivator, nodded slightly, and said:
"Lead the way."
Soon after, Yuan Ming set foot on Lake Heart Island again, only to see everyone had been waiting for some time, but Daoist Mu and Ancestor Bing Lan were not present.
He glanced around and noticed many familiar faces looming among the crowd.
Leading among them was Sima Changqin, surrounded by disciples of the Heavenly Saint Academy.
Compared to the last meeting, his face seemed more weathered, with a reserved demeanor, as if he had been tempered by storms.
Though he wasn't carrying the ancient zither, there was an almost imperceptible sound of zither that surrounded him, mesmerizing people.
Feeling Yuan Ming's gaze, he looked up but showed little hostility in his eyes, then looked away without saying much.
Yuan Ming, seeing this, had no intention to provoke, and his eyes shifted to the Taixuan Sect's group nearby.
Swordsman Qing Ping nodded in greeting, hand resting on his sword. His steps carried frost and snow, and his flowing green robes made him seem like a hero walked out of a painting—free and unfettered.
Behind him, Young Master Que Yue wore an apprehensive expression, secretly observing Yuan Ming with more fear than resentment.
Yuan Ming paid no mind to this, his gaze drifting again until it settled on the Bright Moon Palace's group.
At the front of the group, a woman in a Zhuangyuan Red Dress holding a paper fan stood out remarkably.
Her face held a proud smile, head slightly raised, admiring the banyan trees on the island without caring for anything around her.
This was the contemporary Goddess of the Bright Moon Palace, known as the first Guardian in Xizhuang Yuan.
Yuan Ming's gaze didn't linger on her but quickly turned towards Xi Ying in the crowd.
Upon receiving Daoist Mu's message, he had anticipated that Xi Ying might come with the Bright Moon Palace to Wentian Secret Realm, and sure enough, here she was.
His worries were finally put to rest, seeing that Xi Ying looked well, showing no signs of injury, she even winked at him, mouthing "I'm fine."
Although Yuan Ming felt something was amiss, seeing Xi Ying's sign, he suppressed his doubts and was about to convey voice inquiries when Xi Ying raised a thumb and pointed toward the front Xizhuang Yuan, then made a gesture of silence.
He had no choice but to drop it and keep the doubts in his heart.
At this moment, Xizhuang Yuan suddenly turned her head, glared fiercely at Yuan Ming, and stepped forward to block in front of Xi Ying, obstructing Yuan Ming's view.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows slightly furrowed, but recalling Xi Ying's earlier hint, he suppressed the displeasure in his heart.
Just as he was about to avert his gaze, he suddenly noticed a familiar face in the Bright Moon Palace's group—it was unexpectedly Nan Shangfeng.
At this moment, Nan Shangfeng appeared much haggard, feeling downcast. Upon seeing Yuan Ming looking over, he forced a smile and then lowered his head again.
A sense of doubt arose in Yuan Ming's heart, but he couldn't inquire directly, so he quietly noted it in his mind.
Among the others, apart from the already familiar Hua Xian and the Evergreen Island team, there was only a young man in a black robe remaining.
His features were handsome, with long black hair tied into a ponytail resting on his left shoulder. A thin, bronze-colored chain was used to tie his hair, at the other end of which hung a single-frame crystal lens perched on the left side of his nose.
He noticed Yuan Ming's gaze but showed no response, the whole person like a stubborn stone, without a hint of expression on his face.
Yuan Ming was unfamiliar with this person and was wondering about his identity when Nangong Xian'er's voice reminded him: "Fellow Daoist Yuan, he is named Puppet Immortal, also one of the Guardians, skilled in the Puppet Technique."For more chapters visit novel⸺fire.net
Yuan Ming came to an understanding, nodding subtly without showing expression, then retracted his gaze, no longer looking further.
After fifteen minutes, the wait of everyone finally yielded a result.
Beneath the banyan tree, the figure of Daoist Mu appeared out of thin air. He surveyed everyone and slowly spoke: "Sorry to keep you waiting, Bing Lan is making the final preparations. Follow me for now."
In the next instant, accompanied by a deafening roar, the ground beneath everyone's feet began to writhe as if endowed with life.
Suddenly, countless vines burst out from the soil like giant serpents dancing wildly, forcefully tearing at the ground, enveloping mud and rocks, and rolling to both sides. A deep and mysterious passage gradually revealed itself, leading directly underground.
Everyone followed Daoist Mu into this passage, feeling the darkness and oppression surrounding them, with only faint light ahead leading their steps.
After an indeterminate duration, the view suddenly widened, and a majestic underground hall came into sight.
The hall was extremely spacious, even if thousands of people poured in, it would not seem crowded.
At the center of the hall, a towering gray altar stood majestically, entwined with crystal chains flickering with dark purple spirit light, emitting a mysterious and unfathomable aura.
Around the altar stood seven hefty jade pillars, each connected to the altar with chains wrapping around them, as if guarding some unfathomable secret.
Six of the jade pillars were dim without light, except for one in the southeast direction shrouded in a snow-white spirit light, where Ancestor Bing Lan sat peacefully.
Witnessing this scene, everyone couldn't help but marvel.
At this moment, Puppet Immortal suddenly spoke: "Senior Mu, is it true that only you and Ancestor Bing Lan, the two Mahayana, are opening the Secret Realm this time?"
"The Demon World has been acting frequently, and their vanguard has already arrived. Qinglian and the others are stationed at the Returning Ruins and truly can't spare time to return." Daoist Mu nodded, his face showing a heavy expression.
"If that's the case, won't the maintenance time of the Wentian Secret Realm's entrance be significantly shortened?" Puppet Immortal replied, a trace of worry flashing across his face.
"It's not as severe as you think. At most, it will only be shortened by one-third. Although it's a pity, there's no way around it." Daoist Mu sighed.
Upon hearing this unexpected information, everyone's faces grew much more solemn.
They all knew that Returning Ruins was located at the extreme north of the Chuyun Realm, where space was extremely unstable.
The last time the Demon World invaded, the Demon Clan broke the void from there, entering the Chuyun Realm.
Since the last realm war ended, both the Demon Clan and Chuyun Clan have stationed troops at the Returning Ruins, engaging in constant battles for years.
Ordinarily, a single Mahayana guards the Returning Ruins, but now with three Mahayana gathering, it clearly indicates that the space barriers are on the brink of collapse, potentially leading to a new realm war at any moment.
Daoist Mu seemed to sense the heavy mood in everyone. He paused and then actively changed the topic: "This is your first time visiting the Wentian Secret Realm. Traditionally, I should introduce its origins. Unlike other interfaces of Chuyun, the Wentian Secret Realm is actually a crumbled high-dimensional realm. It adjoins the Chuyun Realm and was once connected with it during the Ancient Era. However, it mysteriously collapsed overnight. After discovering it, the ancient Mahayana used Great Divine Power to establish a relatively stable passage to enter the Wentian Realm to explore the secrets of its collapse."
"May I ask, Senior, what is a high-dimensional realm?" Yuan Ming was curious and couldn't help but ask.
The gazes of the others also turned to Daoist Mu, as many shared this curiosity.
"Just as spirit veins have ranks, different interfaces are also ranked based on their overall power and the richness of spiritual energy. The Chuyun Realm, where we are, is a low-dimensional realm, as is the Demon World." Daoist Mu explained.
"How significant are the differences between high-dimensional and low-dimensional realms?" Yuan Ming further inquired.
"The passage to the Wentian Realm is located beneath Evergreen Island. Consequently, spiritual energy often backflows through the space cracks into this place, causing the concentration of spiritual energy here to be similar to that of the Wentian Realm. You should have already felt the difference when you arrived." Daoist Mu replied with a slight smile.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming felt a shock in his heart, instantly realizing the extraordinary nature of high-dimensional realms.
He took a deep breath, as if he could feel the immense spiritual energy emanating from the high-dimensional realm.
"The higher the dimension of a realm, the more abundant the spiritual energy it contains, and the more numerous the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures. Although the Wentian Realm is fragmented, the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Objects within it far surpass those of the Chuyun Realm and the Demon World. This is why we allow you to enter and seek opportunities." Daoist Mu continued.
Hearing this, everyone nodded, with an added sense of anticipation and excitement in their hearts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1062 - 1027: She Can't Leave with You
chapters.content:
"As a once major world, the Wentian Realm isn't just connected to our Chuyun Realm. Once you enter, besides the chance encounters, there's a high probability of meeting mysterious races from other realms. Fortunately, after the collapse of the Wentian Realm, the Mahayana existences, due to their immense mana, are unable to penetrate the inter-realm barrier to enter. You needn't worry about Mahayana cultivators from other realms meddling in the secret realm," said Daoist Mu again.
"Will individuals from other realms also enter the Wentian Secret Realm at the same time as we do?" asked Swordsman Qing Ping.
