"The barriers of the Wentian Realm are sometimes solid, sometimes weak. Every three thousand years is a cycle, and only when the barriers are weak can the passage be smoothly opened for you to enter. The same applies to other realms," Daoist Mu replied.
"Are there any inhabitants of the Wentian Realm left within the Wentian Secret Realm?" asked Sima Changqin.
"According to ancient Mahayana investigations, when the Wentian Realm collapsed, all intelligent life perished, and the Mahayana were not spared. However, mindless demon beasts survived and, after years of cultivation, some have broken through to the seventh level. This could be the greatest challenge you may face on this journey," said Daoist Mu, his expression grave.
Upon hearing this, everyone's expressions changed.
"You need not worry too much. The Wentian Secret Realm used to be a complete realm, a boundless space with only a scant few seventh-level demon beasts. The chance of encountering them should be small," Daoist Mu reassured upon seeing their concern.
As they heard this, they felt somewhat relieved, though a hint of nervousness lingered on their faces.
"Traversing between realms is extremely difficult. Although we can ensure your entry into the Wentian Secret Realm, the specific arrival location is not fixed. Whether you can find treasures depends entirely on chance and luck. These are maps of the areas explored by Chuyun Realm cultivators so far; there are thirty-seven regions in total, only two of which are adjacent, while the rest stand alone," Daoist Mu continued.
With that, a gesture of his hand made jade scrolls appear floating in mid-air before everyone.
Yuan Ming received a jade scroll, and upon probing it with his Divine Sense, saw wide areas marked on each map, the smallest exceeding the size of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, revealing the vastness of the Wentian Secret Realm.
"The entrance to this secret realm will remain open for a shorter time than usual, only for one year. It's best not to explore too far, lest you miss the time to return," Daoist Mu further advised.
Afterward, he instructed everyone to step onto the stone platform while he leaped atop an enormous jade pillar.
Instantly, a vibrant green spirit light burst from the jade pillar, surging along the chains towards the high platform.
At the same time, Ancestor Bing Lan made gestures for casting, and frost-white spirit light emerged from the jade pillar, merging into the high platform.
The two streams of spirit light converged, and beneath everyone's feet, tiny runes rose like fireflies, swirling and converging to form a trumpet-shaped vortex.
Suddenly, the surrounding space twisted and tore apart, a thumb-sized black ball appeared in the runic vortex, and with a "bang," it expanded instantly, swallowing the runes and forming a swirling black hole above everyone's heads.
The green and frost-white spirit light climbed upon everyone's bodies via the high platform, paused momentarily, then exploded, illuminating the entire underground hall but was then absorbed by the black hole.
When everything returned to darkness, Yuan Ming and the others had disappeared from the high platform.
Ancestor Bing Lan watched the black hole in mid-air with a trace of worry on his face, saying, "The Demon World starting a war now could be an attempt to use the Wentian Secret Realm as a transit point to bypass the Returning Ruins' defenses and catch us off guard? After all, they have the Three Realms Immortal Boat, capable of easily piercing the realm barrier and deploying troops."Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on novel·fire·net
"No need for concern; while the Three Realms Immortal Boat can pierce realm barriers, each breakthrough consumes enormous energy, requiring decades of recharge to be usable again. Furthermore, the Demon World's Three Realms Immortal Boat lacks the World Tree; even if the demon clan can restore its strength, it won't match its former power. The period during which the Wentian Secret Realm is open is too short for them to make consecutive breaches," Daoist Mu shook his head in response.
"In the past battle at the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, the situation was unpredictable. Although Changqin couldn't seize the Three Realms Immortal Boat, fortunately, Yuan Ming turned the tide by capturing the World Tree, otherwise today's situation would have been even more perilous," Ancestor Bing Lan recalled with a sigh.
"Indeed, the failure to retain the Three Realms Immortal Boat remains a hidden threat. I worry that the Demon World will use it to break open the Returning Ruins' realm barrier. Although we have made preparations, whether they will be effective is still unknown," Daoist Mu said, furrowing his brows in concern.
"Compared to the Demon World, our strength is relatively weak, and there's a limit to the means we can employ," Ancestor Bing Lan sighed wistfully.
Daoist Mu remained silent, just slightly raising his head, his gaze penetrating the ink-black hole above the stone platform, as if he could see through endless space into the depths of the secret realm.
...
As the light dawned, everyone felt as if they were in broad daylight, and after a moment of spinning, they appeared in a vast, white world.
Yuan Ming squinted his eyes slightly, surveying the surroundings.
In the midst of heaven and earth, snow danced like cotton, sprawling in all directions, enveloping everything in a shroud of haze.
In the distance, the mountains loomed, towering and mysterious, like giants of ice and snow standing silent.
The snow beneath his feet was thick and hard, crunching underfoot with every step.
Despite the harsh environment, this icy realm was filled with exceedingly rich spiritual energy, nearly ten times denser than Evergreen Island.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, feeling a cool sensation flowing into his lungs, accompanied by an indescribable comfort.
"Heavens, there's a Qianlan Ice Lotus here!" A voice exclaimed, shattering the silence, and everyone turned toward the sound.
Not far off, a ghostly blue ice lake came into view.
On its surface, clusters of blue ice crystals shaped like lotus flowers swayed gracefully, blanketed in icy blue flames, seemingly spirits of ice and snow.
Upon seeing this, a gleam of joy flickered in everyone's eyes.
This Qianlan Ice Lotus is a sixth-level spiritual material, exceptionally precious for cultivators who practice Frost Divine Abilities.
They all moved swiftly toward the ice lake, preparing to collect these spiritual objects.
Yuan Ming, however, did not join them.
He soared into the air, his gaze sweeping around as he carefully investigated the surrounding terrain.
Referring to the map in his hand, he could not find any markings for this area.
Musing for a moment, Yuan Ming's main soul entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and asked, "Senior Kong, do you know where the Fire Origin Spiritual Object needed for refining the Enlightenment Pill is located?"
"How would I know?" Senior Kong shook his head.
Yuan Ming shook his head helplessly, not too disappointed.
He was just trying his luck; after all, if Senior Kong knew, he could save a Vow Power Pill.
He sighed and had to go to the golden hall to ask the gray statue for the location of the Fire Origin Spiritual Object.
"Five hundred Vow Power Pills." The gray statue's voice was cold and mechanical, stating the condition.
Yuan Ming was well prepared; he immediately took out the Vow Power Pills and handed them to the statue.
Over the years of dealings with this statue, Yuan Ming had gradually figured out the standard of Vow Power Pills demanded by the gray statue, generally according to the difficulty level of the matter requested and the causal relationship involved, roughly divided into simple, medium, and difficult three levels.
Among them, a simple question requires dozens of Vow Power Pills, a medium question requires hundreds, and a difficult question requires thousands.
Yuan Ming intentionally accumulated Vow Power Pills over the years, and now he had more than thirty thousand, more than enough for casual use.
Moments later, a gray light appeared in the statue's palm, transforming into a gray talisman that floated toward Yuan Ming.
With a twist of his wrist, the talisman appeared in his palm.
He raised his wrist for a closer look, seeing a faint red light emerge on the talisman, condensing into a small arrow pointing in a direction.
Just then, a faint buzzing sound suddenly arose, coming from far to near.
Everyone turned toward the sound and saw a group of blue light dots flying from the other side of the lake, shuttling through the frozen lake surface air, carrying a layer of white cold air as they surged toward this side.
Seeing the situation, everyone quickly summoned their Protective Spiritual Treasures to guard against any mishaps.
Yuan Ming's gaze was sharp, fixed on the blue light dots in the wind and snow, as they grew larger and revealed their plump, silkworm-like form.
These insects were pale blue all over, emanating a faint glow, with two pairs of nearly transparent wings, their flying speed exceptionally swift.
Before the blue flying silkworms approached, they all spewed blue silk threads like spinning yarn, wrapping toward the crowd.
As soon as the silk threads touched them, everyone sensed something wrong; an extremely cold aura immediately seeped in, spreading over the light shield formed by the Protective Spiritual Treasures.
Among them, several people's Protective Spiritual Treasures began to make "cracking" sounds as hexagonal snowflake ice crystals started forming and expanding, the cold air pressing in.
Young Master Que Yue saw the frost gradually covering the white Jade at his waist, his face instantly falling, and immediately waved his hand, a brilliant light swept across like a blade.
In mid-air, a series of "crackling" sounds rang out, the blue silk threads were severed, and hundreds of blue flying silkworms fell.
However, as the silkworms' bodies burst open, their blue blood splattered out, caught by the strong wind, staining the snowflakes and turning them into icy blue colors, sweeping toward them.
These snowflakes now became as sharp as knives, cutting through everyone's Protective Treasure Light, able to penetrate by an inch, and the extremely cold aura contained within seeped into their bodies, making their hearts feel cold.
"Don't mess around, there's no point in dealing with these insects here." At this moment, Puppet Immortal's voice rang out.
"Indeed, rather than wasting time here, it's better to leave quickly," Sima Changqin promptly said.
"That was my intention, but as disciples of Bright Moon Palace, we are accustomed to moving together, so we won't be accompanying you all," Xizhuang Yuan replied with a smile.
"Then let's go our separate ways." Swordsman Qing Ping nodded in agreement.
Everyone had no objections, and the entire team quickly split into six teams.
The three giant sects of Heavenly Saint Academy formed each team, the cultivators from Evergreen Island formed another team, while Puppet Immortal and Yuan Ming were rather special, each leading their entourage, forming independent teams.
Seeing more and more blue flying silkworms rushing in, everyone immediately moved to leave.
Just then, Yuan Ming suddenly stopped the disciples from Bright Moon Palace and said, "Xi Ying cannot go with you."

chapters.title: The 1063
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's gaze was as sharp as a torch as he noticed the number of blue silkworms outside had surged, weaving a giant web that covered the sky and blocked the sun, like masterful weavers in the void.
The Shura Palace had just flashed out of the void, but unable to avoid it, it crashed straight into the dense silkworm web.
"I'll go out to check the situation." Before Yuan Ming's words were finished, he felt the temperature around the void drop sharply, a coldness that invaded fiercely.
This was exactly the biting cold contained within those blue silken threads, invading the interior of the Spiritual Treasure like a phantom, silently and invisibly altering the atmosphere around.
Yuan Ming's figure flickered, and the next instant he found himself on the broad wasteland.
Snow and wind ravaged the skies, and the blue silkworms fluttering around Shura Palace resembled dense starry constellations.
The giant web formed by the silkworms spanned several hundred zhang, shimmering with a bluish hue, tightly wrapping the Shura Palace within.
Outside the Shura Palace, a thick layer of ice crystals had already formed, crystal clear as though about to be frozen solid by this bone-chilling cold.
Yuan Ming's figure was like lightning, instantly flying to the outer wall of Shura Palace, pressing his palm against it.
The Fire Emperor True Intent surged forth from his body, a wave of intense heat flowing from his palm, swiftly spreading across the entire Shura Palace.
Under the impetus of the Five Elements Dao Fruit, the temperature of Shura Palace rapidly rose as streams of white steam rose from its walls, causing the thick layer of ice crystals to swiftly melt beneath the scorching heat.
However, at this critical juncture, a terrifying aura suddenly descended from the sky above, locking onto both Shura Palace and Yuan Ming like a beast eyeing its prey.
Yuan Ming's body froze, an inexplicable chill gripped his heart, as if caught tightly by an invisible giant hand.
He looked up and saw amidst the snow and wind, emerging from the thick leaden clouds, a massive blue head slowly protruding, its stacked layers of fat giving off a bizarrely fleshy appearance.
This was clearly a giant silkworm as large as a city tower, opening its mouth to spray countless blue threads surging like a tide, enveloping Shura Palace layer upon layer, merging with the giant web to form an unbreakable cage.
Yuan Ming cursed inwardly and, with a flicker, had already fled into the interior of Shura Palace.
He couldn't help but curse out loud, "That Daoist Mu is full of nonsense, claiming that seventh-level demon beast encounters are exceedingly rare? This is plainly a genuine seventh-level demon beast!"
At this moment, Yuan Ming had no time to focus on cursing Daoist Mu, hastily exerting all his power to activate the Space Shifting Divine Ability of Shura Palace.
On the wasteland, the massive gray palace wrapped in layers of blue silken threads flickered with silver light, attempting to dive into the void to escape.
Yet the extreme cold released by those blue threads distorted the surrounding space, causing it to ripple like water waves.
Not only did Shura Palace fail to enter the void, it was instead slowly moving towards the giant mouth of that enormous blue silkworm as dragged by the blue web.
"What's happening? Need my help?" Inside Shura Palace, Xi Ying had come to Yuan Ming's side, her brow tightly furrowed in concern as she asked.
Yuan Ming turned back, giving her a reassuring smile and said, "Don't worry, everything is under control."
As he spoke, his figure flickered again, bringing Xi Ying to the Flower Garden Wilderness, beneath the World Tree.
Compared to before, the World Tree had shrunk another circle, now only dozens of zhang tall, its aura waning to only the level of mid-stage Level 6.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, and the World Tree within his Dantian flew out, expanding a hundredfold in an instant.
His World Tree was already much larger than that World Tree, emitting a significantly stronger aura, reaching the peak of Level 6, radiating a vigorous life force.
Although Yuan Ming hadn't refined any new spiritual treasures over the years, he had continuously refined this World Tree as a Spiritual Treasure, now able to smoothly store and retrieve it within his body.
Seeing this, Xi Ying's eyes couldn't help but brighten once again, once more surprised by Yuan Ming's transformation.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, causing his World Tree to soar into the air, falling towards that World Tree standing on the Flower Garden Wilderness.
As the two approached, a teal glow shimmered on each, drawing them towards each other until they merged completely.
The instant the two World Trees fused, their aura surged sharply, reaching the level of Stage 7.
All of Shura Palace trembled as a vast power emanated from the fused World Tree, spreading to every corner of Shura Palace.
Shura Palace vibrated intensely, emitting dazzling silver light, propelling the Space Shifting Divine Ability to its fullest extent.
The blue silken threads enveloping it snapped one by one, and even the freezing distortive power failed to halt Shura Palace's forceful escape.
The blue giant silkworm in the clouds witnessed this and erupted with a blue glow, more blue threads cascading towards Shura Palace.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ .ɴet
Yet the next instant, the silver light on Shura Palace wrapped in layers surged, the void abruptly warped, and it vanished into the vast silver light, reappearing thousands of miles away.
After emerging thousands of miles away, the silver light continued to flicker on Shura Palace, once again diving into the void, disappearing.
The giant blue silkworm gazed towards the direction of Yuan Ming's disappearance, letting out a resentful roar, but did not continue to pursue, its massive body writhing as it slowly retreated into the leaden clouds.
The countless blue silkworms, as if losing their target, gradually dispersed in all directions into the swirling snow mist until they vanished.
Inside Shura Palace, recognizing that the blue giant silkworm hadn't pursued, Yuan Ming let out a breath of relief, immediately continuing to propel Shura Palace forward with all his might.
...
After a short half-day, Wulu, Hua Zhi, and several others found Yuan Ming beneath the World Tree.
"Brother Yuan, I want to leave Shura Palace and search for the Death Marsh," Wulu said.
"Do you know where the Death Poison Swamp is?" Yuan Ming asked in confusion.
"I don't know, but as long as it's not too far away, I can sense the location of the Death Poison Swamp. However, within the Shura Palace, all my perceptions are isolated, making it impossible to find the Death Poison Swamp." Wulu shook his head and said.
"Did you sense the giant blue silkworm earlier? That's a Level 7 demon beast. This shows that this world is far more dangerous than we imagined. Do you really want to go alone?" Yuan Ming frowned and asked.
"Everyone has their own path, and I'm no exception." Wulu smiled and said.
Yuan Ming anticipated this answer, so while talking to Wulu, his main soul had already slipped into the golden hall within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, standing in front of the gray statue, asking about the whereabouts of the Death Poison Swamp.
This time, the gray statue collected three hundred Vow Power Pills from him and gave him an identical gray talisman for guidance.
"In that case, take this." Yuan Ming said.
As he finished speaking, a gray talisman appeared in his palm.
"What is this?" Wulu asked in confusion.
"Follow the direction it indicates, and you'll be able to find the location of the Death Poison Swamp." Yuan Ming explained without further elaboration.
"Thanks." Wulu accepted the talisman without any doubt, smiling as he said.
"I hope next time we meet, you'll have successfully advanced to Mahayana, and we can fight side by side for the Chuyun Realm." Yuan Ming said.
"Haha, since Brother Yuan said so, I must strive to advance." Wulu, upon hearing this, was taken aback for a moment, then laughed and said.
Afterward, Yuan Ming opened a passage and sent Wulu out of the Shura Palace.
"Are you also planning to act on your own?" After he left, Yuan Ming smiled and looked at Vajra and Hua Zhi, asking.
"We also need to seek some opportunities." After exchanging a glance, Hua Zhi and Vajra both nodded.
"Do you have a fixed destination?" Yuan Ming asked.
Vajra shook his head and looked at Hua Zhi.
"We come from the Demon World and have always followed you, Master. We've consumed many Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, and now we need a large amount of pure Demonic Qi." Hua Zhi said.
"If it's just Demonic Qi, there's no hurry. Once the realm battle starts and we fight against the Demon Clan, it shouldn't be hard to get as much Demonic Qi as you want." Yuan Ming said.
"By then, it will be too late. We don't want to be unable to help when the battle starts, let alone become a burden to you, Master." Hua Zhi shook her head and said, her expression unusually serious.
Yuan Ming nodded with some relief upon hearing this.
"In this Wentian Secret Realm, is there a place where a large amount of pure Demonic Qi gathers?" His main soul asked the gray statue in the golden hall.
"Eight hundred Vow Power Pills." The gray statue said.
"For the same guidance, why does it take eight hundred Vow Power Pills for the place where Demonic Qi gathers? Is there something peculiar about it?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"Want to know? Add another five hundred Vow Power Pills." The gray statue continued.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was speechless and did not continue to ask. He simply took out eight hundred Vow Power Pills and exchanged them for a guiding gray talisman, handing it to Hua Zhi.
"The two of you must support each other. If you encounter a danger or trouble that's hard to resolve, pray to the Nether Moon God, and I'll come to protect you." Yuan Ming solemnly instructed.
"Rest assured, Master, I will take good care of him." Hua Zhi said confidently, like an elder sister.
"Hmph, who needs you to take care of me?" Vajra pouted, discontentedly retorting.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was helpless, though he was also quite used to it.
After the two of them left, he continued to steer the Shura Palace forward.
After a day and a night, he finally passed through the icy barren land, revealing a dark green forest, with towering trees standing lush and verdant.
The Shura Palace had just appeared over this dark green forest when it caught the attention of several Level 6 Great Demons.
They either spewed flames, stirred up strong winds, or released Thunder with their wings, all attacking towards the Shura Palace.
Yuan Ming ignored these attacks, focusing on propelling the Shura Palace to continue forward.
As he delved deeper into the forest, he discovered that the number of demon beasts here far exceeded those in the icy barren land, and they came in many varieties and forms, with more than half being unusual species he had never seen before.
Along the way, Yuan Ming also encountered a Level 6 Great Demon with Space Divine Power that intercepted him.
The Great Demon, using its power to compress space, forced the Shura Palace to reveal its form.
With no other choice, Yuan Ming had to reveal himself and fiercely battle it.
After a struggle, Yuan Ming naturally drove off this Level 6 Great Demon.
He continued to steer the Shura Palace forward, and although demon beasts occasionally attacked, Yuan Ming was highly skilled and could always handle them calmly.
After consecutively slaying several Great Demons, he also obtained quite a few rare items.

chapters.title: Chapter 1065 - 1030: Fully Sated
chapters.content:
As Yuan Ming constantly shuttled through during his flying escape, the Green Black Forest gradually faded in color, becoming increasingly lush and vibrant with vitality.
Three days later, Yuan Ming finally flew over the vast forest, crossed a steep and perilous cliff, and the view suddenly opened up—a vast, limitless blue ocean lay before him.
He crossed the turbulent sea without hesitation, continuing forward.
As he got closer to his destination, the glow on the guiding gray talisman became increasingly dazzling and radiant.
Yuan Ming hastened all the way, nonstop, and half a month later, he finally arrived at the heart of a vast desert.
There, a scorching sea of fire spanned a hundred miles in circumference, as if the fiercest flames in the world converged here.
He stood at the edge of the sea of fire, with an endless black glazed coastline underfoot, a peculiar sight formed by sand melted by high heat.
In front of him, the tumbling flames roared like an enraged giant beast.
In the depths of the sea of fire, the flames rose high and majestic, with fiery tornadoes soaring up to the sky and down to the earth, creating an imposing and magnificent picture.
Yuan Ming lightly pinched the gray talisman between his fingers, which was trembling incessantly at this moment, radiating light, clearly indicating that it had guided him to this journey's destination.
Just as Yuan Ming put away the talisman, a figure suddenly appeared beside him—it was Void.
"The place indicated by the talisman is indeed here. You're really lucky; the Fire Origin Spiritual Object is hidden in the depths of this sea of fire," Void's voice was calm and deep.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brow slightly, staring at the sea of fire before him, and slowly said, "The map given by Daoist Mu does record this area. It should be the Heavenly Slaughter Fire Domain they mentioned, rumored to be extremely dangerous."
"That's right. This sea of fire seems to burn everything to ashes, and although no living creatures appear to be on the surface, there are indeed many spirit-body-form Fire Spirits hidden within. They use the sea of fire as their foundation, formless and intangible, very hard to deal with," Void nodded in agreement.
"The Jade Scroll mentions that these Fire Spirits will devour the Spiritual Power and Soul Power of those who enter, making one easily fall victim if not careful. Numerous geniuses from the Chuyun Realm who came here to explore have perished in this sea of fire," Yuan Ming said with a somber expression.The most update n0vels are published on novel✦fire.net
"Since you can control the Shura Palace, why not try using its void teleportation Divine Skills to travel?" Void suggested.
"I was planning to do just that," Yuan Ming nodded in agreement.
Subsequently, Void's figure flashed and returned to the Stealing Heaven Tripod, while Yuan Ming activated the Shura Palace, and resolutely charged into the sea of fire.
Upon entering the sea of fire, Yuan Ming sensed dozens of spirit bodies emerging from the flames, rushing towards the Shura Palace.
However, before those Fire Spirits could get close, the Shura Palace had already vanished into the void, disappearing without a trace.
When the Shura Palace reappeared, more Fire Spirits surrounded it, as if they were endowed with endless vitality and power by this sea of fire.
As Yuan Ming ventured deeper into the sea of fire, the number of Fire Spirits he encountered increased significantly, including some with unusually strong fluctuations of Spiritual Power.
When the Shura Palace performed void teleportation for the fourth time, dozens of fire giants, each nearly ten zhang tall, blocked the way.
They wielded giant axes of fire, aggressive in demeanor, and the aura they emitted had already reached the level of Level 4 Demon Beasts.
Even more peculiar was that these fire giants also emitted significant Soul Power fluctuations, clearly extraordinary.
Detecting this, Yuan Ming no longer hastened on his way, and with a flash, he was outside the Shura Palace.
He hovered in mid-air above the sea of fire, with raging flames and scorching heat waves below, making his robes flutter and hair fly, while the Fire Emperor True Intent circulating within resisted the searing heat.
Upon seeing a living creature appear, those fire giants immediately charged at him frantically, swinging their fiery giant axes to chop down.
Amidst the whistling wind, countless axe shadows enveloped in flames, each strike carrying the impact of explosive flames, the ground melting like a candle into lava, nearly rivaling the power of a Level 6 Demon Beast's strike.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming did not choose to engage the Fire Spirits immediately but instead directly activated the Primordial Dao Seal.
In the next moment, a massive mixed hole vortex manifested directly above his head.
The colossal devouring force radiated in all directions, and the void instantly seemed to collapse into a huge deep pit, pulling in dozens of Fire Spirits without resistance.
The mixed hole vortex rotated rapidly, refining all the Fire Spirits into a pure golden-red flame.
He looked surprised, as this Flame Spiritual Power actually contained plenty of Sun Essence Fire.
Yuan Ming absorbed this golden-red flame, and the Sun Essence Fire incorporated into his physical body, significantly enhancing his Qi Blood Power.
Besides the golden-red flame, those Fire Spirits also yielded a strand of Soul Power.
These Fire Spirits' spiritual intelligence was immature, with little emotional impurities in the Soul Power, and having been refined by the Primordial Dao Seal, this Soul Power was exceedingly pure, comparable to Moonlight Power, and could be directly absorbed.
"It's just a pity that my Moonlight Technique is already cultivated to its peak, with no follow-up Cultivation Technique to advance further," Yuan Ming said somewhat regretfully.
At this moment, a spark of inspiration suddenly struck him, and with a flick of his wrist, he took out the Soul Destroying Sword.
"Come out," Yuan Ming shook his wrist, a flash of light on the sword, and a young girl's figure emerged from it.
Dressed in a black long dress, with a slender frame and aloof expression, she was clearly the Sword Spirit of the Soul Destroying Sword.
"This Soul Power is beneficial to you, swallow and refine it," Yuan Ming said.
As he spoke, he formed a ball with his hands, extracting the refined Soul Power, compressing it into black Round Orbs the size of dragon eyes, and handed them to the young girl.
"Thank you, Master." The girl's eyes lit up with a hint of surprise, and she quickly received it.
Her slender fingers picked up a Soul Pearl and sent it into her mouth. Without swallowing or chewing, the Soul Pearl transformed into pure Soul Power, absorbed by the Sword Spirit.
The girl's head tilted slightly back, and her face immediately showed a trace of satisfaction, as if she had tasted an unparalleled human delicacy.
After she swallowed seven or eight compressed Soul Pearls, the aura emanating from her body noticeably increased.
"Indeed, it's highly beneficial." Yuan Ming nodded secretly and continued forward.
These Fire Spirits contained a lot of good things, and he was no longer in a hurry to move forward. Instead, he openly released his aura, attracting more Fire Spirits to gather towards him.
The sea of fire below surged intensely, with rolling fire waves rushing in like a tide.
For a moment, countless Fire Spirits emerged from the sea of fire, pouncing towards him.
Among these Fire Spirits, those with powerful strength, already reaching the level of Level 4 demon creatures, numbered over a hundred, and those below Level 3 were countless.
"Good timing!"
Yuan Ming's eyes gleamed with joy. With a wave of his hand, the Mixed Hole Vortex spun out, doubling in size, and began to devour those Fire Spirits even more fiercely, refining them into Golden Red Flames and Soul Power.
Yuan Ming absorbed the Golden Red Flames, while the Soul Power continually compressed into Soul Pearls for the Soul Destroying Sword Spirit to consume and absorb.
About a cup of tea's time later, the sword spirit girl, who was already full, let out a burp and waved her hands repeatedly, saying, "Master, I can't eat anymore... I need to refine for a while to fully absorb."
Sensing the continuous growth of Qi-Blood Power, Yuan Ming felt secretly delighted, then swept his sleeve.
A Red Light flashed, and the Xi He Tablet appeared nearby.
"Why did you call me out?" Xi Hezi's figure flickered, appearing beside Yuan Ming.
"The Fire Spirits here contain pure Flame Spiritual Power and Soul Power, which should also benefit you." Yuan Ming said.
"Oh, really?" Xi Hezi mumbled in doubt but still raised a hand and waved.
The Xi He Tablet transformed into a red meteorite, crashing into the group of Fire Spirits ahead.
Xi Hezi activated the Illusion Sun True Intent, smashing the bodies of seven or eight Fire Spirits.
As she formed seals with both hands, a Great Sun's shadow rose slowly from within the Xi He Tablet, emitting a powerful suction force.
Those shattered Fire Spirits turned into countless fragments, swirling into a stream, rushing towards the Xi He Tablet.
The fiery red light on the Xi He Tablet suddenly shone brightly, and a spirit light appeared on Xi Hezi, who was floating nearby. Her aura also steadily increased.
"Why didn't you call me out earlier in such a good place?" Xi Hezi was overjoyed.
Over the years, aside from refining the Shura Palace, she had been using the spiritual materials Yuan Ming had plundered from everywhere to repair the Xi He Tablet, which had already been restored. Now, what it lacked was Spiritual Power.
These Fire Spirits were the perfect supplements for the Xi He Tablet.
Xi Hezi controlled the Stele to pounce on other Fire Spirits, engaging in a massacre.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming again swept his sleeve, and another figure emerged, precisely the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
A while ago, the Great Sun Glaze Flame helped the Vajra Breakthrough, and afterward, it had been assisting Xi Hezi in forging the Shura Palace, consuming a lot of energy, appearing a size smaller, and its aura significantly reduced.
Yuan Ming informed the Great Sun Glaze Flame about the situation of the Sun Essence Fire contained within the Fire Spirits here.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame was in dire need of replenishment and immediately attacked the gathering Fire Spirits.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame, being a Heavenly Fire, possessed an innate suppression over these Fire Spirits, hunting faster than the Xi He Tablet, constantly refining the Sun Essence Fire within the Fire Spirits.
After all the gathered Fire Spirits were slaughtered, Yuan Ming continued forward.
On the ensuing journey, the encountered Fire Spirits grew increasingly powerful, with even Level 5 and Level 6 Fire Spirits constantly appearing.
However, with Yuan Ming's current strength, he merely needed to sweep through, killing all the encountered Fire Spirits along the way.
Everyone benefited greatly; Yuan Ming's physical body improved significantly, approaching mid-stage Undying Body.
The Xi He Tablet also recovered a large part of its power, but the biggest gain was for the Great Sun Glaze Flame, which restored the previously lost Primordial Qi completely.
After a day and night, a massive red mountain appeared in the sea of fire ahead, with the arrow on the gray talisman pointing towards it.
Wherever Spiritual Objects grow, there are often Exotic Beasts guarding them. From a distance, Yuan Ming put away the Great Sun Glaze Flame and the Xi He Tablet, shielding his celestial aura, then quietly approached.
Upon reaching the mountain, Yuan Ming discovered that the barren red mountain was entirely made of a fire-red Crystal Stone, with flame-shaped patterns faintly visible on the surface, shimmering under the light of nearby flames.
"This is Fire Essence Rock!" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up.
Fire Essence Rock is a high-grade Fire Attribute Spiritual Material, exceptionally Hard, containing abundant Fire Attribute Spiritual Power, a precious material dreamt of for refining Fire Attribute Spiritual Treasure. A palm-sized piece can sell for tens of thousands of Spirit Stones.
This entire mountain is made of Fire Essence Rock. If moved to the Chuyun Realm, who knows how many Spirit Stones it could sell for.

chapters.title: Chapter 1066 - 1031: Picking Gourds
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming operated his Divine Sense without a trace of emotion, probing deep into the mountain's interior, as the joy on his face grew even more intense.
It turned out that the interior of this crimson peak was rich with Fire Essence Rock, and scattered among them were precious Sunstone and Earth Fire Essence Gold, making this mountain a veritable treasure trove of Fire Attribute Ore.
However, at this moment, Yuan Ming had no time to collect these treasures.
Suppressing the wild joy in his heart, he hurriedly made his way straight to the mountain summit.
He felt an invisible attraction, confirming that the Fire Origin Spiritual Object was hidden at the peak.
Though he was shielded from Heaven's Secret at the moment, he did not rashly rush to the summit, choosing instead to observe from a safe distance.
At the top of the crimson peak, there was a three-foot-wide mountain hollow, filled with Fire Spirit Essence Spring as hot as lava.
A crimson vine grew out of the essence spring, climbing along the cliff, lush and verdant, reaching a height of two to three zhang.
On the vine, several crimson gourds of varying sizes hung gracefully, each emitting astonishing waves of the Power of Dao.
"The Mystic Fire Gourd!" Yuan Ming exclaimed softly, his eyes sparkling with a fiery glow.
"You do have a discerning eye. These are indeed the Mystic Fire Gourds, containing the Fire Origin within. But obtaining them won't be easy." The voice of Void echoed in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming's gaze moved along the vine upwards, and suddenly, his pupils contracted.
At the top of the cliff above the vine, a massive Fire-Flood Dragon with crimson scales was coiled.
The Fire Flood Dragon's body stretched several hundred zhang, its scales glittering with a crystalline red sheen. Although it had only one horn, the majestic aura it emitted was not to be underestimated.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NoveI-Fire.ɴet
It had eight massive fire wings, clearly not an ordinary Flood Dragon.
Even from afar, Yuan Ming could feel the overwhelming life aura and terrifying demonic power emanating from the Fire-Flood Dragon.
This was undoubtedly a Level 7 Demon Beast with a powerful physical body and immense demonic power.
The Fire Flood Dragon had its mouth open wide, greedily swallowing the spirit light on the vine.
Furthermore, Yuan Ming noticed two gigantic Fire Spirits hovering in the void beyond the cliff.
One was a brawny giant, leaning on a flaming greatsword, while the other was a lean old Taoist holding a crimson duster.
Both Fire Spirits towered several zhang high, with incredibly vast auras. Although slightly inferior to the Fire Flood Dragon, they were also at the Level 6 Peak.
They too were absorbing the spirit light on the vine.
"This is indeed quite tricky…" Yuan Ming frowned, falling into contemplation.
Facing a Level 7 Fire Flood Dragon and two Level 6 Peak Fire Spirits, he knew he was no match for them alone.
Therefore, after pondering for a moment, he chose to temporarily withdraw.
After retreating to a safe distance, Yuan Ming entered the Shura Palace to seek Xi Ying's help.
After listening to Yuan Ming's description, Xi Ying pondered for a moment and said, "To take away those gourds, we must use a strategy to lure away the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon and those two Fire Spirits. We only have one chance, so we must act cautiously."
"You and I thought the same. Your Soul Cultivation Realm surpasses mine, and your ability to conceal your presence is stronger. Therefore, I wish to ask you to steal the gourds." Yuan Ming nodded in agreement.
"That shouldn't be a problem. But how do you plan to lure away the Fire Flood Dragon and the Fire Spirits?" Xi Ying nodded in agreement.
A trace of contemplation flashed across Yuan Ming's face.
He knew he couldn't divert the Fire Flood Dragon and the Fire Spirits alone, so he needed a capable helper.
After much consideration, he decided to have Wang Fulong and the Great Sun Glaze Flame join forces to strike.
Their combined strength would be enough to hold off the two Fire Spirits, and with Wang Fulong as his believer, he could provide support through the Desire Power anchor at any time.
With this in mind, Yuan Ming quickly transmitted his voice to contact Wang Fulong, urgently summoning him to meet.
Soon, Wang Fulong quickly arrived beneath the World Tree.
After listening to Yuan Ming's request, he agreed without hesitation, determination flashing in his eyes.
At this moment, Void suddenly appeared, solemnly advising everyone:
"As for those two Fire Spirits, they have devoured the Residual Souls of Dharma Phase cultivators who fell here, gradually evolving through cultivation. Although their spiritual intelligence may not be high, they can still exhibit some of the Divine Skills of their original cultivators, so never underestimate them."
"Thank you for the reminder, Senior." Yuan Ming thanked respectfully.
Void waved a hand and vanished in a flash.
"Once you pluck the gourds, the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon and the two Fire Spirits are sure to hunt you down relentlessly. The Shura Palace and the Xi He Tablet will be left with you for defense." Yuan Ming said, solemnly handing the Xi He Tablet to Xi Ying.
Xi Ying nodded, reaching out to take the Xi He Tablet.
Then, Yuan Ming led everyone outside the Shura Palace, according to the plan. He was the first to take action, his figure shooting like a cannonball towards the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon atop the mountain.
The Fire Flood Dragon sensed the threat, its massive body suddenly rising like an arrow, emitting a threatening low growl.
Raising his hand, Yuan Ming waved, and the sky was instantly covered with dark clouds, thunder rumbling.
A gigantic black handprint descended from the sky, striking fiercely at the Fire Flood Dragon's head.
The Fire Flood Dragon roared in anger, its single horn lighting up with golden runes, a crimson beam cutting through the void, slicing onto the Great Black Sky God Palm in an instant.
The aura of destruction spread rapidly, the Great Black Sky God Palm tearing like paper.
The red beam continued to slash towards Yuan Ming, leaving a deep rift in the void wherever it passed.
However, Yuan Ming was well-prepared. He raised a fist and launched a massive red gourd, which was imbued with the Fire Dao Fruit containing the Fire Emperor True Intent.
The Fire Dao Fruit contained the powerful Fire Emperor True Intent, which was the bane of flame divine skills.
As soon as the red beam collided with the Fire Dao Fruit, it was swiftly absorbed into it, vanishing without a trace.
Despite this, the power of the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon far exceeded Yuan Ming's, and the powerful impact still flung him away.
But after stabilizing himself in mid-air, Yuan Ming immediately struck the fire flood dragon with a Kui Water Divine Thunder imbued with Water Emperor True Intent and then quickly retreated.
A thick blue thunderbolt crashed onto the back of the fire flood dragon, and although it didn't cause significant harm, it left a conspicuous white mark on its body.
Thoroughly enraged, the fire flood dragon left the mountain peak with a flap of its wings and pursued Yuan Ming relentlessly.
"Good timing!" Yuan Ming shouted in a low voice, quickly using the Vertical Earth Golden Light Divine Ability to lure the fire flood dragon away.
Meanwhile, in the void near the mountain peak, Wang Fulong and the Great Sun Glaze Flame, who had been concealed by Xi Ying's shielding of heaven's secret, also began their actions.
Wang Fulong revealed himself, flying towards the mountain peak.
He raised his hand and waved, sending out two golden talismans towards the two Fire Spirits.
The golden talismans burned in mid-air, transforming into two massive Golden-armored Gods.
They held gigantic mountain-opening axes in their hands, which they swung fiercely towards the two Fire Spirits.
The tall and burly Fire Spirit opened its eyes, overflowing with flames.
It lifted the giant sword in its hand and went to meet the Golden-armored Gods.
With a booming "bang," the mountain-opening axe and Golden-armored Gods were sliced apart by a single sword strike, transforming into flowing light and disappearing.
The other Golden-armored God hadn't yet reached the slender, elderly Fire Spirit when it was entwined and shredded on the spot by two intertwining fire dragons transformed from its duster.
After vanquishing their foes, the two Fire Spirits angrily glared at Wang Fulong, intending to go after him.
But they seemed to remember something important, and forcefully halted their actions.
At this moment, two enormous golden Fire Pythons suddenly appeared, like two roaring golden dragons, slamming fiercely towards the Fire Spirits.
"Bang bang" resounded throughout the sky.
The moment the Fire Pythons touched the Fire Spirits' bodies, they shattered like bubbles, turning into two surging waves of golden fire that engulfed everything like a tsunami.
The raging flames on the Fire Spirits were mostly extinguished by this golden fire wave, and their bodies were sent flying like broken kites.
A golden figure streaked across the sky like lightning, passing by the two Fire Spirits, it was the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
The Fire Spirits' chests bore two massive holes, their aura sharply declining as if severely injured.
Thoroughly enraged, the Fire Spirits roared wildly as they chased after the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
Once their figures disappeared in the distance, the peak regained its tranquility, leaving only the whispering sound of the wind brushing against the leaves.
At this moment, Xi Ying appeared out of thin air and landed lightly beside the Honghu Spring.
She reached out to pluck the crimson gourd, and as her fingers touched the base of the gourd, she felt a burning sensation.
Xi Ying did not recoil, as an intense red light emerged from her palm to counter the scorching power of the Mystic Fire Gourd, then pulled hard.
Unexpectedly, the Spirit Vine was resilient beyond measure and did not break.
"This Mystic Fire Gourd contains the Fire Origin, and the resilience of the Spirit Vine is comparable to a top-level spiritual treasure. You may find it difficult to break it in a short time; perhaps try to take the entire Mystic Fire Gourd and Spirit Vine into the Shura Palace," Xi Hezi's voice echoed in Xi Ying's Sea of Consciousness.
Upon hearing this, Xi Ying immediately opened the entrance to the Shura Palace, a red glow like a sunrise enveloping the entire Honghu Spring, attempting to draw the entire mountain into the Shura Palace.
At this moment, the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon sensed Xi Ying's actions.
With a roar, its massive body spun around like an enraged fire dragon, rushing back at full speed.
How could Yuan Ming allow it to leave?
He promptly turned to intercept, raising his hand to launch the Five Elements Dao Fruit, quickly pursuing the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon.
The Five Elements Dao Fruit in mid-air spun swiftly, forming a massive five-colored light screen out of nowhere, like a brilliant rainbow, tightly enclosing the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon within.
Countless Five Elements Divine Thunders poured out from the light screen, like a dense rain of arrows, striking the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon.
The fire flood dragon spread its eight wings, unleashing endless flames to form an authentic Flame Spirit Domain.
The densely packed Five Elements Divine Thunders vanished into it like a bull into the sea, unable to even touch the fire flood dragon's body.
The broad tail of the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon ignited with towering flames, lashing fiercely at the five-colored light screen.
With a thunderous "boom," the five-colored light screen, unshaken even by hundreds of Demon Clan like Yun Mei, shattered and collapsed at this moment.
"So this is the power of the Mahayana level," Yuan Ming murmured to himself, a hint of seriousness flashing in his eyes.
He did not panic but instead produced a white elixir with a flip of his hand.
This elixir was surrounded by eight spirit lights; three blossomed like flowers, while five floated in a gaseous state, none other than the mysterious Three Flowers and Five Qi Pill.
(There was a lot happening before the holidays, and I forgot to update yesterday. Today, there are four chapters to make up for it ^^)

chapters.title: Chapter 1067 - 1032: Tao Divine Ability
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming tilted his head back to swallow the white elixir, and after a flash of spirit light above his head, three Dao Flowers emerged.
He shook his arms, five streams of energy burst from his chest, rushing into his limbs and skull, as if his entire body had been thoroughly cleansed, becoming unusually light, and all the meridians in his body condensed.
The next moment, the spiritual energy of the world around him converged like a tide, and Yuan Ming only felt his aura rapidly soaring, breaking through to the Mahayana level in the blink of an eye.
This was the result he obtained after learning about the effects of the Three Flowers and Five Qi Pill from the "Pill King Secret Manual" in the past, and refining it with Dian Xiaosan after he advanced to a seventh-level Alchemist.
The Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon cautiously unfolded its mighty wings, intending to fly back, but suddenly stopped in mid-air.
A heavy expression was revealed in its enormous beast eyes, clearly sensing the significant change in Yuan Ming's aura.
"Now I also possess Mahayana Power, let's have another match!" Yuan Ming raised his hand high, the Five Elements Dao Fruit transformed in response, enlarging several times, shot up like a skyward cannonball, and vanished into the clouds.
Soon after, the sky was filled with the rumbling roar of thunder, like the wrath of heaven.
The next moment, the sound of thunder exploded suddenly, and five godly thunders, like celestial pillars, descended from the sky, carrying destructive power.
Unwilling to be outdone, the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon vigorously activated its spiritual domain, a massive flame erupted like a volcanic explosion in front of it, forming the illusion of a mountain peak.
Under the fierce strikes of the five godly thunders, the Flame Mountain was instantly torn apart, and the godly thunders mercilessly struck the back of the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon.
The back of the Fire Flood Dragon was ripped open with five deep wounds, blood gushed like a fountain, almost penetrating its body.
Fear was evident in the eyes of the Fire Flood Dragon, yet it did not submit.
A flash of red light appeared on its forehead, and the spurted blood quickly merged into the sea of flames of its spiritual domain.
The flames tainted by dragon blood instantly turned blood red, like beast fire enraged, enveloping the large body of the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon.
The figure of the Fire Flood Dragon suddenly vanished into thin air, leaving only a patch of blood-red flames burning.
Several hundred miles away, the figure of the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon reappeared on another patch of flames.
It immediately flapped its wings, fleeing towards the distance, simultaneously opening its mouth to inhale, drawing the surrounding spiritual energy of the heavens and earth like a tide.
The Five-Colored Spiritual Light emerged over its body, and its wounds visibly began to heal rapidly.
"This Five Elements Undying Body is truly formidable!"
Yuan Ming's gaze moved, his body suddenly transformed into a golden light, relentlessly pursuing the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon, the distance between them closing rapidly.
As he saw the silhouette of the Fire Flood Dragon from a distance, Yuan Ming again formed a seal with his hands, and once more, across the sky fell another series of Five-Colored Divine Thunders, forming a massive Thunder Cage that instantly imprisoned the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon within.
Inside the cage, countless lightning bolts struck incessantly on the Fire Flood Dragon, each strike tearing away large patches of flesh.
Despite the severity of its injuries, the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon was remarkably resilient, struggling and twisting with great effort, frantically attacking the Thunder Cage.
Yuan Ming glanced at the distant red mountain peak, seeing Xi Ying transferring the cliff top, Honghu Spring, and the red vine with Fire Spirit Gourds into the Shura Palace.
Meanwhile, those two Fire Spirits with limited spiritual intelligence were being skillfully led far away by Wang Fulong.
Seeing this, a measure of calm returned to his heart.
Yuan Ming withdrew his gaze, raised his hand, and once again waved, causing further changes in the Five Elements Dao Fruit.
Above the Thunder Cage, Five-Colored Light suddenly surged, countless Sword Qi shot out, darting towards the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon.
Though these Sword Qi were slender, they were extremely sharp and, unlike the sheer power of the Five Elements Divine Thunder, they excelled at attacking subtle points.
As the Sword Qi flickered, they drilled into the crevices of the Fire Flood Dragon's scales, creating tiny gaps which allowed the lightning to penetrate its body.
The continuous "sizzling" sound echoed throughout the Fire Flood Dragon's body, the invasion of the Sword Qi and lightning causing it immense suffering.
Even as fierce as it was, it couldn't help but emit cries of pain, its massive body writhing intensely.
Suddenly, five spots of light shone consecutively on the Fire Flood Dragon's brow and back, each revealing a complex rune.
Immediately, a crimson light burst from the middle section of its back, transforming into an enormous light sphere, exploding towards its surroundings.
The intense flames reflected a blood-like red glow, engulfing the Thunder Cage and Five-Colored Sword Qi entirely, amid the surging red clouds, the Fire Flood Dragon's head raised high, and its eyes burned with tangible flames, clearly infuriated to the extreme.
Yet before the flames could scatter, a massive Mixed Hole Vortex appeared beneath the Fire Flood Dragon, releasing an invisible devouring force that swallowed its stout tail into the vortex.
The Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon howled at the sky, its eight wings flapping wildly, frantically struggling to break free, but for the moment, it couldn't escape its bind.
Yuan Ming glanced at Xi Ying's side momentarily, seeing the top of the red mountain peak already flattened, the Honghu Spring and the cliff with the Fire Spirit Gourd vine fully retracted.
His spirit settled, immediately preparing to exert all his strength to completely vanquish the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon before him.
But at this moment, a sudden change occurred.
The five runes on the body of the eight-winged fire flood dragon gathered at the top of its head, forming a circular rune formation with piercing blood light.
It opened its huge bloody mouth and fiercely bit at the void.
Hundreds of feet away, Yuan Ming suddenly felt the void around him stagnate and the light dimmed, and he was swept into a bizarre space surrounded by blood-red light.
Xi Ying saw clearly that the eight-winged fire flood dragon had swallowed Yuan Ming whole into its belly!
Xi Ying's pretty face slightly changed color, and she unhesitatingly invoked the Shura Palace and smashed it down toward the fire flood dragon.
This fierce beast, having just swallowed Yuan Ming, was arrogant and faced the descending palace without fear, raising its head high, intending to once again display its devouring divine skill.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NoveI~Fire.net
Just as it was about to unleash its divine skill, the Shura Palace used space shifting technique to escape into the void turbulence, making it impossible to reach.
In its astonishment, the Shura Palace had already heavily pressed on its head, causing its head to fall to the ground and be smashed into the sea of fire.
The fire flood dragon twisted its body violently, sweeping its thick snake tail, and with great strength, it swatted the Shura Palace away, freeing its body.
As it opened its mouth again, wanting to swallow the still-falling palace, it was hit hard in the jaw by a stone stele turned from black light.
With a booming sound, the fire flood dragon's jaw was thrust upward, colliding with its upper jaw, and the powerful impact caused its head to tilt back as if its jawbones were about to shatter.
Xi Hezi leaned out from the stone stele to check, only to see the fire flood dragon's scales rising, absorbing the surrounding flames to heal.
Sensing the threat of the fierce beast, she immediately steered the Xi He Tablet to flee to a distant place.
The eight-winged fire flood dragon flapped its wings, creating sudden thrust from flames, and almost instantly caught up with the Xi He Tablet.
Just as it opened its huge bloody mouth, about to swallow the stone stele, Xi Ying appeared out of nowhere, her red lips lightly parting, softly murmuring, "Thousand Dream Realm."
The fire in the eyes of the level 7 fire flood dragon beast instantly dissipated, replaced by a confused look.
But within just a few breaths, hatred and flames once again filled its eyes, and it turned to bite Xi Ying.
Xi Ying smiled, not evading, and the green shadow rapidly expanded in the fire flood dragon's open mouth, transforming into large, dense tree branches.
At the same time, the body of the fire flood dragon swelled, and its recently healed wounds burst open again, with countless vines of the World Tree crazily growing from them.
The fire flood dragon frantically swung its body, attempting to resist, but no matter how solid and strong its scales were, it was utterly powerless against the attack from within.
Soon, a giant World Tree stood at the center of the sea of fire, penetrating the back of the red-scaled fire flood dragon with eight wings, causing its body to convulse, and in just a few breaths, it seized its vitality.
The World Tree extracted the Qi blood of the fire flood dragon and quickly shrank back, returning to human form.
At this time, Yuan Ming's immense aura had disappeared, returning to the Dharma manifestation stage, as the effect of the Three Flowers and Five Qi Pill had just passed, fortunately, the eight-winged fire flood dragon had fallen.
He took a deep breath, walked to the front of the fire flood dragon's head, and gazed at the five rune marks on its forehead.
"Is this beast's Tao Divine Ability?" Xi Ying also came forward.
So-called Tao Divine Ability is a method only possessed by beings in the Mahayana realm.
Dharma manifestation cultivators rely on spiritual treasures and scattered Dao Seals in battles. After advancing to Mahayana, undergoing the baptism of Mahayana thunder tribulation, the Dao Seals of Dharma manifestation cultivators will change, either combining with each other or evolving themselves, and condensing into Tao Divine Abilities.
The power of Tao Divine Ability is ten times that of ordinary Dao Seals. Yuan Ming's Five Elements Dao Fruit and the Reincarnation Demon Lord's Six Paths of Reincarnation all belong to Tao Divine Abilities.
Yuan Ming lightly covered the imprint on the fire flood dragon's head with his hand, his eyes flashing with understanding, and murmured to himself, "It should be these marks containing the power of the Five Elements Dao of Wood, Fire, Earth, Gold, and Water, very similar to my cultivated Five Elements Dao Fruit, truly extraordinary."
Before he finished speaking, he was already activating the Primordial Dao Seal, beginning to slowly absorb these five imprints emitting strange fluctuations.
During the absorption process, Yuan Ming had already made a decision in his heart; he would cultivate these Five Elements Dao Fruit as his Tao Divine Ability, hoping to use it to step onto a higher path of cultivation.
Indeed, the power of the Primordial Dao Seal was extraordinary, and within moments, the five Tao Divine Abilities were completely devoured by it.
Besides these Five Elements Tao Divine Abilities, there were two or three dozen scattered Dao Seals hidden within the body of the eight-winged fire flood dragon, which were also gradually absorbed into Yuan Ming's strength under the devour of the Primordial Dao Seal.
These Dao Seals were all condensed by the level 7 demon beast, the eight-winged fire flood dragon, and the power of the Dao they contained was far beyond that of ordinary cultivators. As they were devoured, the power of the Primordial Dao Seal also surged several times.
During the process of devouring these Dao Seals, Yuan Ming felt a stream of strange forces circulating within his body.
Most of these forces were related to the physical body, and although devoured by the Primordial Dao Seal, their influence still spread within Yuan Ming's body.
His Qi Blood Power began to rumble and operate, and although his Body Cultivation Realm did not show obvious changes, mysterious dragon-like markings gradually appeared on his skin, muscles, and bones, enhancing the strength of his physical body rapidly.
At the same time, his mana became more refined in the agitation, as if it had undergone a rebirth-like transformation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1068 - 1033: Exotic Flower
chapters.content:
A moment later, the changes on Yuan Ming's body finally came to a halt, and he slowly opened his eyes, a look of joy appearing on his face.
"The Three Flowers and Five Qi Pill truly did not go to waste," he murmured softly to himself.
After devouring the Tao Divine Ability of the Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon and numerous Dao Seals, his strength had leaped to a new level, giving him much more confidence in facing Level 7 Great Demons.
Then, Yuan Ming began tidying up the battlefield in an orderly manner.
He carefully dug out the Demon Core of the Fire Flood Dragon, then collected the Devil Bone and demon meat, placing everything into the Shura Palace.
Until this moment, Wang Fulong and the Great Sun Glaze Flame had not yet returned.
Yuan Ming sensed Wang Fulong's position, then maneuvered the Shura Palace to quickly pursue in that direction.
Before long, Yuan Ming found the two Fire Spirits still entangled with Wang Fulong and the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
With a thought, the Shura Palace suppressed down immediately, the overwhelming Space Power instantly restraining the Fire Spirits' movements.
Yuan Ming immediately activated the Primordial Dao Seal, and the Mixed Hole Vortex emerged, almost twice as large as before.
The devouring power emanating from it became even more terrifying, seemingly capable of swallowing everything.
The two Fire Spirits had almost no power to resist in the face of this force and were consumed completely.
Yuan Ming took out the Soul Destroying Sword and pulled out the Sword Spirit maiden.
"How about it, have you digested the Soul Power from before?" Yuan Ming asked softly.
The Sword Spirit maiden felt the fluctuations from the Soul Power black balls refined from the two Fire Spirits, burped slightly, and then said quickly, "Master, I can still eat."
Yuan Ming hesitated a little but couldn't resist the pleading look in the maiden's eyes. After a brief hesitation, he handed one of the Fire Spirits to her.
The maiden pounced on it and began chewing and tearing, her eating manner somewhat unsightly.
After she finally finished eating and then looked at the second Fire Spirit, Yuan Ming chuckled and asked, "What, can you still eat?"
"No, no, I can't eat anymore," the maiden shook her head, rubbing her bulging round belly.
Yuan Ming looked at her slightly chubby face and suddenly felt she seemed to have grown a bit.
"Go and refine and absorb well,"
Yuan Ming said, waving his hand to send her back into the Soul Destroying Sword.
At this time, the Great Sun Glaze Flame had completely recovered, and the second Fire Spirit rightfully belonged to Xi Hezi.
After quickly absorbing it, her form became more solid, and the waves of energy emanating from her grew increasingly intense.
"This time is truly nourishing," Xi Hezi said with a satisfied smile on her face, delighted.
After saying this, she flew back into the Xi He Tablet.
Soon after, the Xi He Tablet transformed into a red light, flew into a crimson mountain peak, and began absorbing the Spiritual Power contained within.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming also flew back, placing the Shura Palace in the void beside the mountain.
After doing all this, he returned to the Extreme Fire Realm within the Shura Palace and saw the half-standing black mountain peak inside.
He flew up, gently picked a Fire Spirit Gourd, and then took out the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, summoning Dian Xiaosan.
"You really found the Fire Attribute Original Spiritual Object. With this, I can attempt to refine the Enlightenment Pill," Dian Xiaosan said with a look of joy as he took the Fire Spirit Gourd from Yuan Ming's hand.
"Enlightenment Pill... how confident are you in refining it?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but ask, even though he knew he shouldn't pressure Dian Xiaosan too much.
"I am now the Artifact Spirit of the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod and have merged with it quite well. Coupled with my insight into the True Meaning of Alchemy, I believe there's a fifty percent chance of success," Dian Xiaosan replied after a slight hesitation.
For an elixir as rare as the Enlightenment Pill, fifty percent was already considered a high success rate.
Yuan Ming was pleased in his heart and was about to speak when the figure of Void suddenly appeared.
"Just focus on refining, I will assist you with the Fengtian Secret Technique, so enhancing the success rate by another twenty percent shouldn't be difficult," Void said with a laugh.
"Then I'll be relying on the two seniors," Yuan Ming said solemnly, clasping his fists together.
Seeing the two engrossed in discussing alchemy details, and no one paying attention to him, Yuan Ming departed on his own.
Outside the Shura Palace, Yuan Ming looked at the crimson mountain made entirely of Fire Attribute Spiritual Material. With a thought, he maneuvered the Shura Palace to the mountain's peak and began refining the whole crimson mountain and moving it into the Extreme Fire Realm.
Time flew by, and before he knew it, half a month had passed.
The once towering crimson mountain had been cut in half, with the top half already moved entirely into the Shura Palace.
The remaining half stood still, its surface flickering with scarlet light like blazing flames.
Yuan Ming stood aside, watching from afar.
He saw the spiritual power within that mountain peak gradually converging towards the interior, and the remnant half of the mountain peak was shrinking at a speed visible to the naked eye.
This scene was like an invisible beast devouring the remnants of the mountain, mouthful by mouthful.
Each time the beast devoured, the mountain peak grew smaller, until finally, only a house-sized mountain body remained.
At this moment, all the lights suddenly disappeared, and a crimson shadow shot out, transforming into a red stone stele.
Spiritual patterns shone on the stele, radiating strong spiritual power fluctuations, like a splendid star.
Then, a female figure appeared above the stele. She rode the flying stele and came before Yuan Ming.
"Congratulations, you've finally restored to the Dao Treasure level," Yuan Ming saw this and cheerfully congratulated her.
"Mutual congratulations. Once I stabilize my realm, I can continue refining the Shura Palace. Now that my power has reached the Dao Treasure level, the ritual refining of the Shura Palace will be twice as effective with half the effort." Xi Hezi replied with a smile.
After speaking, her figure merged back into the stele and flew back into the Shura Palace.
Yuan Ming then stepped into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and arrived at the golden great hall.
He inquired about the location of the Yin Soul Flower from a gray statue, and after some negotiation, he obtained the answer at the cost of fifty Vow Power Pills.
He then drove the Shura Palace swiftly towards the direction where the Yin Soul Flower was located.
After he had left for a while, the sea of flames on the ground suddenly began to churn, and a mysterious bird covered in flames coagulated out of the fire.
This bird was a hundred feet long, with its tail feathers making up half of it. Its fiery red feathers faintly shone with multicolored brilliance, covered with mysterious patterns.
It was clearly a Youtian Fire Phoenix, with an incredibly terrifying aura, not at all inferior to the dead Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon.
As soon as the figure of the Youtian Fire Phoenix appeared, a green whirlwind suddenly spun down from the sky.
From the whirlwind emerged a giant bird surrounded by a green whirlwind, even larger than the Youtian Fire Phoenix, with a similar appearance, but its feathers were like peacock green, also faintly covered with a layer of multicolored brilliance, appearing extremely majestic.
This was also an extremely powerful Level 7 Demon Beast.
"Qingluan, luckily we listened to your advice this time and didn't act recklessly. Not only is that person's power unfathomable, but the strength of the red stone stele can't be underestimated either. The death of that Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon was not in vain." The Youtian Fire Phoenix spoke to the green giant bird.
"Although we don't get along with that Eight-winged Fire Flood Dragon, these outsider raiders are even more despicable. Every time they set foot here, they bring a bloody storm, killing wantonly everywhere. This time, we can't fight individually anymore." Qingluan also spoke, responding.
"You're right. You and I will act separately and contact the other guys. This time, it will be us hunting these unknowing raiders." A hint of murderous intent flashed in the Youtian Fire Phoenix's eyes.
...
After leaving the Heavenly Slaughter Fire Domain, Yuan Ming and his group flew for several days, finally seeing a mountain range shrouded in purple light.
In the range, giant rocks stood like sharp beast teeth, crystal clear like crystals, appearing even more illusionary under the purple light.
Occasionally, gray shadows flickered among the stones, like mist or smoke, elusive, as if they were the hidden spirits of this mysterious mountain range.
Among these rocks, slender purple trees soared into the clouds, their trunks growing opaque from top to bottom, appearing like floating ghostly shadows from afar, giving an illusionary feeling.
The sky over the mountain range was filled with dense soul power, as if every inch of air was imbued with some mysterious force, which even affected Yuan Ming in flight, stirring waves in his Sea of Consciousness.
"It seems the stones in this place are rich in soul power, making it undoubtedly a holy land of cultivation for Soul Cultivators. According to the statue's information, the Yin Soul Flower should be within this mountain range," Yuan Ming turned to Xi Ying and said.
Xi Ying nodded, with a hint of surprise in her eyes as she gazed at the range, as if discovering something unexpected.
"Do you know this place?" Yuan Ming discerned Xi Ying's thoughts and couldn't help asking.
Xi Ying glanced at Yuan Ming, didn't answer directly, just pointed lightly to her lips, indicating she couldn't speak.
Yuan Ming realized that Xi Ying was restricted by the forbidden in her body, unable to reveal the truth to him.
This meant that this mountain range had some major connection with the Bright Moon Palace, possibly being their true destination for this journey.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ novel⸺fire.net
"In that case, let's continue searching for the Yin Soul Flower," Xi Ying said at this moment.
Yuan Ming nodded in agreement, though he was unsure of the Bright Moon Palace's exact plans, since Xi Ying knew the insider information, naturally he should follow her guidance.
The group continued to delve into the range, following the statue's directions along the way.
Soon, they arrived at the edge of a precipitous cliff.
Beneath the cliff was a bottomless dark abyss, with purple light drifting and swirling like fog, resembling a gateway to an illusionary realm, filled with mystery and eeriness.
And about ten feet below the cliff's edge, a pale gray little flower quietly blossomed with buds.
Each petal had a purple human-shaped spot on it, with the center of the flower exhaling purple spirit light, twining around the stem and leaves like a ribbon, beautiful as a dream.

chapters.title: Chapter 1069 - 1034: Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace
chapters.content:
"Is this the Yin Soul Flower?" Yuan Ming's figure moved, flying into the abyss. He carefully picked the small flower and handed it to Xi Ying.
Xi Ying took the small flower, examined it closely, and then nodded, "Yes, this is the Yin Soul Flower we are looking for. The year is sufficient. Next, I will enter seclusion to refine the Nine Yin True Soul Pill. You need to wait for me for a few days."
"Do you need my help?" Yuan Ming asked.
"No need, refining the Nine Yin True Soul Pill requires special techniques that cannot be shared." Xi Ying shook her head.
Yuan Ming understood in his heart. This should also be a restriction set by the Bright Moon Palace, so he did not ask further. He then opened the Shura Palace, letting Xi Ying enter on her own for seclusion.
As for himself, he thought for a moment, and with the power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, contacted Yun Luo Fairy, who stayed back in White Emperor City.
"Yun Luo, how is the cultivation of the One Qi Transforms Three Purities technique progressing?" he directly asked.
Yun Luo Fairy was cultivating at the time. Hearing Yuan Ming's voice, she quickly gathered her energy and responded, "Reporting to Master, the progress is quite smooth. I can already refine the Yuqing clone."
The One Qi Transforms Three Purities technique has three realms: Yuqing, Shangqing, and Taiching. Each time one cultivates to a realm, a clone can be divided.
"Oh? What about the progress of the others?" Yuan Ming was pleasantly surprised and asked again.
Before he left White Emperor City, he had appointed Yun Luo Fairy as the chief of White Emperor City, responsible for overseeing all affairs.
After imparting the technique of One Qi Transforms Three Purities, he also instructed everyone to report their cultivation progress to Yun Luo Fairy regularly, so he could keep track.
"Reporting to Master, the progress of the other fellow Daoists is not ideal. Currently, only I have the deepest understanding of this technique." Yun Luo Fairy replied, with a hint of commendation in her tone.
Yuan Ming was not surprised, as it hadn't been long since he imparted the cultivation technique. Having someone cultivate the Yuqing clone was already commendable.
"It seems you are quite compatible with this technique. Your future achievements are limitless. For the time being, put other matters aside and focus on cultivating this technique. I have great use for it." Yuan Ming instructed.
"Yes." Yun Luo Fairy nodded in agreement and continued her cultivation.
Yuan Ming ended the communication with Yun Luo Fairy. Immediately, he gently picked up a stick of black incense and carefully inserted it into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The next moment, his consciousness flowed like water into Yun Luo Fairy's body.
Time flowed slowly and quietly until Yuan Ming withdrew from Yun Luo Fairy's body, opened his eyes, and immediately performed Inner Observation on his Dantian.
In the depths of his Dantian, a cyan rune floated silently, emitting a mysterious aura. Although the aura felt slightly insufficient and the color somewhat dim, it radiated a unique brilliance.
This was the Jade Clear Seal, a mark that Yuan Ming condensed after cultivating the One Qi Transforms Three Purities to the Yuqing realm through Yun Luo Fairy's body.
Yuan Ming felt a sense of delight in his heart. He withdrew from Inner Observation, and with his hands forming seals, activated the Stealing Heaven Tripod to establish contact with Qiu Nu, who also remained in White Emperor City.
He did not converse with Qiu Nu but secretly operated the One Qi Transforms Three Purities technique, projecting the Yuqing Seal in his Dantian through the void to Qiu Nu's body.
After that, he raised his hand and pointed towards his forehead, muttering a low incantation.
In the next moment, a cyan light shot swiftly from behind his head, landing beside him, gradually condensing into Qiu Nu's form.
Feeling the Dharma manifestation aura emanating from Qiu Nu's clone, Yuan Ming couldn't help but smile.
Bringing along Qiu Nu's clone, Yuan Ming arrived at the location of the World Tree. With a thought, Qiu Nu's clone voluntarily stepped forward, raising her hand towards the Innate Bitter Bamboo growing under the tree.
In the palm of Qiu Nu's clone, a cyan spirit light streaked across the void like a meteor, accurately landing on the Bitter Bamboo.
Under Yuan Ming's gaze, the Innate Bitter Bamboo grew at an astonishing speed, and its age rapidly increased.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming could clearly feel his own lifespan depleting at an alarming rate.
This was because the lifeforce cost of the divine skills performed by his clone had to be borne entirely by him.
Yuan Ming had anticipated this.
He was already at the peak of Dharma cultivation, and with the World Tree as his lifebound spirit plant, his lifespan was exceptionally long, spanning thirty to forty thousand years, capable of withstanding such consumption.
What surprised him was that the proportion of lifespan exchange had also changed when performing Green Wood Mysterious Light with Dharma cultivation.
Under Yuan Ming's precise control, Qiu Nu's clone ultimately consumed ten thousand years of his lifespan, successfully advancing the age of the Bitter Bamboo to an astonishing eighteen thousand years.
Following this, Yuan Ming performed an incantation to dissolve Qiu Nu's clone, took out the Soul Destroying Sword, and with a light swing, cut down the upper half of the Innate Bitter Bamboo.
Not long after, Yuan Ming found Xi Hezi and handed the Bitter Bamboo to her, saying:
"Xi Hezi, I have found the ten-thousand-year-old Bitter Bamboo you wanted."
Xi Hezi's eyes lit up, and she excitedly took the Bitter Bamboo, saying: "Oh, very impressive. I did not expect you to actually obtain a ten-thousand-year-old Innate Bitter Bamboo. Leave the rest to me. The Clean Vase I create this time will surely amaze you!"This update is available on .net
"Then I shall wait and see." Yuan Ming smiled.
Now that all conditions were met, he only had to wait for the completion of the Enlightenment Pill and the Clean Vase to attempt to take that step.
With a mix of anticipation and apprehension, Yuan Ming once again immersed himself in cultivation.
...
Five days later.
Yuan Ming, who was in seclusion cultivating, suddenly had a change in expression, his figure disappearing like an illusion, and reappeared outside the seclusion room the next moment.
The door slowly opened, and Xi Ying gracefully stepped out, a faint smile on her brow, her aura surging around her, clearly having reached the late stage of the Life Witch realm.
Before Yuan Ming could open his mouth to inquire, Xi Ying restrained her excitement and said solemnly, "I have reached sufficient cultivation, barely able to break through the limits of the spell. The following words you must remember firmly."
Seeing her serious expression, Yuan Ming immediately composed himself and said solemnly, "You speak, I am listening."
Xi Ying took a deep breath, her hands quickly forming a sealing gesture, lightly touching her brow.
A flash of gray light appeared in her eyes, her voice slightly hoarse: "Towards the southeast, delve into the mountain range, and seek out the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace!"
As soon as she finished speaking, a dull gray rune appeared at her brow, trembling slightly and emitting a deafening hum.
Immediately after, Xi Ying rolled her eyes and fell softly to the ground, slipping into unconsciousness.
"Xi Ying! What's wrong?" Yuan Ming hurriedly stepped forward, supporting the fallen Xi Ying, calling out repeatedly.
However, no matter how he called out, Xi Ying remained unresponsive, only the dull gray rune at her brow still hovered, seemingly an invisible seal, locking her consciousness firmly.
Yuan Ming's face darkened, trying to use Soul Power to break the rune on Xi Ying's brow, but no matter how he urged, the rune remained unmoved, and Xi Ying still lay unconscious.
