He couldn't help but feel a trace of resentment towards the Bright Moon Palace, but now was not the time to pursue it.
Thus, he placed Xi Ying within the Shura Palace, then flew swiftly towards the southeast direction of the mountain range with Wang Fulong.
It was uncertain how much time passed, but Yuan Ming suddenly noticed that the purple light in the mountain range was becoming increasingly intense.
He extended his Divine Sense, and not far ahead, a cluster of dilapidated palaces stood among the mountains.
These palaces were all tinted with a purple hue, yet were not constructed from the mountain stones, their bricks and tiles a deep shade, distinctly different from the crystalline mountain stones.
Looking around, the palaces were scattered across the mountains, stretching from the peaks to the depths, intertwining and stacking, leaving no rest for the eyes.
One could imagine how magnificent these palaces must have been when they were intact back then.
However, now, most of the palaces were in ruins, with hardly any intact part, the furniture inside also chaotic and disorderly, in disarray.
Yuan Ming searched around the dilapidated palaces but found nothing of value, so he continued moving southeast.
He speculated that this might be a site of a Sect from the Wentian Realm.
Considering the scale of this palace cluster and the mysteriousness of the mountain range, Yuan Ming believed that at least one Ghost Witch patriarch must have presided here in the past.
And the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace mentioned by Xi Ying might be intricately connected to this Ghost Witch patriarch.
After flying for about two hours, Yuan Ming suddenly saw a grand palace perched atop a distant mountain peak, shrouded in purple clouds.
As he flew closer, he discovered countless murals painted on the outer walls of the palace, but no matter how intensely he focused, he could not make out the content of the murals.
Staring for too long could even induce a sudden attack of dizziness.
He quickly averted his gaze, looking towards the palace's main entrance.
Above the door, a plaque with four large characters was carved — Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace.
Yuan Ming, with Wang Fulong, landed in front of the entrance, tentatively reaching out to push.
The next moment, a burst of purple spirit light erupted from the door, enveloping both him and Wang Fulong.
Their vision blurred, and when they regained clarity, they found themselves within a void filled with purple mist.
Upon entering, Yuan Ming immediately felt severed from all connections to the outside world, as if within another realm. This sensation was even stronger than the isolation felt when crossing realm barriers.
He looked around and saw only ethereal purple smoke all around, with nowhere to rest his feet.
Far in the distance, there was only a wooden door hanging in the air, leading who knows where.
As Yuan Ming closely observed the surroundings, he suddenly reacted, raising his hand to summon the Shura Palace.
Moments later, Xi Ying slowly emerged from it.
At this moment, the rune on her brow had vanished, her eyes clear as water, her expression and behavior no different from usual.
"You're awake?" Yuan Ming exclaimed in joy.
"Yes, thanks to you finding the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace, it seems my judgment was correct." Xi Ying nodded with a smile, a hint of joy on her face.
"Is this place truly able to isolate the restrictions set by the Bright Moon Palace?" Yuan Ming seemed to realize something and couldn't help but ask quietly.
"Indeed. The Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace is the Innate Spiritual Treasure of a Ghost Witch, a world unto itself, capable of isolating the soul domain. The spell set by the Bright Moon Palace didn't directly act on me, but imposed limitations remotely through some means. As long as I remain here, the spell cannot reach me." Xi Ying nodded in response.
Yuan Ming frowned, pondering for a moment before saying, "But once you leave here, won't you fall back into a state of unconsciousness?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1070 - 1035: Soul Bone
chapters.content:
"Indeed, that is true. But as long as I can step into the Ghost Witch Realm, the Soul-binding Spell will naturally be lifted. That is why I resolutely came here," Xi Ying smiled slightly, explaining.
Yuan Ming immediately understood and hurriedly asked, "If that's the case, is there anything I can help with?"
"There's no need for you to act right now. Besides, we currently lack some essential conditions; just the two of us find it difficult to accomplish anything. But rest assured, I have a capable ally, and once he arrives, we can further our plans," Xi Ying gently shook her head and said softly.
"An ally? Who is it?" Yuan Ming's curiosity was piqued.
Xi Ying smiled mysteriously but did not reveal the answer directly: "Once he arrives, you will naturally know."
Having said that, she let Wang Fulong return to the Shura Palace, then privately taught Yuan Ming the mnemonic for the eighth layer of the Moonlight Technique, and thereafter started cultivating together with Yuan Ming.
...
A day later.
In the Purple Cloud Space, four rays of light suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
Before long, four people from the Bright Moon Palace appeared within this Purple Cloud Space.
Led by Xizhuang Yuan, who looked around, a trace of delight appeared on her face but she unexpectedly noticed Yuan Ming and Xi Ying not far away.
"Yuan Ming! Xi Ying! What are you two doing here?" She was surprised, with a hint of anger.
"Is she the ally you mentioned?" Yuan Ming did not answer her question but instead turned to Xi Ying for an answer.
"No," Xi Ying shook her head.
Xizhuang Yuan's gaze also turned to Xi Ying, noticing she had reached the Late-stage Life Witch cultivation, her heart suddenly understood.
"So that's it, I never thought you would know the secret of the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace. This is extremely confidential within the palace; who exactly told you? Quickly confess!" Xizhuang Yuan sternly questioned, raising her hands as if about to act.
At this moment, a practitioner from the Bright Moon Palace in a white robe suddenly stepped forward, placing his hand on Xizhuang Yuan's shoulder.
Xizhuang Yuan was taken aback and quickly turned her head, only to meet a pair of eyes flickering with strange spirit light.
In just a moment, Xizhuang Yuan's body went limp, the brilliance in her eyes vanished, clearly trapped in an illusion unable to extricate herself.
This sudden change left everyone except Xi Ying in shock.
"Senior Brother Xu, what are you doing!" Another practitioner from the Bright Moon Palace beside Nan Shangfeng reacted with disbelief.
The male cultivator in white did not answer but glanced back at them.
Soon after, Nan Shangfeng and the remaining practitioner from the Bright Moon Palace also fell, similarly trapped in illusions.
Only then did Xi Ying step forward to greet: "Senior Xia, you have finally arrived."
Yuan Ming was taken aback, and after taking a closer look, he saw the male cultivator in white gently wipe his face, which quickly transformed into the appearance of Xia Jie.
"Little friend, it's been a long time," Xia Jie smiled slightly at Yuan Ming in greeting.
"So it's Senior Xia. Since we parted back then, I've often thought of you. How have you been lately?" Yuan Ming stepped forward and greeted respectfully.
"After healing the injury to my Divine Soul, I am no longer troubled, now my strength is fully restored. I couldn't be better. But you, back then I only intended to help you achieve Life Witch status to aid in my healing. Unexpectedly, after all these years, you've come this far, far exceeding my expectations," Xia Jie praised.
"Senior, you flatter me," Yuan Ming replied modestly, then asked, "Senior, have you come to the Wentian Secret Realm for the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace as well?"
"More or less, yet this place is just secondary. What I'm truly after is the Bright Moon Soul Bone within her," Xia Jie pointed to the fallen Xizhuang Yuan.
"What is the Bright Moon Soul Bone?" Yuan Ming asked in confusion.
"Let me explain," Xi Ying chimed in at this moment.
Yuan Ming looked at Xi Ying, his eyes growing more puzzled, but Xi Ying paid no mind and began to narrate everything in detail:
"It all starts with the founding of the Bright Moon Palace. Actually, in the ancient era, the Chuyun Realm had no Soul Cultivator lineage, until millions of years ago when the Bright Moon Palace's founder, Immortal Shuanghua, accidentally discovered a skeletal remains with no trace of life. Yet, it did not decay and would draw any who approached into an illusion. Back then, even after reaching the Mahayana stage, Immortal Shuanghua was still trapped in the illusion for ten thousand years before breaking free."
"Just a skeletal remains that could trap a Mahayana being for ten thousand years, could it be..." Yuan Ming said incredulously.
"According to Immortal Shuanghua's deductions afterward, the owner of the remains must have surpassed the Ghost Witch in cultivation during their lifetime, reaching the legendary Witch God Realm. Although they had fallen, their lifetime's legacy remained with their body. Immortal Shuanghua eventually conceived the Moonlight Technique through studying the soul power operation method of these remains, thereby establishing the Bright Moon Palace. Henceforth, the Bright Moon Palace's generations of development, be it cultivation techniques or magical skills, all came from research on the remains." Xi Ying revealed the Bright Moon Palace's greatest secret to Yuan Ming.
Hearing about this ancient secret left Yuan Ming utterly shocked.
Xi Ying allowed Yuan Ming some time to process, and once he accepted these truths, continued explaining.
"Back then, Immortal Shuanghua revered the remains' owner as the Bright Moon Goddess, and the remains continued under this name. About three million years ago, the then Bright Moon Palace Master, Moon Shadow Hermit, developed a new method. He extracted two bones from these remains and transplanted them into the bodies of the then Saint Heir and Goddess of the Bright Moon Palace. He named these bones Bright Moon Soul Bones. After transplantation, they could deepen a cultivator's connection with the Bright Moon Goddess' remains. With the Divine Map Game Painting divine skill, divine maps could be inscribed on the original bones, thus borrowing power from the Bright Moon Goddess."
"Borrowing power from the Witch God? Such a powerful divine skill—shouldn't it be used by the Bright Moon Palace Master who has reached the Ghost Witch stage? Why give it to the Saint Heir and Goddess?" Yuan Ming was both surprised and somewhat perplexed.
"Because borrowing power doesn't come without a cost. The amount of power you can borrow is closely linked to the number of divine maps inscribed on your bones. The more divine maps inscribed, the greater the power borrowed. But concurrently, you'll gradually be assimilated and eroded by the remains. If the soul bone isn't timely removed, the transplant recipient will become part of the remains, providing nourishment for its resurrection." Xi Ying gently shook his head.
"Resurrection?" Yuan Ming's eyes widened.
"Indeed, that's correct. After Moon Shadow Hermit developed the Secret Technique, several Saint Heirs and Goddesses excessively borrowed power from the Bright Moon Goddess to resist formidable enemies, ultimately becoming nourishment for the remains, causing them to grow small pieces of flesh about the size of a pinky finger. Therefore, there's a hypothesis within the Bright Moon Palace that suggests if provided with enough nourishment, the deceased Bright Moon Goddess might one day resurrect." Xi Ying stated solemnly.
"Isn't transplanting soul bones very dangerous? Why do people in the Bright Moon Palace still use this method? Aren't they afraid of the Bright Moon Goddess truly resurrecting?" Yuan Ming frowned deeply, filled with concern.
"This issue is also a subject of debate within the Bright Moon Palace's upper echelon. But for now, it seems at least a cultivator at the Peak of Dharma must turn into nourishment for remarkable changes in the remains to occur. Moreover, as long as excessive power isn't borrowed and the soul bone is timely transferred to the next Saint Heir or Goddess, the hazards aren't really significant." Xi Ying explained.
"I see, so your goal is to use the soul bones to summon the Bright Moon Goddess's power to help yourself break through, right? But wait, shouldn't this be a top secret of the Bright Moon Palace? How do you know about it?" Yuan Ming mused, nodding, but soon his brow furrowed again.
"It's all because of this." Xi Ying said as he gently turned over his right hand and revealed the Soul Suppressing Kettle.
Seeing the familiar Soul Suppressing Kettle, scenes from the past flashed rapidly through Yuan Ming's mind. A hint of nostalgia appeared in his eyes, but he still felt perplexed by Xi Ying's intentions.
"Have you heard of the name Tan Hua? He was an active Soul Cultivator over ten thousand years ago, and this kettle is his Innate Spiritual Treasure, containing a strand of his Residual Soul Origin. After I broke through to the Late-stage Life Witch, I refined this origin and acquired part of his memories. These secrets were discovered this way." Xi Ying didn't keep Yuan Ming in the dark.
"I've heard of Tan Hua. However, rumors say he once challenged the Bright Moon Palace, but according to what you just stated, he should've been a member of the Bright Moon Palace." Yuan Ming nodded, recalling relevant information.
"The rumors aren't false; he was indeed the Saint Heir of the Bright Moon Palace, but something happened, forcing him to defect. The memories I obtained don't cover this part, so I don't know the specific reason, only that he stole the Moon God Pendant, one of the Moon God's Three Treasures, when he fled the Bright Moon Palace. He roamed the Chuyun Realm for many years afterward and participated in the last realm domain war." Xi Ying said.
"Oh, I see. Then he vanishing later probably means he died in the realm domain war, right?" Yuan Ming speculated.
"You're correct. He was severely defeated by a Ghost Witch from the Demon World back then, suffered irreparable injuries, and shortly after returning to the Chuyun Realm, he perished. His body and Innate Spiritual Treasure, the Soul Suppressing Kettle, were taken by his disciple. After many years of wandering, his disciple unintentionally entered a secluded world, contemplating claiming it for himself, and subsequently settled there, establishing a cult feared by the world. You're likely very familiar with his name." Xi Ying looked at Yuan Ming with a meaningful expression.
"Wu Yue God." Yuan Ming also quickly uttered the name that had troubled him for a long time.
"What happened afterward, you already know. The Soul Suppressing Kettle eventually fell into my hands, and upon learning everything, I informed Senior Xia Jie, which led to today's collaboration." Xi Ying explained.
While Xi Ying clarified things for Yuan Ming, Senior Xia Jie cast a spell and chanted a mnemonic to separate the soul bone.
He rubbed his palms together, and two bright white spirit lights emerged instantly, enveloping his hands like gloves.
Next, he lifted his right hand slightly, and the unconscious Xizhuang Yuan hovered in mid-air in the shape of a "大" character.
Xia Jie stepped forward and lightly tapped Xizhuang Yuan's head. In an instant, all the bones within Xizhuang Yuan's body glowed with a striking white light, visible even through clothes and flesh.
Among them, the most striking was Xizhuang Yuan's right pinky finger.
Against the backdrop of the white light, only the front joint of this pinky finger exuded a deep blue luster resembling moonlight—faint yet mystical.Updates are released by NoveI[F]ire.net

chapters.title: Chapter 1071 - 1036: The Woman in the Coffin
chapters.content:
Senior Xia Jie confirmed the position of the soul bone, and with his right hand lifted, Xizhuang Yuan proactively extended his hand towards him.
Immediately, Xia Jie's expression became serious; he also stretched out his palms, one above the other, covering Xizhuang Yuan's right hand from a distance.
He began to chant obscure and difficult incantations in a low voice, and spirit light emitted from between his palms, trembling slightly as if it possessed life.
Then, from the center of Xia Jie's palms, two threads of spirit light thin as silk silently emerged, precisely piercing into Xizhuang Yuan's little finger, instantly taut like a string.
Under Yuan Ming and Xi Ying's tense gazes, Xia Jie carefully manipulated his hands, and the joint emitting deep blue radiance seemed to be drawn by some mysterious force, gradually detaching from Xizhuang Yuan's body.
Time slowly passed, a duration stretching infinitely like thirty minutes.
Finally, with a crisp sound, the Bright Moon Soul Bone completely separated from Xizhuang Yuan's body, suspended in the air.
That soul bone was crystal clear, like a meticulously crafted jade, though its shape was no different from a common little finger joint, yet the profound blue brilliance it contained revealed an extraordinary aura.
Yuan Ming stared at it, a strong admiration involuntarily surging in his heart; this joint was flawless, akin to a divine artifact not meant to exist in this world.
At that moment, an indescribable greed suddenly rose within Yuan Ming's heart, as if drawn by the soul bone, wanting to claim it for himself.
But the next instant, he abruptly awoke, realizing his emotional anomaly, and immediately executed a magic formula, forcing himself to calm and concentrate.
Xi Ying and Xia Jie also seemed to feel the same temptation, but they quickly adjusted their mental states.
Xia Jie dared not delay for a moment; with a thought, a prepared Jade Box flew out from thin air, carefully ingesting the Bright Moon Soul Bone.
Once the soul bone was collected, Yuan Ming and the others felt the greedful tide recede like waves, their hearts instantly relaxed considerably.
"The remains of the Bright Moon Goddess contain an unusual seductive power. We can only adjust our mentality to resist after forcibly detaching it," Xia Jie explained.
Yuan Ming nodded, asking, "What should we do next?"
"Follow me."
Xia Jie said, then first flew towards the wooden door.
Stopping before the door, he swiftly released several magic formulas, and the wooden door immediately glowed brightly, then thunderously opened, revealing a winding jade corridor.
Yuan Ming's eyes flashed slightly, a hint of doubt rising within.
Xia Jie seemed to sense his confusion, explaining without turning his head, "I came to this place years ago; the Cultivation Technique I practice originates from the inheritance left by the owner here—Purple Cloud Master."
Yuan Ming suddenly understood, following Xia Jie into the corridor.
On both sides of the corridor, the jade walls emitted a gentle light, as if they were in a passage leading to a fairyland.
"Moreover, the Stealing Heaven Tripod in your hand and the remnants of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword were also obtained from this place," Xia Jie said casually as he walked.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was greatly surprised, his heart filled with intense curiosity.
He instinctively spread his Divine Sense, exploring the interior of the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace.
Xia Jie did not stop him, continuing to lead the way.
Soon, they crossed the corridor, arriving at a spacious square hall.
In the center of the hall, a complicated Space Array appeared in their view.
Yuan Ming glanced at it; despite his vast knowledge, he could only vaguely identify some aspects of the Array.
And above the Array, a corpse wrapped only in outer skin and bone sat cross-legged; although its features were unclear, the broken attire faintly suggested a former noble aura.
At the moment they entered the hall, a bronze bell above the corpse's head suddenly vibrated violently, emitting a deep and distant bell sound.
Simultaneously, large patches of dark purple stains began to emerge on the floor of the hall, and countless yin soul ghost hands emerged from the stains, scrambling to enter their bodies, appearing in their Seas of Consciousness, tightly gripping their Divine Souls.
Yuan Ming felt his Divine Soul being constantly pulled by a powerful force, as if about to be dragged into an Endless Abyss.
He struggled desperately but couldn't move, only watching himself sink further, his consciousness slowly descending.
"Hey!"
At that moment, Xia Jie's powerful shout exploded like thunder in Yuan Ming's ears.
He shuddered all over, and his Divine Soul instantly returned to clarity.
Looking down, he saw the stains and ghost hands had vanished completely; the breathtaking scene just now seemed like an illusion.
In front of him, Xia Jie had already approached the Space Array.
He raised his hand to perform a gesture, and the bronze bell floating above the corpse's head slowly flew into his hand.
"This treasure is called the Soul-falling Bell, once wielded by the Purple Cloud Master. It was merely responding on its own just now, without anyone guiding it, hence its power is not apparent and does not harm your Divine Soul," Xia Jie turned and explained calmly.
Yuan Ming nodded, his gaze turning to the Formation, a look of confusion in his eyes: "This Formation is extraordinary, far surpassing the typical Seventh-level Array. Could Senior Xia Jie explain it to me?"
Xia Jie smiled slightly and said, "Actually, it's quite simple. The reason you can't understand it is because this Formation has already surpassed the Seventh Level."
"A Level 8 Array? Isn't that the same level as the Bright Moon Goddess's remnant? Who could have set it up?" Yuan Ming was taken aback, exclaiming in surprise.
Xia Jie pointed to the skeleton at the center of the array and said slowly, "It was naturally set up by the Purple Cloud Master himself."
Yuan Ming gazed at the skeleton, overwhelmed with an indescribable shock.
A moment later, he suddenly recalled something and asked, "Senior Xia Jie, is there any inheritance left behind here from the Purple Cloud Master?"
"I only found the secret skill to control this Level 8 Array; the rest of the inheritance is missing, possibly long scattered in the world," Xia Jie shook his head, regrettably.

Setting up this array was merely to exploit its ability to break the boundary of realms, hoping to open a passage to a higher plane and transcend the pinnacle of the Ghost Witch, reaching the Witch God Realm," Xia Jie pondered, speculating.

Seeing Xia Jie's determined expression, Yuan Ming's doubts eased a bit.
However, he was still uneasy. While Xia Jie was preparing to activate the Array, he secretly transmitted a message to Xi Ying, asking: "Is Xia Jie really reliable?"
"He should be a trustworthy person. I investigated him secretly and found no negative information. In the Chuyun Realm, he is highly respected, and several Mahayana also recognize him. According to the intelligence, he harbors no malicious thoughts; his actions are all for protecting the Chuyun Realm," Xi Ying replied via transmission.

If not for the floor of the grand hall beneath his feet, he might have thought he had already walked out of the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace.
And at the center of the Formation, with a change in Xia Jie's spell, those fragment-like runes clustered together, forming a colossal Light Pillar that shot straight to the firmament.
Then, Xia Jie vertically aligned one hand, twisted a spell, and a wooden box containing the soul bone flew out with a "pop," automatically opening. Under the gentle force, the soul bone slowly merged into the Light Pillar.
With a loud "boom," a fierce Soul Power aura erupted from the base of the Light Pillar.
This aura flowed upwards along the Light Pillar, rushing into the clouds, quickly penetrating the void and reaching the distant other side.
"Hmm?"
At the summit of Moon Viewing Cliff at the Bright Moon Palace, the Bright Moon Palace Master's eyes flickered with a hint of surprise.
She gazed at the laurel tree before her, observing the faint glow circulating on it, as if a hazy power was quietly flowing out, merging into the endless void.
Her brow furrowed slightly, and an inexplicable feeling rose in her heart.

At this moment, a faint glow shimmered on the Jade Coffin, with an invisible power continuously flowing out, following an unknown trajectory, rushing towards the outside world, and ultimately merging into the void.
The Bright Moon Palace Master stood afar, gazing at the woman inside the coffin, her expression solemn.
Her main body was stationed in the Returning Ruins, and what remained here was merely a Clone with limited Divine Skills.
Even so, she could still sense the power's immense strength and peculiarity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1072 - 1037: The Mastermind Behind the Scenes
chapters.content:
At the same time, in the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace.
After a brief wait, the Soul Power from the remnants of the Bright Moon Goddess descended from the sky, pouring down along the Light Pillar at the center of the Formation like a waterfall.
This Soul Power was extremely pure, without a trace of impurity, and its quality was so high that it could even be compared to the purest Moonlight Power.

The Soul Cultivator aura on them rapidly increased, and even Xia Jie, who had already reached the Peak of Life Witch, had the Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness grow once again, advancing to deeper levels.
Yuan Ming stood by to protect them. Although he was not actively absorbing the Soul Power, some of it still integrated into his body.
Under the influence of this Soul Power, his Sea of Consciousness became unprecedentedly clear, and the strength of his Divine Soul steadily increased.
Surprisingly, the Soul Power of the Bright Moon Goddess seemed fundamentally different from ordinary Soul Power.
Under the influence of this Soul Power, not only the three of them, but also the numerous Spiritual Treasures carried by Yuan Ming were affected, beginning to actively absorb this Soul Power, showing signs of increasing power.
Among them, the most striking was the Shura Palace.
If the speed at which other Spiritual Treasures absorbed the Soul Power could be described as a trickling stream, then the speed at which the Shura Palace devoured it could be likened to a flooding torrent.
The amount of Soul Power it absorbed was comparable to the combined efforts of Xi Ying and Xia Jie.
Fortunately, the Soul Power of the Bright Moon Goddess was endless, and the influx rate far exceeded expectations. Otherwise, the Shura Palace's absorption might have affected Xi Ying and Xia Jie.
Yuan Ming saw this and did not stop the Shura Palace from continuing to absorb the Soul Power.
As the Soul Power continuously surged in, the World Tree within the Shura Palace began to undergo astounding changes.
Previously, though Yuan Ming transplanted the World Tree into the Shura Palace and forcibly combined the two, there was always a subtle sense of repulsion between them that defied description.
However, now Yuan Ming could clearly feel that this sense of repulsion was dissolving at an astonishing rate.
The World Tree was gradually merging with the Shura Palace, and this fusion wasn't merely superficial with roots intertwining and branches filling in, but penetrated deeply into the essence of both.

Though originating from the same source, their growth trajectories were vastly different. This difference did not impede their fusion; instead, it made the process even quicker than anticipated.
In just a few breaths, they melded like milk and water, becoming indistinguishable from each other.
The fusion continued, and the World Tree at this moment seemed like a giant heart, pulsating within the Shura Palace.
Each heartbeat was accompanied by a slight tremor in the Shura Palace, as if the entire space was resonating with it.
Even more magically, with each pulse, a vast amount of nature's spiritual energy was drawn in, flowing like blood pumped by a heart, continuously infusing the Shura Palace with new vitality and power.
Nurtured by nature's spiritual energy, the power of the Shura Palace grew at an alarming speed, quickly closing the gap with the Three Realms Immortal Boat.
It seemed that it wouldn't be long before it could rival the Three Realms Immortal Boat, perhaps even surpass it.
Meanwhile, in the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace, the three continued to absorb the Soul Power of the Bright Moon Goddess, while in the Chuyun Realm, the Bright Moon Palace Master began to feel a tinge of unease.
She gazed at the steadily depleting Soul Power, a surge of indescribable doubt rising in her heart.
"Something's wrong. No matter how she borrows power, the Goddess couldn't possibly extract such a vast amount. According to the usual pattern, she should have long been eroded by this power and turned into nourishment." The Bright Moon Palace Master's face grew steadily solemn.
Thus, without hesitation, she formed a spell and sent her voice far away: "Immediately activate the Sect Protection Array, seal the space around the sect!"
Her voice echoed within the Bright Moon Palace, shaking the disciples with its thunder-like intensity.
The elder responsible for overseeing the Sect Protection Array also felt a pang of tension. Although unaware of the specific situation, they promptly followed the Bright Moon Palace Master's orders, activating the Sect Protection Array.
Moments later, a dazzling moon-white light curtain rose from the ground, completely enveloping the Bright Moon Palace.
This Great Array, like an indestructible barrier, completely isolated the inner and outer space, thoroughly locking down the entire void.
Within the range of this Formation, all space Magic would become ineffective, like a bird caged, unable to spread its wings.
The Sect Protection Array of the Bright Moon Palace, fortified and perfected over generations by the Great Mahayana Palace Masters, was considered top-tier even among seventh-level arrays.
However, upon deploying the array, the Bright Moon Palace Master's expression did not ease.
Because, in front of her, the Soul Power of the Bright Moon Goddess seemed completely unaffected by the Sect Protection Array, continuing to be drawn into the void like a continuous trickling stream.
Although the speed had decreased by less than ten percent, such a loss was still unbearable for the Bright Moon Palace.
"To be unaffected by my Bright Moon Palace's Sect Protection Array, and to have such deep understanding of the Bright Moon Goddess's corpse, who could the mastermind behind this be?" The Bright Moon Palace Master frowned, thoughts racing, but found no answers.
...
An hour later, within the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace, the soul power of the Bright Moon Goddess flowed like a gentle stream, quietly nourishing Yuan Ming and the two others.
Under this nourishment, Xi Ying's soul power had already touched the peak of the Life Witch realm, only a step away from the Ghost Witch realm.
Yet this step seemed like an abyss a thousand fathoms deep, and it was not easy to cross with just the enhancement of soul power.
Yuan Ming also benefited immensely, his soul power had unconsciously risen to the mid-stage of Life Witch, and the cultivation he once ignored was now steadily progressing.
Most astounding of all was the Shura Palace, which absorbed a massive amount of soul power.
Its power had long surpassed the Three Realms Immortal Boat, even exceeding it, whether in its ability to tear through interfaces or its own sturdiness, reaching unprecedented heights.
Crucially, the fusion of Yuan Ming's World Tree clone and the Shura Palace allowed his soul splitting to gradually transform into the Artifact Spirit of the Shura Palace as he enhanced.
Although this Artifact Spirit was not as nimble and intelligent as Xi Hezi and Void, it shared a connection with Yuan Ming's mind; just a thought was needed to control it freely, far surpassing ordinary Artifact Spirits.
The amount of soul power absorbed by the three was unimaginably vast.
Yet the soul power of the Bright Moon Goddess seemed endless, continuously flowing in, as if it would never cease.
Just as Yuan Ming and Xi Ying were immersed in the nourishment of this power, they gradually began to feel discomfort.
A strange tightening and pain emanated from their Sea of Consciousness, as if they had reached their limit.
At that moment, the surrounding atmosphere abruptly changed.
The sky above darkened in an instant, and a coldness emerged out of nowhere, causing Yuan Ming and Xi Ying to shiver involuntarily.
Suddenly, a deafening roar came from above, and they immediately felt their Qi-Blood surging, a chill coursing through their bodies, with a moody pressure in their hearts, and negative emotions surged like a tide.
Looking up, they saw a pale gray round moon appear out of thin air, and in just a moment, it transformed into an endless expanse of gray clouds, covering the sky above the three of them, with the sound of howling persistent in the air.
"It's the Yin Moon Soul Tribulation!" Xi Ying's eyes narrowed as he muttered in shock.
Clearly, this was a sign of Senior Xia Jie about to break through to the Ghost Witch realm.
Yuan Ming's expression tightened, immediately stopping the absorption of soul power, and withdrew together with Xi Ying.
Above the dark clouds, streaks of Yin Thunder flickered and danced. Though not blinding, they gave a heart-stopping feeling.
From deep within the clouds, dull and mournful booms echoed continuously, as though ancient bells were tolling.
The surrounding Yin Wind suddenly arose, biting and sharp, quickly covering the ground with a layer of light gray frost.
Under this windswept atmosphere, Xia Jie sat by the Great Array, the Qi-Blood on his body rapidly dissipating, his face pale as paper, almost like a corpse.
Just when everyone thought Xia Jie would be engulfed by this chill, his forehead suddenly shone brightly, and his Divine Soul leaped from his Sea of Consciousness.
With both palms clapped together, a powerful wave of soul power spread out, isolating the surrounding Yin Wind.
At this moment, the Yin Thunder within the cloud suddenly intensified, arcs of electricity fell from the sky, initially sparse and scattered, then in the blink of an eye, pouring down like a torrential rain.
At the same time, the Yin Wind grew even more violent, as if it intended to completely obliterate Xia Jie.
Amidst this stormy wind and thunder, clusters of Yin Fire also descended from the clouds.
With just a distant glance, Yuan Ming felt as if flames ignited within his Sea of Consciousness, spreading the pain of burning throughout his body.
Yet Xia Jie showed no fear.
Pointing his right hand at the sky, he gathered his soul power into a giant sword, slicing apart each falling bolt of Yin Thunder, while his left hand formed a barrier, keeping the Yin Wind at bay.

Simultaneously, all forms of tribulation, such as Yin Thunder and cold winds, vanished instantly, as if they had never appeared.
Under the moonlight, Xia Jie's Divine Soul rose slowly, iridescent lights unfurling across his soul body, gradually cohering into a Divine Wheel Light Ring, resembling an indestructible barrier, tightly encompassing his Divine Soul.
As Xia Jie's Divine Soul merged with that round moon, a surge of overwhelming energy swept outwards, causing the pale gray round moon to vanish without a trace.
Now, the sky held nothing but Xia Jie's Divine Soul, radiant as a second moon in the night sky, dazzlingly resplendent.

Moments later, Xia Jie's Divine Soul returned to his Physical Body, and Yuan Ming and Xi Ying flew swiftly over, respectfully saluting Xia Jie in unison.
"Congratulations, Senior, on advancing to the Ghost Witch Realm."

At the same time, Yuan Ming felt his own Soul Power continuously draining, and a wave of unfounded dread welled up inside him.
It was as if some unknown danger lurked around, watching him closely, seeking a flaw for a fatal strike.
Xi Ying seemed to sense the same pressure; Xia Jie observed this but said nothing, only dimming the light in his eyes slightly.
Instantly, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying felt the pressure reduce drastically, relaxing significantly.
Only then did Yuan Ming realize that the oppressive feeling was indeed the soul domain effect formed after Xia Jie's advancement to the Ghost Witch.
"The Bright Moon Goddess's power has not been completely exhausted. I need to continue absorbing it. But your strengths are still shallow, and your accumulation is insufficient; reaching this stage is your limit. Staying longer might risk losing control. You should wait outside the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace," Xia Jie said.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying did not argue, having just sensed their limits.

"There is never an absolute certainty in the world. I know the hope of success is slim, but as long as hope is not zero, it's worth a try. If I retreat now, I might regret it immensely later," Xia Jie shook his head gently, his eyes displaying determination and resolve.
"Senior, is there really a need to take such a risk? Even if one doesn't attempt it, preserving strength to fight the Demon Clan later is not without hope of victory. If failure occurs, not only is prior effort wasted, but everything might revert back to square one," Yuan Ming sighed, his eyes revealing worry.
"The worst result is merely maintaining the status quo. Besides, you and Xi Ying have improved your cultivation through this event; whether successful or not, it's not in vain. Once the war starts, lives will be lost; if I can provide Chuyun a slender chance with my power, it's a worthwhile trade," Xia Jie laughed heartily, waving a hand, sending Yuan Ming and Xi Ying out of the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace.

The outside sky instantly turned somber, with rolling Yin Qi seemingly crushing the purple light inside the mountain range.
The astonishing aura waves instantly spread throughout the Wentian Secret Realm, as if some terrifying force was awakening.
"This commotion… is too loud," Yuan Ming said in surprise.
"Senior Xia Jie has just advanced to Ghost Witch and is not yet familiar with controlling this power. Now fully absorbing the Bright Moon Goddess's power, he might already be struggling to control it," Xi Ying said with a serious expression, her concern evident.
"We can't leave things like this; it will certainly attract attention from others. If it's just people from other domains it's manageable, but if the Level 7 Demon Beast is drawn here, it will surely affect Senior. We cannot just leave," Yuan Ming said with furrowed brows.
"You're right, with our current strength, although we cannot repel them, we can at least delay for a while," Xi Ying nodded in agreement.

The aura it released was no longer limited to the purple mountains, but surged like waves, spreading into the endless distance.
The sky seemed shrouded by a heavy night curtain, with starlight and moonlight devoured, leaving only the purple glow flickering in the mountains like fireflies, adding a mysterious color to the dark world.
The rocks and trees, bathed in purple light, appeared dreamlike, as if placed in another dimension.
The tranquil atmosphere was suddenly broken, accompanied by several deafening blasts, as the Qingluan Three Demons rushed in like a storm.
Their gazes sharp, they immediately locked onto the location of the Purple Cloud Heavenly Palace. With a glance exchanged, without needing words, they launched a fierce assault in unison.
In an instant, the sky seemed ignited, a rain of fire pouring down, the wind howling angrily, sweeping everything away.
